en: to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for

ex.en: How could she abandon her own child?
ex.cn: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子？

vt. 遗弃；放弃：desert, yield, quit

en: a short form of a word or expression

ex.en: The abbreviation for Kansas is KS.

en: very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous

ex.en: abnormal behaviour
ex.cn: 反常行为

ex.en: an abnormal level of cholesterol
ex.cn: 胆固醇水平异常

syn: adj. 反常的，不规则的；变态的：unnatural, eccentric

ex.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
ex.cn: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

t: n&a. 土著(的)；土生动植物(的)

n. 土著居民；[动]土生生物：indigenous population

ex.en: The disease causes pregnant animals to abort.
ex.cn: 这种疾病会导致怀孕的动物流产。

syn: vi. 流产；堕胎；夭折；发育不全：miscarry, come to an untimely end
vt. 使流产；使中止：discontinue

en: a medical operation to end a  pregnancy  so that the baby is not born alive

ex.en: She decided to have an abortion .
ex.cn: 她决定做人工流产。

ex.en: anti-abortion campaigners
ex.cn: 参与反堕胎运动的人

ex.cn: 关于这类协调的谣传很多；但如同许多其他谣传一样，它们没有事实根据。

ex.cn: 最后，将结束的祷告告诉主：愿在你拥有信仰的时候希望的上帝用快乐与和平充满你的人生，让你在圣灵的力量下富于希望。

en: to reduce the length of (a written work) by condensing or rewriting

ex.cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

t: adj. 抽象的；n. (书籍、演说等的)摘要

ex.cn: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

ex.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
ex.cn: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

adj. 抽象的；深奥的：deep, nonobjective

ex.cn: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

ex.cn: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

ex.cn: 他没有学历。

ex.cn: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

n. 大学生，大学教师；学者：undergraduate, don, scholar, college student, university student

ex.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
ex.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

syn: vi. 加速；促进；增加：improve, increase speed
rm: ac(=to) + celer(快速的) + ate(使…) → 加速； 促进

en: the way you use to enter a building or reach a place

ex.en: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
ex.cn: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

syn: vt. 使用；[计]存取；接近：make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise
n. 进入；使用权；[电]通路：opening, admittance

en: something such as a piece of equipment or a decoration that is not necessary, but that makes a machine, car, room etc more useful or more attractive

ex.en: bathroom accessories such as mirrors and towel-rails
ex.cn: 镜子和毛巾架等浴室配件

syn: n. 配件；附件；[法]从犯：attachment, mating parts
adj. 副的；同谋的；[昆]附属的：deputy, vice, subsidiary, auxiliary
rm: ac(附近) + cess(走) + ory → 接近主体部件 → 附件， 零件

en: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe

ex.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
ex.cn: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

ex.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.
ex.cn: 你得给轮胎充气了。

ph.cn: 在空中；悬而未决；在流传中；不设防

vt. 使通风，晾干；夸耀：sport, ventilate

en: an occasion when an opinion, idea etc is discussed

ex.en: give them an airing.
ex.cn: 把室内盆栽植物搬出去透透气。

ph.cn: 在空中；悬而未决；在流传中；不设防

syn: n. 通风；晾干；（开车）兜风：perflation, aeration

syn: n. [建]通道，走道；侧廊：door, exit, channel, route, walkway

t: n. 警报，惊慌；v. 使忧虑
en: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger

ex.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
ex.cn: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

ex.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
ex.cn: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

en: a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in

ex.en: a photograph album
ex.cn: 相册

t: n&a. 外侨；外国人的；不相容的

n. 外国人，外侨；外星人：foreigner, uitlander

ex.cn: 最新的纳税提案将失去远许多选民的支持。

ex.en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
ex.cn: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

ex.en: a strange woman, dressed all in black
ex.cn: 一袭黑衣的奇怪女子

adv. 全然地；越发：utterly, sheerly

ex.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
ex.cn: 质量的差异显而易见。

ex.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
ex.cn: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

en: an urgent request for something important

ex.cn: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

en: a desire for food

ex.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
ex.cn: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

ex.cn: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

ex.cn: 观众掌声雷动。

ex.cn: 300名支持者为她的演讲热烈鼓掌。

ex.en: This provides some of the advantages of an appliance but with the flexibility to distribute as software only, along with the ability to consolidate multiple appliances on the same physical hardware.
ex.cn: 这种组合提供了设备的一些好处，同时又具有仅作为软件分发的灵活性，而且还能够将多个设备合并到相同的物理硬件上。

en: someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc

ex.cn: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

en: a statement or opinion judging the worth, value, or condition of something

ex.cn: 病人的状况没有明显改变。

ex.cn: 他的徒弟老是乱放工具。

ex.cn: 我走近那幢房子的时候注意到楼上有灯光。

ex.en: She heard footsteps approaching.
ex.cn: 她听到有脚步声走过来。

en: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose

学术能力倾向；学术才能

ex.cn: 妩媚动人的年轻女子

en: an accident in which two or more people or vehicles hit each other while moving in different directions

ex.en: Two people were killed in a head-on collision (= between two vehicles that are moving directly towards each other ) on highway 218.
ex.cn: 218号公路上有两辆汽车迎面相撞，两人死亡。

syn: n. [物]碰撞；冲突：interference, conflict, war, crash, impact
rm: 来自collide(vi. 冲撞)

en: when someone obeys a rule, agreement, or demand

ex.en: Inspectors were sent to visit nuclear sites and verify compliance with the treaty.
ex.cn: 监察员被派去参观核址并核实条约的遵守情况。

syn: n. 顺从，服从；承诺：commitment, obedience

t: adj. 结构复杂的；困难的
en: consisting of many closely connected parts

ex.en: a complicated pattern
ex.cn: 复杂的图案

ex.en: The human brain is an incredibly complicated organ.
ex.cn: 人脑是一个结构极其复杂的器官。

syn: adj. 难懂的，复杂的：involved, detailed, sophisticated, elusive
rm: com(共同) + plic(重叠) + ated → 重叠在一起的 → 复杂的

ex.en: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
ex.cn: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

syn: n. 并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱：chaos, confusion, disorder, involvement, mix

t: n. 敬意，赞扬；问候；v. 恭维；称赞
en: used by a person or company when they send or give something to you

ex.en: With the compliments of J. Smith & Son. J.
ex.cn: 史密斯父子公司敬赠。

ex.en: Please accept these tickets with our compliments.
ex.cn: 赠票若干，敬请笑纳。

ph.cn: 言不由衷(或挖苦人)的恭维话

syn: n. 恭维；称赞；问候；致意；道贺：praise, regard
vt. 恭维；称赞：speak well of, pay a tribute to
rm: com(共同) + pli(满， 填满) + ment(名词后缀) → 一起满足某人的愿望 → 赞美

en: to do what you have to do or are asked to do

ex.en: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
ex.cn: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

syn: vi. 遵守；顺从，遵从；答应：engage, abide by/obey/observe
rm: com(表加强) + ply(装满) → 完全装满 → 完全满足 → 遵从； 服从

en: one of several parts that together make up a whole machine, system etc

ex.en: companies that make electronic components for computer products
ex.cn: 为计算机产品生产电子零件的公司

ph.cn: 分量分析；[化]组分分析；组成成分分析

syn: adj. [天]组成的，构成的：constituent
n. 成分；组件；[电子]元件：module, element, constituent
rm: com(共同) + pon(放) + ent → 放到一起(的东西) → 成分

t: v. 组成，构成；创作；排字；使安静
en: to write a piece of music

ex.en: Barrington has composed the music for a new production of ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’.
ex.cn: 巴林顿为新版的《仲夏夜之梦》谱了曲。

syn: vt. 构成；写作；使平静；排…的版：constitute, form, structure, calm
vi. 组成；作曲；排字：write, consist, make up
rm: com(共同) + pos(放) + e → 放到一起 → 组成， 构成

en: made up of different parts or materials

ex.en: The author builds up a useful compo-site picture of contemporary consumer culture.
ex.cn: 作者勾勒出了一幅实用的当代消费文化全景图。

ex.en: composite metals
ex.cn: 复合金属

ph.cn: 组合结构；复合机构；混合结构
复合指标；财经综合指数

syn: n. 复合材料；合成物；菊科：synthetic, complex material
adj. [数][植]复合的；合成的；菊科的：synthetic, mulriple

t: n&a. 混合物(的)，复合词(的)；院子(的)
en: a substance containing atoms from two or more  elements

ex.en: man-made organic compounds
ex.cn: 人造有机化合物

syn: vt. 合成；混合；和解妥协；搀合：synthetise, mix together
vi. 和解；妥协：make it up, make peace with someone
rm: com(一起) + pound(放置) → 放到一起使合成 → 化合物

en: to press something or make it smaller so that it takes up less space, or to become smaller

ex.en: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
ex.cn: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

ex.en: Isobel nodded, her lips compressed.
ex.cn: 伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

syn: vt. 压缩，压紧；精简：impact, pack
rm: com(表加强) + press(压) → 使劲压 → 压紧； 压缩

syn: vt. 包含；由…组成：involve, contain
rm: com(共同) + pris(抓住) + e → 共同抓住 → 包含

t: n. 妥协，折衷；v. 妥协；使遭受危害
en: an agreement that is achieved after everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first, or the act of making this agreement

ex.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of marriage.
ex.cn: 妥协是婚姻生活中必不可少的。

ex.en: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
ex.cn: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

syn: vt. 妥协；危害：harm, meet someone halfway
vi. 妥协；让步：meet someone halfway, come to terms with
rm: com + promise(保证) → 相互保证 → 妥协

en: something that is compulsory must be done because it is the law or because someone in authority orders you to

ex.en: the threat of compulsory redundancies
ex.cn: 强制性裁员的威胁

ex.en: Car insurance is compulsory.
ex.cn: 汽车保险是强制性的。

syn: adj. 义务的；必修的；被强制的：required, obligatory
n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作：required routine
rm: com(共同) + puls(推) + ory → 共同推进的 → 义务的； 必修的

en: to calculate a result, answer, sum etc

ex.en: Final results had not yet been computed.
ex.cn: 最终的结果还未计算出来。

ph.cn: 不可计量，无法计算；难以估计

syn: vt. [数]计算；估算；用计算机计算：cast, figure
vi. [数]计算；估算；推断：figure, cast

en: to hide something carefully

ex.en: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
ex.cn: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

ex.en: The path was concealed by long grass.
ex.cn: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

syn: vt. 隐藏；隐瞒：lock, pocket, to hide
rm: con + ceal(看作seal， 密封) → 密封起来 → 隐藏； 隐瞒； 掩盖

en: to admit that something is true or correct, although you wish it were not true

ex.en: ‘That’s the only possible solution.’ ‘Yes, I suppose so,’ Charles conceded.
ex.cn: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

syn: vt. 承认；退让；给予，容许：afford, accept, agree, recognize, extend
vi. 让步：meet halfway, give ground
rm: con(带着) + ced(走) + e → 带着某物走 → 让步

en: to think of a new idea, plan etc and develop it in your mind

ex.en: Scientists first conceived the idea of the atomic bomb in the 1930’s.
ex.cn: 在20世纪30年代，科学家第一次有了原子弹的设想。

syn: vt. 怀孕；构思；以为；持有：design, hold
vi. 怀孕；设想；考虑：allow, think of, think about
rm: con(共同) + ceiv(抓住) → 怀有一种想法 → 想出

t: v. 集中，全神贯注于；浓缩；n. 浓缩物
en: to think very carefully about something that you are doing

ex.en: Now please concentrate.
ex.cn: 现在请集中注意力。

ex.en: Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate.
ex.cn: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

ph.cn: 集中精力于；全神贯注于

syn: vi. 集中；[物]浓缩；全神贯注；聚集：focus, collect, mass, crowd
vt. 集中；[物]浓缩：centre, localise
rm: con(共同) + centr(中心) + ate → 置于同一个中心 → 集中， 聚集

t: n. 概念的形成，概念，想法；怀孕
en: an idea about what something is like, or a general understanding of something

ex.en: the original conception of the book
ex.cn: 此书最初的构想

syn: n. [妇产]怀孕；概念；设想；开始：idea, threshold, pregnancy, beginning, opening

t: "n. 所关切的事；企业；关心v影响,涉及,关心；n. "
en: a feeling of wanting someone to be happy and healthy

ex.en: He was moved by her obvious concern.
ex.cn: 她明显的关心使他感动。

ph.cn: ◎从事,忙于(常与with, about, in, over连用)
对…表示担心/忧虑；使（自己）关心…

syn: vt. 涉及，关系到；使担心：deal with, to relate to
n. 关系；关心；关心的事：relationship, connection, attention, consideration, bearing
rm: con(表加强) + cern(观察) → 关心； 关注

en: a concerted effort etc is done by people working together in a carefully planned and very determined way

ex.en: Libraries have made a concerted effort to attract young people.
ex.cn: 各图书馆同心协力吸引年轻人。

syn: adj. 协调的；协定的；商议定的：harmonious, coordinated
rm: 那个得了癌症(cancer)的音乐家举行了最后一次个人音乐会(concert)

t: v. 仔细考虑；注视；打算；预计
en: to think about something that you might do in the future

ex.en: He had even contemplated suicide.
ex.cn: 他甚至想过自杀。

syn: vt. 沉思；注视；思忖；预期：watch, behold
vi. 冥思苦想；深思熟虑：puzzle
rm: con + templ(看作temple， 庙) + ate → 庙里的和尚常常打坐→ 思量， 沉思

t: adj. 同时代的，当代的；n. 同龄人，同时代的人
en: belonging to the present time

ex.en: She writes a lot of contemporary music for people like Whitney Houston.
ex.cn: 她为惠特尼·休斯敦等人创作大量当代音乐作品。

syn: n. 同时代的人；同时期的东西：coeval
adj. 当代的；同时代的；属于同一时期的：modern-day, cotemporary
rm: con(共同) + tempor(时间) + ary → 同时代的

en: a feeling that someone or something is not important and deserves no respect

ex.en: The public is treated with contempt by broadcasters.
ex.cn: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

ex.en: How could she have loved a man who so clearly held her in contempt ?
ex.cn: 她怎么会爱上一个明显看不起她的男人呢？

ph.cn: 蔑视法庭；对法院的藐视罪
不顾；不把…放在眼里；藐视

syn: n. 轻视，蔑视；耻辱：despite, defiance
rm: con(共同) + tempt(尝试) → 小意思！大家都能试 → 轻视

en: to compete against someone in order to gain something

ex.en: Inevitably, fights break out between the members of contending groups.
ex.cn: 争权夺利的几个团体之间不可避免地发生了打斗。

syn: vi. 竞争；奋斗；斗争；争论：fight, debate, cope
vt. 主张；为...斗争：maintain, submit, advocate

t: n&a&vt. 满意(的)，满足(的)；使满意(足)

ex.en: Empty the contents of the pan into the sieve.
ex.cn: 将平锅里的东西全部倒入漏勺。

syn: n. 内容，目录；满足；[物]容量：satisfaction, directory, bulk, list, fill
adj. 满意的：satisfactory, well-pleasing
rm: con(全部) + tent(拥有) → 全部都拥有 → 满意的

en: argument and disagreement between people

ex.en: His case has become a source of contention between civil liberties activists and the government.
ex.cn: 他的案子已变成了公民自由活动家们和政府之间的争论缘由。

ph.cn: 争论的焦点；争端的原因

syn: n. 争论，争辩；争夺；论点：thesis, combat

t: v. 争论，争义，斗争；n. 争夺，竞争；比赛
en: a competition or a situation in which two or more people or groups are competing with each other

ex.en: His wife is contesting a seat on the council.
ex.cn: 他妻子在角逐市政会的一个席位。

syn: vt. 争辩；提出质疑：argue against, chop logic
vi. 竞争；争辩：cope, rival

t: n. 上下文，(事情)来龙去脉
en: the words that come just before and after a word or sentence and that help you understand its meaning

ex.en: The meaning of ‘mad’ depends on its context. mad
ex.cn: 一词的意义要视上下文而定。

ph.cn: 关于这点；由此而论；由于这个原因；在这个背景下

syn: n. 环境；[计]上下文；来龙去脉：circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
rm: con(共同) + text(编织) → 共同编织在一起 → 上下文

ex.en: a contingency plan
ex.cn: 应变计划

ph.cn: 应急计划，意外事件计划

syn: n. 偶然性；[安全]意外事故；可能性；[审计]意外开支：possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, chance
rm: con + ting(触摸) + ency → 触摸引起的 → 可能性

en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions

ex.en: ...a tank designed to ensure continuity of fuel supply during aerobatics.
ex.cn: …为特技飞行中确保持续供油而设计的油箱。

ph.cn: 业务连续性；企业永续经营

syn: n. [数]连续性；一连串；[电影]分镜头剧本：series of, seriality
rm: continu(=continue连续) + ity → 连续(性)

t: n. 合同，契约；v. 缔结；负债；感染；使皱缩
en: an official agreement between two or more people, stating what each will do

ex.en: Employees who refuse to relocate are in breach of contract (= have done something not allowed by their contracts ) .
ex.cn: 员工拒绝调动岗位是违反合约的。

syn: vi. 收缩；感染；订约：communicate, shrink
vt. 感染；订约；使缩短：affect, catch, communicate
rm: con(共同) + tract(拉， 拽) → 将双方拉到一起 → 契约， 合同

en: to disagree with something, especially by saying that the opposite is true

ex.en: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
ex.cn: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

ex.en: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
ex.cn: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

syn: vt. 反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触：negative, deny
vi. 反驳；否认；发生矛盾：deny, talk back
rm: contra(反) + dict(说话； 断言) → 说反话 → 反驳

en: a difference between two statements, beliefs, or ideas about something that means they cannot both be true

ex.en: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
ex.cn: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

syn: n. [数]矛盾；否认；反驳：conflict, discrepancy
rm: contra(反) + dict(说话； 断言) + ion → 反着说 → 否认， 反驳

t: v. 使对比，形成对照；n. 明显的差别
en: if two things contrast, the difference between them is very easy to see and is sometimes surprising

ex.en: an essay comparing and contrasting (= showing how two things are similar and different ) Verdi and Wagner and their operas
ex.cn: 把威尔第和瓦格纳以及他们的歌剧进行比较和对照的一篇文章

syn: n. 对比；差别；对照物：parallel, distinction, differential
rm: contra(反) + st(=stand站立) → 反着站 → 对比； 对照

en: to help to make something happen

ex.en: Stress is a contributing factor in many illnesses.
ex.cn: 压力是许多疾病的致病因素。

syn: vt. 贡献，出力；[图情]投稿；[经]捐献：make contribution, offer up
vt. 贡献，出力；[图情]投稿；[经]捐献：make contribution, offer up
rm: con(全部) + tribut(给予) + e → 无偿给予 → 捐赠， 捐助

en: something that you give or do in order to help something be successful

ex.en: a campaign contribution
ex.cn: 竞选捐款

ph.cn: 捐赠，贡献给；为…做出贡献

syn: n. 贡献；捐献；投稿：subscription, contributing to

t: v. 发明; 设计; 设法；造成
en: to succeed in doing something in spite of difficulties

ex.en: In 1862, a technique was contrived to take a series of photographs showing stages of movement.
ex.cn: 1862年时发明了一种技术，可以拍出一连串展示连续动作的照片。

syn: vt. 设计；发明；图谋：design, engineer, style, project, frame
vi. 谋划；设法做到：to see that
rm: contri(看作contra， 反) + ve(=vene走) → (和普通人不同)反着走 → 设计， 发明

en: a serious argument about something that involves many people and continues for a long time

ex.en: a political controversy
ex.cn: 政治争议

ex.en: the controversy surrounding Skinner’s theories
ex.cn: 围绕斯金纳的理论的争议

syn: n. 争论；论战；辩论：combat, debate, dispute
rm: contro(反) + vers(转) + y → 因反对而转向另一方 → 争论， 辩论

en: causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed

ex.en: the controversial issue of welfare reform
ex.cn: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

ex.en: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
ex.cn: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

syn: adj. 有争议的；有争论的：disputed, questioned
rm: contro(反) + vers(转) + ial → 反着转 → 争论的

en: if a group of people convene, or someone convenes them, they come together, especially for a formal meeting

ex.en: a report by experts convened by the National Institutes of Health
ex.cn: 由全国健康协会召集的专家提出的一份报告

syn: vt. 召集，集合；传唤：call together, assemble
vi. 聚集，集合：concentrate, collect, mass, crowd, aggregate

en: the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time

ex.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
ex.cn: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

syn: n. 便利；厕所；便利的事物：john, bathroom, toilet
rm: con(共同) + ven(来) + ience → 共同行动来维护便民设施 → 便利设施

en: bent, twisted, or not in a straight line

ex.en: Your tie’s crooked.
ex.cn: 你的领带歪了。

ex.en: narrow crooked streets
ex.cn: 狭窄曲折的街道

syn: adj. 弯曲的；歪的；不正当的：curve, winding, flexural

en: to lower your body close to the ground by bending your knees completely

ex.en: He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
ex.cn: 他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。

ex.en: Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
ex.cn: 葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

syn: vi. 蹲伏，蜷伏；卑躬屈膝：stay down, grovel
vt. 低头；屈膝：head drop, drop on one's knees

t: n. 王冠，王权；顶部；v. 为加冕；褒奖
en: the top part of a hat or someone’s head

ex.en: a hat with a high crown
ex.cn: 高顶帽

ph.cn: 更妙的是；更糟糕的是；尤其是

syn: n. [纸]王冠；花冠；王权；顶点：height, sky, summit, peak, lei
vt. 加冕；居…之顶；表彰；使圆满完成：coronate, cite
rm: crow(乌鸦) + n → 给乌鸦戴王冠 → 王冠

t: adj. 决定性的；紧要关头的
en: something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it

ex.en: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
ex.cn: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

syn: adj. 重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的：important, considerable, material, critical, big
rm: cruc(十字形， 交叉) + ial(形容词后缀) → 十字路口 → 决定性的， 至关重要的

t: adj. 天然的，粗鲁的，粗制的
en: not exact or without any detail, but generally correct and useful

ex.en: a crude estimate of the population available for work
ex.cn: 对劳动力人口的粗略估计

syn: adj. 粗糙的；天然的，未加工的；粗鲁的：rough, native, robust, raw, coarse
rm: c ＋ rud(天然的) + e → 天然的

t: v. 巡航；以节省燃料的速度前进；n. 乘船巡游
en: to move at a steady speed in a car, aircraft etc

ex.en: We were cruising along at 50 miles per hour.
ex.cn: 我们以每小时50英里的速度平稳行驶。

ex.en: We fly at a cruising speed of 500 mph.
ex.cn: 我们以每小时500英里的巡航速度平稳飞行。

ex.en: Their ideas diffused quickly across Europe.
ex.cn: 他们的观点很快在欧洲传播开来。

ph.cn: 漫反射率；漫反射系数；护散反射率

syn: adj. 弥漫的；[植][物]散开的：divergent
vt. [物]扩散；传播；漫射：transmit, spread abroad
rm: dif(分开) + fus(倾泻) + e → 分开倾泻 → 散布； 漫射； 扩散

en: a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with  share s  in the company

ex.en: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 percent.
ex.cn: 第一季度的股息增加了近4％。

syn: n. 股息；[数]被除数；奖金：bonus, stake

t: adj. 神的，极好的；v. 占卜
en: coming from or relating to God or a god

ex.en: divine power
ex.cn: 神的力量

ex.en: divine love
ex.cn: 上帝的慈爱

ph.cn: n. 神曲（意大利诗人但丁作的叙事诗）

syn: adj. 神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的：remarkable, extraordinary, wonderful, excellent, famous
vt. 占卜；预言；用占卜勘探：predict, prognosticate

t: adj. 使人头晕的，眩晕的
en: feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill

ex.en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
ex.cn: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

ex.en: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (= a short period when you feel dizzy ) .
ex.cn: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

syn: adj. 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的：swimming, foolish, stupid
vt. 使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然：cloud, confuse
rm: di(二) + zz(打鼾声) + y → 室友打鼾， 吵得睡不着 → 眩晕的

t: n. 船坞；码头；刑事被告席；v. 引入船坞
en: a place in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded, or repaired

ex.en: A crowd was waiting at the dock to greet them.
ex.cn: 一群人在码头等着迎接他们。

ph.cn: n. 码头；灌油码头；装货码头

syn: n. [水运]码头；[船]船坞；被告席；尾巴的骨肉部分：landing, pier
vt. 使靠码头；剪短：crop, bob

en: a set of beliefs that form an important part of a religion or system of ideas

ex.en: traditional doctrines of divine power
ex.cn: 神力的传统教义

ex.en: Marxist doctrine
ex.cn: 马克思主义学说

ph.cn: 门罗主义；类似门罗主义的策略

syn: n. 主义；学说；教义；信条：principle, theory, belief, teaching

en: to move quickly to avoid someone or something

ex.en: He ran across the courtyard, dodging a storm of bullets.
ex.cn: 他跑过院子，躲避雨点般的子弹。

syn: n. 躲闪；托词：subterfuge
vi. 躲避，避开：escape, stay away from
n. [劳经]失业救济金；赈济物；施舍品：unemployment benefit, unemployment pension

en: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with

ex.en: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
ex.cn: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

syn: n. 领域；域名；产业；地产：province, territory, world, industry, kingdom, universe, field

en: a round roof on a building

ex.en: ...the dome of the Capitol.
ex.cn: …国会大厦的穹顶。

ph.cn: 穹状构造；穹隆构造；穹窿构造

syn: n. [建]圆屋顶：cupola
rm: 和home(n. 家)一起记

t: adj. 家的，家庭的，本国的；n. 佣人
en: relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries

ex.en: Unfortunately his domestic life wasn’t very happy.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，他的家庭生活并不幸福。

ph.cn: 国内需求；本地内部需求

syn: adj. 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的：internal, household, home, family
n. 国货；佣人：servant
rm: dom(家) ＋ estic → 家庭的

en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things

ex.en: ...a change which would maintain his party's dominant position in Scotland.
ex.cn: …巩固他的政党在苏格兰支配地位的一场变革。

syn: adj. 显性的；[生物]占优势的；[数]支配的，统治的：ruling, predominant
rm: domin(统治) + ant → 统治的

t: v. 统治，支配，俯瞰，俯视
en: to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things

ex.en: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
ex.cn: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

ex.en: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
ex.cn: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

syn: vt. 控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位：possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle
vi. 占优势；处于支配地位：advantage over, prevail over
rm: domin(统治) + ate → 支配， 统治

en: something, especially money, that you give to a person or an organ-ization in order to help them

ex.en: There have been generous donations from EU funds.
ex.cn: 欧盟基金给予了慷慨的捐款。

syn: n. 捐款，[经]捐赠物；捐赠：endowment, offertory
rm: don(给予) + ation → 免费给予 → 捐赠

t: n. 毁灭，死亡；v. 注定，判定
en: to make someone or something certain to fail, die, be destroyed etc

ex.en: The plan was doomed from the start .
ex.cn: 这个计划一开始就注定要失败。

syn: n. 厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日：death, sentence, end, award
vt. 注定；判决；使失败：fate, determine

en: not active or not growing at the present time but able to be active later

ex.en: a huge dormant volcano
ex.cn: 一座巨大的休眠火山

ph.cn: 休眠火山；睡火山，休火山

syn: adj. 休眠的；静止的；睡眠状态的；隐匿的：still, resting

t: n. (药)一剂，一服；v. 给服药
en: the amount of a medicine or a drug that you should take

ex.en: I quite like Jamie in small doses (= in limited amounts but not a lot or often ) .
ex.cn: 如果偶尔在一起的话，我还是蛮喜欢杰米的。

syn: n. [药][核]剂量；一剂，一服：dosage, potion
vi. 服药：take medicine
rm: 玫瑰(rose)对生气中的女孩是一剂(dose)良药

t: n. 小点，小圆点；v. 加上小点，散布于，点缀
en: a small round mark or spot

ex.en: a pattern of dots
ex.cn: 圆点图案

syn: n. [数]点，圆点；嫁妆：dowry, tocher
rm: 和pot(n. 壶)一起记； pot(壶)上有许多可爱的dot(小圆点)

en: not sure that something is true or right

ex.en: ‘Everything’s going to be all right, you’ll see.’ Jenny looked doubtful .
ex.cn: “一切都会顺顺当当的，你等着看好了。” 珍妮看起来不大相信的样子。

syn: adj. 可疑的；令人生疑的；疑心的；不能确定的：suspicious, questionable

en: used when saying that something is almost certain to happen or be true

ex.en: Doubtless there would be lots of rumours.
ex.cn: 无疑会谣言四起。

syn: adv. 无疑地；确定地；大概，多半：easily, no doubt, probably, clearly, possibly
adj. 无疑的；确定的：established, fixed, defined, certain, positive

en: a machine that takes people and goods from one level to another in a building

ex.en: We’ll have to take the elevator.
ex.cn: 我们只好坐电梯了。

ph.cn: 斗式提升机；斗式运输机
液压升降机；液压卷杨机；水力提升机

syn: n. 电梯；[机]升降机；升降舵；起卸机：lift, moving staircase

en: to succeed in getting information or a reaction from someone, especially when this is difficult

ex.en: When her knock elicited no response, she opened the door and peeped in.
ex.cn: 敲门没有回应，她便推开门往里张望。

syn: vt. 抽出，引出；引起：premise, attract, produce, cause, operate

en: someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age

ex.en: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
ex.cn: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

syn: adj. 合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的：qualified, applicable, becoming, shaped, likely
n. 合格者；适任者；有资格者：acceptee
rm: e + lig(=lect选择) + ible → 能被选择出来的 → 符合条件的

en: to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted

ex.en: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
ex.cn: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者

syn: vt. 消除；排除：avoid, exclude
rm: e(出) + limin(界限) + ate → 划在界限之外 → 消灭， 消除

t: n&a. 社会精华(的)，高贵者(的)
en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite

ex.en: ...a government comprised mainly of the elite.
ex.cn: …主要由精英组成的政府。

syn: n. 精英；精华；中坚分子：essence, flower, regular, prime, distillation
rm: e + lite(看作词根 lig， 选择) → 选出来的都是精英 → 精英

en: able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people

ex.en: an eloquent appeal for support
ex.cn: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

syn: adj. 意味深长的；雄辩的，有口才的；有说服力的；动人的：meaningful, affecting, significant, moving, speaking

en: in, at, or to another place

ex.en: She is becoming famous in Australia and elsewhere.
ex.cn: 她在澳大利亚和其他地方渐渐出名了。

ex.en: Kerala has less crime and alcoholism than elsewhere in India.
ex.cn: 喀拉拉邦的犯罪和酗酒现象少于印度的其他地区。

syn: adv. 在别处；到别处：otherwhere

en: an official order to stop trade with another country

ex.en: Several countries embargoed arms shipments to Yugoslavia.
ex.cn: 好几个国家对南斯拉夫实行武器禁运。

syn: n. 禁令；禁止；封港令：ban, prohibition

en: to go onto a ship or a plane, or to put or take something onto a ship or plane

ex.en: He's embarking on a new career as a writer.
ex.cn: 他正开始一个当作家的新生涯。

syn: vi. 从事，着手；上船或飞机：wage, occupy in
vt. 使从事；使上船：imbark

en: to make someone feel ashamed, nervous, or uncomfortable, especially in front of other people

ex.en: He didn’t want to embarrass her by asking questions.
ex.cn: 他不想提问让她尴尬。

syn: vt. 使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍：slow, abash

en: a group of officials who represent their government in a foreign country, or the building they work in

ex.en: the American Embassy in Paris
ex.cn: 美国驻巴黎大使馆

syn: n. 大使馆；大使馆全体人员：ambassade, chancellery

t: v. 把嵌入，使扎根于社会，使深留脑中
en: to put something firmly and deeply into something else, or to be put into something in this way

ex.en: Feelings of guilt are deeply embedded in her personality.
ex.cn: 负罪感在她的性格里根深蒂固。

ph.cn: 嵌入水印；嵌入水印滤镜

syn: vt. 栽种；使嵌入，使插入；使深留脑中：rear, bed
rm: em(进入…中) + bed(床) → 把…放入床中 → 把…嵌入

en: to be a very good example of an idea or quality

ex.en: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
ex.cn: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

syn: vt. 体现，使具体化；具体表达：objectify, reify
rm: em(给予) + body(身体) → 给予身体 → 使具体化

en: to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way

ex.en: Jack warmly embraced his son.
ex.cn: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

ex.en: Maggie and Laura embraced.
ex.cn: 玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

syn: vt. 拥抱；信奉，皈依；包含：involve, contain
vi. 拥抱：hug, cuddle
rm: em(使…) + brac(胳膊) + e → 使在胳膊里 → 拥抱

en: to appear or come out from somewhere

ex.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
ex.cn: 花儿在春天开放。

syn: vi. 浮现；摆脱；暴露：ray, cast off
rm: e(出) + merg(浸没) + e → 从浸没物之中出来 → 显露

t: n. 紧急情况，突发事件
en: an unexpected and dangerous situation that must be dealt with immediately

ex.en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
ex.cn: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

ex.en: (= In case of emergency ), press the alarm button.
ex.cn: 遇到紧急情况，请按报警按钮。

syn: n. 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻：critical situation, bombshell
adj. 紧急的；备用的：urgent, instant
rm: emerge(出现) ＋ (e)ncy → 突然出现 → 紧急情况， 突发事件

en: to leave your own country in order to live in another country

ex.en: He emigrated to Belgium.
ex.cn: 他移民去了比利时。

syn: vi. 移居；移居外国：transmigrate
vt. 移民：to immigrate, to migrate

en: an eminent person is famous, important, and respected

ex.en: an eminent lawyer
ex.cn: 杰出的律师

ph.cn: [律]土地征用权；国家最高支配权

syn: adj. 杰出的；有名的；明显的：outstanding, excellent, obvious, prominent, brilliant
rm: e(出) + min(突出) + ent → 杰出的， 显赫的

en: to send out gas, heat, light, sound etc

ex.en: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
ex.cn: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

syn: vt. 发出，放射；发行；发表：deliver, ray
rm: e(出) + mit(送) → 发出， 散发

en: a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger

ex.en: Her voice was full of emotion.
ex.cn: 她的声音充满了激情。

ex.en: She was good at hiding her emotions.
ex.cn: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

syn: n. [心理]情感；情绪：mood, will, spirit, affect, feeling
rm: e(出) + mot(动) + ion(名词后缀) → 心里释放出的东西 → 感情； 情绪

en: to say something in a strong way

ex.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
ex.cn: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

ex.en: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
ex.cn: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

syn: vt. 强调，着重：stress, highlight

en: based on scientific testing or practical experience, not on ideas

ex.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}
ex.cn: 实验证据

ph.cn: 经验研究，实证研究；实征性研究

en: the act of paying someone to work for you

ex.en: She was offered employment in the sales office.
ex.cn: 她获聘在销售部工作。

ph.cn: 就业率；雇用率；人力资源新进率

syn: n. 使用；职业；[劳经]雇用：usage, utilization, profession, career, use, pursuit

en: a short piece of writing giving someone’s ideas about politics, society etc

ex.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
ex.cn: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

syn: n. 散文；试图；随笔：attempt, prose
vt. 尝试；对…做试验：sample, have a try

en: the most basic and important quality of something

ex.en: In essence his message was very simple.
ex.cn: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

syn: n. 本质，实质；精华；[化工]香精：substance, truth, principle, entity, texture
rm: ess(存在) + ence → 存在即是本质 → 本质

ex.en: She packed a few essentials.
ex.cn: 她把几件生活必需品装进箱子。

ph.cn: 原发性高血压；特发性高血压

syn: adj. 基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的：elementary, fundamental, basic, necessary, primary
n. 本质；要素；要点；必需品：element, principle, entity, necessity, requirement, texture
rm: ess(存在) + ential → 存在的东西 → 要素； 实质， 本质

t: v. 建立，委任；安置；证实；确立
en: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time

ex.en: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
ex.cn: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

ex.en: Our goal is to establish a new research centre in the North.
ex.cn: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

syn: vt. 建立；创办；安置：build, found, constitute, put, station
rm: e(出) + st(站立) + abl(能…的) + ish(使…) → 使能够站立出来 → 建立； 确立

en: law all of someone’s property and money, especially everything that is left after they die

ex.en: His estate was valued at $150,000.
ex.cn: 他的遗产价值为15万美元。

ph.cn: 房地产市场；不动产市场

syn: n. 房地产；[经]财产；身份：identity, property, treasure, possession, worth

en: a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone

ex.en: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
ex.cn: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

syn: vt. 尊敬；认为；考虑；估价：assess, honor, expect, evaluate, guess
n. 尊重；尊敬：estimation, respect, regard, worship
rm: e(音似： 一) + stee(看作steel, 钢铁) + m(看作man, 人) → 一个有钢铁般意志的人值得尊敬 → 尊重； 尊敬

t: n. n.；n. 估计，估价；v. 评价，估量
en: a calculation of the value, size, amount etc of something made using the information that you have, which may not be complete

ex.en: We just need an estimate of the number of people who will come.
ex.cn: 我们只需估算一下有多少人会来。

ex.en: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
ex.cn: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

syn: vi. 估计，估价：evaluate, guess at
n. 估计，估价；判断，看法：computation, appraisal, calculation, assessment, judgment, evaluation, viewpoint
rm: 评估(estimate)地产(estate)

t: adj. 永久的，不朽的，不停的
en: continuing for ever and having no end

ex.en: the Christian promise of eternal life
ex.cn: 基督教承诺的永生

ex.en: She’s an eternal optimist (= she always expects that good things will happen ).
ex.cn: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

syn: adj. 永恒的；不朽的：permanent, lasting, everlasting, undying, timeless
rm: 外部(external)世界是永恒的(eternal)诱惑

en: relating to a particular race, nation, or tribe and their customs and traditions

ex.en: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
ex.cn: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

ex.en: ethnic Russians in Estonia
ex.cn: 居住在爱沙尼亚的俄罗斯人

ph.cn: n. 同种同文化之民族

syn: adj. 种族的；人种的：racial, tribal

en: the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group

ex.en: strict rules of professional etiquette
ex.cn: 严格的行规

syn: n. 礼节，礼仪；规矩：ceremony, manner, protocol

en: to send people away from a dangerous place to a safe place

ex.en: Police evacuated the area.
ex.cn: 警方将该地区人员全部疏散。

syn: vt. 疏散，撤退；排泄：withdraw, beat a retreat
vi. 疏散；撤退；排泄：withdraw, beat a retreat
rm: e(出) + vacu(空) + ate(动词后缀) → 空出去 → 疏散； 撤离

en: to avoid talking about something, especially because you are trying to hide something

ex.en: I could tell that he was trying to evade the issue.
ex.cn: 我看得出他在极力回避这个问题。

ex.en: The minister evaded the question.
ex.cn: 部长回避了那个问题。

syn: vt. 逃避；规避；逃脱：get out of, elude
vi. 逃避；规避；逃脱：escape, get out of

en: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

ex.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
ex.cn: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

ex.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
ex.cn: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

syn: vt. 评价；估价；求…的值：value, score, rate, prize
vi. 评价；估价：to assess, to appraise
rm: e(出) + val(价值) + uate → 使给出价值 → 评价， 估价

t: v. 使蒸发，使脱水，消失
en: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas

ex.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
ex.cn: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

ex.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
ex.cn: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

syn: vt. 使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失：vapor
vi. 蒸发，挥发；消失，失踪：disappear, blank

ex.cn: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

ex.cn: 我不想使情况变得更糟。

ex.cn: 所有这些机构和人士要么补充或便利我们的工作，要么表达人民的卫生需求。

ex.cn: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

对…的信任；对…有信仰；对…有信心

ex.cn: 书从他手上跌落。

ex.cn: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

ex.cn: 你要哪种味道的，巧克力还是香草？

ex.cn: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

ex.cn: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

ex.cn: 我微笑的看着这一切，我知道这个时刻是多么的短暂。

ex.cn: 他加了一些面粉使汤浓些。

ex.cn: 他用流利的意大利语讲话。

ex.cn: 一阵狂风

ex.cn: 海沃德美术馆的非洲艺术展览

ex.cn: 他们的宗教禁止饮酒和赌博。

ex.cn: 控制细胞分裂的基因

ex.cn: 亲切的微笑

en: something that you hope to achieve in the future

ex.en: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
ex.cn: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

syn: n. 目标；球门，得分数；终点：target, object, destination, cause, aim

en: morally bad

ex.en: Stay away from Jerry – he’s no good.
ex.cn: 离杰里远点——他不是什么好东西。

ex.cn: 它只不过是从身边的不同语言当中,借用了一些单词串,以随意的方式将它们放在一起

ex.en: All the master had to do was shake the tree a little and the garden was full of leaves again, spread out in haphazard patterns.
ex.cn: 大师什么都没有做，只是摇了摇树。 花园又重新被凋落的树叶覆盖了，整个花园展现出随意的样式。

ex.en: A number of black youths have complained of being harassed by the police.
ex.cn: 一些黑人青年投诉称受到警察骚扰。

en: when someone behaves in an unpleasant or threatening way towards you

ex.cn: 美国黑人多年来一直抱怨受到警察的骚扰。

ex.cn: 一把硬木椅

ex.cn: 有害废弃物的处理

ex.cn: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

ex.cn: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

en: to make a low continuous sound

ex.cn: 机器在车间里嗡嗡作响。

en: people in general

ex.cn: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

ex.cn: 反人类罪

ex.cn: 一个谦卑的男人

ex.en: ...her lawyer husband, trapped in a humdrum but well-paid job.
ex.cn: ...她整天做着单调乏味的工作但收入颇丰的律师丈夫。

ex.cn: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

ex.cn: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

ex.cn: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

ex.cn: 飓风毁坏了沿海地区的大部分。

ex.cn: 飓风损害赔偿金的金额被确定为三百万美元。

ex.cn: 水含有氢和氧。

ex.cn: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

ex.cn: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

ex.cn: 演播室里的每个人都爆发出一阵狂笑。

ex.cn: 沃尔特·迪斯尼坚持他的理想。

syn: adj. [数]理想的；完美的；想象的；不切实际的：perfect, full, unreasonable, dream

t: adj. 同一的，完全相似的

syn: adj. [数]同一的；完全相同的：self, same

ex.en: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
ex.cn: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

ex.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
ex.cn: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

vi. 确定；认同；一致：cotton, square

t: n. 认出，识别；身分证明
en: official papers or cards, such as your passport, that prove who you are

ex.en: Do you have any identification?
ex.cn: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

ex.en: fingerprinting as a means of identification
ex.cn: 作为一种身份证明方式的指纹提取

ex.cn: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

t: n. 思想，思想体系，意识形态
en: a set of beliefs on which a political or economic system is based, or which strongly influence the way people behave

ex.en: the ideologies of fascism and terrorism
ex.cn: 法西斯主义和恐怖主义的意识形态

ex.en: a new ideology based on individualism
ex.cn: 基于个人主义的新思想体系

en: a group of words that has a special meaning that is different from the ordinary meaning of each separate word. For example, ‘under the weather’ is an idiom meaning ‘ill’.

ex.cn: 新的音乐风格

syn: n. 成语，习语；土话：phrase, dialect

ex.en: Are you an idiot?
ex.cn: 你是一个白痴吗？

ex.cn: 通货膨胀率现已超过16%。

syn: n. 膨胀；[金融]通货膨胀；夸张；自命不凡：expansion, bulking

ex.cn: 警探提醒说这些人可能会造成严重伤害。

ex.cn: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

ex.cn: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

ex.cn: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

ex.cn: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

ex.cn: 5,000英镑的初始投资

ex.cn: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

ex.cn: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

ex.cn: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

ex.cn: 他的儿子被注射了强效的药。

ex.cn: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

ex.cn: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

ex.cn: 很多人对技术革新的速度感到不知所措。

ex.cn: 她在多个委员会担任委员。

ex.cn: 那是疯狂的冒险之举。

ex.cn: 他从衣袋里掏出一把小钥匙，然后缓缓地将其插入锁孔里。

ex.cn: 他开第二枪时，枪卡壳了。

ex.cn: 她变得过分地猜忌，接着是一场激烈的打斗。

ex.cn: “你知道我是对的！”她嘲笑道。

ex.cn: 总统被一群抗议者报以嘘声和嘲笑。

ex.cn: 他损害了他的前程。

ex.cn: 威尔科克斯扭扭头，示意他们该走了。

ex.cn: 我每天早晨都去慢跑。

ex.cn: 我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。

t: n. 学术性刊物，期刊；日记

ex.cn: 一位著名的新闻记者兼播音员

ex.cn: …一个独立的司法体系。

ex.en: ...efforts to manipulate the judicial process.
ex.cn: …操纵审判程序的努力。

ex.cn: 照片乱七八糟地堆在一起。

ex.cn: 阿伯特路与米尔街的交叉口

ex.cn: 40号高速公路上的第5交叉口

ex.cn: 亚马孙丛林

ex.cn: 她现在和比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

ex.cn: 消费者们将不必为了使用新制式而丢掉他们的老盒式磁带。

ex.cn: 陪审团裁定他无罪。

ex.cn: 你留着吧，我不需要了。

保持；继续；不低落；不落后
