en: if there is a mess somewhere or a place is a mess, things there are dirty or not neatly arranged

ex.en: What a mess!
ex.cn: 太乱了！

ex.en: Sorry – the place is a bit of a mess .
ex.cn: 对不起——这里有些乱。

syn: n. 混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西：difficulty, disorder, chaos, confusion, corner
vt. 弄乱，弄脏；毁坏；使就餐：destroy, soil, mud, spot, damage

en: if a company or government has a monopoly of a business or political activity, it has complete control of it so that other organizations cannot compete with it

ex.en: a monopoly in copper trading
ex.cn: 对铜交易的垄断

syn: n. [经]垄断；垄断者；[贸易]专卖权：cornerer
rm: mono(单个) + poly(多) → 独占某商品绝大多数的市场份额 → 垄断， 专卖

en: relating to money, especially all the money in a particular country

ex.en: the government’s tight monetary policy
ex.cn: 政府从紧的货币政策

ex.en: objects of little monetary value
ex.cn: 不值钱的物件

syn: adj. 货币的；财政的：financial, fiscal

en: boring because of always being the same

ex.en: a monotonous diet
ex.cn: 单调的饮食

ex.en: a little boy who wet his bed with monotonous regularity
ex.cn: 一个老是尿床的小男孩

syn: adj. [声]单调的，无抑扬顿挫的；无变化的：same, flat, blank
rm: mono(单个) + ton(声音) + ous → 一个声音的 → 单调的

en: the season, from about April to October, when it rains a lot in India and other southern Asian countries

ex.en: ...the end of the monsoon.
ex.cn: …雨季的结束。

syn: n. [气候]季风；（印度等地的）雨季；季候风：rainy season, raining period

t: n. 怪物；畸形的动植物；恶人
en: an imaginary or ancient creature that is large, ugly, and frightening

ex.en: the remains of a prehistoric monster
ex.cn: 史前怪兽的遗骸

ex.en: the search for the Loch Ness Monster
ex.cn: 对内斯湖水怪的搜寻

ph.cn: 尼斯湖水怪（相传在尼斯湖出现的一种巨型怪兽）

syn: n. 怪物；巨人，巨兽；残忍的人：giant, bugbear
adj. 巨大的，庞大的：huge, enormous, tremendous, massive, macro
rm: “蒙死他” → 怪物把他给吓蒙了 → 怪物

t: adj. 巨大的；恐怖的；可耻的，丢脸的
en: unusually large

ex.en: a monstrous nose
ex.cn: 很大的鼻子

syn: adj. 巨大的；怪异的；荒谬的；畸形的：huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro

en: a small two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

ex.en: Look at that family on a moped!
ex.cn: 看看脚踏车上的那一家子！

t: n. 道德，美德；伦理体系
en: beliefs or ideas about what is right and wrong and about how people should behave

ex.en: ...standards of morality and justice in society.
ex.cn: …社会中道德和正义的标准。

syn: n. 道德；品行，美德：virtue, excellence
rm: moral(道德的) ＋ ity → 道德， 美德

en: with a strong and unhealthy interest in unpleasant subjects, especially death

ex.en: The trip was made all the worse by Frankie’s morbid fear of flying.
ex.cn: 弗朗基对坐飞机有种病态的恐惧，使得旅途变得更加糟糕。

ex.en: His head was full of morbid thoughts.
ex.cn: 他的脑袋里全是不健康的思想。

syn: adj. 病态的；由病引起的；恐怖的；病变部位的：sick, pathological

en: in addition – used to introduce information that adds to or supports what has previously been said

ex.en: The rent is reasonable and, moreover, the location is perfect.
ex.cn: 租金合理，而且位置也非常好。

ex.en: The source of the information is irrelevant. Moreover, the information need not be confidential.
ex.cn: 信息来源无关紧要，而且也不一定必须是机密的。

syn: adv. 而且；此外：besides, again, also, then, additionally

t: adj. 必有一死的；致命的；极大的；n. 致命性
en: something very serious that may cause the end of something

ex.en: The computer has dealt a mortal blow to traditional printing methods.
ex.cn: 计算机 给了传统的印刷方法一记致命的打击。

ex.en: Our health service is in mortal danger.
ex.cn: 我们的公共医疗保健服务岌岌可危。

syn: adj. 凡人的；[医]致死的；终有一死的；不共戴天的：kill, laical
n. 人类，凡人：mankind, humanity, people

t: v. 抵押，按揭，贷款购房

ex.en: At this point, such claims have no bearing on the mortgage or housing crisis; they have bearing only on the holders of these securities themselves.
ex.cn: 从这一点上来说，这些贷款凭证与抵押贷款或住房危机没有任何关系，他们只与拥有这些证券的持有者有关。

syn: vt. [经]抵押：hold in pledge, hypothecate
n. [经]抵押：hypothecation, pledge

t: n&a. 镶嵌细工的，镶嵌工艺品的，嵌花式的
en: a group of different things that exist next to each other or together

ex.en: rooms decorated with wall paintings and mosaics
ex.cn: 用壁画和马赛克装饰的房间

ph.cn: 玻璃马赛克；玻璃镶嵌砖

syn: n. [建]马赛克；[细胞][遗]镶嵌；镶嵌细工：crustification, marquetry

t: n&a&ad. 大多数，最；最多的(地)

ph.cn: 最重要的；首要的；最关键的
大部分，大多数的；绝大多数

syn: adv. 最；非常，极其；最多；几乎：extremely, badly, highly, greatly, almost, nearly, too
adj. 大部分的，多数的；最多的：large, maximum

en: a hotel for people who are travelling by car, where you can park your car outside your room

ex.en: The gas station just neighbours to the motel.
ex.cn: 加油站就在汽车旅馆的附近。

ex.en: I also have to get back to the motel. The manager took my passport last night, and now he and the passport are nowhere to be found.
ex.cn: 我也必须回到汽车旅馆去，因为旅馆经理昨天晚上拿走了我的护照，到现在为止他本人和我的护照都不知所踪。

en: an idea, subject, or image that is regularly repeated and developed in a book, film, work of art etc

ex.en: The theme of creation is a recurrent motif in Celtic mythology.
ex.cn: 天地万物的创造是凯尔特神话中反复出现的主题。

syn: n. 主题；动机；主旨；图形；意念：topic, theme, subject, substance, incentive

t: n. 运动，动态；手势；眼色，姿势；提议
en: the process of moving or the way that someone or something moves

ex.en: Newton’s first law of motion
ex.cn: 牛顿第一运动定律

ph.cn: 运动控制，拖动控制；动作控制，移动控制

syn: n. 动作；移动；手势；请求；意向：removal, intention, move, shift, asking
vi. 运动；打手势：do sport, do morning exercise
rm: mot(移动) + ion → 运动

en: to make someone want to achieve something and make them willing to work hard in order to do this

ex.en: A good teacher has to be able to motivate her students.
ex.cn: 好教师必须能够激发学生的积极性。

syn: vt. 刺激；使有动机；激发…的积极性：stimulate, fan, needle, activate

en: a short sentence or phrase giving a rule on how to behave, which expresses the aims or beliefs of a person, school, or institution

ex.en: ‘Be prepared’ is the motto of the Boy Scouts.
ex.cn: “时刻准备着”是童子军的格言。

syn: n. 座右铭，格言；箴言：imprese, maxim

en: a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, so that when it becomes solid, it takes the shape of the container

ex.en: Another method, used especially for figures, was to pour the clay into a mould.
ex.cn: 另一个方法是把黏土倒入模具中，尤其用于铸造人像。

ex.en: lime jell-o in a mould
ex.cn: 装在果冻模里的来檬果冻

syn: vi. 发霉：go moldy
vt. 浇铸；用泥土覆盖：cast, typecast

t: v. 爬上，骑上；增加；n. 山
en: to increase gradually in amount or degree

ex.en: Tension here is mounting , as we await the final result.
ex.cn: 我们等待着最终结果，这里的气氛也越来越紧张。

ex.en: Casualties on both sides of the battle have continued to mount.
ex.cn: 交战双方的伤亡人数继续增加。

ph.cn: 埃佛勒斯峰（喜马拉雅山主峰之一，中国称珠穆朗玛峰）

syn: vt. 增加；爬上；使骑上马：enhance, boost, jack, hot, gain
vi. 爬；上升：climb, arise, raise, go up
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“登上”

en: an idea, belief, or opinion

ex.en: She had no notion what he meant.
ex.cn: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

syn: n. 概念；见解；打算：concept, idea, eye, construct, sight
rm: not(知道) + ion(名词后缀) → 知道的东西 → 观念； 想法

t: adj. 自名昭著的，声名狼藉的
en: famous or well-known for something bad

ex.en: a notorious computer hacker
ex.cn: 声名狼藉的电脑黑客

ex.en: notorious cases of human rights abuses
ex.cn: 臭名昭著的践踏人权案

syn: adj. 声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的：infamous, disreputable
n. [数]零；无价值：nothing, nought
adj. 无价值的；无用的：useless, unnecessary, worthless

en: to keep a feeling, idea, or belief strong or help it to grow stronger

ex.en: We need to nourish our hopes and dreams.
ex.cn: 我们应该怀有希望和梦想。

syn: vt. 滋养；怀有；使健壮：harbor

en: something that helps a feeling, idea, or belief to grow stronger

ex.en: His favorite fruits and vegetables as well as 55 lb. of bamboo will be on board for nourishment.
ex.cn: 除了它最喜爱的水果和蔬菜以外还有55磅的竹子将会作为它在飞机上的食物。

syn: n. 食物；营养品；滋养品：nutrition, diet, eating

en: not like anything known before, and unusual or interesting

ex.en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
ex.cn: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

syn: adj. 新奇的；异常的：patent, exquisite
n. 小说：story, fiction

t: n. 新颖；新奇；新奇的事物
en: the quality of being new, unusual, and interesting

ex.en: Many toys have no attraction beyond their novelty value.
ex.cn: 许多玩具除了有些新奇感之外，别无吸引力。

ex.en: It was fun for a while, but the novelty wore off (= it became boring ).
ex.cn: 开始有一阵很好玩，可是新鲜感随后便消失了。

syn: n. 新奇；新奇的事物；新颖小巧而廉价的物品：newness, originality

en: someone who has no experience in a skill, subject, or activity

ex.en: The computer course is ideal for novices.
ex.cn: 这门计算机课程非常适合初学者。

ex.en: This trail is not recommended for novice bikers.
ex.cn: 不建议自行车新手走这条小路。

syn: n. 初学者，新手：learner, beginner
rm: nov(新) + ice → 新手

en: not in any place or to any place

ex.en: Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US.
ex.cn: 没有什么地方的吸毒问题比美国更严重。

ph.cn: 不知打哪儿来；突然冒出来；莫名其妙的出现

syn: adv. 无处；任何地方都不；毫无结果：noplace
n. 无处；任何地方；无名之地：anywhere

en: harmful or poisonous

ex.en: noxious fumes
ex.cn: 有毒烟雾

syn: adj. 有害的；有毒的；败坏道德的；讨厌的：harmful, toxic, evil, poisonous, rank

t: n. (意义、意见、颜色)细微差别
en: a very slight, hardly noticeable difference in manner, colour, meaning etc

ex.en: He was aware of every nuance in her voice.
ex.cn: 他听得出她声音中的每一个细微变化。

ex.en: subtle nuances of meaning
ex.cn: 含义的细微差别

en: the central part of an atom, made up of neutrons, protons, and other elementary particles

ex.en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
ex.cn: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

syn: n. [核][天][生物]核，核心；原子核：core, quick

en: a person, thing, or situation that annoys you or causes problems

ex.en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
ex.cn: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

ph.cn: n. 妨害公众安宁；妨害公众利益的人或事物

syn: n. 讨厌的人；损害；麻烦事；讨厌的东西：injury, harm, damage

en: an agreement, contract etc that is null and void has no legal force

ex.en: The contract was declared null and void.
ex.cn: 该合同被宣布无效。

ph.cn: 零假设；虚假设；解消假设

syn: adj. 无效的，无价值的；等于零的：useless, ineffective
n. 零，[数]空：nothing, nought

en: to make something lose its effect or value

ex.en: Recent inflation could nullify the economic growth of the last several years.
ex.cn: 最近的通货膨胀可能会抵消过去数年的经济增长。

syn: vt. 使无效，作废；取消：recall, invalidate

t: adj. 麻木的，失去知觉的
en: a part of your body that is numb is unable to feel anything, for example because you are very cold

ex.en: My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
ex.cn: 我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。

ex.en: The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
ex.cn: 麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。

syn: vt. 使麻木；使发愣；使失去感觉：torpify, perish
adj. 麻木的；发愣的：stupid, asleep

ex.en: Where children respect a parent and know that he or she demands good behavior in school, even mediocre or loutish teachers can pull off the trick④of producing modestly literate and numerate children.
ex.cn: 如果孩子尊重父母，并且知道父母要求自己好好上学，即便是平庸的或是很笨的老师也能够成功地教出一般水平的能读会算的小学生。

syn: vt. [数]数，列举；读（数）：specify, enumerate

t: adj. 数字的，用数字表示的
en: expressed or considered in numbers

ex.en: a numerical code
ex.cn: 数字密码

ex.en: The home team tried to utilize their numerical advantage (= the fact that they had more players than the other team ).
ex.cn: 主队试图利用他们在人数上的优势。

syn: adj. [数]数值的；数字的；用数字表示的（等于numeric）：digital

en: many

ex.en: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
ex.cn: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

ex.en: The two leaders have worked together on numerous occasions.
ex.cn: 那两位领导人已经多次合作。

syn: adj. 许多的，很多的：many, multiple, hundred, plenty
rm: numer(数) + ous(多…的) → 数目众多的 → 众多的

en: a place where young children are taken care of during the day while their parents are at work

ex.en: He has painted murals in his children's nursery.
ex.cn: 他在他家的育儿室画上了壁画。

syn: n. [林]苗圃；托儿所；温床：soil, nest
rm: 来自nurse(v. 看护)

en: someone who watches something happening without being involved in it

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers had gathered at the scene of the accident.
ex.cn: 一群旁观者围聚在事故现场。

syn: n. 旁观者；观众（等于spectator）：audience, spectator

en: the beginning of something, especially something bad

ex.en: the onset of winter
ex.cn: 冬天的来临

syn: n. 开始，着手；发作；攻击，进攻：beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh

t: adj. 不透光的，不透明的
en: opaque glass or liquid is difficult to see through and often thick

ex.en: a shower with an opaque glass door
ex.cn: 装有不透明玻璃门的淋浴间

syn: adj. [物]不透明的；不传热的；迟钝的：slow, non-transparent
vt. [物]使不透明；使不反光：devitrify
rm: opa(不透明) + que → 不透明的

t: n. 口，孔；开始；张开；职位空缺
en: a hole or space in something

ex.en: There are very few openings in scientific research.
ex.cn: 科学研究领域很少有职位空缺。

ph.cn: 开放，扩大开放；疏通，打通；开发矿山
开学典礼；开幕式；开幕仪式；开幕典礼
开盘价；按开市价盘；开盘指令；开盘委托

syn: n. 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位：beginning, opportunity, threshold, conception, chance
adj. 开始的：preliminary, inauguratory

en: your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject

ex.en: When choosing an insurance policy it’s best to get an independent opinion.
ex.cn: 选择保险时，最好听听专家的独立意见。

ph.cn: adv. 依我看来，在我看来

syn: n. 意见；主张：comment, view, judgement, mind, thinking

en: someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument

ex.en: Graf’s opponent in today’s final will be Sukova.
ex.cn: 格拉芙今天的决赛对手将是苏科娃。

ex.en: He is admired even by his political opponents.
ex.cn: 他甚至受到政敌的钦佩。

syn: n. 对手；反对者；敌手：equal, anti, comparative, rival, match
adj. 对立的；敌对的：contrary, adverse, against
rm: op(反) + pon(放) + ent → 处于对立面的 → 对手， 敌手； 对立的， 对抗的

en: a chance to do something or an occasion when it is easy for you to do something

ex.en: There are fewer opportunities for new graduates this year.
ex.cn: 今年新毕业的大学生就业机会较少。

syn: n. 时机，机会：occasion, chance, opening, room
rm: opportun(e)(合适的， 适当的) + ity → 合适的时机 → 机会， 时机

en: to disagree with something such as a plan or idea and try to prevent it from happening or succeeding

ex.en: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
ex.cn: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

syn: vt. 反对；对抗，抗争：combat, sit down on
vi. 反对：object, sit down on
rm: op(反) + pos(放) + e → 反着放 → 反对， 反抗

syn: conj. 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时：because, although, since, for, seeing
prep. 如同；当作；以…的身份：in the light of, like

t: adj. 对面的；相反的，对立的；prep. 在对面
en: as different as possible from something else

ex.en: I thought the medicine would make him sleep, but it had the opposite effect.
ex.cn: 我以为这药会让他睡觉，但是它却起了反作用。

ex.en: At the opposite extreme, Ashworth’s style is very simple and modern.
ex.cn: 截然相反的是，阿什沃思的风格非常简单和现代。

syn: adj. 相反的；[植]对面的；对立的：contrary, adverse, counter, against, cross
n. 对立面；反义词：antithesis, antonym

en: to treat a group of people unfairly or cruelly, and prevent them from having the same rights that other people in society have

ex.en: native tribes oppressed by the authorities
ex.cn: 受到当局压迫的土著部落

syn: vt. 压迫，压抑；使……烦恼；使……感到沉重：lie on

en: to choose one thing or do one thing instead of another

ex.en: Depending on your circumstances you can opt for one method or the other.
ex.cn: 根据自己的情况，你可以选择这种或那种方法。

ph.cn: 决定退出；插播；请求免除
决定不参加...；决定（从...）退出

syn: vi. 选择：to choose, to make a choice

t: adj. 视觉的，眼睛的，光学的
en: relating to machines or processes which are concerned with light, images, or the way we see things

ex.en: microscopes and other optical instruments
ex.cn: 显微镜和其他光学仪器

syn: adj. 光学的；眼睛的，[生理]视觉的：visual, ocular
rm: opt(眼睛) + ical → 视力的

en: a tendency to believe that good things will always happen

ex.en: There are grounds for cautious optimism.
ex.cn: 有理由保持谨慎乐观。

rm: optim(最好) + ism(抽象名词后缀) → 认为自己是最好的 → 乐观， 乐观主义

en: the best or most suitable for a particular purpose or in a particular situation

ex.en: optimum conditions for growth
ex.cn: 最适宜生长的条件

ex.en: This design makes the optimum use of the available space.
ex.cn: 这一设计最大限度地利用了现有的空间。

rm: optim(最好) + um → 最好的

t: n. 选择，可选择的事物
en: a choice you can make in a particular situation

ex.en: There are a number of options available.
ex.cn: 有多种选择。

ex.en: He had two options.
ex.cn: 他有两种选择。

ph.cn: 出售选择权；卖出选择权；卖出期权

syn: n. [计]选项；选择权；买卖的特权：election, choice
rm: opt(选择) + ion → 选择

t: adj. 非强制的，自愿的，自发的
en: if something is optional, you do not have to do it or use it, but you can choose to if you want to

ex.en: three optional courses
ex.cn: 三门选修课

ex.en: The other excursions are optional.
ex.cn: 其他的短途旅行是自选项目。

syn: adj. 可选择的，随意的：selectable, hit-or-miss
n. 选修科目：elective subjects
rm: option(选择) + al → 可选择的

t: n. 天体轨道；势力范围；v. 沿轨道运行
en: the curved path travelled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc

ex.en: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time.
ex.cn: 火星和地球的轨道随着时间而发生改变。

ph.cn: 在轨道上；在轨道上运行；[俚语]飘飘然

syn: n. [天][航]轨道；[昆]眼眶；势力范围；生活常规：path, track, railway, trajectory
vi. 盘旋；绕轨道运行：serpentuate, circle round
rm: orb(轨道) + it → 轨道

en: a place where fruit trees are grown

ex.en: a cherry orchard
ex.cn: 樱桃园

ph.cn: 乌节路（新加坡最出名的购物街道）

syn: n. [园艺]果园；果树林：grove

ex.en: He directed an orchestra.
ex.cn: 他指挥一个管弦乐队。

ex.en: She conducted an orchestra of forty instruments.
ex.cn: 她在一个拥有40种乐器的管弦乐队里当指挥。

ph.cn: 爱乐乐团，爱乐团；管弦乐团

rm: or + chest(胸腔) + ra → 管弦乐队的成员大都需借助胸腔的力气吹奏乐器 → 管弦乐队

t: n. (对品格或忍耐力的)严格考验

ex.en: They manned themselves for an ordeal.
ex.cn: 他们振奋精神迎接考验。

syn: n. 折磨；严酷的考验；痛苦的经验：illusage, torture

t: adj. 整齐的；有秩序的；有条不紊的
en: arranged or organized in a sensible or neat way

ex.en: She needs to organize her ideas in a more orderly way.
ex.cn: 她需要把自己的想法组织得更有条理些。

syn: adj. 有秩序的；整齐的；值班的：regular, straight
n. 勤务兵；传令兵；护理员：batman, lashkar

en: rock or earth from which metal can be obtained

ex.en: iron ore
ex.cn: 铁矿石

ex.en: veins of rich ore
ex.cn: 富矿脉

syn: n. [矿物]矿；矿石：mine

t: v. 心脏急速跳动；人擅抖
en: If someone's heart palpitates, it beats very fast in an irregular way, because they are frightened or anxious

ex.en: He felt suddenly faint, and his heart began to palpitate.
ex.cn: 他突然感到晕厥，心脏也开始悸动。

syn: vi. 发抖；（心脏）悸动；跳动：pulse, shake

en: to look after someone very kindly, for example by giving them the things that they want and making them feel warm and comfortable

ex.en: She spent her childhood as the pampered daughter of a wealthy family.
ex.cn: 她出身于一个富裕家庭，从小娇生惯养。

syn: vt. 纵容；使…过量；给…吃得过多：baby, indulge

en: a very thin book with paper covers, that gives information about something

ex.en: a political pamphlet
ex.cn: 政治宣传册

syn: n. 小册子：booklet, tract

t: n&vt. 镶板，控制板；座谈小组；镶饰
en: a board in a car, plane, boat etc that has the controls on it

ex.en: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him.
ex.cn: 他集结了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

ph.cn: ◎[英国英语]已登记为替参加国民健康保险者治病的医生

syn: n. 仪表板；[建]嵌板；座谈小组，全体陪审员：fascia board, instrument board

t: n. 恐慌，惊慌；v. 受惊，惊慌
en: a sudden strong feeling of fear or nervousness that makes you unable to think clearly or behave sensibly

ex.en: a feeling of sheer panic
ex.cn: 惊恐万分的感觉

ex.en: She got into a panic when she couldn’t find the tickets.
ex.cn: 她找不到票，慌了起来。

syn: n. 恐慌，惊慌；[金融]大恐慌：alarm
adj. 恐慌的；没有理由的：unfounded

t: n. 全景，全方位，整体效应
en: an impressive view of a wide area of land

ex.en: Horton looked out over a panorama of fertile valleys and gentle hills.
ex.cn: 霍顿眺望着那一片肥沃山谷和平缓山脉的景象。

syn: n. 全景，全貌；全景画；概论：panoramic view, overall view

t: v. 气喘，喘息；气喘吁吁地说
en: to breathe quickly with short noisy breaths, for example because you have been running or because it is very hot

ex.en: He came in panting after running up the steps.
ex.cn: 他跑上台阶，气喘吁吁地走了进来。

ex.en: He was panting for breath .
ex.cn: 他上气不接下气。

syn: vi. 喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说出某事：rare, aspire
n. 气喘；喘息；喷气声：asthma, wheeziness

en: a piece of clothing that covers you from your waist to your feet and has a separate part for each leg

ex.en: She was wearing dark blue pants and a white sweater.
ex.cn: 她穿着深蓝色长裤和白色毛衣。

syn: n. 裤子；短裤：britches, short trousers

en: a piece of equipment fastened to the back of people who jump out of planes, which makes them fall slowly and safely to the ground

ex.en: a parachute jump
ex.cn: 跳伞

syn: n. [航]降落伞：chute
vi. 跳伞：to bail out

t: v. 阅兵整队；列队行进，游行；夸耀；炫示
en: to walk or march together to celebrate or protest about something

ex.en: Young athletes will get a chance to parade their skills.
ex.cn: 年轻运动员将有机会一展身手。

ph.cn: [美国英语]学时髦；跟着大众行动

syn: n. 游行；阅兵；炫耀；行进；阅兵场：display, pageant
vt. 游行；炫耀；列队行进：show off, brag about

en: a place that has everything you need for doing a particular activity

ex.en: The market is a shopper’s paradise.
ex.cn: 这个市场是购物者的乐园。

syn: n. 天堂：heaven, Olympus

t: n. 似是而非的论点；看似悖谬实则正确的观点
en: a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true

ex.en: The paradox is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.
ex.cn: 悖论就是: 如果渔夫减少捕鱼，反而会打到更多的鱼。

t: adj. 平行的，相当的；n. 类似的人或事，比较
en: two lines, paths etc that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart along their whole length

ex.en: Lines AB and CD are parallel. AB
ex.cn: 线与CD线平行。

ex.en: two parallel roads
ex.cn: 两条平行的道路

ph.cn: 并行的；[电]并联的；平行的

syn: n. [天][数]平行线；对比：contrast
adj. [天][数]平行的；类似的，相同的：same, uniform
rm: par(并列) + all(其他的) + el → 把不同的东西并列放置 → 类似的， 相对应的

en: if something paralyses you, it makes you lose the ability to move part or all of your body, or to feel it

ex.en: Her legs were partly paralysed in the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车事故中她的双腿部分瘫痪。

en: more important than anything else

ex.en: During a war the interests of the state are paramount, and those of the individual come last.
ex.cn: 战争时期国家利益是首要的，个人利益置于最后。

ex.en: Women’s role as mothers is of paramount importance to society.
ex.cn: 女性作为母亲的角色对社会至关重要。

syn: adj. 最重要的，主要的；至高无上的：primary, main, major, central, great
n. 最高统治者：monarch, imperator
rm: par ＋ amount(数量) → 在量上超过别的 → 最重要的， 决定性的

t: n. 麻痹，瘫痪；完全无力
en: the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body or feel things in it

ex.en: paralysis of the lower body
ex.cn: 下半身瘫痪

ex.en: The snake’s poison causes paralysis.
ex.cn: 这种蛇的毒液会引起身体麻痹。

ph.cn: 驰缓性麻痹；弛缓性瘫痪；松弛性麻痹；软瘫

syn: n. [内科]麻痹；无力；停顿：numbness, asthenia
rm: para(半) + lys(分开) + is → 身体裂成两半 → 瘫痪， 麻痹

en: a mental illness that makes someone believe that they are very important and that people hate them and are trying to harm them

ex.en: They capitalize on panic and paranoia.
ex.cn: 他们利用恐慌和偏执狂。

syn: n. [心理]偏执狂，[内科]妄想狂：monomania

t: n. 随身用品；贴身用品
en: You can refer to a large number of objects that someone has with them or that are connected with a particular activity as paraphernalia

ex.en: ...a large courtyard full of builders' paraphernalia.
ex.cn: …一个充满建筑装备的大院子

syn: n. 随身用具；全部有关的事物；设备：equipment, furniture, facility, plant

en: to express in a shorter, clearer, or different way what someone has said or written

ex.en: To paraphrase Finkelstein, mathematics is a language, like English.
ex.cn: 芬克尔斯坦的意思是，数学是一门语言，就像英语一样。

syn: vt. 改述：rephrase
vi. 释义；意译：free translation

t: n. 寄生虫，寄生植物；靠他人为生的人
en: a plant or animal that lives on or in another plant or animal and gets food from it

ex.en: Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
ex.cn: 袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

syn: n. [生物][基医]寄生虫；食客：helminth, vermin

en: the group of people who are elected to make a country’s laws and discuss important national affairs

ex.en: They demanded a free parliament and press.
ex.cn: 他们要求议会自由和新闻自由。

ph.cn: 国会议员；下院议员；下议院议员

syn: n. 议会，国会：congress, house
rm: parlia(看作parle， 谈判) + ment → 谈判的地方 → 议会

en: a piece of writing, music etc or an action that copies someone or something in an amusing way

ex.en: Her performance contains a strong element of self-parody (= when someone makes fun of their own style ) .
ex.cn: 她的表演包含了强烈的自嘲元素。

en: a piece or feature of something such as an object, area, event, or period of time

ex.en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
ex.cn: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

syn: n. 部分；角色；零件：role, workers, portion, proportion, character
vt. 分离；分配；分开：portion, separate from

en: allowed by law or by the rules

ex.en: the maximum permissible level of radiation
ex.cn: 允许的最大辐射水平

t: v. 允许；许可；n. 许可证
en: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law

ex.en: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
ex.cn: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

ex.en: He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood.
ex.cn: 他血液中的酒精含量超出了允许的水平。

syn: vi. 许可；允许：to allow, make a promise
vt. 许可；允许：license, let, have, grant

t: adj. 垂直的，成直角的；直立的；n. 垂直线
en: not leaning to one side or the other but exactly vertical

ex.en: a perpendicular line
ex.cn: 垂直线

ex.en: a perpendicular wall of rock
ex.cn: 直立的石壁

syn: adj. [数]垂直的，正交的；直立的；陡峭的：vertical, standing, orthogonal

en: permanent

ex.en: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
ex.cn: 山顶的终年积雪

syn: adj. 永久的；不断的；四季开花的；无期限的：permanent, ceaseless, loud
rm: per(自始至终) + pet(追求) + ual → 自始至终追求的 → 长期的； 永久的

en: if something perplexes you, it makes you feel confused and worried because it is difficult to understand

ex.en: Shea’s symptoms perplexed the doctors.
ex.cn: 谢伊的症状令医生们困惑。

syn: vt. 使困惑，使为难；使复杂化：bepuzzle, confuse
rm: per(完全) + plex(重叠) → 完全重叠在一起 → 使困惑； 使复杂化

t: n. (正式用语)困惑，窘困，令人困惑的事或物
en: the feeling of being confused or worried by something you cannot understand

ex.en: moral perplexities
ex.cn: 道德难题

syn: n. 困惑；混乱：chaos, confusion, disorder, involvement, mix

en: to treat someone cruelly or unfairly over a period of time, especially because of their religious or political beliefs

ex.en: The Puritans left England to escape being persecuted.
ex.cn: 清教徒离开了英国以躲避迫害。

syn: vt. 迫害；困扰；同…捣乱：beset, eat at

en: to continue trying to do something in a very determined way in spite of difficulties – use this to show approval

ex.en: It can be tricky at first, but persevere.
ex.cn: 一开始会有些棘手，不过要坚持。

syn: vi. 坚持；不屈不挠；固执己见（在辩论中）：stay, stand on

en: to continue to do something, although this is difficult, or other people oppose it

ex.en: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
ex.cn: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

syn: vi. 存留，坚持；持续，固执：stay, abide
vt. 坚持说，反复说：iterate
rm: per(自始至终) + sist(坐) → 始终坐着 → 坚持； 持续

en: belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general

ex.en: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
ex.cn: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

ex.en: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
ex.cn: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

ph.cn: 个人信息，个人情况；个人资料，个人资讯

syn: adj. 个人的；身体的；亲自的：individual, subjective, physical

en: someone’s character, especially the way they behave towards other people

ex.en: Despite their different personalities, they became the best of friends.
ex.cn: 尽管个性不同，他们还是成了最好的朋友。

ex.en: Unfortunately, the illness can lead to changes in personality.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，这种病会导致性格变化。

syn: n. [心理]个性；品格；名人：being, kidney, lion, individuality

en: the people who work in a company, organization, or military force

ex.en: All personnel are to receive security badges.
ex.cn: 所有人员都将拿到安保徽章。

syn: n. 人事部门；全体人员：crew, Personnel Department
rm: 员工(personnel)应该有个人(personal)时间

t: n. 透视；透视画法；视角，观点
en: a way of thinking about something, especially one which is influenced by the type of person you are or by your experiences

ex.en: the artist’s use of perspective
ex.cn: 那位画家对透视法的运用

syn: n. 观点；远景；[数]透视图：viewpoint, outlook, eye, sentiment, standpoint
adj. [数]透视的：clairvoyant
rm: per(贯穿) + spect(看) + ive → 贯穿看 → 角度， 方法； 透视法

en: if you perspire, parts of your body become wet, especially because you are hot or have been doing hard work

ex.en: Willie was perspiring heavily .
ex.cn: 威利大汗淋漓。

syn: vi. 流汗；分泌；渗出：seep

en: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it

ex.en: ...matters pertaining to naval district defence.
ex.cn: …与海军区域防卫有关的问题。

syn: vi. 属于；关于；适合：gear, serve

ex.en: He asked me a lot of very pertinent questions .
ex.cn: 他问了我许多直接相关的问题。

syn: adj. 相关的，相干的；中肯的；切题的：relevant, relational, correlative

en: If something perturbs you, it worries you quite a lot

ex.en: What perturbs me is that magazine articles are so much shorter nowadays.
ex.cn: 让我不安的是现在杂志文章都短多了。

syn: vt. 扰乱；使…混乱；使…心绪不宁：disorder, upset

en: if a feeling, idea, or smell pervades a place, it is present in every part of it

ex.en: A spirit of hopelessness pervaded the country.
ex.cn: 一种无望的情绪笼罩着该国。

syn: vt. 遍及；弥漫：suffuse

t: adj. 刚愎的；坚持错误的，行为反常的

ex.en: He gets perverse satisfaction from embarrassing people.
ex.cn: 他通过使人难堪获得变态的满足感。

syn: adj. 堕落的，不正当的；倔强的；违反常情的：fallen, vicious

t: v. 误用，使人堕落；n. 堕落者，反常者
en: to influence someone so that they begin to think or behave in an immoral way

ex.en: TV violence perverts the minds of young children.
ex.cn: 电视暴力腐蚀了孩子们的心灵。

syn: vt. 使堕落；滥用；使反常：abuse, strain
n. 堕落者；行为反常者；性欲反常者：deteriorator

en: a tendency to believe that bad things will happen

ex.en: ...universal pessimism about the economy.
ex.cn: …对经济形势普遍的悲观看法。

syn: n. 悲观，悲观情绪；厌世主义：despondence

en: a very bad situation that someone is in

ex.en: the country’s economic plight
ex.cn: 该国的经济困境

syn: n. 困境；境况；誓约：difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix, predicament
vt. 保证；约定：undertake, assure

t: n. 小块土地；阴谋，情节；v. 绘制，标绘
en: the events that form the main story of a book, film, or play

ex.en: The plot was a little confusing.
ex.cn: 情节有些费解。

ex.en: We discover that Jack isn’t as innocent as he seems, as the plot unfolds (= gradually becomes clearer ) .
ex.cn: 随着情节的展开，我们发现杰克并不像表面上看起来那么清白。

ph.cn: 划分；分配；描绘，提出…纲要

syn: n. 情节；图；阴谋：action, designing, scenario
vt. 密谋；[测]绘图；划分；标绘：lot, to divide

en: a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted

ex.en: In those days the land was plowed by oxen.
ex.cn: 在那个年代是用公牛来犁地的。

syn: vt. [农机]犁；耕：till, plow
vi. 用犁耕田；开路：open circuit, clear the way for

en: a round flat piece of rubber used for stopping the water flowing out of a bath or  sink

ex.en: the bath plug
ex.cn: 浴缸塞子

ph.cn: n. 火花塞；带头人；中坚分子

syn: n. [电]插头；[核]塞子；栓：male connector, tampion
vi. 塞住；用插头将与电源接通：stop up

t: v. 铅锤，测锺；v. 探测，查明
en: to succeed in understanding something completely

ex.en: Psychologists try to plumb the deepest mysteries of the human psyche.
ex.cn: 心理学家试图探究人类心理最深层的奥秘。

syn: vt. [数]使垂直；探测，探索：detect, explore
n. [数]垂直；[测]铅锤：verticalness, perpendicularity

en: to suddenly and quickly decrease in value or amount

ex.en: House prices have plummeted down.
ex.cn: 房价已经暴跌。

syn: n. [测]铅锤，坠子：gravity weight, sinker

en: to steal large amounts of money or property from somewhere, especially while fighting in a war

ex.en: The rich provinces of Asia Minor were plundered by the invaders.
ex.cn: 小亚细亚的富饶地区遭到侵略者的劫掠。

syn: n. 抢夺；战利品；掠夺品：prize, capture
vt. 掠夺；抢劫；侵吞：harry, despoil

en: Plunge is also a noun

ex.en: ...a plunge into cold water.
ex.cn: …向着冰冷的水中的纵身一跳。

ph.cn: 投入；跳入；突然或仓促地开始某事
冒险尝试；采取决定性步骤

syn: n. 投入；跳进：investment, input
vi. 投入；陷入；跳进：plough into, throw one's self into

en: used to show that one number or amount is added to another

ex.en: Three plus six equals nine (3+6=9).
ex.cn: 3 加6等于9。

ex.en: The total cost was $10,000, plus 14% interest.
ex.cn: 全部费用是1万美元，外加14%的利息。

ph.cn: (高尔夫球比赛中强者对弱者的)让一分，让一击

syn: n. 正号，加号；好处；附加额：benefit, good
adj. [数]正的；附加的：additional, attached, positive, more, second
rm: pl(看作play， 玩) + us(我们) → 加上我们， 大家一起玩儿 → 加上

en: having a point at the end

ex.en: a pointed beard
ex.cn: 一把山羊胡

syn: adj. 尖的；突出的；锐利的；率直的：prominent, keen, striking
v. 指出；瞄准（point的过去式）：collimated

t: adj. 无意义的，无目标的
en: worthless or not likely to have any useful result

ex.en: Life just seemed pointless to me.
ex.cn: 生活对我来说简直没什么意义。

ex.en: a pointless quarrel
ex.cn: 无谓的争吵

syn: adj. 无意义的；钝的；不尖的；不得要领的：empty, meaningless

t: v. 平衡，保持平衡；n. 泰然自若，自信
en: to put or hold something in a carefully balanced position, especially above something else

ex.en: Louisa seems to have much more poise and confidence.
ex.cn: 路易莎似乎更加沉着自信了。

syn: n. 平衡；姿势；镇静：balance, attitude
vt. 使平衡；保持...姿势：balance, equilibrize

en: to quickly push your finger or some other pointed object into something or someone

ex.en: Vanessa gave me a playful poke in the ribs.
ex.cn: 瓦妮莎开玩笑地戳了一下我的肋骨。

syn: vi. 刺，捅；戳；伸出；刺探；闲荡：moon, run through
vt. 刺，捅；戳；拨开：stick, pink

t: adj. 南(北)极的；极端相反的
en: close to or relating to the North Pole or the South Pole

ex.en: As our climate warms up, the polar ice caps will begin to melt.
ex.cn: 随着地球气候逐渐变暖，极地的冰冠将开始融化。

ph.cn: 极坐标；极座标；极坐标系统

syn: adj. [数]极地的；两极的；正好相反的：dipolar, diametrical

en: the most northern or most southern point on a  planet  , especially the Earth

ex.en: the distance from pole to equator
ex.cn: 地极到赤道的距离

ph.cn: 增长极；增长点；发展轴心

syn: n. [建]杆；极点；电极：electrode, climax

en: a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization

ex.en: an insurance policy
ex.cn: 保险单

syn: n. 政策，方针；[保险]保险单：deal, programm

t: v. 磨光，擦光；润饰，使优美；n. 擦光剂
en: to make something smooth, bright, and shiny by rubbing it

ex.en: I spent all afternoon polishing the silver.
ex.cn: 我整个下午都在擦拭银器。

syn: n. [机]磨光，擦亮；上光剂，擦亮剂；优雅，精良：grace, buffing
vt. [机]磨光，使发亮：furbish
rm: pol(磨) + ish(使…) → 磨光， 擦亮

en: sensible and likely to gain you an advantage

ex.en: Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
ex.cn: 许多城镇经常发现改变拥戴对象不失为明智之举。

ph.cn: n. 国家（指在一个政府领导下组成一个政治集团的人民）

syn: adj. 精明的；有策略的；狡猾的；审慎的：calculating, designing, knowing, subtle
vi. 拉选票：seek a vote

en: to give a flower or plant pollen so that it can produce seeds

ex.en: flowers pollinated by bees
ex.cn: 由蜜蜂授粉的花

rm: pollin(看作pollen， 花粉) + ate → 给…授粉

en: someone who is pompous thinks that they are important, and shows this by being very formal and using long words – used to show disapproval

ex.en: He seems rather pompous.
ex.cn: 他看上去相当自负。

ex.en: the book’s pompous style
ex.cn: 该书浮夸的文风

syn: adj. 自大的；浮夸的；华而不实的；爱炫耀的：arrogant, purple

en: to spend time thinking carefully and seriously about a problem, a difficult question, or something that has happened

ex.en: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
ex.cn: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

syn: vt. 仔细考虑；衡量：mull over, reflect on
vi. 考虑；沉思：allow, think about, think of

t: adj. 沉重的，笨重的；(文章)冗长的
en: Ponderous writing or speech is very serious, uses more words than necessary, and is dull

ex.en: He had a dense, ponderous style.
ex.cn: 他的风格是词藻堆砌、冗长沉闷。

syn: adj. 笨重的；沉闷的；呆板的：mechanical, wooden, dead, cumbersome

en: a hard shiny white substance that is used for making expensive plates, cups etc

ex.en: a porcelain vase
ex.cn: 瓷花瓶

syn: n. [陶瓷]瓷；瓷器：china, stoneware
adj. 瓷制的；精美的：china, delicate, fine

t: vi&n. 捕食；被捕食的动物
en: an animal, bird etc that is hunted and eaten by another animal

ex.en: a tiger stalking its prey
ex.cn: 潜行跟踪猎物的老虎

ph.cn: 成为...的牺牲品；深受...之害

syn: vi. 捕食；掠夺；折磨：grind down, lie on
n. 捕食；牺牲者；被捕食的动物：victim, predation
rm: 兔子天天祈祷(pray)不要成为狼的猎物(prey)

en: most important

ex.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
ex.cn: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

ex.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
ex.cn: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

syn: adj. 主要的；[数]初级的；基本的：elementary, major, central, main, leading
n. 原色；最主要者：original color, fundamental colour
rm: prim(第一) + ary → 最初的； 主要的

en: most important

ex.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
ex.cn: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

ex.en: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
ex.cn: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

syn: adj. 主要的；最好的；基本的：greatest, major, elementary, central, main
adv. 极好地：excellently, famously
rm: prim(第一) + e → 首要的； 最好的

en: belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines

ex.en: a primitive society
ex.cn: 原始社会

ex.en: a primitive nomadic tribe
ex.cn: 原始的游牧部落

syn: adj. [数][生物][地质]原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的：original, simple, crude, plain, rough
n. [数][生物][地质]原始人：Euroman
rm: prim(第一) + it + ive(具…性质的) → 第一时间的 → 原始的

en: most important

ex.en: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
ex.cn: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

ex.en: Teaching is her principal source of income.
ex.cn: 教书是她主要的收入来源。

syn: n. 校长；委托人，当事人；资本；主犯：president, client, party, headmaster
adj. 首要的；最重要的：supreme, main, lead
rm: prin(第一) + cip(拿， 取) + al → 最先拿取 → 主要的； 校长

en: existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation

ex.en: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
ex.cn: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

ex.en: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
ex.cn: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

ph.cn: 事先批准；预先审批；事前批准；事前许可；预先核准

syn: adj. [数]优先的；在先的，在前的：preferred, underlying
adv. 在前，居先：before, antecedently
rm: pri(第一) + or → 排在第一的 → 在前的， 优先的

en: before other people or things

ex.en: Members receive priority bookings and reduced ticket prices to all concerts.
ex.cn: 会员可优先预订所有音乐会的门票，并享受优惠票价。

syn: n. [通信][计]优先；优先权；[数]优先次序；优先考虑的事：precedence, preference to sth

en: the state of being free from public attention

ex.en: each individual’s right to privacy
ex.cn: 每个人的隐私权

syn: n. 隐私；秘密；隐居；隐居处：secret, confidence, mystery
rm: priv(私有) + acy → 隐私

en: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people

ex.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
ex.cn: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

ph.cn: 特权；特别优惠；特殊许可

syn: n. [计]特权；优待；基本权利：franchise, peculiar
rm: priv(单个) + i + leg(法律) + e → 法律上的独享权利 → 特权

t: n. 试用，试读；见习，试用；缓刑
en: a system that allows some criminals not to go to prison or to leave prison, if they behave well and see a probation officer regularly, for a particular period of time

ex.en: The judge sentenced Jennings to three years’ probation.
ex.cn: 法官判詹宁斯三年缓刑。

syn: n. [劳经]试用；缓刑；查验：suspended sentence, try-on
rm: prob(检查， 试验) + ation → 察看 → 试用； 试用期

t: n&v. 医学探针；新闻调查；探测
en: to ask questions in order to find things out, especially things that other people do not want you to know

ex.en: Police probed claims that he had sold drugs.
ex.cn: 警方就有人称他贩卖毒品一事进行了调查。

syn: n. [电子][医]探针；调查：investigation, research
vi. 调查；[航]探测：examine, explore
rm: prob(检测) + e → 探测， 查究

en: a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way

ex.en: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
ex.cn: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

ph.cn: 民事诉讼；民事诉讼法；民事诉讼程序

syn: n. 程序，[管理]手续；步骤：routine, program, move, step
rm: proce(e)d(前进) + ure → 程序； 过程

en: to continue to do something that has already been planned or started

ex.en: Before proceeding further, we must define our terms.
ex.cn: 我们必须先定义术语，然后再往下展开。

syn: vi. 开始；继续进行；发生；行进：occur, happen, travel, pursue
rm: pro(向前) + ceed(行走) → 进行； 前进

t: n. 程序，进程；活动，诉讼
en: when someone uses a court of law to deal with a legal case

ex.en: John is taking legal proceedings against his ex-partner.
ex.cn: 约翰在对他的前合伙人提起法律诉讼。

syn: n. 进行；程序；诉讼；事项：going on, routine, program, conduct, law
v. 开始；继续做；行进（proceed的ing形式）：starting, beginning, initiating
rm: pro(向前) + ceed(行走) → 进行； 前进

en: to say publicly or officially that something important is true or exists

ex.en: The President proclaimed the republic’s independence.
ex.cn: 总统宣布共和国独立。

syn: vt. 宣告，公布；声明；表明；赞扬：indicate, sound, post, state, publish
rm: pro(在…前面， 向前) + claim(大声呼喊) → 在前面大叫 → 宣告， 声明； 显示

en: to obtain something, especially something that is difficult to get

ex.en: It remained very difficult to procure food, fuel, and other daily necessities.
ex.cn: 当时仍然很难获得食品、燃料和其他日用必需品。

syn: vt. 获得，取得；导致：earn, buy, score, find, result in
vi. 取得：bite on, to acquire

en: very large or great in a surprising or impressive way

ex.en: the artist’s prodigious output
ex.cn: 那位艺术家惊人的高产

syn: adj. 惊人的，异常的，奇妙的；巨大的：tremendous, wonderful, huge, enormous, massive

en: relating to the production of goods, crops, or wealth

ex.en: the economy’s productive capacity
ex.cn: 该经济体的生产能力

syn: adj. 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的：fruitful, procreative

en: the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, especially in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them

ex.en: high productivity levels in manufacturing
ex.cn: 制造业中的高生产率

ex.en: It cost the country $4 million in lost productivity .
ex.cn: 它对该国造成了400万美元的生产力损失。

ph.cn: 初级生产力；第一性生产力；基础生产力；初级生产率

syn: n. 生产力；[经]生产率；生产能力：fertility, productive forces
rm: product(产品) + ivity → 生产力； 生产率

t: adj. 亵神的，亵渎的；v. 亵渎，玷污
en: showing a lack of respect for God or holy things

ex.en: profane language
ex.cn: 亵渎的语言

syn: adj. 亵渎的；世俗的；异教的：lay, mundane
vt. 亵渎；玷污：cloud, unhallow

t: adj. 职业的；n. 专业人员
en: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work

ex.en: This business plan looks very professional.
ex.cn: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

ex.en: a more professional approach to work
ex.cn: 更专业的工作方法

syn: adj. 专业的；职业的；职业性的：vocational, specialized, occupational
n. [管理]专业人员；职业运动员：career man

en: a good standard of ability and skill

ex.en: I brought her proficiency up to the required level.
ex.cn: 我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。

ex.en: With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
ex.cn: 通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。

syn: n. 精通，熟练：proficient in, conversancy

en: a side view of someone’s head

ex.en: Dani has a lovely profile.
ex.cn: 达尼的侧面轮廓很好看。

ph.cn: 鲜明的姿态；引人注目的高姿态；明确的立场
公司简介；公司概况；企业介绍

syn: n. 侧面；轮廓；外形；[建][地质]剖面：configuration, side, shell, outline
rm: pro(在…前面) + fil(线条) + e → 外部的线条 → 侧面轮廓

en: something that is difficult to understand or explain

ex.en: The meaning of the poem has always been a puzzle.
ex.cn: 那首诗的含义始终是个谜。

ex.en: He thought he had solved the puzzle .
ex.cn: 他认为他已经解开了那个谜。

ph.cn: n. 七巧板；智力拼图玩具

syn: vt. 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出：baffle, discomfit
vi. 迷惑；冥思苦想：contemplate

en: unusual and attractive, especially in an old-fashioned way

ex.en: a quaint little village in Yorkshire
ex.cn: 约克郡一个古色古香的小村庄

syn: adj. 古雅的；奇怪的；离奇有趣的；做得很精巧的：strange, peculiar

en: if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject

ex.en: He left school without any qualifications.
ex.cn: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

ph.cn: 资格考试；合格试验；质量鉴定试验

syn: n. 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格：membership, limitation, capacity, condition, restriction
rm: 来自qualify(v. 合格， 具备资格)

en: to have the right to have or do something, or to give someone this right

ex.en: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
ex.cn: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

syn: vt. 限制；使具有资格；证明…合格：block, set a limit to
vi. 取得资格，有资格：be in a position, be qualified to

en: relating to the quality or standard of something rather than the quantity

ex.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
ex.cn: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

ph.cn: 定性研究；质化研究；定性调查

rm: qualit(y)(质量) + ative → 质量的； 定性的

en: relating to amounts rather than to the quality or standard of something

ex.en: ...the advantages of quantitative and qualitative research.
ex.cn: …定量和定性研究的优点。

ph.cn: 定量法；量化方法；计量方法

syn: adj. [计量]定量的；量的，数量的：mensurable

en: a place where large amounts of stone or sand are dug out of the ground

ex.en: a slate quarry
ex.cn: 板岩采石场

syn: n. [矿业]采石场；猎物；来源：source, provenience
vt. 挖出；努力挖掘：dig up, scoop out

en: produced or happening four times a year

ex.en: We publish a quarterly journal.
ex.cn: 我们出版一份季刊。

ex.en: The rent is payable quarterly.
ex.cn: 房租按季度支付。

t: adj. 奇怪的，不平常的；可疑的；眩晕的
en: strange or difficult to explain

ex.en: She gave a queer laugh.
ex.cn: 她古怪地笑了笑。

ex.en: Hank was beginning to feel a little queer.
ex.cn: 汉克开始感觉有点不对头。

ph.cn: 酷儿理论（指文化中所有非常态的表达方式）

syn: adj. 奇怪的；同性恋的；不舒服的；心智不平衡的：strange, uncomfortable
vt. 搞糟；使陷于不利地位：make a mess of, foul up

en: to stop a fire from burning

ex.en: a desperate bid to quench the raging flames
ex.cn: 为扑灭熊熊大火而不顾一切的努力

syn: vt. 熄灭，[机]淬火；解渴；结束；冷浸：conclude, go out
vi. 熄灭；平息：die, cool, go out

en: a long search for something that is difficult to find

ex.en: They journeyed to the distant Molucca islands in quest of spices.
ex.cn: 他们远赴摩鹿加群岛寻找香料。

syn: n. 追求；寻找：pursuit, looking for
vi. 追求；寻找：pursue / pursuit, go after

t: n. 问题单，调查表，征求意见表
en: a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information

ex.en: Teachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
ex.cn: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

en: a word used especially in letters or speeches to introduce the subject you are writing or talking about

ex.en: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
ex.cn: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

syn: prep. 关于，至于：concerning, about, in the case of, with reference to, in relation to
rm: regard(关心) + ing → 关于

syn: n. [生物][化学][物]再生，重生；重建：reconstruction, breeding, restructuring, rebirth

t: n. 政体，政权；政治制度
en: a government, especially one that was not elected fairly or that you disapprove of for some other reason

ex.en: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
ex.cn: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

syn: n. 政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制：government, power

en: to put someone’s or something’s name on an official list

ex.en: The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
ex.cn: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

syn: vt. 登记；[专利]注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出：book in, book down
vi. 登记；[专利]注册；挂号：book in, book down
rm: 词根记忆: re(回) + gist(=gest带来) + er → 带回来 → 登记

ex.en: The groom knew immediately that something was wrong when the registrar at Derry's Guildhall unexpectedly claimed that there was unfinished paperwork just before the ceremony began.
ex.cn: 当时，在婚礼仪式开始之前，市政厅的登记员意外地宣布还有一些文件没有完成，新郎立即意识到出现了一些误会。

ex.en: For example, the concept of a registrar disappeared and was replaced with the term system, indicating that a decision had been made to automate many of the mundane aspects of enrollment.
ex.cn: 例如，登记员的概念消失并且被术语 系统取代，这表示已经决定自动处理许多有关参加的琐碎事件。

ph.cn: 公司注册官；企业监管局

syn: n. 登记员；注册主任；专科住院医师：greffier

en: to control an activity or process, especially by rules

ex.en: strict rules regulating the use of chemicals in food
ex.cn: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

syn: vt. 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理：possess, define, contain, manage, state
rm: reg(统治) + ul + ate(动词后缀) → 统治并加以管理 → 管制

t: v. 恢复地位；使残疾者恢复正常的生活
en: to help someone to live a healthy, useful, or active life again after they have been seriously ill or in prison

ex.en: a special unit for rehabilitating stroke patients
ex.cn: 协助中风患者康复的特殊病房

syn: vt. 使康复；使恢复名誉；使恢复原状：repristinate, unmake
vi. 复兴；复权；恢复正常生活：revive
rm: re + hab(拥有) + ilit + ate → 重新拥有 → 使恢复原状， 修复

en: the period when someone is king, queen, or  emperor

ex.en: George VI reigned from 1936 to 1952.
ex.cn: 乔治六世于1936年至1952年在位。

syn: vi. 统治；支配；盛行；君临：predominate over, to rule
n. 统治；统治时期；支配：governance, disposal, rule, dominance

en: to pay money back to someone when their money has been spent or lost

ex.en: I'll be happy to reimburse you for any expenses you've had.
ex.cn: 我很乐意报销你的所有花费。

syn: vt. 偿还；赔偿：replace, tender

en: to give support to an opinion, idea, or feeling, and make it stronger

ex.en: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.

t: n. 填料，填充物，填充剂

ex.cn: 洋苏叶和洋葱填料

ex.cn: 匆忙中她绊了一下，把牛奶洒得满地都是。

ex.cn: 成龙和李连杰在电影中都不爱用替身演员。

ex.cn: 期间，只有一个叫史蒂夫·特鲁格利亚的人，45岁，职业是电影特技演员，并且曾是英国特种部队的一员，说他有一个类似的计划：7月份的时候从美国上空跳下。

en: an object that is sturdy is strong, well-made, and not easily broken

ex.cn: 那把椅子看上去不太结实。

ex.cn: 结实而舒适的鞋子

ex.cn: 将日本的管理方式用于欧洲企业的尝试

syn: n. 风格；时尚；类型；字体：mode, description, fashion, type, colour

t: v. 使屈服、征服，克制；使柔和，使安静

ex.cn: 警察设法控制住了愤怒的人群。

ex.cn: 拿破仑控制了大半个欧洲。

t: n. 国民；主题；adj. 隶属的，受支配的；v. 征服
en: the thing you are talking about or considering in a conversation, discussion, book, film etc

ex.en: Paul has strong opinions on most subjects.
ex.cn: 保罗在大多数问题上观点激烈。

ex.cn: 本章涵盖的主题是运动和营养。

adj. 服从的；易患…的；受制于…的：followed, compliant

ex.cn: 作为评论家，他过于主观。

ex.en: a highly subjective point of view
ex.cn: 相当主观的看法

syn: adj. 主观的；个人的；自觉的：personal, individual

t: adj. 水下的；n. 潜水艇
en: a ship, especially a military one, that can stay under water

ex.en: The captain dived his submarine deep to escape from the destroyers.
ex.cn: 海军上校使他的潜艇深深下潜以逃避驱逐艇。

syn: n. 潜水艇；海底生物：sub, pigboat
adj. [海洋]海底的；水下的：benthonic, undersea
rm: sub(在…下面) + marine(海洋的； 船舶的) → 在海底航行的 → 潜水艇

ex.en: Hippos are unable to submerge in the few remaining water holes.
ex.cn: 河马无法淹没在仅存的几个水坑里。

syn: vt. 淹没；把…浸入；沉浸：flood, flow
vi. 淹没；潜入水中；湮没：drown out, swallow up

en: to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve

ex.en: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain.
ex.cn: 绝望中，琼斯夫人不得已接受了一次她右膝的手术以减轻疼痛。

syn: vt. 使服从；主张；呈递：maintain, advocate
vi. [计]提交；服从：put in, hand in
rm: sub(在…下面) + mit(放) → 放在下面 → 屈从； 提交

t: adj. 下级的，次要的,从属的；n. 部下，下级职员

ex.en: a subordinate officer
ex.cn: 下级官员

syn: n. 下属，下级；部属，属下：inferior, underling
adj. 从属的；次要的：dependent, secondary, supporting, minor, peripheral
rm: sub(在…下面) + ordin(顺序) + ate → 顺序在下 → 次要的

t: vt&vi. 捐款，捐助；订阅；同意，赞成
en: to pay money, usually once a year, to have copies of a newspaper or magazine sent to you, or to have some other service

ex.en: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
ex.cn: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

syn: vi. 订阅；捐款；[经]认购；赞成；签署：sign, donate money
vt. 签署；赞成；捐助：ink, agree, sign, uphold
rm: sub(在…下面) + scrib(写) + e → 在下面写上名字 → 订阅， 订购

en: happening or coming after something else

ex.en: These skills were passed on to subsequent generations.
ex.cn: 这些技能代代相传。

ex.en: subsequent pages of the book
ex.cn: 接下去的书页

ph.cn: 财务报表编制后发生的事项

syn: adj. [地质]后来的，随后的：succeeding, pursuant
rm: sub(在…下面) + sequ(跟随) + ent → 继…之后的， 随后的

ex.en: After the heavy rains, part of the road subsided.
ex.cn: 大雨过后，部分路面塌陷了。

syn: vi. 平息；减弱；沉淀；坐下：fall, settle, lower, cool, deposit

t: adj. 辅助的；附属的；n. 子公司，附属机构

ex.cn: 一个附带假设

全资附属公司；全部控股子公司

syn: adj. 附属的；辅助的：assistant, helping, affiliated, auxiliary
n. 子公司；辅助者：auxiliary, subcompany
rm: sub(在…下面) + sid(坐) ＋ iary → 坐在下面的 → 次要的； 辅助的

en: money that is paid by a government or organization to make prices lower, reduce the cost of producing goods etc

ex.en: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
ex.cn: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

rm: sub(在…下面) + sid(坐) + y → 在台下就坐领津贴 → 津贴， 补助金

t: n. 专题论文集，讨论会
en: a formal meeting in which people who know a lot about a particular subject have discussions about it

ex.en: He had been taking part in an international symposium on population.
ex.cn: 他那时在参加一个有关人口的国际研讨会。

syn: n. 讨论会，座谈会；专题论文集；酒宴，宴会：forum, consultation, seminar

en: something wrong with your body or mind which shows that you have a particular illness

ex.en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
ex.cn: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

syn: n. [临床]症状；征兆：premonitor, prefiguration
rm: sym(一起) + pto(掉下) + m → 一起掉下来的 → 症状； 征候

t: v. 使同时发生，使同步发生
en: to happen at exactly the same time, or to arrange for two or more actions to happen at exactly the same time

ex.en: It was virtually impossible to synchronize our lives so as to take vacations and weekends together.
ex.cn: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。

syn: vi. 同步；同时发生：sync up, coincide

en: a word with the same meaning as another word in the same language

ex.en: The term "industrial democracy" is often used as a synonym for worker participation.
ex.cn: “工业民主”这一词语常被用作“工人参与”的同义词。

t: n. 合成法；综合，合成物
en: something that has been made by combining different things, or the process of combining things

ex.en: speech synthesis software
ex.cn: 语音合成软件

syn: n. 综合，[化学]合成；综合体：integration, comprehensiveness
rm: syn(共同) + thesis(论题) → 将相同的论题综合起来 → 综合

en: produced by combining different artificial substances, rather than being naturally produced

ex.en: synthetic chemicals
ex.cn: 合成化学品

syn: adj. 综合的；合成的，人造的：comprehensive, integrated, artificial, general
n. 合成物：composition

t: adj. 有系统的，系统的；有计划有步骤的
en: Something that is done in a systematic way is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way

ex.en: They went about their business in a systematic way.
ex.cn: 他们按部就班地做生意。

syn: adj. 系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情]分类的：scientific, classified
rm: 来自system(n. 系统)

en: a small round hard piece of medicine which you swallow

ex.en: She took a couple of headache tablets .
ex.cn: 她吃了几片头痛药。

syn: n. 碑；[药]药片；写字板；小块：wordpad, nubble

t: n. (宗教迷信)禁忌；adj. 禁忌的，禁止的
en: a custom that says you must avoid a particular activity or subject, either because it is considered offensive or because your religion does not allow it

ex.en: The topic of addiction remains something of a taboo in our family.
ex.cn: 毒瘾在我们家依然是个有些忌讳的话题。

syn: n. 禁忌；禁止：ban, don't
adj. 禁忌的；忌讳的：ticklish

en: tacit agreement, approval, support etc is given without anything actually being said

ex.en: a tacit agreement between the three big companies
ex.cn: 三家大公司之间的默契

syn: adj. 缄默的；不言而喻的：reserved, self-evident

en: to try to deal with a difficult problem

ex.en: There is more than one way to tackle the problem.
ex.cn: 解决这个问题不止一个办法。

ex.en: It took twelve fire engines to tackle the blaze .
ex.cn: 出动了12辆消防车来扑救那场大火。

syn: n. [机]滑车；装备；用具；扭倒：equipment, tool, arm, setup
vt. 处理；抓住；固定；与…交涉：grasp, root, cope with
rm: tack(钉) + le → 除去眼中钉 → 对付， 处理

ex.en: You have probably heard of this tactic before.
ex.cn: 你以前也可能听说过这个策略。

ex.en: I used every weapon and tactic I could think of.
ex.cn: 我用了我能想到的每一种武器和战术。

syn: n. 策略，战略：strategy, device

en: a small piece of paper, plastic etc attached to something to show what it is, who owns it, what it costs etc

ex.cn: 工作人员戴着姓名标签，对同僚直呼其名。

syn: n. 标签；名称；结束语；附属物：name, ticket, label, belonging
vt. 尾随，紧随；连接；起浑名；添饰：dog, shadow, couple

en: relating to or caused by heat

ex.en: thermal energy
ex.cn: 热能

ph.cn: 火力；火力发电；热功率；热电站
热稳定性，耐热性；热稳性

syn: adj. [热]热的，热量的：hot, heated, hottest
rm: therm(＝thermo热) + al → 热的

en: a piece of equipment that measures the temperature of the air, of your body etc

ex.en: The thermometer registered over 100˚C.
ex.cn: 温度计显示高于100摄氏度。

ph.cn: 红外测温仪；红外线温度计

syn: n. [仪]温度计；[医]体温计：temperature gauge, temperature meter

en: an instrument used for keeping a room or a machine at a particular temperature

ex.en: Turn off your thermostat when you’re not home.
ex.cn: 当你不在家的时候关掉恒温器。

ex.en: They"ll quickly adjust her thermostat to high heat.
ex.cn: 他们会很快调整自己恒温器到高热量。

syn: n. [自]恒温器；自动调温器：thermal cutout, attemperator

syn: n. 宝库；辞典；知识宝库；分类词汇汇编：treasury, treasure house

en: a long piece of writing about a particular subject that you do as part of an advanced university degree such as an MA or a PhD

ex.cn: 辛西娅还在写论文。

syn: n. 论文；论点：dissertation, tractate

en: the top part of your leg, between your knee and your  hip

ex.en: chicken thighs
ex.cn: 鸡腿

rm: 跑完步感觉大腿(thigh)肌肉紧绷(tight)

en: the feeling of wanting or needing a drink

ex.en: Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
ex.cn: 只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。

ex.en: We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
ex.cn: 我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。

vi. 渴望；口渴：rare, aspire

en: a sharp point that grows on the stem of a plant such as a rose

ex.en: a long, low hedge of thorns
ex.cn: 一长排矮矮的荆棘树篱

syn: n. [植]刺；荆棘：thrust, spine

en: including every possible detail

ex.cn: 医生给他做了一次全面的体检。

ex.en: a thorough and detailed biography
ex.cn: 详尽的传记

syn: adj. 彻底的；十分的；周密的：complete, radical

en: always thinking of the things you can do to make people happy or comfortable

ex.en: Paul is very thoughtful.
ex.cn: 保罗非常体贴人。

syn: adj. 深思的；体贴的；关切的：considerate

t: n. 门槛；开始；开端，入门
en: the entrance to a room or building, or the area of floor or ground at the entrance

ex.en: She opened the door and stepped across the threshold.
ex.cn: 她打开门，跨过门槛。

ex.en: Winning first place must have been quite a thrill.
ex.cn: 赢得第一名肯定让人非常激动。

ex.en: Even though I’ve been acting for years, I still get a thrill out of going on stage.
ex.cn: 尽管我演了多年戏，走上舞台我仍然感到十分激动。

syn: n. 激动；[医]震颤；紧张：intensity, stress, tension, warmth, excitation
vt. 使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动：tie oneself up in knots

en: to become very successful or very strong and healthy

ex.en: plants that thrive in tropical rain forests
ex.cn: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

ex.en: a business which managed to thrive during a recession
ex.cn: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

syn: vi. 繁荣，兴旺；茁壮成长：succeed, flower

en: the passage from the back of your mouth to the top of the tubes that go down to your lungs and stomach

ex.en: The singer complained of a sore throat after Wednesday’s show.
ex.cn: 星期三演出后，这位歌手说喉咙痛。

syn: n. 喉咙；嗓子，嗓音；窄路：organ, voice

ex.cn: “我不会得到安息的，”凯瑟琳哀哭着，感到她身体的衰弱，因为在这场过度的激动下，她的心猛烈地、不规则地跳动着，甚至跳得能觉察出来。

ex.en: Pan-Arabism -- of which the post-World War II independent state of Syria claimed to constitute the "throbbing-heart" -- became a substitute for Syria's very weak national identity.
ex.cn: 泛阿拉伯主义这个概念，系由二战后独立的叙利亚提出，主张组成一颗“悸动的心脏”，令其成为叙利亚国虚弱的民族认同的替代品。

n. 跳动，激动：warmth, excitation

t: n. 人群，群众；v. 拥挤，群集

ex.en: She got lost in the throng.
ex.cn: 她在人群中迷路了。

syn: n. 人群；众多：crowd, mass
vt. 群集；挤满：burst at the seams, be packed with

en: in every part of a particular area, place etc

ex.en: a large organization with offices throughout the world
ex.cn: 在世界各地都设有办事处的一家大型机构

ex.en: The disease spread rapidly throughout Europe.
ex.cn: 疾病迅速在整个欧洲蔓延开来。

syn: adv. 自始至终，到处；全部：everywhere, around, wholly, about
prep. 贯穿，遍及：over all

t: n. 猛推；冲锋，突击；推力
en: a sudden strong movement in which you push something forward

ex.en: He jumped back to avoid another thrust of the knife.
ex.cn: 他往后一闪，躲避再次捅来的一刀。

syn: n. [力]推力；刺：pushing force, spine
vt. 插；插入；推挤：build in, plug in

en: the part of your hand that is shaped like a thick short finger and helps you to hold things

ex.en: a baby sucking its thumb
ex.cn: 吮着大拇指的婴儿

ex.en: She held the coin carefully between finger and thumb.
ex.cn: 她小心翼翼地把那枚硬币捏在食指和拇指之间。

syn: vt. 翻阅；以拇指拨弄；作搭车手势；笨拙地摆弄：turn over, browse through

en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

ex.en: We were woken in the night by thunder.
ex.cn: 晚上我们被雷声惊醒。

syn: n. [气象]雷；轰隆声；恐吓：threat, intimidation
vi. 打雷；怒喝：fulminate

t: n. (钟表)滴答声；一刹那；v. 用勾作为记号

ex.en: I’ll be with you in a tick (= soon ) .
ex.cn: 我马上就来。

ex.en: It’ll only take two ticks.
ex.cn: 只要一会儿。

ph.cn: [口语]一会儿，一刹那间，一转眼间

vi. 发出滴答声；标以记号：tictoc

t: n. 潮汐，(舆论，公众情绪)潮流趋势
en: the regular rising and falling of the level of the sea

ex.en: Is the tide going out or coming in ?
ex.cn: 现在是退潮还是涨潮？

ex.en: We went for a walk and got cut off by the tide .
ex.cn: 我们去散步，结果被潮水困住了。

ex.cn: 她半透明的皮肤下青筋显现。

t: adj. 疲倦的，困乏的；令人厌倦的

ex.en: She found Rachel in the kitchen, looking old and weary.
ex.cn: 她发现雷切尔在厨房里，看上去苍老而疲惫。

ex.en: She sat down with a weary sigh.
ex.cn: 她疲倦地叹口气坐了下来。

syn: adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的；令人厌烦的：tired, worn, trying, boring, harassed
vi. 疲倦；厌烦：jade, be tired out

en: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket etc by crossing threads or thin pieces under and over each other by hand or on a loom

ex.en: hand-woven scarves
ex.cn: 手织围巾

ex.en: Only a few of the women still weave.
ex.cn: 只有数量很少的妇女还在编织。

ph.cn: 斜纹组织；斜纹织；斜织法

ex.en: He watched a spider spinning its web.
ex.cn: 他观察一只蜘蛛织网。

syn: n. 网；卷筒纸；蹼；织物；圈套：net, cloth, mesh, trap

t: n. 楔子，楔形物；v. 挤进；把楔住
en: a piece of wood, metal etc that has one thick edge and one pointed edge and is used especially for keeping a door open or for splitting wood

ex.en: Garnish with lemon wedges.
ex.cn: 用几角柠檬片作装饰。

syn: vt. 楔入；挤进；楔住：edge in, key on
vi. 楔入；挤进：edge in, key on
rm: 楔子(wedge)的边缘(edge)很尖锐

en: to remove unwanted plants from a garden or other place

ex.en: Caspar was weeding the garden.
ex.cn: 卡斯帕正在给花园除草。

syn: vt. 除草；铲除：shovel
n. [植]杂草，野草；菸草：fireweed, ruderal

ex.en: A really weird thing happened last night.
ex.cn: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

ex.en: He’s a weird bloke.
ex.cn: 他是个古怪的家伙。

en: to join metals by melting their edges and pressing them together when they are hot

ex.en: The new handle will have to be welded on.
ex.cn: 新的把手得焊上去。

t: n. 幸福，福利；社会保障
en: someone’s welfare is their health and happiness

ex.en: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
ex.cn: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

ph.cn: 社会福利；社会福利工作（等于social work）
公共福利，公用福利设施；社会福利

syn: n. 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁：happiness, weal

t: adj. 任何的，无论什么样的

en: used at the beginning of an official document to mean ‘because of a particular fact’

ex.en: He had never done anything for them, whereas they had done everything for him.
ex.cn: 他从未为他们做过任何事，反之他们却为他做了所有事。

syn: conj. 然而；鉴于；反之：however, while, nevertheless, but, yet

en: a situation in which two people, ideas, or statements agree with each other

ex.en: There was a silence as the women turned with one accord to stare at Doreen.
ex.cn: 那些女人一齐转身盯着多琳看，全场鸦雀无声。

syn: n. 符合；一致；协议；自愿：agreement, unity, identity, keeping, consensus
vt. 使一致；给予：afford, allow, deal, extend, deliver

t: n. 账目；帐户；计算；v. 说明
en: an arrangement in which a bank keeps your money safe so that you can pay more in or take money out

ex.en: My salary is paid into my bank account.
ex.cn: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

ex.en: I’ve opened an account with Barclay’s Bank.
ex.cn: 我在巴克莱银行开了一个账户。

ph.cn: 在某人帐上重视，	记帐
对…负有责任；对…做出解释；说明……的原因

syn: n. [会计]帐户；解释；帐目，帐单；理由：interpretation, explanation, construction, sake, reason
vi. 解释；导致；报帐：result in, to interpret
rm: ac(表加强) + count(数) → 账目需要一数再数 → 账

ex.cn: 但我同样认为，在这里发表评论的每一个人都应当受到问责：换而言之，在其发言时，我们其他人应当能够知道他们是谁。

syn: adj. 有责任的；有解释义务的；可解释的：responsible, liable

en: someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc

ex.en: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
ex.cn: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

ex.en: The accountant checked this unnecessary spending in good time.
ex.cn: 会计及时卡住了这笔不必要的开支。

ph.cn: 总会计师；会计主任，会计处长

rm: account(账目) + ant(表人) → 管账的人 → 会计师

ex.en: What is the moral of this fable? If you want to accumulate enduring wealth, do not lend to grasshoppers.
ex.cn: 这则故事的寓意是什么？如果你希望积累长久的财富，就不要借钱给蚱蜢。

ex.en: It is the business of the scientist to accumulate knowledge about the universe and all that is in it, and to find, if he is able, common factors which underlie and account for the facts that he knows.
ex.cn: 科学家要做的事就是积累有关宇宙和宇宙中的一切事物的知识, 而且要是可能的话, 找出那些既能构成科学家所知事实的基础, 又能解释这些事实的共同因素。

vt. 积攒：scrape up

en: to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad

ex.en: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
ex.cn: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

syn: vt. 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于：blame, law

en: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

ex.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
ex.cn: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

ex.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
ex.cn: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

syn: vt. 达到；完成：accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil
vi. 达到目的；如愿以偿：gain one's ends, Make it.

t: adj. 酸的；尖刻的；n. 酸

ex.cn: 一个多汁、略带酸味的苹果

syn: n. [化学]酸；<俚>迷幻药：acerbity
adj. [食品]酸的；讽刺的；刻薄的：sour, vinegary

ex.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
ex.cn: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

ex.en: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
ex.cn: 克莱尔承认有罪。

syn: vt. 承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到：accept, agree, recognize, grant, face

ex.cn: 我得熟悉一下新的规章制度。

syn: vt. 使熟悉；使认识：familiarize

en: to obtain something by buying it or being given it

ex.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
ex.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

ex.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
ex.cn: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

syn: vt. 获得；取得；学到；捕获：earn, buy, score, find, make
rm: ac(表加强) + quir(追求) + e → 不断追求才能够获得 → 获得， 取得

ex.en: the acquisition of language
ex.cn: 语言的习得

ph.cn: 数据采集系统；资料获取系统

syn: n. 获得物，获得：getting, procurement, winning

en: to make an electrical system or chemical process start working

ex.en: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
ex.cn: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

ex.en: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
ex.cn: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

syn: vt. 刺激；使活动；使活泼；使产生放射性：stimulate, fan, motivate, needle
rm: act(做) + iv + ate(使…) → 使活跃 → 激活

ex.en: She alleged that there was rampant drug use among the male members of the group.
ex.cn: 她指称该组织中有大量的男性成员吸毒。

syn: vt. 宣称，断言；提出…作为理由：declare, asseverate
rm: al(向) + leg(送) + e → 用力向某人寄送 → 断言， 宣称

en: loyalty to a leader, country, belief etc

ex.en: an oath of allegiance
ex.cn: 效忠宣誓

ex.en: The people here have strong political allegiances .
ex.cn: 这里的民众政治忠诚度很高。

syn: n. 效忠，忠诚；忠贞：loyalty, devotion

en: to make something less painful or difficult to deal with

ex.en: measures to alleviate poverty
ex.cn: 扶贫措施

syn: vt. 减轻，缓和：moderate, relax
rm: al + lev(轻) + iate → 减轻

ex.cn: 独立组织和联盟

星空联盟（全球最大的航空联盟）

syn: n. 联盟，联合；联姻：union, association, league, combined with, combination, unity

ex.cn: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

syn: vt. 分配；拨出；使坐落于：portion, part, appropriate

ex.en: The seats are allotted to the candidates who have won the most votes.
ex.cn: 这些席位被分配给了赢得了最多选票的候选人。

syn: vt. 分配；拨给；分派：portion, part

ex.en: Sales staff get a generous mileage allowance or a company car.
ex.cn: 销售人员有优厚的里程补贴或者公司提供的专用汽车。

ex.en: If you are entitled to sickness allowance, you must claim it from your employer.
ex.cn: 你如果有资格领取疾病津贴，必须向雇主申请索要。

syn: n. [劳经]津贴，零用钱；允许；限额：permission, quota, pension, subsidy
vt. 定量供应：ration
rm: allow(允许) + ance → 允许， 容忍

ex.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
ex.cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

syn: n. [材]合金：composition metal

ex.cn: 欧洲盟国会议

syn: n. 同盟国；伙伴；同盟者；助手：friend, partner, assistant, comrade, aid
vt. 使联盟；使联合：combine, associate
adj. 独自的；单独的；孤独的：independent, isolated, separate, sole
adv. 独自地；单独地：respectively, solely

ex.cn: 用其中一面墙壁旁边的白色书写板，如果有问题，你只要在那里写下你的名字。

syn: adv. 在旁边：aside

en: relating to the alphabet

ex.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order .
ex.cn: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。

syn: adj. 字母的；[计]依字母顺序的：abecedarian

ex.en: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
ex.cn: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

ex.en: The city centre has altered beyond recognition (=  changed very much  ) .
ex.cn: 市中心变得都认不出来了。

syn: vt. 改变，更改：influence, fashion, shift, vary, modify

ex.cn: 蓝红相间的条纹

ex.cn: 一层韭葱、一层面条地交替放置。

ex.en: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
ex.cn: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

ex.en: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
ex.cn: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

syn: n. 高地；高度；[数]顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级：height, raise, elevation, rise
rm: alt(高) + i ＋ tude(表状态， 名词后缀) → 海拔， 高度

en: someone who does an activity just for pleasure, not as their job

ex.en: a gifted amateur
ex.cn: 有天赋的业余爱好者

ex.en: Mickelson won his first major golf tournament while still an amateur.
ex.cn: 米克尔森还是业余选手时就赢得了他第一个高尔夫球锦标赛大奖。

syn: n. 爱好者；业余爱好者；外行：lover, fan
adj. 业余的；外行的：strange, leisure, lay

en: to surprise someone very much

ex.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
ex.cn: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

syn: vt. 使吃惊：take aback, take by surprise

en: a clear glass or plastic container for fish and other water animals

ex.en: In Amsterdam the girls all stand in the windows shimmering as tantalising as tropical fish beyond the gleam of aquarium glass.
ex.cn: 在阿姆斯特丹，姑娘们都站在窗后，光芒四射柔情撩人宛如水族馆玻璃背后脉脉含情的热带鱼。

t: adj. 水产的；(运行)水上的
en: living or growing in water

ex.cn: 水生植物

en: decided or arranged without any reason or plan, often unfairly

ex.en: an arbitrary decision
ex.cn: 武断的决定

ex.en: the arbitrary arrests of political opponents
ex.cn: 对政敌的任意逮捕

syn: adj. [数]任意的；武断的；专制的：artificial, random, absolute

en: a curved shape or line

ex.en: the arc of a rainbow
ex.cn: 彩虹的弧状

en: a structure with a curved top and straight sides that supports the weight of a bridge or building

ex.en: When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.
ex.cn: 从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。

adj. 主要的：primary, major, central, main, leading

t: adj. (语言、词汇等)古代的，已不通用的
en: old and no longer used

ex.en: archaic words
ex.cn: 古词

syn: adj. [语][生物]古代的；陈旧的；古体的；古色古香的：ancient, old

en: someone whose job is to design buildings

ex.en: James Madison was the principal architect of the constitution.
ex.cn: 詹姆斯·麦迪逊是该宪法的主设计师。

ph.cn: n. 造园技师；环境美化设计家
系统架构师；系统结构设计员

en: Archives are a collection of documents and records that contain historical information. You can also use archives to refer to the place where archives are stored.

ex.en: ...the State Library's archives.
ex.cn: …国立图书馆的档案。

syn: n. 档案，档案室；案卷（archive的复数）：records, portfolios

en: If you describe a place or the weather as arctic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely cold

ex.en: The bathroom, with its spartan pre-war facilities, is positively arctic.
ex.cn: 这个有简陋战前设施的浴室实在冷极了。

ex.en: ...winter in the Arctic.
ex.cn: …北极的冬天。

syn: adj. 北极的；极寒的：hyperboloidal, gelid
n. 北极圈；御寒防水套鞋：the Arctic Circle

en: showing strong positive feelings about an activity and determination to succeed at it

ex.en: an ardent supporter of free trade
ex.cn: 自由贸易的热心支持者

syn: adj. 热情的；热心的；激烈的；燃烧般的：intense, acute, warm, eager, tropical

en: involving a lot of strength and effort

ex.en: ...a long, hot and arduous trip.
ex.cn: …一段漫长、灼热、艰难的旅程。

syn: adj. 努力的；费力的；险峻的：hard, rapid, bold, struggling

en: a building with a large flat central area surrounded by seats, where sports or entertainments take place

ex.en: a sports arena
ex.cn: 运动场

ex.en: an indoor arena
ex.cn: 室内剧场

syn: n. 舞台；竞技场：stage, lists

en: to state, giving clear reasons, that something is true, should be done etc

ex.en: She argued the case for changing the law.
ex.cn: 她提出论据，力主修改法律。

ex.en: The researchers put forward a well-argued case for banning the drug.
ex.cn: 研究人员为禁止这种药提出了充足的论据。

syn: vi. 争论，辩论；提出理由：debate, dispute about
vt. 辩论，争论；证明；说服：debate, discuss, demonstrate, prove, satisfy

en: if a problem or difficult situation arises, it begins to happen

ex.en: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
ex.cn: 外交部出现了危机。

ex.en: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
ex.cn: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

syn: vi. 出现；上升；起立：occur, raise, figure, offer, come out

en: metal or leather clothing that protects your body, worn by soldiers in battles in past times

ex.en: a knight wearing a suit of armour
ex.cn: 全身披挂的骑士

syn: n. 盔甲；装甲；护面：mail, helmets

en: to wake someone

ex.en: His revolutionary work in linguistics has aroused intense scholarly interest.
ex.cn: 他在语言学方面的革命性著作引起了强烈的学术兴趣。
