vi. 激发；醒来；发奋：make someone tick, wake up

en: An array of objects is a collection of them that is displayed or arranged in a particular way

ex.en: We visited the local markets and saw wonderful arrays of fruit and vegetables.
ex.cn: 我们参观了当地的市场，看到了漂亮地摆放着的水果蔬菜。

syn: n. 数组，阵列；排列，列阵；大批，一系列；衣服：series of, clothes, thread, garment, ranging
vt. 排列，部署；打扮：dress oneself, rank, form
rm: ar + ray(光线) → 像光线一样整齐排列 → 陈列； 大批

en: behaving in an unpleasant or rude way because you think you are more important than other people

ex.en: He was unbearably arrogant.
ex.cn: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

ex.en: an arrogant attitude
ex.cn: 傲慢的态度

syn: adj. 自大的，傲慢的：haughty, cocky

en: one of the tubes that carries blood from your heart to the rest of your body

ex.en: ...Connecticut Ave., one of the main arteries of Washington.
ex.cn: …康涅狄格大道，华盛顿的主干道之一。

syn: n. [解剖]动脉；[公路]干道；主流：mainstream, backbone road
rm: 和vein(n. 静脉)一起记

en: Artillery consists of large, powerful guns that are transported on wheels and used by an army

ex.en: Using tanks and heavy artillery, they seized the town.
ex.cn: 他们使用坦克和重炮攻下了这座城市。

syn: n. [军]火炮；大炮；炮队；炮术：Cannons, ordnance

t: n. 物品；文章；条款；[语]冠词
en: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
ex.cn: 该报社论称政府软弱。

ex.en: newspaper articles
ex.cn: 报纸上的文章

ph.cn: 根据契约当学徒，依雇用契约工作着

syn: n. 文章；物品；[法]条款；[语]冠词：item, provision, clause

en: a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls down the side of a mountain

ex.en: Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
ex.cn: 两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

syn: n. [水文][地理]雪崩：slide, snowslide, lawine
vi. 崩塌：molder

en: to prevent something unpleasant from happening

ex.en: The tragedy could have been averted if the crew had followed safety procedures.
ex.cn: 如果乘务人员按照安全规则操作，这场悲剧是可以避免的。

syn: vt. 避免，防止；转移：escape, shift, shun

en: the science or practice of flying in aircraft

ex.en: ...the aviation industry.
ex.cn: …航空工业。

syn: n. [航]航空；飞行术；飞机制造业：avigation, airmanship
rm: avi(鸟) + at + ion(名词后缀) → 像鸟一样飞 → 航空， 飞行

en: to prevent something bad from happening

ex.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
ex.cn: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

ex.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
ex.cn: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

syn: vt. 避免；避开，躲避；消除：eliminate, escape, shun
rm: a(表加强) + void(空旷， 空虚) → 越来越空虚， 使人想躲开 → 躲开

en: if you are aware that a situation exists, you realize or know that it exists

ex.en: Mr Braley has been made aware of the need for absolute secrecy.
ex.cn: 布雷利先生被告知需要绝对保密。

ex.en: As you are aware, a fee will be charged annually.
ex.cn: 正如你所知道的那样，每年都要收取一笔费用。

syn: adj. 意识到的；知道的；有…方面知识的；懂世故的：conscious, sensible

t: adj. 可怕的；糟糕的；极度的
en: very bad or unpleasant

ex.en: The weather was awful.
ex.cn: 天气很糟糕。

ex.en: He is a pretty awful driver.
ex.cn: 他开车水平相当糟糕。

ph.cn: 气候恶劣；非常糟糕的天气

syn: adj. 可怕的，吓人的；糟糕的，糟透的（口语）；庄严的，威严的：terrible, august, horrible, awesome, fearful
adv. 十分，极其：extremely, full, most, rare

t: adj. 难使用的，笨拙的；尴尬的
en: making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say

ex.en: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
ex.cn: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

ex.en: There was an awkward moment when she didn’t know whether to shake his hand or kiss his cheek.
ex.cn: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

syn: adj. 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的：testing, embarrassed

en: the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns

ex.en: The Earth rotates on an axis between the north and south poles.
ex.cn: 地球绕着南北两极之间的地轴自转。

syn: n. 轴；轴线；轴心国：sheft, spindle

en: someone who is being considered for a job or is competing in an election

ex.en: a presidential candidate
ex.cn: 总统候选人

ph.cn: 合格的候选人；合资格人员

syn: n. 候选人，候补者；应试者：examinee
rm: can(能) + did(做) + ate → 踏实能干才能当候选人 → 候选人

en: a long thin stick with a curved handle that you can use to help you walk

ex.en: Children knew that if they misbehaved they would get the cane .
ex.cn: 孩子们知道，如果调皮捣蛋的话就会挨藤条。

syn: n. 手杖；藤条；细长的茎：walking stick, canne

en: a large heavy powerful gun that was used in the past to fire heavy metal balls

ex.en: The cannons boom, the band plays.
ex.cn: 炮声隆隆，鼓乐齐鸣。

ph.cn: 我行我素不顾后果的人

syn: n. 大炮；[军]加农炮；榴弹炮；机关炮：artillery gun, ordnance
vi. 炮轰；开炮：fire a gun
rm: “加农”

t: n. 食堂；小卖部；餐具箱；水壶
en: a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply

ex.en: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
ex.cn: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

syn: n. 食堂，小卖部；水壶：mess, refectory
rm: “看停” → 小孩一看到餐厅就停下不走了 → 餐厅

en: strong cloth used to make bags, tents, shoes etc

ex.en: a canvas bag
ex.cn: 帆布包

ph.cn: (拳击等中)被击倒在地；即将失败

syn: n. [纺]帆布：sailcloth

t: n. 容量；容积；理解力；地位；资格
en: the amount of space a container, room etc has to hold things or people

ex.en: The room had seating capacity for about 80.
ex.cn: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

ex.en: The orchestra played to a capacity crowd (= the largest number of people who can fit into a hall, theatre etc ) .
ex.cn: 管弦乐队为满场的观众演奏。

ph.cn: 承载量；结果能力；产仔能力

syn: n. 能力；[物]容量；资格，地位；生产力：ability, competence, membership, status, productivity
rm: cap(拿住) + ac + ity(表状态、 情况， 名词后缀) → 能拿住 → 能力

en: a large piece of land surrounded on three sides by water

ex.en: Cape Cod
ex.cn: 科德角

ph.cn: 开普敦（等于Capetown，南非西南部港市）
卡纳维拉尔角（位于美国）

syn: n. [地理]海角，岬；披肩：ness, promontory

t: n. 资本，大写字母；首都；adj. 可处死刑的
en: an important city where the main government of a country, state etc is

ex.en: Washington D.C., the capital of the United States
ex.cn: 美国首都华盛顿特区

syn: n. 首都，省会；[会计]资金；大写字母；资本家：fund, upper case
adj. 首都的；重要的；大写的：crucial, important, considerable, material, big

t: n. 荚；装一剂药的小囊；密封舱
en: a plastic container shaped like a very small tube with medicine inside that you swallow whole

ex.en: a space capsule orbiting the Earth
ex.cn: 沿地球轨道飞行的太空舱

ph.cn: [口语]概括地说，简单扼要地讲

syn: n. [药]胶囊；[植]蒴果；太空舱；小容器：micella
adj. 压缩的；概要的：compressive, constringent
rm: cap(帽子) + sule(音似： seal，“密封”) → 帽状物 → 胶囊； 密封舱

t: n. 报纸文章的标题；照片说明
en: A caption is the words printed underneath a picture or cartoon which explain what it is about

ex.en: The local paper featured me standing on a stepladder with a caption, "Wendy climbs the ladder to success."
ex.cn: 当地的报纸刊登了一幅我站在活梯上的特写，下面写着：“温迪登上了成功之梯。”

syn: n. [语][计][图情]标题；字幕；说明；逮捕：explanation, notes, title, legend, heading

t: n&a. 俘虏，迷恋者；被俘虏的，被拴住的
en: someone who is kept as a prisoner, especially in a war

ex.en: He described the difficulties of surviving for four months as a captive.
ex.cn: 他讲述了沦为阶下囚的4个月中生存的种种不易。

ph.cn: 受制而走不开的听众或观众

syn: adj. 被俘虏的；被迷住的：spellbound
n. 俘虏；迷恋者：prisoner
rm: capt(抓住) + ive → 被抓住的， 被捕获的

t: vt&n. 捕获，俘虏，夺得；战利品
en: to catch a person and keep them as a prisoner

ex.en: Government troops have succeeded in capturing the rebel leader.
ex.cn: 政府军已经成功抓获叛乱分子的头目。

ex.en: 40 captured French soldiers
ex.cn: 40名被俘虏的法国士兵

syn: vt. [物]俘获；夺得：snatch
n. 捕获；战利品，俘虏：taking, prize, acquiring
rm: capt(抓住) + ure(表行为) → 抓住 → 捕获， 俘获

t: adj. 主要的，基本的；n. 深红色；基数
en: very important or basic

ex.en: Having clean hands is one of the cardinal rules when preparing food.
ex.cn: 双手洁净是准备食物时的一项最基本要求。

ex.en: an issue of cardinal importance
ex.cn: 至关重要的问题

syn: adj. 主要的，基本的；深红色的：primary, elementary, major, fundamental, basic
n. 红衣主教；枢机主教；鲜红色：conclavist, red hat

en: information that is clearly arranged in the form of a simple picture, set of figures,  graph  etc, or a piece of paper with this information on it

ex.en: a chart showing last year’s sales
ex.cn: 显示去年销售情况的一份图表

ex.en: a weather chart
ex.cn: 天气图

syn: n. 图表；海图；图纸：graph, diagram

t: n&v. 特许状，凭照，宪章；租赁；v. 特许
en: a signed statement from a government or ruler which allows a town, organization, or university to officially exist and have special rights

ex.en: The town’s charter was granted in 1838.
ex.cn: 该镇的特许状是1838年颁发的。

ph.cn: 佣船契约；包船契约；租船方

syn: vt. 特许；[车辆][航]包租；发给特许执照：license
n. 宪章；执照；特许状：license, patent, permit

en: to quickly follow someone or something in order to catch them

ex.en: The dogs saw him running and chased him.
ex.cn: 那些狗看到他在跑就追他。

ex.en: kids chasing around the house
ex.cn: 在屋里追逐嬉戏的孩子们

ph.cn: 开门见山；提到关键问题；转入（或切入）正题

syn: vt. 追逐；追捕；试图赢得；雕镂：go after, track down
vi. 追逐；追赶；奔跑：pursue, go after
rm: 谁动了我的奶酪(cheese)， 我就去追(chase)谁

t: n. 断层，裂口；巨大分歧，差别
en: a big difference between two people, groups, or things

ex.en: a rope bridge across the chasm
ex.cn: 峡谷上的索桥

syn: n. 峡谷；裂口；分歧；深坑：canyon, pit, variance

t: adj. 有道德的；善良的；贞洁的；简朴的
en: not having sex with anyone, or not with anyone except your husband or wife

ex.en: She led a chaste decent life.
ex.cn: 她过着贞洁正派的生活。

syn: adj. 纯洁的；贞洁的；有道德的；朴素的：stainless, pure, white, plain

en: an informal friendly conversation

ex.en: She was enjoying their friendly little chat .
ex.cn: 她很喜欢他们那种友好的闲聊。

ex.en: She used to drop in for a chat quite often.
ex.cn: 她以前常常会过来聊聊天。

syn: vi. 聊天；闲谈：visit with, chew the fat
n. 聊天；闲谈：chinwag, chit-chat

en: to do something in order to find out whether something really is correct, true, or in good condition

ex.en: Check the tiles carefully before you buy them.
ex.cn: 购买之前要把瓷砖仔细检查一下。

ex.en: A first rule in solving any mystery is to check the facts.
ex.cn: 揭开谜团的第一条规则是核查事实。

syn: vt. 检查；制止；寄存：examine, inspect, review, park
n. [金融]支票；阻止；阻止物：prevention, cheque

en: a general medical examination that a doctor or  dentist  gives you to make sure you are healthy

ex.en: It’s important to have regular checkups .
ex.cn: 定期做体检是很重要的。

syn: n. 审查，检查；健康检查：inspection, monitoring

en: a shout of happiness, praise, approval, or encouragement

ex.en: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
ex.cn: 人群中爆发出巨大的欢呼声。

ex.en: So let’s give a cheer to the kids who passed their exams.
ex.cn: 那么我们为通过考试的孩子们欢呼吧。

ph.cn: 使高兴；高兴起来；使振奋

syn: vt. 欢呼；使高兴；为…加油：please, glad, satisfy
n. 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事：sunshine, breast, applause, brightness

t: v. 爱护，抱有(希望)；怀有(情感)
en: If you cherish someone or something, you take good care of them because you love them

ex.en: He genuinely loved and cherished her.
ex.cn: 他真爱并珍惜过她。

syn: vt. 珍爱；怀抱：treasure, imbosom

en: to bite food several times before swallowing it

ex.en: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
ex.cn: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

syn: n. 咀嚼；咀嚼物：mastication, quid
vt. 嚼碎，咀嚼：masticate
n. 时髦；别致的款式：stylishness, trendiness
adj. 别致的：picturesque

t: n. 领袖，部门主任；adj. 主要的，首席的
en: highest in rank

ex.en: Most health chiefs believe the reforms have gone too far.
ex.cn: 大多数卫生部领导人都觉得改革搞得过火了。

ph.cn: 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
主要地，尤其；在首席地位

syn: n. 首领；酋长；主要部分：leader, captain, boss
adj. 首席的；主要的；主任的：primary, major, central, leading, great

t: n&a&v. 寒冷，扫兴的，(使)感冒
en: a feeling of coldness

ex.en: There was a slight chill in the air .
ex.cn: 空气中有些微的寒意。

ex.en: I turned on the heater in the hall to take the chill off the house (= to heat it slightly ) .
ex.cn: 我开了厅里的暖气给屋子驱寒。

syn: n. 寒冷；寒意；寒心：cold, algor
adj. 寒冷的；冷漠的；扫兴的：cold, distant
rm: c + hill(小山) → 山上 → 高处不胜寒 → 寒冷

en: the front part of your face below your mouth

ex.en: He rubbed his chin thoughtfully.
ex.cn: 他若有所思地抚摸着下巴。

syn: n. 下巴；聊天；引体向上动作：chat, jaw
vi. 闲谈；作引体向上动作：visit, dish

t: n. 片屑，薄片；集成电路；v. 削,铲,形成缺口"
en: a small piece of  silicon  that has a set of complicated electrical connections on it and is used to store and  process  information in computers

ex.en: the age of the silicon chip
ex.cn: 芯片时代

ex.en: chip technology
ex.cn: 芯片技术

ph.cn: 蓝筹股；优值股票；高值筹码

syn: vt. 削，凿；削成碎片：pele, whittle
vi. 剥落；碎裂：shell, flake off
rm: 大家对KFC的炸薯条(fried chips)一定不陌生

en: a metal tool with a sharp edge, used to cut wood or stone

ex.en: He set out to chisel a dog out of sandstone.
ex.cn: 他开始用凿子将砂岩雕刻成一只狗。

syn: vt. 雕，刻；[木]凿；欺骗：chip, sell, character
vi. 雕，刻；[木]凿；欺骗：kid, pull a fast one

en: a group of people who sing together for other people to listen to

ex.en: He joined a church choir at the age of eight.
ex.cn: 他八岁时加入了一个教堂唱诗班。

syn: n. 唱诗班；合唱队；舞蹈队：chorus
vt. 合唱：chorus

ex.en: Weeds were choking the stream.
ex.cn: 野草将溪流堵塞了。

syn: vt. 呛；使窒息；阻塞；抑制；扑灭：control, stay, restrain
vi. 窒息；阻塞；说不出话来：plug up, block up

t: adj. 殖民地的，关于殖民的；n. 殖民地居民
en: relating to a country that controls and rules other countries, usually ones that are far away

ex.en: the struggle against colonial rule
ex.cn: 反抗殖民统治的斗争

ex.en: Britain was the largest colonial power .
ex.cn: 英国曾是最大的殖民强国。

en: a country or area that is under the political control of a more powerful country, usually one that is far away

ex.en: Algeria was formerly a French colony.
ex.cn: 阿尔及利亚以前是法国的殖民地。

syn: n. 殖民地；移民队：settlements
rm: col(耕种) + on + y(表场所， 名词后缀) → 在某处耕种 → 将那里变为自己的殖民地 → 殖民地

en: used to emphasize that something is extremely large

ex.en: a colossal statue of the King
ex.cn: 国王的巨大雕像

ex.en: This whole holiday was a colossal waste of money.
ex.cn: 这次度假浪费了大量的钱财。

syn: adj. 巨大的；异常的，非常的：huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro, intense

t: n. 柱; 柱状物；书报上的栏；纵列
en: a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a decoration

ex.en: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
ex.cn: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

syn: n. 纵队，[数]列；专栏；圆柱，柱形物：pillar, tier

en: fighting, especially during a war

ex.en: We flew over 200 combat missions in the war.
ex.cn: 我们在战争中执行过两百多次战斗飞行任务。

ex.en: training in unarmed combat
ex.cn: 徒手格斗训练

syn: vt. 反对；与…战斗：sit down on, to oppose
vi. 战斗；搏斗：fight, conflict
rm: com(共同) + bat(打) → 战斗， 搏斗

t: v. 联合；连结；n. 集团，联合企业
en: if you combine two or more different things, or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together

ex.en: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
ex.cn: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

ex.en: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
ex.cn: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

syn: vt. 使化合；使联合，使结合：bond, associate
vi. 联合，结合；化合：band, bond, couple, become one, connect
rm: com(共同) + bi(两个) + ne → 使两个在一起 → 联合， 结合

t: adj. 易燃的，可燃的；n. 易燃物，可燃物
en: able to burn easily

ex.en: The ability of coal to release a combustible gas has long been known.
ex.cn: 煤能够释放易燃气体这一点早已为人所知。

syn: adj. [化工]易燃的；易激动的；燃烧性的：emotional, flammable
n. [化工]可燃物；易燃物：tinderbox, burnable

t: v. 来，达到；开始；出现；成为
en: to move towards you or arrive at the place where you are

ex.en: Let me know when they come.
ex.cn: 他们来了就告诉我。

ex.en: Can you come here for a minute?
ex.cn: 你到这里来一会儿好吗？

ph.cn: 回来；记起；恢复原状，重新流行

syn: vi. 来；开始；出现；发生；变成；到达：occur, happen, proceed, become, figure
vt. 做；假装；将满（…岁）：simulate, doest

en: something that you allow someone to have in order to end an argument or a disagreement

ex.en: The British were not prepared to make any concessions .
ex.cn: 英国人没有打算作出让步。

ph.cn: 特许经营权合约；租让制合同

syn: n. 让步；特许（权）；承认；退位：recognition, license
rm: con(共同) + cess(行走， 前进) + ion → 要想大家共同进步， 必须都做出让步 → 让步

en: short, with no unnecessary words

ex.en: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
ex.cn: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。

syn: adj. 简明的，简洁的：brief, compact

en: to invent a clever story, excuse, or plan, especially in order to deceive someone

ex.en: John concocted an elaborate excuse for being late.
ex.cn: 约翰为迟到编了一个巧妙的借口。

syn: vt. 捏造；混合而制；调合；图谋：manufacture, trump up

t: n. 混凝土；adj. 有形的；具体的；v. 浇混凝土于
en: a substance used for building that is made by mixing sand, small stones,  cement  , and water

ex.en: The posts have to be set in concrete.
ex.cn: 这些柱子必须固定在混凝土中。

ph.cn: 混凝土结构；具体结构；混凝土建造物

syn: adj. [建]混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的：honest, effective, real
vi. 凝结：to freeze, clot
rm: con + cre(产生) + te → 产生(事物) → 具体存在的事物 → 实在的； 具体的

t: v. 谴责，迫使；判刑；宣告(建筑)不宜使用
en: to say very strongly that you do not approve of something or someone, especially because you think it is morally wrong

ex.en: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
ex.cn: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

syn: vt. 谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨：denounce, deplore
rm: con(共同) + dem(伤害； 诅咒) + n → 极力谴责

en: if a gas condenses, or is condensed, it becomes a liquid

ex.en: the mist which condensed on every cold surface
ex.cn: 每个冰冷的表面上凝结的水汽

syn: vi. 浓缩；凝结：concentrate, to freeze
vt. 使浓缩；使压缩：dewater, inspissate
rm: con + dense(密集的) → 变得密集的 → (使)压缩

t: n. 条件，状况，环境；v. 决定；支配；训练
en: the situation in which people live or work, especially the physical things that affect the quality of their lives

ex.en: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
ex.cn: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

ex.en: In May, staff went on strike, demanding better pay and conditions .
ex.cn: 五月份员工举行了罢工，要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

syn: n. [数]条件；情况；环境；身分：circumstance, situation, context, qualification, thing
vt. 使适应；使健康；决定；以…为条件：adapt, suit, season, conclude

en: sympathy for someone who has had something bad happen to them, especially when someone has died

ex.en: a letter of condolence
ex.cn: 吊唁信

syn: n. 哀悼；慰问：sympathy, consolation

t: adj. 有助于的；有益于的
en: if a situation is conducive to something such as work, rest etc, it provides conditions that make it easy for you to work etc

ex.en: an environment conducive to learning
ex.cn: 有助于学习的环境

syn: adj. 有益的；有助于…的：beneficial, helpful, useful, advantageous, profitable

t: v. 授予(称号，学位等)；协商
en: to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved

ex.en: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
ex.cn: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

syn: vt. 授予；给予：afford, award, allow, grant, deal
vi. 协商：arrange, treat

en: to admit something that you feel embarrassed about

ex.en: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
ex.cn: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

syn: vt. 承认；坦白；忏悔；[法]供认：accept, recognize, agree, acknowledge, grant
vi. 承认；坦白；忏悔；[法]供认：accept, recognize

t: n. 信任，信心，自信；adj. 骗得信任的
en: the feeling that you can trust someone or something to be good, work well, or produce good results

ex.en: I felt I was doing well and my confidence began to grow.
ex.cn: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

syn: n. 信心；信任；秘密：faith, trust, secret, privacy, hope

en: sure that something will happen in the way that you want or expect

ex.en: Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
ex.cn: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

syn: adj. 自信的；确信的：sure, convinced, assured

en: spoken or written in secret and intended to be kept secret

ex.en: a confidential government report
ex.cn: 一份机密的政府报告

ex.en: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
ex.cn: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

ph.cn: 机密数据；保密资料；机密资料

syn: adj. [管理]机密的；表示信任的；获信任的：classified, secret

en: the shape or arrangement of the parts of something

ex.en: ...Stonehenge, in southwestern England, an ancient configuration of giant stones.
ex.cn: …史前巨石柱群，位于英国西南部，是一座古代巨石阵列。

syn: n. 配置；结构；外形：allocation, mechanics, framework, profile, texture
rm: con + figur(e)(形状) + ation → 轮廓， 外形

en: to keep someone or something within the limits of a particular activity or subject

ex.en: Vaughan is confined to a wheelchair .
ex.cn: 沃恩离不开轮椅。

syn: n. 界限，边界：boundary, border
vt. 限制；禁闭：block, set a limit to
rm: con(表加强) + fin(界限) + e → 限制； 管制

ex.en: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones.
ex.cn: X光片已经证实他没有骨折。

syn: vt. 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固：identify, favor, sustain, validate
rm: con(表加强) + firm(坚固的) → 使更加坚固 → 证实； 肯定

t: n. 战斗；斗争；意见(分歧)
en: fighting or a war

ex.en: efforts to resolve the conflict
ex.cn: 解决武装冲突的努力

syn: n. 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执：interference, difference, war, battle, collision
vi. 冲突，抵触；争执；战斗：combat, collide with
rm: con(共同) + flict(击， 打) → 互相打 → 冲突， 抵触

en: to obey a law, rule etc

ex.en: the pressure on schoolchildren to conform
ex.cn: 小学生要顺应社会的压力

syn: vi. 符合；遵照；适应环境：accord, meet with
vt. 使遵守；使一致；使顺从：accord, reconcile
rm: con(共同) + form(形状) → 形状相同 → 相一致

en: if a problem, difficulty etc confronts you, it appears and needs to be dealt with

ex.en: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
ex.cn: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

syn: vt. 面对；遭遇；比较：front, compare
rm: con(一起) + front(额头， 脸) → 一起对顶额头 → 遭遇； 面对

t: n. 会议，协定；惯例；习俗
en: a large formal meeting for people who belong to the same profession or organization or who have the same interests

ex.en: a teachers’ convention
ex.cn: 教师大会

ex.en: the city’s new convention center
ex.cn: 该市新建的会议中心

ph.cn: 国际惯例；国际公约；国际协定
n. 会议中心；会展中心
全国代表大会（美国政党为总统候选人提名而召开）；国民公会（指1792－1795年间的法国议会）

syn: n. 大会；[法]惯例；[计]约定；协定；习俗：tradition, usage, institution, appointment, bond
rm: con(共同) + vent(来) + ion → 大家共同来到 → 大会， 会议

en: to come from different directions and meet at the same point to become one thing

ex.en: The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
ex.cn: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

syn: vi. 聚合；集中于一点：group, gather together
vt. 会聚；使聚集；使向一点会合：cluster

en: used when one situation is the opposite of another

ex.en: American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
ex.cn: 美国的消费者喜欢白色的鸡蛋，而英国的消费者却相反，他们喜欢棕色的鸡蛋。

syn: adv. 相反地：contrary, counter, backward, inversely
rm: con + vers(转) + e ＋ ly → 转过去 → 相反地， 颠倒地

t: n. 变换，转化，改变；兑换
en: when you change something from one form, purpose, or system to a different one

ex.en: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes.
ex.cn: …把废弃的铁路改变成自行车道。

syn: n. 转换；变换；[金融]兑换；改变信仰：transformation, reforming, switching, exchange, changing
rm: con + vers(转) + ion → 转化； 转变

t: v. 转变，兑换；使改变信仰
en: to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way

ex.en: a 19th-century converted barn
ex.cn: 由19世纪谷仓改建的房子

syn: vi. 转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰：transform, shift
n. 皈依者；改变宗教信仰者：idolater, proselytizer
rm: con(完全地) + vert(转) → 完全转变 → (使)转变， (使)转化

en: to communicate or express something, with or without using words

ex.en: All this information can be conveyed in a simple diagram.
ex.cn: 所有这些信息可以通过一张简单的图表来表示。

ex.en: Ads convey the message that thin is beautiful.
ex.cn: 广告传递的信息是: 瘦就是美。

syn: vt. 传达；运输；让与：communicate, release, transport
rm: con + vey(搬运) → 传送， 运送

t: v. 证明有罪；n. 罪犯
en: to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court

ex.en: a convicted murderer
ex.cn: 已定罪的谋杀犯

syn: n. 罪犯：criminal offender, culprit

en: a very strong belief or opinion

ex.en: It was a reasonable explanation, but his voice lacked conviction .
ex.cn: 这解释合情合理，只是他的语气不坚定。

syn: n. 定罪；确信；证明有罪：assurance, damningness

en: to make someone feel certain that something is true

ex.en: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
ex.cn: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

syn: vt. 说服；使确信，使信服：assure, reason, satisfy, argue
rm: con(完全) + vinc(征服， 克服) + e → 彻底征服对方 → 说服

en: to work with someone else to achieve something that you both want

ex.en: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
ex.cn: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

syn: vi. 合作，配合；协力：fit, work together
rm: co(共同) + oper(工作) + ate → 一起工作 → 合作， 协作

en: to organize an activity so that the people involved in it work well together and achieve a good result

ex.en: The agencies are working together to co-ordinate policy on food safety.
ex.cn: 这些机构在共同合作为食品安全政策做协调工作。

syn: adj. 并列的；[物化]同等的：paratactic, tantamount
vt. 调整；整合：adjust, restructure
rm: co(共同) + ordin(顺序) + ate(使…) → 使…顺序一致 → 协调

en: friendly but quite polite and formal

ex.en: The talks were conducted in a cordial atmosphere.
ex.cn: 会谈在友好的气氛中进行。

syn: adj. 热忱的，诚恳的；兴奋的：genuine, heady
n. 补品；兴奋剂；甜香酒，甘露酒：a shot in the arm, agonist

t: n. 软木；adj. 软木制的；v. 塞住，抑制
en: the  bark (= outer part )  of a tree from southern Europe and North Africa, used to make things

ex.en: a cork bulletin board
ex.cn: 软木公告板

syn: n. [木]软木塞，软木制品；软木：soft wood
vt. 抑制，堵住；用软木塞塞住：control, restrain, stay
rm: “犒客” → 犒劳客人 → 打开酒(瓶上的软木塞)犒劳客人 → 软木塞

t: adj. 社团的；法人的；共同的
en: shared by or involving all the members of a group

ex.en: corporate responsibility
ex.cn: 共同的责任

ph.cn: 公司治理；企业管治，企业治理；公司管治

syn: adj. [法]法人的；共同的，全体的；社团的：mutual, entire, common, collective, universal
rm: corp(身体) + or + ate → 团体的

t: n. 市镇自治机关；法人；公司
en: a big company, or a group of companies acting together as a single organization

ex.en: He works for a large American corporation.
ex.cn: 他在一家美国大公司工作。

ex.en: multinational corporations
ex.cn: 跨国公司

syn: n. [贸易]公司；法人（团体）；社团；大腹便便；市政当局：establishment, company, society, association, league

t: n. 尸体；被废弃的东西
en: the dead body of a person

ex.en: The corpse was found by children playing in the woods.
ex.cn: 这具尸体是在林子里玩耍的孩子发现的。

syn: n. 尸体：lich, carcass, Corse, ptoma

en: a trained army unit made of two or more  divisions (= groups of soldiers )

ex.en: the medical corps
ex.cn: 医疗部队

syn: n. 军团；兵种；兵队；（德国大学的）学生联合会：cohorts, legion
rm: 和cops(警察)一起记， 两者都是国家的防卫力量

en: if two or more facts, ideas etc correlate or if you correlate them, they are closely connected to each other or one causes the other

ex.en: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
ex.cn: 试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

ph.cn: 找出一一对应的关系；使…与…发生关系

syn: n. 相关物；相关联的人：relative
adj. 关联的：associated

en: if two things or ideas correspond, the parts or information in one relate to the parts or information in the other

ex.en: The two halves of the document did not correspond.
ex.cn: 这份文件的前后两部分不相符。

syn: vi. 符合，一致；相应；通信：cotton, identify, square, accord, meet with
rm: cor(共同) + re(又， 再) + spond(回答， 约定) → 又作出相同的反应 → 相一致， 符合

en: the process of sending and receiving letters

ex.en: The magazine is unable to enter into any correspondence on medical matters.
ex.cn: 本杂志无法答复有关医学方面的来信。

ex.en: All correspondence between us must cease.
ex.cn: 我们之间的所有通信必须停止。

syn: n. 通信；一致；相当：accordance, communication, unity, agreement, identity

en: someone who is employed by a newspaper or a television station etc to report news from a particular area or on a particular subject

ex.en: Our correspondent in South Africa sent this report.
ex.cn: 我们的驻南非记者发来这份报道。

ph.cn: 往来行；代理银行；通汇银行
报社派驻国外的通讯记者

syn: n. 通讯记者；客户；通信者；代理商行：client server software, client server relationship

en: the ability to achieve what you want by deceiving people in a clever way

ex.en: the tiger’s ferocity and cunning
ex.cn: 老虎的凶猛和狡诈

ex.en: She would use low cunning (= unpleasant dishonest methods ) to win people’s sympathy.
ex.cn: 她会耍卑鄙的花招来博得别人的同情。

syn: adj. 狡猾的；巧妙的；可爱的：happy, lovely, designing, knowing, pretty
n. 狡猾：artfulness, subtility

en: a piece of furniture with doors, and sometimes shelves, used for storing clothes, plates, food etc

ex.en: It’s in the kitchen cupboard.
ex.cn: 它在厨房的碗柜里。

ex.en: The cupboard doors were open.
ex.cn: 柜门开着。

ph.cn: （尤指小孩的）有所企图而假装的热情

syn: n. [家具]碗柜；食橱：dresser, spense

t: n&v. 勒马的皮带；控制，约束
en: to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect

ex.en: measures to curb the spread of the virus
ex.cn: 控制病毒扩散的措施

ph.cn: n. 场外交易市场；股票证券场外交易市场

syn: n. 抑制；路边；勒马绳：checking, control, restraint, suppression, inhibition
vt. 控制；勒住：possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle

t: v. 治愈；加工处理；n. 治愈，疗法；对策
en: to make an illness or medical condition go away

ex.en: Many types of cancer can now be cured.
ex.cn: 现在许多癌症都可以治好。

ex.en: an operation that can cure short-sightedness in 15 minutes
ex.cn: 15分钟就可治愈近视的一种手术

syn: vt. [临床]治疗；治愈；[化学]使硫化；加工处理：help, remedy
vi. 治病；痊愈；[临床]受治疗；[化学]被硫化；被加工处理：heal up

t: n. 卷毛；卷发；v. 使卷曲
en: a piece of hair that hangs in a curved shape

ex.en: a little boy with beautiful blonde curls
ex.cn: 满头漂亮的金色鬈发的小男孩

ex.en: She has hair that refuses to curl.
ex.cn: 她的头发怎么也不卷。

syn: vi. [纸]卷曲；盘绕：crisp
n. [纸]卷曲；卷发；螺旋状物：wave, wavy hair

en: the system or type of money that a country uses

ex.en: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
ex.cn: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

ex.en: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
ex.cn: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

syn: n. [金融]货币；通货：money, circulating medium

t: adj. 当前的；通用的；流行的；n. 水流；气流
en: happening or existing now

ex.en: the current President
ex.cn: 现任总统

ex.en: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
ex.cn: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

ph.cn: 现行状态；初速电流状态

syn: adj. 现在的；流通的，通用的；最近的；草写的：recent, now, universal, late, present
n. （水，气，电）[流]流；趋势；涌流：tendency, direction, tide, trend, set

en: the subjects that are taught by a school, college etc, or the things that are studied in a particular subject

ex.en: Languages are an essential part of the school curriculum.
ex.cn: 语言是学校课程中必不可少的部分。

ex.en: curriculum planning
ex.cn: 课程安排

t: n. 诅咒，祸因，骂人话；v. 咒骂，被所苦
en: a swear word or words that you say because you are very angry

ex.en: He muttered a curse under his breath.
ex.cn: 他低声骂了一句。

syn: n. 诅咒；咒骂：oath, anathema
vt. 诅咒；咒骂：drat, beshrew

en: to reduce or limit something

ex.en: The new law will curtail police powers.
ex.cn: 这条新法规将削弱警方的权力。

syn: vt. 缩减；剪短；剥夺…特权等：crop, to cut back
rm: cur(关注) + tail(切割) → 专注地切短 → 缩短， 削减

t: n. 曲线；v. 弄弯,；n. 成曲线
en: a line that gradually bends like part of a circle

ex.en: The curve illustrates costs per capita.
ex.cn: 这条曲线显示人均费用。

syn: n. [数]曲线；弯曲；曲线球；曲线图表：give, winding
vt. 弯；使弯曲：wind, bend

t: n. 垫子，坐垫，垫状物；v. 装垫子；缓冲
en: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put on a chair or the floor to make it more comfortable

ex.en: a velvet cushion
ex.cn: 天鹅绒垫子

ex.en: a cushion cover
ex.cn: 垫子套

syn: n. [轻]垫子；起缓解作用之物；（猪等的）臀肉；银行储蓄：gaddi, mat

t: n. 保管人，监护人；公共建筑看守
en: someone who is responsible for looking after something important or valuable

ex.en: a custodian at the stadium
ex.cn: 体育场看门人

syn: n. [经管]管理人；监护人；保管人：administrator, supervisor

t: n. 习俗，惯例；光顾；海关
en: something that is done by people in a particular society because it is traditional

ex.en: He awoke early, as was his custom.
ex.cn: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

ph.cn: 定做的，非现成的；定制品

syn: n. 习惯；风俗；海关：manner, habit, way
adj. 定制的，定做的：made-to-order, tailored

en: something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done

ex.en: Barbara answered with her customary enthusiasm.

ex.cn: 中西部是美国的粮仓。

ex.en: Every journey has its low point, and ours was the granary of France, known as the Beauce.
ex.cn: 每次旅行都有低潮，我们的低潮是在贝奥斯，这里是有名的法兰西谷仓。

syn: n. [粮食]谷仓，粮仓；盛产粮食的地区：barn

t: adj. 最重大的；豪华的；傲慢的；美妙的
en: used in the titles of buildings or places that are big and impressive

ex.en: the Grand Hotel
ex.cn: 格兰大酒店

ex.en: Grand Central Station
ex.cn: 中央大火车站

ph.cn: n. 国际汽车大奖赛；头等奖，最高奖

syn: adj. 宏伟的；豪华的；极重要的：magnificent, noble
n. 大钢琴；一千美元：gee

t: v. 同意给予，授予，承认；n. 拨款；补助款
en: to give someone something or allow them to have something that they have asked for

ex.en: Britain could grant Spain’s request .
ex.cn: 英国可能会同意西班牙的请求。

ex.en: I would love to be able to grant her wish.
ex.cn: 我很希望能够满足她的愿望。

ph.cn: 政府批地书，政府补助金
政府赠地；政府拨给大学或铁路之土地

syn: vt. [法][专利]授予；允许；承认：award, let, accept, recognize, agree
vi. 同意：accept, see with, to agree with, agree on/upon, be agreeable to
rm: 授予(grant)显赫的(grand)贵族爵位

en: consisting of granules

ex.en: ...a granular fertilizer.
ex.cn: ...一种粒状化肥。

syn: adj. 颗粒的；粒状的：grainy

en: a drawing that uses a line or lines to show how two or more sets of measurements are related to each other

ex.en: Martin showed me a graph of their recent sales.
ex.cn: 马丁给我看了他们最近销售情况的图表。

syn: n. 图表；曲线图：chart, diagram
rm: 本身为词根， 意为“书写； 图” → 图表

t: adj. 图解的；书写的；生动的
en: Graphic means concerned with drawing or pictures, especially in publishing, industry, or computing

ex.en: ...fine and graphic arts.
ex.cn: …美术与制图艺术。

ph.cn: 平面造型设计；图示设计

syn: adj. 形象的；图表的；绘画似的：ikonic, imagic
rm: graph(书写) + ic(形容词后缀) → 文字的； 生动的

t: n. 火炉，炉格；v. 擦碎，磨碎；擦响
en: A grate is a framework of metal bars in a fireplace, which holds the wood or coal

ex.en: A wood fire burned in the grate.
ex.cn: 柴火在炉栅里燃烧。

syn: n. 壁炉；格栅：fire place, grizzly screen

ex.en: I cherish for you the liveliest feeling of affection and gratitude.
ex.cn: 我对你怀有最强烈的爱和感激之情。

ex.en: To my father I dedicate this volume in token of affection and gratitude.
ex.cn: 我谨以此书献给我的父亲， 以表示对他的爱戴和感激之情。

en: a small gift of money given to someone for a service they provided

ex.en: The porter expects a gratuity.
ex.cn: 那个搬运工想要小费。

syn: n. 赏钱，小费；赠物；[劳经]退职金：fee, tip

en: grave problems, situations, or worries are very great or bad

ex.en: Matthew’s life is in grave danger .
ex.cn: 马修的生命危在旦夕。

ex.en: The report expressed grave concern over the technicians’ lack of training.
ex.cn: 报告中对技术人员缺乏培训深表忧虑。

ph.cn: 乱葬冈；集体埋葬的墓地

syn: adj. 重大的；严肃的；黯淡的：important, serious, significant, great, cracking
n. 墓穴，坟墓；死亡：death, end

en: small stones, used to make a surface for paths, roads etc

ex.en: a gravel path
ex.cn: 石子小道

syn: n. 碎石；砂砾：rubble, crushed stone
vt. 用碎石铺；使船搁浅在沙滩上；使困惑：confuse, perplex
rm: grav(重的) + el(表小玩意、 小东西) → 重的小东西 → 沙砾

t: n. 地球引力；重量；严重性
en: the force that causes something to fall to the ground or to be attracted to another  planet

ex.en: the force of gravity
ex.cn: 重力

syn: n. [力]重力，地心引力；严重性；庄严：weight, seriousness

t: v. (牲畜)吃草；放牧；擦过(牲畜)n擦伤
en: to accidentally break the surface of your skin by rubbing it against something

ex.en: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
ex.cn: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

syn: vt. 放牧；擦伤：grass, feed, raw, range
vi. 吃草；擦伤：brush burn

en: very determined to do what you want, even when other people advise you not to do it

ex.en: He's young, very headstrong, but he's a good man underneath.
ex.cn: 他年轻、任性，但骨子里是个好人。

syn: adj. 任性的；顽固的；刚愎的：resistant, self-willed

en: to make someone who is ill become healthy again, especially by using natural powers or prayer

ex.en: a preacher who claims that he can heal the sick
ex.cn: 自称可以治病的传道士

syn: vt. 治愈，痊愈；和解：charm away, charm off
vi. 痊愈：cure, scar

t: n&vt. 堆；一堆；堆积；许多，大量；装载
en: a large untidy pile of things

ex.en: a rubbish heap
ex.cn: 垃圾堆

ex.en: We piled the branches into heaps for burning.
ex.cn: 我们把树枝堆起来烧。

syn: n. 堆；许多；累积：lots of, pile, accumulation, sea, hundred
vt. 堆；堆积：bank up, stack up
rm: 通过大量(heap)量变一跃(leap)发生质变

t: n. 听力，听力所及距离，被听到机会；审讯
en: the sense which you use to hear sounds

ex.en: a child with a hearing disability
ex.cn: 有听力障碍的儿童

syn: n. [生理]听力；[法]审讯，听讯：trial, aural comprehension
v. 听见（hear的ing形式）：earring

en: the organ in your chest which pumps blood through your body

ex.en: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
ex.cn: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

ex.en: Can you hear my heart beating?
ex.cn: 你能听见我的心跳吗？

syn: n. [内科][解剖]心脏；感情；勇气；心形；要点：courage, affection, core, main, feeling
vt. 鼓励；铭记：encourage, brand, uphold

t: v. 用力举起；说出；掷扔；n. 举，拉，扔
en: to move up and down with very strong movements

ex.en: Michael’s shoulders heaved with silent laughter.
ex.cn: 迈克尔憋着不笑出声来，双肩直抖。

ex.en: The sea heaved up and down beneath the boat.
ex.cn: 船的下面大海波涛汹涌。

syn: vt. 举起；使起伏；投掷；恶心；发出（叹息等）：lift up, hold up
vi. 起伏；举起；喘息；呕吐：wave, roll

ex.en: I’ve had a pretty hectic day.
ex.cn: 我忙乱了一整天。

syn: n. 脸红；患肺结核：flushing
adj. 兴奋的，狂热的；脸上发红；肺病的：crazy, wild, enthusiastic

t: n&v. 围树篱；障碍；躲闪；推诿
en: a row of small bushes or trees growing close together, usually dividing one field or garden from another
syn: n. [建]树篱；障碍：bar, obstacle, dam, let, stop

en: if something heightens a feeling, effect etc, or if a feeling etc heightens, it becomes stronger or increases

ex.en: There are fears that the march will heighten racial tension.
ex.cn: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

ex.en: Increased levels of fat in the diet could heighten the risk of cancer.
ex.cn: 饮食中脂肪摄入量的提升会增加患癌症的风险。

syn: vt. 提高；增高；加强；使更显著：enhance, raise, cement, muscle
vi. 升高；变强：strengthen, breeze up
rm: height(高度， 海拔) + en(使…) → 提高 → (使)增强， (使)加剧

en: the person who has the legal right to receive the property or title of another person when they die

ex.en: Jonson was his political heir as leader of the party.
ex.cn: 琼森是他的政治接班人，他将担任该党派的领袖。

ph.cn: [律]法定继承人，有确定继承权的人

syn: n. [法]继承人；后嗣；嗣子：heritor, haeres
rm: “儿啊” → 儿子当然是继承人了 → 继承人

en: a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly

ex.en: You can helicopter to the island.
ex.cn: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

ex.en: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
ex.cn: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

syn: n. [航]直升飞机：copter, whirlybird, verticraft
rm: helic(螺旋) + opter → 带螺旋翼的飞机 → 直升飞机

en: the place where the souls of bad people are believed to be punished after death, especially in the Christian and Muslim religions

ex.en: War is hell.
ex.cn: 战争是人间地狱。

ph.cn: （表示不在乎、无可奈何、气恼、不耐烦等）究竟，到底

syn: n. 地狱；究竟（作加强语气词）；训斥；黑暗势力：Sam Hill, sheol
vi. 过放荡生活；飞驰：rocket, ball it up

en: a half of the Earth, especially one of the halves above and below the  equator

ex.en: the Northern hemisphere
ex.cn: 北半球

syn: n. [天]半球：semisphere
rm: hemi(半) + spher(球) + e → 半球

t: adv. 从此地，从此时，因此
en: for this reason

ex.en: The cost of transport is a major expense for an industry. Hence factory location is an important consideration.
ex.cn: 运输成本是企业的一大支出，因此工厂选址是重要的考虑因素。

syn: adv. 因此；今后：therefore, accordingly, consequently, thus, as a result of
rm: “恨死” → 恨死你， 从此不相往来 → 从此

ex.en: multiple sclerosis (henceforth referred to as MS)
ex.cn: 多发性硬化（以下称为MS）

syn: adv. 今后；自此以后：forwards, hereafter

en: a small plant that is used to improve the taste of food, or to make medicine

ex.en: Sprinkle the dish with chopped fresh herbs.
ex.cn: 在菜肴上撒些切碎的新鲜香草。

syn: n. 香草，[植]药草：bouquet garni, vanilla

t: n. 兽群，牧口群，牧人；v. 把赶到一起
en: a group of animals of one kind that live and feed together

ex.en: You have to be an individual; it’s no use running with the herd.
ex.cn: 你必须特立独行，随大溜没有用处。

ex.en: Stefano used a motorcycle to herd the sheep.
ex.cn: 斯蒂芬诺骑一辆摩托车驱赶羊群。

ph.cn: 羊群行为；羊群效应；从众行为；群体恐慌行为

syn: n. 兽群，畜群；放牧人：drove, menagerie
vt. 放牧；使成群：grass, feed, range

t: adj. 闲着的，空闲的；懒的；无根据的；v. 虚度
en: lazy

ex.en: Go and wake up that idle brother of yours.
ex.cn: 去把你那懒哥哥叫起来。

ph.cn: 空闲时间，闲置时间；停工时间，停歇时间

syn: adj. 闲置的；懒惰的；停顿的：stopped, lazy
vi. 无所事事；虚度；[机]空转：sit around, lie about

en: to start burning, or to make something start burning

ex.en: The petrol tank suddenly ignited.
ex.cn: 油箱突然着火了。

ex.en: The candle ignited the plastic.
ex.cn: 蜡烛烧着了塑料。

syn: vt. 点燃；使燃烧；使激动：heat, light
vi. 点火；燃烧：burn, light the fire

en: lack of knowledge or information about something

ex.en: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
ex.cn: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

syn: n. 无知，愚昧；不知，不懂：darkness, unwisdom
rm: i(不) + gno(r)(知道) + ance → 什么都不知道 → 无知

en: someone who has not learned to read or write

ex.en: ...a subclass of illiterates.
ex.cn: …文盲阶层。

syn: adj. 文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的：letterless, unlettered
n. 文盲：unschooled, analphabetic

t: v. 照亮；用灯装饰；阐明
en: to make a light shine on something, or to fill a place with light

ex.en: A single candle illuminated his face.
ex.cn: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

ex.en: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
ex.cn: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

syn: vt. 阐明，说明；照亮；使灿烂；用灯装饰：say, lamp, elucidate, clarify
vi. 照亮：light up, to shine
rm: il(向内) + lumin(光) + ate → 向内投入光 → 照亮； 启发

en: an idea or opinion that is wrong, especially about yourself

ex.en: She was under no illusion that he loved her.
ex.cn: 她不再幻想他爱她了。

ex.en: It is an illusion that the Arctic is dark in winter.
ex.cn: 认为北极冬天一片黑暗是错误的。

syn: n. 幻觉，[心理]错觉；错误的观念或信仰：hallucination, fantasm
rm: il(不， 无) + lus(看作lust， 光) + ion(名词后缀)→ 看到根本没有的光 → 幻觉， 假象

t: v. 举例或以图表说明，配以插图
en: to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples

ex.en: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
ex.cn: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

ex.en: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
ex.cn: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

syn: vt. 阐明，举例说明；图解：clarify, elucidate
vi. 举例：give an example, cite an example
rm: il(向内) + lus(光) + tr + ate → 向内投入光 → 阐明

t: adj. 想象的，有想象力的
en: containing new and interesting ideas

ex.en: an imaginative use of computer technology
ex.cn: 计算机技术的妙用

ex.en: children’s imaginative play
ex.cn: 儿童富有想象力的游戏

syn: adj. 虚构的；富于想像的；有创造力的：fictitious, figmentary
rm: 来自imagine(v. 想象)

en: to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh

ex.en: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
ex.cn: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

syn: vt. 模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制：simulate, model after
rm: imit(模仿) + ate(动词后缀) → 模仿

t: n. 模仿，仿造，仿制品，人造
en: when you copy someone else’s actions

ex.en: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
ex.cn: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

syn: n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品：simulation, mimicry
adj. 人造的，仿制的：artificial, synthetic

en: extremely large

ex.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
ex.cn: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

ex.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
ex.cn: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

syn: adj. 巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的：huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
rm: im(不) + mens(测量) + e → 不能测量的 → 巨大的， 广大的

ex.en: He left school at 16 and immersed himself in the Labour Party.
ex.cn: 他16岁离开学校投身工党。

ph.cn: 全神贯注于，专心于；把…浸入水中

syn: vt. 沉浸；使陷入：let sb in for, entrap

en: someone who enters another country to live there permanently

ex.en: an illegal immigrant
ex.cn: 非法移民

ex.en: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
ex.cn: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

syn: adj. 移民的；迁入的：emigratory
n. 移民，侨民：migration, transplantation
rm: im(向内) + migr(迁移) + ant(表人) → 向内迁移的人 → 移民； 侨民

en: an event that is imminent, especially an unpleasant one, will happen very soon

ex.en: A new trade agreement is imminent.
ex.cn: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

ph.cn: 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

syn: adj. 即将来临的；迫近的：upcoming, forthcoming

t: adj. 免除的；安全的，不受影响的
en: not affected by something that happens or is done

ex.en: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
ex.cn: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

ph.cn: 免疫反应（体内免疫系统对外来有机体或化学物挑战所作出的反应）；免疫应答；免疫响应
艾滋病；获得性免疫缺陷综合症

syn: adj. [免疫]免疫的；免于……的，免除的：exonerative
rm: im(没有) + mun(作用) + e → 没有作用 → 免疫的； 免除的

en: the force of one object hitting another

ex.en: The force of the impact knocked the breath out of her.
ex.cn: 撞击力使她喘不过气来。

syn: vt. 影响；[力]撞击；冲突；压紧：affect, influence, reach, work on, strike
vi. [力]冲击；产生影响：charge at

en: to damage something or make it not as good as it should be

ex.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
ex.cn: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

syn: vt. 损害；削弱；减少：hurt, break, blast
rm: im(不) + pair(相等) → 使…不一样 → 损害

en: to give a particular quality to something

ex.en: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
ex.cn: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

syn: vt. 给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露：afford, allow, deal, reveal, extend

en: to make it difficult for someone or something to move forward or make progress

ex.en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
ex.cn: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。

syn: vt. 阻碍；妨碍；阻止：dispute, let, stem, slow
rm: im + ped(脚) + e → 用脚绊倒 → 阻碍， 妨碍

t: adj. 紧急的，必要的，强制的，祈使语气
en: extremely important and needing to be done or dealt with immediately

ex.en: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
ex.cn: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

ph.cn: 祈使语气；命令语气；祈使式

syn: adj. 必要的，势在必行的；命令的；紧急的：necessary, urgent, essential, emergency, instant
n. 需要；命令；祈使语气；规则：necessity, instruction, need, request, order

en: relating to an empire or to the person who rules it

ex.en: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
ex.cn: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

syn: adj. [纸]帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的：august, sovereign

t: n. 动力，原动力，推动，激励
en: an influence that makes something happen or makes it happen more quickly

ex.en: The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research.
ex.cn: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

syn: n. 动力；促进；冲力：momentum, promotion, acceleration
rm: im + pet(追求) + us → 有追求才有动力 → 推动， 促进

t: n. 工具，器具；v. 贯彻，履行
en: a tool, especially one used for outdoor physical work
syn: vt. 实施，执行；实现，使生效：accomplish, perform, come true, fulfill, enforce
n. [机]工具，器具；手段：instrument, facilities, vehicle, tool, engine
rm: im(里面) + ple(填满) + ment → 把…里面填满 → 实施； 执行

en: the ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like

ex.en: a woman of great insight
ex.cn: 一位极有眼光的妇女

syn: n. 洞察力；洞悉：perception, penetration
rm: in(内) + sight(眼光) → 眼光深入 → 洞察力

t: adj. 无味的，枯燥乏味的；单调的
en: food or drink that is insipid does not have much taste

ex.en: an insipid pasta dish
ex.cn: 一盘没有味道的意大利面食

syn: adj. 清淡的；无趣的：dull, bored

en: rude and not showing any respect

ex.en: an insolent tone of voice
ex.cn: 傲慢的语气

ex.en: You insolent child!
ex.cn: 你这个没礼貌的孩子！

syn: adj. 无礼的；傲慢的；粗野的；无耻的：robust, gross, rough, country, bush

en: not having enough money to pay what you owe

ex.en: The company was later declared insolvent (= officially said to be insolvent ).
ex.cn: 公司随后被宣布破产。

syn: n. [经]破产者；无力偿还者：bankrupt
adj. [经]破产的；无力偿还的：broke, bankrupt

en: an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed

ex.en: An inspection was carried out at the school.
ex.cn: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

syn: n. 视察，检查：examination, checking, monitoring

t: n. 灵感，鼓舞人心的人或事，好主意
en: a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly

ex.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
ex.cn: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

ex.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
ex.cn: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

syn: n. 灵感；鼓舞；[生理]吸气；妙计：stimulation, afflatus
rm: in(进入) + spir(呼吸) + ation → 吸入灵气 → 灵感

t: v. 激励，鼓励，灌注以创造力
en: to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something

ex.en: We need someone who can inspire the team.
ex.cn: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

ex.en: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
ex.cn: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

syn: vt. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感：stimulate, lift, wake, spirit, effect
rm: in(向内) + spir(呼吸) + e → 吸气 → 鼓气 → 鼓舞

ex.en: inspiring music
ex.cn: 激励人心的音乐

syn: adj. 鼓舞人心的；灌输的；启发灵感的：heartening, stimulatory
v. 鼓舞；激发；使感悟（inspire的ing形式）：prompting
rm: in(使…) + spir(呼吸) + ing → 使呼吸的 → 鼓舞人心的

en: to put a piece of equipment somewhere and connect it so that it is ready to be used

ex.en: They’ve installed the new computer network at last.
ex.cn: 他们终于安装了新电脑网络。

ex.en: Security cameras have been installed in the city centre.
ex.cn: 在市中心已安装了一些监控摄像机。

syn: vt. 安装；任命；安顿：fit, constitute, fix, place, name
rm: in(进入) + stall(放) → 放进 → 安置； 安装

t: n. 分期连载，分期支付的款子
en: one of a series of regular payments that you make until you have paid all the money you owe

ex.en: the second instalment of a loan
ex.cn: 一项贷款的第二期还款

ex.en: They’re letting me pay for the washing machine by monthly instalments.
ex.cn: 他们允许我以每月分期付款的方式买下这台洗衣机。

syn: n. 分期付款；装设；就职：payment by installment, installment payment

ex.en: So, the second method is almost always combined with the first, by checking the fields in instantaneous and then doing a batch validation before the form is submitted.
ex.cn: 所以，第二种方法几乎总是和第一种方法结合在一起，先对域进行瞬时检查，然后在表单被提交之前执行批处理确认。

syn: adj. 瞬间的；即时的；猝发的：momentary, flashy

ex.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
ex.cn: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

syn: n. [生物]本能，直觉；[心理]天性：intuition, natural ability
adj. 充满着的：abrim
rm: in(在…之内) + stinct(刺激) → 内在的刺激 → 本能， 直觉

en: a small tool used in work such as science or medicine

ex.en: surgical instruments
ex.cn: 外科(手术)器械

ex.cn: 他在建立与欧洲各组织之间的联系中起了重要作用。

syn: adj. 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的：helpful, useful, assistant
rm: 来自instrument(n. 手段； 工具)

t: v. 使绝缘，使绝热，隔离

ex.cn: 隔热[隔音]的阁楼

syn: vt. 隔离，使孤立；使绝缘，使隔热：segregant, quarantine

t: v. 侮辱，凌辱；n. 侮辱的言词或行为

ex.cn: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

ex.cn: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

ex.cn: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

syn: n. [保险]保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金：assurance, safety, premium, compensation

ex.cn: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

syn: vt. 确保，保证；给…保险：undertake, assure
vi. 确保；投保：to ensure, snake stare

en: not broken, damaged, or spoiled

ex.en: Only the medieval tower had remained intact.
ex.cn: 只有这座中世纪塔楼保存完好。

ex.en: His reputation survived intact.
ex.cn: 他的声望丝毫未受影响。

t: adj. 构成整体所必需的，完整的
en: forming a necessary part of something

ex.cn: 蔬菜是我们膳食中不可缺少的一部分。

t: v. 使一体化，取消种族隔离
en: to end the practice of separating people of different races in schools, colleges etc

ex.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
ex.cn: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

syn: vi. 求积分；取消隔离；成为一体：become one flesh
adj. 整合的；完全的：complete, absolute, full, total, round
rm: in(不) ＋ tegr(触摸， 接触) + ate → 未被触摸 → (使)成为一体

en: the quality of being honest and strong about what you believe to be right

ex.en: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
ex.cn: 我一直把他当作一个正直诚实的人。

syn: n. [数]完整；正直；诚实；廉正：truth, honesty, full, righteousness, completeness

en: the ability to understand things and to think intelligently

ex.en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
ex.cn: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

syn: n. 智力，理解力；知识分子；思维逻辑领悟力；智力高的人：brain, understanding, mind, mentality, head

en: the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits

ex.cn: 那一信息的核心是和平绝不应该成为对任何人有利或不利的根源。

en: to take someone somewhere illegally by force, often in order to get money for returning them

ex.cn: 一名妇女遭到持枪绑架，警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

syn: vt. 绑架；诱拐；拐骗：spirit, abduct

en: one of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine

ex.cn: 肾脏移植

syn: n. [解剖]肾脏；腰子；个性：personality, individuality

en: your family

ex.en: We’ll have to notify the next of kin of his death.
ex.cn: 我们得把他去世的消息通知他的直系亲属。

adj. 同类的；有亲属关系的；性质类似的：congeneric, akin

ex.cn: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

ex.cn: 萨莉把化妆包放在手提包里。

ex.en: a bike repair kit
ex.cn: 一套自行车修理工具

ph.cn: 酶联免疫试剂盒（Enzyme Linked Immunosorbent Assay Kit）
重复工具包；维修工具；工作服

ex.cn: 我祖母教过我编织。

ex.cn: 她在织毛衣。

t: n. 圆形把手，旋纽，圆形突出物

ex.en: He thought the door was locked, but he turned the knob and the door opened.
ex.cn: 他本以为门是锁住的，但是转了一下把手门就开了。

ex.cn: 黄铜门把手

ex.en: Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
ex.cn: 南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。

ex.cn: 蛤蜊味道鲜美，茄子也同样美味。

en: an arm or leg

ex.en: She would be able to stretch out her cramped limbs and rest for a few hours.
ex.cn: 她将可以伸开蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

syn: n. 肢，臂；分支；枝干：extremitas, offshoot
rm: 多喝点维C饮科， 手臂(limb)有力就能爬(climb)上高山了

t: adj. 柔软的，软弱的；vt&n. 跛行，蹒跚
en: not firm or strong

ex.en: a limp handshake
ex.cn: 无力的握手

ex.cn: 他突然身子一软。

ex.cn: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

ex.en: Sign your name on the dotted line (= line made up of a series of dots ).

ex.cn: 线形图

en: A liner is a large ship in which people travel long distances, especially on holiday

ex.en: ...luxury ocean liners.
ex.cn: …豪华远洋客轮。

ph.cn: 内衬；橡胶密封层；气密层

syn: n. [水运]班轮，[航]班机；[机][铁路]衬垫；画线者：pad, airliner

ex.cn: 新一轮成人识字[扫盲]运动

ex.cn: 意大利文学

ex.cn: 没有阳光，植物就无法生存。

ex.en: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.
ex.cn: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

ex.cn: 营养不良的难民

ex.cn: 人质说他们挨了饿，但没有受到虐待。

ex.cn: 这种药物会加快你的新陈代谢。

t: adj. 确定的；确信的，实际的；正的；阳性的
en: if you take positive action, you do something definite in order to try and achieve something

ex.en: We need to take positive steps to improve the situation of families in poverty.
ex.cn: 我们需要采取积极措施来改善贫困家庭的状况。

ex.en: Positive action was required.
ex.cn: 要求采取积极行动。

syn: adj. [电]积极的；[摄][物][数]正的，[化学][医]阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的：active, established, practical, actual, fixed, effective, sincere
rm: pos(放) + it + ive(形容词后缀) → 放正心态的 → 积极的

en: if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere

ex.en: That information is not in our possession.
ex.cn: 那则信息不归我们所有。

ex.en: How did the painting come into your possession (= how did you get it ) ?
ex.cn: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

syn: n. 拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷：estate, property, treasure, worth

en: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post

ex.en: How much is the postage for a postcard?
ex.cn: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

syn: n. [邮]邮资，邮费：taxe, franking

t: n. 招贴画，广告；广告画
en: a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration

ex.en: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
ex.cn: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

ex.en: a poster campaign for the election
ex.cn: 选举的海报宣传

ph.cn: n. 作为模范的人或物
广告纸板；海报用纸；写布告用的硬纸板

syn: n. 海报，广告；[印刷]招贴：advertisement, bill, publicity

en: all the people in the future who will be alive after you are dead

ex.en: A photographer recorded the scene on video for posterity.
ex.cn: 一位摄影师为子孙后代摄下了这个场面。

syn: n. 子孙，后裔；后代：child, seed, progeny

t: adj. 大学毕业后的，研究院的；n. 研究生
en: relating to studies done at a university after completing a first degree

ex.en: postgraduate degrees
ex.cn: 研究生学位

ph.cn: 研究生文凭；研究生文凭课程

syn: n. 研究生，研究所学生：graduate student, advanced student

t: adj. 遗腹的；父亡后出生的；死后的；身后的
en: happening, printed etc after someone’s death

ex.en: a posthumous collection of his articles
ex.cn: 他身后出版的文集

t: n&a. ，验尸，尸体解剖；事后的，死后的
en: A postmortem is a medical examination of a dead person's body in order to find out how they died

ex.en: A postmortem was carried out to establish the cause of death.
ex.cn: 进行了尸检以确定死因。

syn: n. 验尸；检视；尸体检查：autopsy, necroscopy

en: to change the date or time of a planned event or action to a later one

ex.en: The match had to be postponed until next week.
ex.cn: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

ex.en: His trial has been postponed indefinitely (= no one knows when it will happen ) .
ex.cn: 对他的审判被无限期推迟了。

syn: vt. 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面：adjourn
vi. 延缓，延迟；延缓发作：stave off, time delay
rm: post(在…后面) + pon(放) + e → 放到后面 → 延迟， 延期

en: a message written at the end of a letter after you have signed your name
the way you position your body when sitting or standing

ex.en: her upright posture
ex.cn: 她笔挺的姿势

syn: n. 姿势；态度；情形：behavior, status
vi. 摆姿势：pose
rm: post(放) + ure → 姿势

en: having a very powerful effect or influence on your body or mind

ex.en: potent drugs
ex.cn: 强效药物

ex.en: a potent symbol of oppression
ex.cn: 压迫的有力象征

syn: adj. 有效的；强有力的，有权势的；有说服力的：valid, available, effective, virtual, telling

t: adj. 潜在的;；adj. 可能的；n. 潜能；潜力
en: likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

ex.en: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
ex.cn: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

ph.cn: [经]市场潜力；市场潜在需求量

syn: n. 潜能；可能性；[电]电势：possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance
adj. 潜在的；可能的；势的：feasible, possible, underlying, latent
rm: po + tent(伸展) + ial → 无限伸展的 → 潜在的； 可能的； 潜能

en: A potion is a drink that contains medicine, poison, or something that is supposed to have magic powers

ex.en: ...a magic potion that will make Siegfried forget Brunnhilde and fall in love with Gutrune.
ex.cn: …一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

syn: n. 一剂；一服；饮剂：dose, potus

en: money that you gain by selling things or doing business, after your costs have been paid

ex.en: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
ex.cn: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500美元左右。

ex.en: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
ex.cn: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

syn: n. [会计]利润；利益：behalf, margin, benefit, gain, sake
vi. 获利；有益：advantage, gain

t: adj. 深的，极深的；渊博的；深奥的
en: having a strong influence or effect

ex.en: a profound sense of guilt
ex.cn: 强烈的内疚感

syn: adj. 深厚的；意义深远的；渊博的：encyclopedic, cyclopaedic
rm: pro(在…前面) + found(创立) → 有超前创见性 → 深远的； 深奥的

t: adj. 极其丰富的；很多的；大量的
en: produced or existing in large quantities

ex.en: He made profuse apologies .
ex.cn: 他不住地道歉。

ex.en: Profuse sweating is one of the symptoms of heat exhaustion.
ex.cn: 大量出汗是中暑虚脱的症状之一。

syn: adj. 丰富的；很多的；慷慨的；浪费的：abundant, numerous, full, generous, plenty

en: to say that an action is illegal or not allowed

ex.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
ex.cn: 厂区严禁吸烟。

syn: vt. 阻止，禁止：stem, block, dispute, bar, discourage
rm: pro(在…之前) + hibit(拿住) → 提前拿住 → 禁止， 阻止

t: n. 方案，计划；v. 设计；投影；抛
en: a carefully planned piece of work to get information about something, to build something, to improve something etc

ex.en: The project aims to provide an analysis of children’s emotions.
ex.cn: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

ex.en: a three-year research project
ex.cn: 一项为期三年的研究计划

ph.cn: 建筑计划，建设项目；基建计划

syn: vi. 设计；计划；表达；投射：design, engineer
vt. 设计；计划；发射；放映：design, schedule, engineer, style, frame
rm: pro(向前) + ject(投， 掷) → 向前掷 → (使)突出， (使)伸出

en: a prolific artist, writer etc produces many works of art, books etc

ex.en: Handel’s prolific output of opera
ex.cn: 韩德尔丰富的歌剧作品

syn: adj. 多产的；丰富的：abundant, productive, full, luxurious

en: the introduction to a play, a long poem etc

ex.en: The prologue to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.
ex.cn: 该小说的前言是以新闻报道的形式写的。

syn: n. 开场白；序言：opening remarks, introductory remarks

en: to deliberately make something such as a feeling or an activity last longer

ex.en: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
ex.cn: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

syn: vt. 延长；拖延：drag on, drag out

t: adj. 突出的，显要的，著名的
en: important

ex.en: a prominent Russian scientist
ex.cn: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

ex.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
ex.cn: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

syn: adj. 突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的：obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
rm: pro(向前) + min(突出) + ent(形容词后缀) → 突出的； 显著的

en: If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it

ex.en: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
ex.cn: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

ex.en: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
ex.cn: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

syn: n. 许诺，允诺；希望：wish, hope, pleasure
vt. 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望：pledge, vouchsafe

t: adj. 有希望的；有出息的
en: showing signs of being successful or good in the future

ex.en: a promising career in law
ex.cn: 很有前途的法律职业

ex.en: a promising young actor
ex.cn: 大有前途的年轻演员

ph.cn: n. 发展前景；光明的前途
发展潜力大的市场；有销路的市场

syn: adj. 有希望的，有前途的：likely, hopeful
v. 许诺，答应（promise的现在分词形式）：undertaking
rm: promis(e)(承诺) + ing → 承诺了的 → 有希望的

en: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread

ex.en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
ex.cn: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

syn: vt. 促进；提升；推销；发扬：facilitate, boost, prefer, upgrade, further
rm: pro(向前) + mot(动) + e → 向前动 → 促进

en: done quickly, immediately, or at the right time

ex.en: Prompt action must be taken.
ex.cn: 必须立即采取行动。

ex.en: Prompt payment is requested.
ex.cn: 请立即付款。

syn: adj. 敏捷的，迅速的；立刻的：rapid, fast, fly, forward, ready
vt. [计]提示；促进；激起；（给演员）提白：facilitate, boost, further

en: likely to do something or suffer from something, especially something bad or harmful

ex.en: His eyes shifted to the prone body on the floor.
ex.cn: 他的视线移向了趴在地上的尸体。

syn: adj. [昆]俯卧的；有…倾向的，易于…的：liable, apt

en: information which is false or which emphasizes just one part of a situation, used by a government or political group to make people agree with them

ex.en: the spreading of political propaganda
ex.cn: 政治宣传的开展

ex.en: the government propaganda machine
ex.cn: 政府的宣传机器

syn: n. 宣传；传道总会：advertisement, publicity, dissemination

t: vt&vi. 繁殖；增殖；传播，宣传
en: to spread an idea, belief etc to many people

ex.en: The group launched a website to propagate its ideas .
ex.cn: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

syn: vt. 传播；传送；繁殖；宣传：breed, transmit
vi. 繁殖；增殖：breed, increase
rm: pro(向前) + pag(扎牢， 系牢) + ate → 向前系牢 → 繁殖； 传播

en: to move, drive, or push something forward

ex.en: a boat propelled by a small motor
ex.cn: 由小马达驱动的小船

ex.en: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
ex.cn: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

syn: vt. 推进；驱使；激励；驱策：stimulate, power
rm: pro(向前) + pel(推) → 推进

en: the thing or things that someone owns

ex.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
ex.cn: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

ex.en: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
ex.cn: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

ph.cn: 物业管理；资产管理；物业管理专员

syn: n. 性质，性能；[经]财产；[法]所有权：performance, nature, ownership, estate, capability
rm: proper(固有的) + ty(表物) → 固有物 → 财产， 所有物

en: a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magic powers

ex.en: She had the gift of prophecy.
ex.cn: 她有预言的天赋。

syn: n. 预言；预言书；预言能力：prediction, message

t: n. 比率，比例；大小，容积
en: The proportion of one kind of person or thing in a group is the number of people or things of that kind compared to the total number of people or things in the group

ex.en: The proportion of women in the profession had risen to 17.3%.
ex.cn: 从事那个职业的女性比例已经增长到17.3%。

syn: n. [数]比例；部分；面积；均衡：ratio, area, equilibrium, scale, part
vt. 使成比例；使均衡；分摊：apportion
rm: pro + portion(部分) → 比例； 部分

en: to suggest something as a plan or course of action

ex.en: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
ex.cn: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

ex.en: the proposed budget cuts
ex.cn: 所提出的预算削减

ph.cn: 推荐某人(参加某组织)；提名某人(任某职)

syn: vt. 建议；打算，计划；求婚：schedule, design, map, think, purpose
vi. 建议；求婚；打算：aim, offer
rm: pro(在…前面) + pos(放) + e → 在前面放出 → 行动之前指出 → 建议， 提议

en: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true

ex.en: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.
ex.cn: 民主国家间互不交战的观点是基于一个微不足道的历史实例。

ph.cn: 价值主张；价值定位；价值命题
◎[口语]向某人提出一项办法(或提议)

syn: n. [数]命题；提议；主题；议题：sentence, theme, subject, offer

t: n. 正当行为；正当；适当
syn: n. 适当；礼节；得体：fitness, ceremony, relevance

en: to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely

ex.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
ex.cn: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

ex.en: I quit school at 16.
ex.cn: 我十六岁辍学。

syn: vt. 离开；放弃；停止；使…解除：yield, desert, split, get out
vi. 离开；[劳经]辞职；停止：split, get out

en: to shake slightly because you are cold, or because you feel very afraid, angry, excited etc

ex.en: The child was quivering in her arms.
ex.cn: 那孩子在她怀里发抖。

ex.en: Her mouth quivered slightly as she turned away.
ex.cn: 她嘴唇微微哆嗦着，转过头去。

syn: n. 颤抖；箭袋；震动：shock, flesh-creep
vi. 颤抖；振动：quake, judder

t: n. 配额，限额(进口及移民人数)
en: an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period

ex.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
ex.cn: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

ex.en: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
ex.cn: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

ph.cn: n. 配额制；定额分配制

syn: n. 配额；[经管]定额；[经]限额：norm, allowance
rm: “阔的” → 出手阔绰， 没有限额 → 限额

syn: n. [机]齿条；[交]行李架；拷问台：toothed bar, baggage holder
vi. 变形；随风飘；小步跑：become deformed, to morph

en: a loud noise

ex.en: The old machine used to make an awful racket .
ex.cn: 这台旧机器以前噪音大得吓人。

syn: n. 球拍；吵闹，喧闹：row, sound
rm: 这副球拍(racket)被火箭(rocket)带入过太空

en: a piece of equipment that uses radio waves to find the position of things and watch their movement

ex.en: The coastline can now be monitored by radar.
ex.cn: 现在能用雷达监测海岸线了。

ex.en: We could see the plane quite clearly on the radar screen.
ex.cn: 我们在雷达屏幕上可清晰地看到飞机。

ph.cn: 雷达截面，雷达目标有效截面

en: if something radiates light or heat, or if light or heat radiates from something, the light or heat is sent out in all directions

ex.en: The log fire radiated a warm cosy glow.
ex.cn: 燃烧的原木发出温暖舒适的红光。

syn: vt. [物]辐射；传播；流露；发射；广播：release, send, broadcast, beam, project
vi. [物]辐射；流露；发光；从中心向各方伸展：shine on, light emission
rm: radi(光线) + ate(使…) → 发光； 发热

t: adj. 根本的，基本的，政治激进的

ph.cn: 游离基聚合；游离基引发聚合反应
n. 根治性乳房切除术

syn: adj. 激进的；根本的；彻底的：thorough, organic, fundamental, ultimate, complete
n. 基础；激进分子；[物化]原子团；[数]根数：elements, basis, foundation, base, bed

t: n. 半径；以半径度量的面积
en: the distance from the centre to the edge of a circle, or a line drawn from the centre to the edge

ex.en: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
ex.cn: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40英里内都能感觉得到。

syn: n. [数]半径，半径范围；[解剖]桡骨；辐射光线；有效航程：semidiameter
rm: rad(光线) + ius → 半径就像是从同一点散发出的许多光线 → 半径

en: a flat floating structure, usually made of pieces of wood tied together, used as a boat

ex.en: ...a river trip on bamboo rafts through dense rainforest.
ex.cn: …一次乘着竹筏穿过茂密雨林的河上旅行。

syn: n. 筏；救生艇；（美）大量：lots of, wealth, ocean, body, billion

en: a strong feeling of uncontrollable anger

ex.en: Sobbing with rage, Carol was taken to the hospital.
ex.cn: 卡罗尔气得呜呜哭，被送往医院。

ex.en: Richens was 17 when he flew into a rage and stabbed another teenager.
ex.cn: 里琴斯17岁那年一怒之下捅了一名少年。

ph.cn: 暴怒行为（主要是指驾驶人因不耐前车或不满抢道而引起的愤怒）

syn: n. 愤怒；狂暴，肆虐；情绪激动：anger, wrath
vi. 大怒，发怒；流行，风行：obtain, anger

t: adj. 褴褛的，外形参差不齐的
en: wearing clothes that are old and torn

ex.en: Crowds of ragged children played among the rocks.
ex.cn: 一群群破衣烂衫的孩子在岩石间玩耍。

ph.cn: 斗牛用的红布；激怒人的东西

syn: adj. 衣衫褴褛的；粗糙的；参差不齐的；锯齿状的；刺耳的；不规则的：grinding, crude, abnormal, rough, sharp

en: a short attack on a place by soldiers, planes, or ships, intended to cause damage but not take control

ex.en: a bombing raid
ex.cn: 轰炸

ex.en: an air raid warning siren
ex.cn: 空袭警报

syn: n. [军]袭击；突袭；搜捕；抢劫：robbery, assault
vt. [军]袭击，突袭：hit, descend on

en: a bar that is fastened along or around something, especially to stop you from going somewhere or from falling

ex.en: Several passengers were leaning against the ship’s rail.
ex.cn: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

ph.cn: 城市轨道交通；铁路直达运输

syn: n. [铁路]铁轨；[建]扶手；横杆；围栏：pen, rider
vi. 抱怨；责骂：rate, beef about

en: a large public meeting, especially one that is held outdoors to support a political idea, protest etc

ex.en: About 1,000 people attended the rally in Hyde Park.
ex.cn: 大约有1,000人参加了海德公园的集会。

ex.en: We decided to hold a rally to put pressure on the government.
ex.cn: 我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。

ph.cn: 赛前动员会，鼓舞士气的集会

syn: vi. 团结；重整；恢复；（网球等）连续对打：league, restore
vt. 团结；集合；恢复健康、力量等：assemble, fall in

t: v. 闲逛，漫步；漫谈；蔓延
en: to go on a walk in the countryside for pleasure

ex.en: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
ex.cn: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

syn: n. 漫步；漫游；随笔：essay, travel
vi. 漫步；漫游；闲逛；漫谈；蔓延：range, wander off

t: adj. (指植物)繁茂的；蔓生的；不能控制的
en: a plant that is rampant grows and spreads quickly, in a way that is difficult to control

ex.en: Pickpocketing is rampant in the downtown area.
ex.cn: 闹市区扒窃活动猖獗。

syn: adj. 猖獗的；蔓延的；狂暴的；奔放的：angry, rude

t: n&a. 随便；无目的的，任意的

ph.cn: 随机变数，随机变量；无规变量

syn: adj. [数]随机的；任意的；[建]胡乱的：stochastic, arbitrary
n. 随意：ad libitum
rm: ran(跑) + dom(领域) → 可以在各种领域跑的 → 任意的

en: to put things in a particular order or position

ex.en: In the dining room, team photographs were ranged along the wall.
ex.cn: 餐厅里，球队的照片排列在墙上。

ph.cn: 大范围的；许多各种不同的

syn: n. 范围；幅度；排；[地理]山脉：extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, area
vi. 平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到：reach, parallel with

en: an amount of money that is paid to free someone who is held as a prisoner

ex.en: The kidnappers were demanding a ransom of $250,000.
ex.cn: 绑匪索取25万美元的赎金。

ex.en: The government refused to pay the ransom .
ex.cn: 政府拒绝交付赎金。

syn: vt. 赎回，赎；勒索赎金；救赎；得赎金后释放：redeem, atone for
n. 赎金；赎身，赎回：redemption

en: a relationship between two amounts, represented by a pair of numbers showing how much bigger one amount is than the other

ex.en: The ratio between the two sides is one to four.
ex.cn: 双方人数对比是一对四。

ex.en: From the database snapshot, note the counters in Listing 3 and monitor the ratio among these counters.
ex.cn: 在数据库快照中，注意清单 3 中的计数器并监控这些计数器之间的比例。

syn: n. 比率，[数]比例：rate, scale
rm: rat(清点) + io → 比， 比率

t: adj. 有推理能力的；合理的
en: rational thoughts, decisions etc are based on reasons rather than emotions

ex.en: Parents need to be fully informed so they can make a rational decision.
ex.cn: 父母需要充分了解情况，这样才可以作出合理的决定。

ex.en: I’m sure there’s a rational explanation for all this.
ex.cn: 我相信这一切都有合理的解释。

syn: adj. 合理的；理性的：reasonable, logical, possible, just, legitimate

en: to make someone remember something that they must do

ex.en: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
ex.cn: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

ex.en: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
ex.cn: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

syn: vt. 提醒；使想起：jack, put in mind
rm: re(又， 再) + mind(注意) → 使再次注意 → 提醒

en: an amount of money that you send to pay for something

ex.en: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
ex.cn: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。

en: a small part of something that remains after the rest of it has been used, destroyed, or eaten

ex.en: Beneath the present church were remnants of Roman flooring.
ex.cn: 在目前的这座教堂下面还有残余的古罗马地板。

ph.cn: 超新星遗迹，超新星残骸

syn: n. 剩余：surplus, residual, spare
adj. 剩余的：remaining, surplus, residual, odd

en: a strong feeling of being sorry that you have done something very bad

ex.en: Throughout the trial, he had shown no remorse .
ex.cn: 整个审判过程中，他没有表示出一丝悔意。

syn: n. 懊悔；同情：feeling, compassion, sorrow, sympathy, pity

t: n. 文艺复兴；复兴，勃发
en: a new interest in something, especially a particular form of art, music etc, that has not been popular for a long period

ex.en: ...the Renaissance masterpieces in London's galleries.
ex.cn: …伦敦美术馆里文艺复兴时期的杰作。

ph.cn: n. 文艺复兴人；多才多艺的人
[建]早期文艺复兴的艺术风格；文艺复兴初期（1378-1500）

syn: n. 复兴；新生；复活：reconstruction, fresh, revival, renewal
rm: re(重新) + naiss(=nasc出生) + ance → 获得新生 → 复兴， 新生

t: v. 提供，报答；表演，演奏；翻译
en: to give something to someone or do something, because it is your duty or because someone expects you to

ex.en: an obligation to render assistance to those in need
ex.cn: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

ex.en: a bill of $3,200 for services rendered
ex.cn: 一张3,200美元服务费的账单

syn: vt. 致使；提出；实施；着色；以…回报：introduce, present, prefer, file, advance
n. 打底；交纳；粉刷：cosmetic brush
rm: ren(回， 向后) + der(给) → 还给 → 以…回报； 提供

t: n. 约会；集会，聚会之地点
en: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place, often secretly

ex.en: plans for a secret rendezvous
ex.cn: 秘密约会的计划

syn: n. 约会；约会地点；集结地：date, engagement
vi. [军][航]会合；约会：link up, make an appointment
n. 革新；修理；恢复活力：innovation, reformation, repair, renewal

t: adj. 有名望的，声誉鹊起的
en: known and admired by a lot of people, especially for a special skill, achievement, or quality

ex.en: The area is renowned for its Romanesque churches.
ex.cn: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

syn: adj. 著名的；有声望的：famous, noted, distinguished, celebrated, famed

en: if something repels you, it is so unpleasant that you do not want to be near it, or it makes you feel ill

ex.en: The smell repelled him.
ex.cn: 这气味让他反感。

syn: vt. 击退；抵制；使厌恶；使不愉快：refuse, roll back
rm: re(=back向后) + pel(推) → 向后推 → 击退， 驱逐

en: to send someone back to their own country

ex.en: After the war, prisoners were repatriated.
ex.cn: 战后，战俘被遣返。

rm: re(重新) + patr(父亲； 祖国) + iate → 重新送回祖国 → 把(某人)遣返回国； 归国

en: to be sorry for something and wish you had not done it – used especially when considering your actions in a religious way

ex.en: Those who refuse to repent, he said, will be punished.
ex.cn: 他说，那些不肯悔悟的人将受到惩罚。

syn: vi. 后悔；忏悔：rue
vt. 后悔；对…感到后悔：regret

t: n. 全部剧目，全部节目
en: all the plays, pieces of music etc that a performer or group knows and can perform

ex.en: the behavioural repertoire of infants
ex.cn: 婴幼儿的行为能力

rm: re(一再) + pert(带) + oire → 反复带着的剧目 → (剧团等)常备剧目

en: doing or saying the same thing many times

ex.en: Children used to learn by repetition.
ex.cn: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

syn: n. 重复；背诵；副本：reiteration, iterance

en: to officially speak or take action for another person or group of people

ex.en: Mr Kobayashi was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
ex.cn: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

syn: vt. 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送：conduct oneself, bear oneself, trace, figure
vi. 代表；提出异议：to stand for, stand for sth
rm: re + present(出席) → 代表出席 → 代表

en: criticism, blame, or disapproval

ex.en: ‘You don’t need me,’ she said quietly, without reproach.
ex.cn: “你不需要我。”她语气平静，没有丝毫责备。

syn: n. 责备；耻辱：blame, thumbs-down
vt. 责备；申斥：blame for, talk to

en: a type of animal, such as a snake or  lizard  , whose body temperature changes according to the temperature around it, and that usually lays eggs to have babies

ex.en: Bird evolved from reptiles, so the first bird must have come out of an egg--laid by a reptile.
ex.cn: 禽类是由爬虫类进化而来，所以，第一只禽鸟肯定是从爬虫类孵化的蛋里出来的。

ex.en: No matter how dry your skin gets, you will never turn into an alligator or any other type of reptile.
ex.cn: 不论皮肤多么干燥，你永远不会变成美洲鳄或任何其他一种皮肤粗糙的爬行动物。

syn: adj. 爬虫类的；卑鄙的：poor, mean, base, dirty
n. [脊椎]爬行动物；卑鄙的人：insect, ratfink
rm: rept(爬) + ile → 爬行动物

en: the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past

ex.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
ex.cn: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

syn: n. 名声，名誉；声望：credit, name, fame, celebrity, prestige
rm: re(重新) + put(想) + ation(表状态) → 反复想想， 名气只是过眼烟云 → 名誉， 名声

en: a polite or formal demand for something

ex.en: To request more information, please call our toll free number.
ex.cn: 欲知详情，请拨打我们的免费电话。

syn: n. [计]请求；需要：asking, necessity, need, motion, want
vt. 要求，[计]请求：exact, desire, call for
rm: re(再， 又) + quest(寻求) → 请求； 要求

en: to save someone or something from a situation of danger or harm

ex.en: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
ex.cn: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

syn: n. 营救；援救；解救：deliverance

en: if there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar, especially in the way they look

ex.en: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete.
ex.cn: 他和皮特有一个惊人的相似之处。

syn: n. 相似；相似之处；相似物；肖像：image, conformity, likeness

en: to look like or be similar to someone or something

ex.en: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
ex.cn: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

ex.en: He grew up to resemble his father.
ex.cn: 他长大了，很像他父亲。

syn: vt. 类似，像：favor
rm: re(又) + sembl(一样， 相同) + e → 与…相似， 像

en: information or a story that is passed from one person to another and which may or may not be true

ex.en: U.S. officials are discounting rumours of a coup.
ex.cn: 美国政府官员对一场政变的传闻将信将疑。

syn: n. 谣言：scuttlebutt, canard
rm: “辱骂” → 谣言往往比辱骂更伤人 → 谣言

en: an occasion when something suddenly breaks apart or bursts

ex.en: The pipe will rupture at its weakest point.
ex.cn: 管道最薄弱的地方会破裂的。

syn: n. 破裂；决裂；疝气：fracture, cracking
vi. 破裂；发疝气：fracture, crack

en: happening in or relating to the countryside, not the city

ex.en: a rural setting
ex.cn: 乡村环境

ex.en: rural bus routes
ex.cn: 乡村公共汽车路线

syn: adj. 农村的，乡下的；田园的，有乡村风味的：country, sylvan
rm: rur(乡村) + al→ 农村的， 乡村的

en: the reddish-brown substance that forms on iron or steel when it gets wet

ex.en: There were large patches of rust on the car.
ex.cn: 车上有大片锈斑。

syn: n. [材][化工]锈；生锈；[植保]锈病：patination
vt. 使生锈；腐蚀：eat, cauterize

en: so determined to get what you want that you do not care if you have to hurt other people in order to do it

ex.en: a ruthless dictator
ex.cn: 无情的独裁者

ex.en: They have shown a ruthless disregard for basic human rights.
ex.cn: 他们冷酷地无视基本人权。

syn: adj. 无情的，残忍的：cruel, relentless
rm: ruth(怜悯) + less(无) → 没有怜悯的 → 无情的， 冷酷的， 残忍的

t: n. 故意毁坏，故意破坏，阴谋
en: deliberate damage that is done to equipment, vehicles etc in order to prevent an enemy or opponent from using them

ex.en: The terrorists were planning acts of sabotage to destabilize the country.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子在策划破坏国家安定的行动。

ex.en: industrial sabotage
ex.cn: 工业破坏活动

syn: vt. 妨害；对…采取破坏行动：encumber, incumber
n. 破坏；破坏活动；怠工：destruction, breaking, blasting, disruption, demolition

t: n. 麻袋，解雇；v. 解雇；劫掠
en: when someone is dismissed from their job

ex.en: They’ve never actually given anyone the sack .
ex.cn: 他们从未真的辞退过什么人。

ex.en: He got the sack for stealing.
ex.cn: 他因偷东西而被解雇。

syn: n. 麻布袋；洗劫：gunny bag, burlap bag
vt. 解雇；把……装入袋；劫掠：get the boot, dehire
rm: 因为缺少(lack)竞争力， 公司解雇(sack)员工

en: relating to a god or religion

ex.en: a sacred vow
ex.cn: 神圣的誓言

ex.en: the miraculous powers of sacred relics
ex.cn: 圣物的神奇力量

ph.cn: 圣心（即耶稣之心，爱的源泉）

syn: adj. 神的；神圣的；宗教的；庄严的：religious, blessed

en: when you decide not to have something valuable, in order to get something that is more important

ex.en: The minister stressed the need for economic sacrifice.
ex.cn: 部长强调了在经济上作出牺牲的必要性。

ex.en: The workforce were willing to make sacrifices in order to preserve jobs.
ex.cn: 雇员为了保住饭碗情愿作出牺牲。

syn: n. 牺牲；祭品；供奉：offering, victimization
vt. 牺牲；献祭；亏本出售：immolate, martyr
rm: sacr(神圣的) + i + fic (做) + e → 为了神圣的事情而去做 → 牺牲， 献祭

t: n. 马鞍，鞍座；鞍状山脊
en: a leather seat that you sit on when you ride a horse
syn: n. 鞍，鞍状物；[车辆]车座；拖具：sella
vt. 承受；使负担；装以马鞍：absorb, burden

en: to protect something from harm or damage

ex.en: technology that will safeguard the environment
ex.cn: 将会保护环境的技术

syn: n. [安全]保护；保卫；保护措施：protection, lee, conservation
vt. [安全]保护，护卫：secure, preserve, shelter

en: in order to help, improve, or please someone or something

ex.en: He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health.
ex.cn: 他为了健康而迁居海滨。

ex.en: I only went for Kay’s sake.
ex.cn: 我是为了凯才去的。

syn: n. 目的；利益；理由；日本米酒：goals, intention, purpose, behalf, objective

en: containing or consisting of salt

ex.en: saline solution
ex.cn: 盐溶液

syn: adj. 盐的；含盐分的：salted
n. [地理][水文]盐湖；碱盐泻药：Playas
rm: sal(盐) + ine → 含盐的， 咸的

en: an act of raising your right hand to your head as a sign of respect, usually done by a soldier to an officer

ex.en: As they left, the corporal gave them a respectful salute.
ex.cn: 他们离开时，下士恭敬地向他们行礼。

syn: n. 致敬，欢迎；敬礼：welcome, Huanying
vt. 行礼致敬，欢迎：greet, be welcome to

t: n. (从火灾及其他灾难中)抢救财物救助
en: when you save things from a situation in which other things have already been damaged, destroyed, or lost

ex.en: a massive salvage operation
ex.cn: 大规模的抢救行动

ph.cn: 海难救助作业，救助作业；财产抢救；补救手术

syn: n. 打捞；[水运][安全]海上救助；抢救财货；救难的奖金：refloatation

t: n. 批准，认可，赞许；制裁
en: official orders or laws stopping trade, communication etc with another country, as a way of forcing its leaders to make political changes

ex.en: a resolution to impose sanctions (= start using sanctions ) on DPRK
ex.cn: 对朝鲜实施制裁的决议

ex.en: the threat of trade sanctions
ex.cn: 贸易制裁的威胁

syn: n. 制裁，处罚；认可；支持：approval, penalty, holding, support, adhesion
vt. 制裁，处罚；批准；鼓励：encourage, confirm, heart, uphold
rm: sanct(神圣的) + ion → 神圣之物， 原指教会的法令， 引申为“批准， 赞许” → 批准， 认可

t: adj. 清洁的，保健的，卫生的
en: relating to the ways that dirt, infection, and waste are removed, so that places are clean and healthy for people to live in

ex.en: Diseases were spread through poor sanitary conditions .
ex.cn: 疾病因卫生条件很差而传播开来。

ex.en: a prison with no proper sanitary facilities
ex.cn: 一座缺少适当卫生设施的监狱

syn: adj. 卫生的，清洁的：clean, hygienic
n. 公共厕所：latrine, public convenience
rm: san(健康) + it + ary → 健康的 → 清洁的； 保健的

t: n. 心智健全，神智正常；判断正确
en: the condition of being mentally healthy

ex.en: I began to doubt his sanity.
ex.cn: 我开始怀疑他是否神志正常。

ex.en: She wondered if she was losing her sanity .
ex.cn: 她怀疑自己是否精神有问题。

syn: n. 明智；头脑清楚；精神健全；通情达理：wisdom, judiciousness

en: a way of speaking or writing that involves saying the opposite of what you really mean in order to make an unkind joke or to show that you are annoyed

ex.en: ‘Good of you to arrive on time,’ George said, with heavy sarcasm (= very clear sarcasm ) .
ex.cn: “你到得真准时啊。”乔治不加掩饰地挖苦道。

syn: n. 讽刺；挖苦；嘲笑：hit, satire

t: v. 浸透，浸湿；使满，使饱和
en: to make something very wet

ex.en: Water poured through the hole, saturating the carpet.
ex.cn: 水从洞里流进来，浸湿了地毯。

syn: vt. 浸透，使湿透；使饱和，使充满：freight, water logging
adj. 浸透的，饱和的；深颜色的：permeant, satd
rm: sat(充足) + ur + ate(使…) → 使充足 → 使饱和

t: n. 调味汁，酱油；莽撞，冒失
en: a thick cooked liquid that is served with food to give it a particular taste

ex.en: spaghetti sauces
ex.cn: 意大利面酱

ph.cn: 番茄酱，蕃茄汁；番茄沙司

syn: n. 酱油；沙司；调味汁：soy, shoyu
vt. 使增加趣味；给…调味：season

en: very violent or cruel

ex.en: a savage dog
ex.cn: 一条凶猛的狗

ex.en: a savage murder
ex.cn: 凶残的谋杀

syn: adj. 野蛮的；残酷的；狂怒的；荒凉的：wild, cruel, iron, desert
n. 未开化的；粗鲁的人；残暴成性的人：yahoo, woodenness

t: n. 镶嵌；环境，背景；(日月)沉落
en: the place where something is or where something happens, and the general environment

ex.en: I’ve worked with children in various settings, mainly in secondary school.
ex.cn: 我在许多地方教过孩子，主要是在中学。

syn: n. 环境；安装；布置；[天]沉落：context, circumstance, installation, arrangement, surrounding
v. 放置；沉没；使…处于某位置（set的ing形式）：putting, positioning, laying
rm: set(布置) + t + ing → 布置(新居) → 环境； 安置

t: v. 定居，停留；解决；支付
en: to end an argument or solve a disagreement

ex.en: We hope the factions will be able to settle their differences (= agree to stop arguing ) by peaceful means.
ex.cn: 我们希望各派系能以和平方式解决分歧。

ex.en: Forensic tests should settle the question of whether Bates was actually present at the scene of the crime.
ex.cn: 法医检验应该能够解决贝茨是否在犯罪现场的问题。

syn: vi. 解决；定居；沉淀；下陷：deposit, beach, work out, figure out
vt. 解决；安排；使…定居：decide, schedule, budget, place in, work out
rm: set(放置) + tle → 放置在一个地方就好像定居了下来 → 定居， 安家

t: adj. 严重的；严厉的，剧烈的
en: severe problems, injuries, illnesses etc are very bad or very serious

ex.en: His injuries were quite severe.
ex.cn: 他的伤势很严重。

ex.en: She’s suffering from severe depression.
ex.cn: 她患有严重的抑郁症。

ph.cn: 严重急性呼吸系统综合症

syn: adj. 严峻的；严厉的；剧烈的；苛刻的：tight, hard, smart, harsh, rigorous

en: a pipe or passage under the ground that carries away waste material and used water from houses, factories etc

ex.en: ...the city's sewer system.
ex.cn: …该城市的下水道系统。

syn: n. [建]下水道；阴沟；裁缝师：sewage, cloacae

t: adj. 破旧的，褴褛的，卑鄙的，不公平的
en: shabby clothes, places, or objects are untidy and in bad condition because they have been used for a long time

ex.en: Hugh’s jacket was old and shabby.

ex.cn: 把衣服浸泡在冷水里。

ex.cn: 把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

t: adj. 严肃的，认真的，清醒的

城市社会学，都市社会学

en: relating to the sun

t: n. 脚底；adj. 单独的；惟一的

ex.en: The soles of his feet were caked in mud.
ex.cn: 他的脚掌上沾满了泥巴。

adj. 唯一的；[法]单独的；仅有的：alone, unique, independent, one, isolated

ex.cn: 严肃的表情

ex.cn: 他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。

ex.en: a gesture of solidarity
ex.cn: 团结的表示

ex.cn: 呼吁工人们团结

ex.cn: 这场比赛的唯一入球

n. [动]独居者；隐士：hermit, anchorite

ex.cn: 一首极其美妙的钢琴独奏曲

ex.cn: 学生必须达到某一标准，否则无法通过。

ex.cn: 无论是否使用这项服务，你都必须一直付费。

t: n. 主要产品；名产；纤维；主要成分，主食

ex.cn: 抱歉，我不是故意吓你一跳的。
