en: to suffer or die because you do not have enough to eat

ex.en: Thousands of people will starve if food doesn’t reach the city.
ex.cn: 如果食品不能运到那座城市，成千上万的人就要饿死。

ex.cn: 饥饿儿童的照片

ex.cn: 一位受人尊敬的政界元老

ex.cn: 经济学家预测，房价将长期保持稳定。

ex.cn: 你是怎么开车的，竟会撞上一辆停着的车子？

en: materials that you use for writing, such as paper, pens, pencils etc

ex.en: ...envelopes and other office stationery.
ex.cn: …信封及其他办公文具。

syn: n. [轻]文具；信纸：writing materials, letter pad

t: n. 统计，统计数字；统计学
en: quantitative data on any subject, esp data comparing the distribution of some quantity for different subclasses of the population

ex.en: statistics for earnings by different age groups

syn: n. [统计]统计；统计学；统计资料：correlations, numerical statement

en: an image of a person or animal that is made in solid material such as stone or metal and is usually large

ex.en: Churchill’s statue stands outside the parliament building.
ex.cn: 丘吉尔的塑像矗立在议会大厦外。

ex.en: A bronze statue was erected in his honour.
ex.cn: 人们立了一座铜像纪念他。

syn: n. [建]雕像，塑像：effigy
rm: stat(站) + ue → 总是站立的东西 → 塑像

en: the official legal position or condition of a person, group, country etc

ex.en: These documents have no legal status in Britain.
ex.cn: 这些文件在英国并无法律效力。

ex.cn: 你的婚姻状况是什么？

syn: n. 地位；状态；情形；重要身分：capacity, ranking

en: a law passed by a parliament, council etc and formally written down

ex.en: Protection for the consumer is laid down by statute (= established by law ) .
ex.cn: 保障消费者权益已有法律明文规定。

syn: n. [法]法规；法令；条例：act, ordinance

t: "a. 坚定的, 不变的，不动摇的 "
syn: adj. 坚定的；不变的：committed, firm, constant, confirmed, permanent

en: continuing or developing gradually or without stopping, and not likely to change

ex.en: Paul is making steady progress.
ex.cn: 保罗逐渐在进步。

ex.en: a steady rain
ex.cn: 下个不停的雨

vt. 使稳定；稳固；使坚定：firm, stabilitate

t: adj. 坚固的，巨大的；富有的
en: large in amount or number

ex.en: We have the support of a substantial number of parents.
ex.cn: 我们有相当多家长的支持。

ex.en: a substantial salary
ex.cn: 丰厚的薪水

n. 本质；重要材料：essence, entity, principle, texture, interior

ex.en: Katzen offered little evidence to substantiate his claims .
ex.cn: 卡曾拿不出什么证据来证明他的说法。

syn: vt. 证实；使实体化：favor, make sure, validate, sustain

t: n. 代替人，代用品；v. 代替
en: someone who does someone else’s job for a limited period of time, especially in a sports team or school

ex.en: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
ex.cn: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

ex.en: substitute goalkeeper
ex.cn: 替补守门员

syn: n. 代用品；代替者：replacement, proxy
vi. [计]替代：supply, fill in

en: the words printed over a film in a foreign language to translate what is being said by the actors

ex.en: a French film with English subtitles
ex.cn: 附有英语字幕的法国电影

t: adj. 微妙的；难以捉摸的；精明的
en: not easy to notice or understand unless you pay careful attention

ex.en: The pictures are similar, but there are subtle differences between them.
ex.cn: 这些图片很相似，但它们之间有细微的差别。

ex.en: The warning signs of the disease are so subtle that they are often ignored.
ex.cn: 这种疾病的警示征兆不易察觉，因而往往被忽视。

syn: adj. 微妙的；精细的；敏感的；狡猾的；稀薄的：sensitive, delicate, detailed, refined, designing

en: to take a number or an amount from a larger number or amount

ex.en: The pupil could add and subtract but hadn't learned to divide.
ex.cn: 这名小学生能做加法和减法，但还没学会做除法。

ex.cn: 因此，如果您在循环中具有人员活动，并且想要运行以上的请求，那么您必须确保您只减去了属于一起的事件。

ex.cn: 她连续四次夺得冠军。

ex.cn: 简明扼要的解释

ex.en: Don't succumb to the temptation to have just one cigarette.
ex.cn: 不要屈服于只抽一支烟的诱惑。

rm: suc(在…下面) + cumb(躺) → 躺下不再起来 → 死亡

en: to take air, liquid etc into your mouth by making your lips form a small hole and using the muscles of your mouth to pull it in

ex.cn: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

ex.cn: 农业商品

ex.en: To avoid confusion, the teams wore different colours.
ex.cn: 为了避免混淆，各队穿着不同颜色的服装。

打乱；使陷入混乱；使…惊慌失措

ex.cn: 执政党工党的代表大会

ex.cn: 他们想在一家与他们自己的价值观相同的组织里工作。

ex.cn: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

ex.cn: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

ex.en: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
ex.cn: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

ex.cn: 我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。

ex.en: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
ex.cn: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

ex.cn: 勤勉刻苦的学生

ex.cn: 救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

ex.cn: 雨接连下了四天。

ex.cn: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

ex.cn: 他没有得到车主的许可就把车开走了。

en: the period during the 1930s when there was not much business activity and not many jobs

ex.cn: 他从未忘记20世纪30年代经济大萧条时期他所目睹的艰辛。

ph.cn: 大萧条（美国经济大萧条时期）

syn: n. 沮丧；[地理]洼地；[经]不景气；忧愁：recession, disappointment
rm: 来自depress(vt. 使沮丧； 使不景气)

en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it

ex.en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
ex.cn: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

syn: vt. 使丧失，剥夺：shear, strip of
rm: de(离开) + priv(私有的) + e → 使某物离开某人 → 使丧失

en: someone who is directly below another person in rank, and who is officially in charge when that person is not there

ex.en: His brother was acting as his deputy in America.
ex.cn: 他的兄弟充当他在美洲的代理人。

syn: n. [法][贸易]代理人，代表：agent, representation, factor, secondary, proxy
adj. 副的；[法][贸易]代理的：acting, vice, agent, auxiliary
rm: de + puty(看作duty， 责任) → 应负责任的人 → 代理人

en: a derelict building or piece of land is in very bad condition because it has not been used for a long time

ex.en: Her body was found dumped in a derelict warehouse less than a mile from her home.
ex.cn: 她的尸体被发现丢在离她家不到一英里的一座废弃的仓库里。

syn: adj. 玩忽职守的；无主的；被抛弃了的：ownerless, masterless
n. 遗弃物；玩忽职守者；被遗弃的人：Ishmael
rm: de(表加强)  + re(后) + lict(分离) → 完全置后 → 被抛弃的

en: to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something

ex.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
ex.cn: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

syn: vi. 起源：to originate
rm: de + rive(r) → 黄河是中华文明的发源地 → 起源

t: v. 下降；下来；遗传；袭击
en: to move from a higher level to a lower one

ex.en: Our plane started to descend.
ex.cn: 我们的飞机开始下降。

ex.en: I heard his footsteps descending the stairs.
ex.cn: 我听到他下楼的脚步声。

ph.cn: vt. 突然到达）；袭击（突然降临

syn: vi. 下降；下去；下来；遗传；屈尊：decline, go down
rm: de(向下) + scend(爬) → 往下爬 → 下降； 遗传

en: the process of going down

ex.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts prior to descent.
ex.cn: 乘客在飞机降落之前必须系好安全带。

syn: n. [航]下降；[遗]血统；袭击：reduction, birth, decline, fall, blood

en: a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like

ex.en: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
ex.cn: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

ex.en: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
ex.cn: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

syn: n. 描述，描写；类型；说明书：presentation, type, style, characterization

t: n&a. 沙漠；n. 无人居住的；v. 丢弃；n. 离开
en: a large area of land where it is always very dry, and there is a lot of sand

ex.en: the Sahara Desert
ex.cn: 撒哈拉沙漠

ex.en: This area of the country is mostly desert.
ex.cn: 该国的这一地区大部分是沙漠。

ph.cn: 戈壁沙漠（蒙古和中国西北部）

syn: vt. 遗弃；放弃；逃跑：yield, quit
vi. 遗弃；开小差；逃掉：run out on, walk out on
rm: de(分开) + sert(放置) → 不放进去 → 舍弃

en: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour

ex.en: What have I done to deserve this?
ex.cn: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

ex.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
ex.cn: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

syn: vi. 应受，应得：be deserving of
vt. 应受，应得：be deserving of
rm: de + serv(服务)  + e → 花钱享受应得的服务 → 应得； 值得

t: n&v. 设计，构思；设计制图术
en: the art or process of making a drawing of something to show how you will make it or what it will look like

ex.en: The new plane is in its final design stage.
ex.cn: 这种新型飞机正处于最后的设计阶段。

ex.en: the design process
ex.cn: 设计过程

syn: vt. 设计；计划；构思：project, engineer, style, schedule, frame
n. 设计；图案：programming, device, pattern
rm: de + sign(标记) → 做标记 → 设计

t: v. 把定名为，指派，标出
en: to choose someone or something for a particular job or purpose

ex.en: Buildings are designated by red squares on the map.
ex.cn: 在地图上建筑物用红色方块标明。

syn: vt. 指定；指派；标出；把…定名为：specify, ticket, name, appoint
adj. 指定的；选定的：assigned, named, appointed

en: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it

ex.en: Read the manufacturer's guidelines before discarding the box.
ex.cn: 先阅读制造商的说明书再把盒子丢掉。

syn: vt. 抛弃；放弃；丢弃：yield, desert, quit
vi. 放弃：fall out of, render up, to renounce, to abandon, to give up
rm: dis(分离) + card(纸牌) → 出牌， 把牌扔出去 → 丢弃， 遗弃

en: to notice or understand something by thinking about it carefully

ex.en: We could just discern a town in the distance.
ex.cn: 我们依稀看到远处有一座城镇。

syn: vt. 识别；领悟，认识：recognize, identify
vi. 看清楚，辨别：see clearly, tell from

t: v&n. 卸货；排出(液体，气体)；释放
en: to send out gas, liquid, smoke etc, or to allow it to escape

ex.en: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
ex.cn: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

ph.cn: 局部放电；部分放电；部份履行

syn: vt. [劳经]解雇；卸下；放出；免除：issue, forgive
vi. [环境]排放；卸货；[流]流出：issue, shed
rm: dis(分离) + charge(职责； 电荷) → 解雇； 放(电)

t: n&vt. 训练，纪律，戒律，惩罚
en: a way of training someone so that they learn to control their behaviour and obey rules

ex.en: The book gives parents advice on discipline.
ex.cn: 这本书指导父母如何管教孩子。

ex.en: serious discipline problems in the police force
ex.cn: 警察队伍内严重的纪律问题

syn: n. 学科；[管理]纪律；训练；惩罚：science, punishment, rod, knowledge, payment
vt. 训练，训导；惩戒：coach, drill
rm: dis(不) + cip + line(线) → 不站成一条线就要受惩罚 → 必须遵守纪律 → 纪律

en: to make something publicly known, especially after it has been kept secret

ex.en: Some companies have already voluntarily disclosed similar information .
ex.cn: 一些公司已经主动透露了类似的信息。

ex.en: He refused to disclose the identity of the politician.
ex.cn: 他拒绝透露那位政治家的身份。

syn: vt. 公开；揭露：reveal, expose
rm: dis(不) + clos(关闭) + e → 不关闭 → 揭露； 透露； 公开

t: n. 不和，争吵，(声音)不和谐
en: disagreement or arguing between people

ex.en: marital discord
ex.cn: 婚姻不和

ex.en: discord within NATO
ex.cn: 北约内部的纷争

ph.cn: 不和的金苹果；引起不和的争端；不和的种子；祸根（据希腊神话三女神因争金苹果而导致特洛伊战争）

syn: n. [声]不和；不调和；嘈杂声：misunderstanding, strife
vi. 不一致；刺耳：out of tune with, out of line

t: n. 折扣；v. 不全信，低估，漠视
en: a reduction in the usual price of something

ex.en: They are often available at a discount.
ex.cn: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

ph.cn: 打折扣；不受欢迎，没销路

syn: n. [贸易]折扣；[金融]贴现率：agio, rabato
vt. [贸易]打折扣；将…贴现；贬损：water sth. down, preach down
rm: dis(分离) + count(计算) → 不计算在内的部分 → 折扣

t: adj. 谨慎的，思虑两全的
en: careful about what you say or do, so that you do not offend, upset, or embarrass people or tell secrets

ex.en: He assured her that he would be discreet.
ex.cn: 他向她保证会谨慎行事。

ex.en: I stood back at a discreet distance.
ex.cn: 我谨慎地保持一段距离站在后面。

syn: adj. 谨慎的；小心的：careful, cautious, prudent, wary

t: adj. 分离的，不相关联的
en: clearly separate

ex.en: The change happens in a series of discrete steps.
ex.cn: 这个变化在一系列分离的步骤中发生。

syn: adj. 离散的，[数]不连续的：uncontinuous, incontinuous

en: a difference between two amounts, details, reports etc that should be the same

ex.en: ...the discrepancy between press and radio reports.
ex.cn: …报刊报道与广播报道之间的差异。

syn: n. 不符；矛盾；相差：conflict, unconformity
rm: dis(分开) + crep(发出破裂声) + ancy → 裂开 → 矛盾

en: to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way

ex.en: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
ex.cn: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。

syn: vt. 歧视；区别；辨别：tell from, distinguish from
vi. 歧视；区别；辨别：tell from, distinguish from
rm: dis(分开) + crimin(分开) + ate → 分开对待 → 区别； 歧视

en: a complete lack of respect that you show for someone or something because you think they are not important or good enough

ex.en: a look of complete disdain
ex.cn: 极为鄙视的样子

syn: n. 蔑视：defiance, snotnose
rm: dis(不) + dain(=dign高贵) → 把人弄得不高贵 → 鄙视， 蔑视

en: to change someone’s appearance so that people cannot recognize them

ex.en: He escaped across the border disguised as a priest.
ex.cn: 他装扮成神父越境逃走了。

ph.cn: 伪装，假扮成；托辞；以……为借口

syn: vt. 掩饰；假装；隐瞒：simulate, come
n. 伪装；假装；用作伪装的东西：simulation, acting

en: a strong feeling of dislike, annoyance, or disapproval

ex.en: He reached into the bin with a look of disgust on his face.
ex.cn: 他把手伸进垃圾箱，脸上带着厌恶的表情。

syn: n. 厌恶，嫌恶：aversion, abomination
vt. 使厌恶；使作呕：indispose, repel
n. 沮丧，灰心；惊慌：depression, alarm, disappointment
vt. 使沮丧；使惊慌：depress, dispirit

t: v. 解散；解雇；不考虑；消除
en: to remove someone from their job

ex.en: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
ex.cn: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

syn: vt. 解散；解雇；开除；让...离开：remove, fire out
vi. 解散：disband, break up
rm: dis(分开) + miss(送， 放出) → 解散， 解雇

t: n&vt. 混乱，骚动，(身心)失调
en: a mental or physical illness which prevents part of your body from working properly

ex.en: severe eating disorders such as bulimia and anorexia
ex.cn: 像贪食症和厌食症这类严重的进食障碍

ph.cn: 混乱；慌乱地， 狼狈不堪；杂乱地

syn: n. 混乱；骚乱：chaos, confusion, disturbance, turmoil, involvement
vt. [医]使失调；[电子]扰乱：upset, disarrange
rm: dis(不) + order(顺序) → 无序 → 混乱

t: v&n. 派遣，发送，迅速办理，急件
en: to send someone or something somewhere for a particular purpose

ex.en: Goods are normally dispatched within 24 hours.
ex.cn: 货物一般在24小时内派送。

ph.cn: 调度中心；运输中心；勤务中心

syn: n. 派遣；急件：urgent-mail
vt. 派遣；分派：mission, send along

en: to make something go away, especially a belief, idea, or feeling

ex.en: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
ex.cn: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

ex.en: Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
ex.cn: 阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

syn: vt. 驱散，驱逐；消除（烦恼等）：eliminate, avoid

en: if a group of people disperse or are dispersed, they go away in different directions

ex.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
ex.cn: 警察用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

ph.cn: 分散体系；分散系统；分散物系

syn: vt. 分散；使散开；传播：transmit, spread around
vi. 分散：spread around, spread about

en: to take the place or position of something or someone

ex.en: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
ex.cn: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。

ex.en: immigrants who displace US workers in the job market
ex.cn: 在就业市场上取代美国工人的移民

syn: vt. 取代；置换；转移；把…免职；排水：shift, replace by
rm: dis(分离) + place(位置) → 使从位置上离开 → 取代

en: an arrangement of things for people to look at or buy

ex.en: a dazzling display (= very good display ) of flowers
ex.cn: 令人目眩神迷的花卉展

ex.en: The window display caught her eye.
ex.cn: 橱窗陈列吸引了她的目光。

ph.cn: n. 液晶显示器；液晶屏幕

syn: n. [电子]显示；炫耀：exhibition, manifestation
vt. [电子]显示；表现；陈列：reveal, make clear, conduct oneself, prove, represent
rm: dis(分开) + play(播放， 表演) → 分开播放 → 陈列， 展览

en: to arrange things or put them in their places

ex.en: Chinese vases are disposed around the gallery.
ex.cn: 中国花瓶摆放在展馆四周。

ph.cn: 处理；转让；解决；吃光；除掉；卖掉

syn: vt. 处理；处置；安排：schedule, budget, settle, place in, cope with
vi. 处理；安排；（能够）决定：manage, place in, cope with

t: adj. 阴暗的，迟钝的，沉闷的，钝的；v. 变钝
en: not interesting or exciting

ex.en: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
ex.cn: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

ex.en: a dull movie
ex.cn: 一部沉闷的电影

syn: adj. 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的：slow, blunt
vt. 使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和：relax, benumb
rm: 和充实的(full)相反的是乏味的(dull)

en: in the proper or expected way

ex.en: Here are your travel documents, all duly signed.
ex.cn: 这是你的旅行证件，都签好了。

syn: adv. 适当地；充分地；按时地：properly, fully, well, adequately, appropriately

t: adj. 哑的；暂不说话的；愚笨的
en: stupid

ex.en: What a dumb question.
ex.cn: 多么愚蠢的问题。

ex.en: a bunch of dumb kids
ex.cn: 一帮笨孩子

ph.cn: n. 小型送货升降机；送菜升降机，餐用升降机

syn: adj. 哑的，无说话能力的；不说话的，无声音的：tongueless, speechless

t: v. 倒垃圾，倾销；n. 堆垃圾的地方
en: to get rid of goods by selling them in a foreign country at a much lower price

ex.en: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried toward the market.
ex.cn: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德旅馆，急匆匆地向市场赶去。

syn: vt. 倾倒；倾卸：pour in
vi. 倒垃圾：empty the trash
rm: “当铺” → 到当铺去倾销 → 倾卸， 倾倒

t: adj. 完全一样的，复制的；n. 复制品；v. 复写
en: exactly the same as something, or made as an exact copy of something

ex.en: A duplicate copy should be made for the county record office.
ex.cn: 应该制作一个副本呈交县档案室。

ex.en: a duplicate key
ex.cn: 配制的钥匙

syn: vt. [印刷][专利]复制；使加倍：repeat, double
n. 副本；[印刷][专利]复制品：repeat, reproduction, counterpart
rm: du(两， 双) + plic(重叠) + ate → 两种重叠状态 → 完全相同的； 复制品

t: adj. 耐用的；n. 耐用品
en: staying in good condition for a long time, even if used a lot

ex.en: Wood is a durable material.
ex.cn: 木头是耐用材料。

syn: adj. 耐用的，持久的：continued, sustained, service, lasting
n. 耐用品：hardgoods
rm: dur(持续) + able(可…的) → 耐久的； 耐用的

t: n. 矮子，矮小的动植物；v. 使矮小
en: an imaginary creature that looks like a small man

ex.en: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
ex.cn: 《白雪公主和七个小矮人》

syn: n. 侏儒，[内科]矮子：homuncle, mannikin
adj. [生物]矮小的：scrubby, runty

en: to live in a particular place

ex.en: They dwelt in the forest.
ex.cn: 他们住在森林里。

syn: vi. 居住；存在于；细想某事：belong, room, harbor, live, reside in

en: to gradually become less and less or smaller and smaller

ex.en: The elephant population is dwindling.
ex.cn: 大象的数量在减少。

ex.en: His money had dwindled away.
ex.cn: 他的钱在逐渐变少。

syn: vi. 减少；变小：to cut down, fall off
vt. 使缩小，使减少：shrink, astrict
rm: d + wind(风) + le → 随风而去， 越来越小 → (使)缩小

t: adj. 精力充沛的；动力的；n. (pl)力学，动力学
en: full of energy and new ideas, and determined to succeed

ex.en: dynamic and ambitious people
ex.cn: 精力充沛且雄心勃勃的人

ph.cn: 动态分析；动力特性分析

syn: adj. [力]动态的；动力的；动力学的；有活力的：vital, actional
n. 动态；[力]动力：trends, momentum, impetus
rm: dynam(力量) + ic → 力量的 → 动力的； 活跃的

en: very serious and sincere

ex.en: a rather earnest young man
ex.cn: 相当认真的一个年轻人

ex.en: Matthews was in earnest conversation with a young girl.
ex.cn: 马修斯在和一个年轻姑娘认真地谈话。

ph.cn: [古语]十分严肃地，一本正经地

syn: adj. 认真的，热心的；重要的：crucial, important, serious, considerable, material
n. 认真；[贸易]定金；诚挚：sincerity, staidness

t: v&n. 减轻，放松，小心移置；舒适
en: feeling relaxed, especially in a situation in which people might feel a little nervous

ex.en: They won with ease.
ex.cn: 他们轻松获胜。

ph.cn: ◎自我安慰，泄愤，出气；抛弃心头的烦闷

syn: vt. 减轻，缓和；使安心：moderate, relax
n. 轻松，舒适；安逸，悠闲：comfort, leisure

en: a Christian holy day in March or April when Christians remember the death of Christ and his return to life

ex.en: on Easter Sunday
ex.cn: 在复活节星期日

ph.cn: （复活节人们用作礼物或装饰品的）复活节兔子；[美俚]令人仰慕的人

t: n&a. 古怪(的)，偏执(的)，不同心(的)
en: An eccentric is an eccentric person

ex.en: Askew used several names, and had a reputation as an eccentric.
ex.cn: 艾斯丘用过几个名字，并以“怪人”著称。

syn: adj. 古怪的，反常的：abnormal, odd, curious
n. 古怪的人：fantastic, weirdo
rm: ec(=e出) + centr(中心) + ic → 偏离中心的 → 古怪的， 反常的

en: if a sound echoes, you hear it again because it was made near something such as a wall or hill

ex.en: The sound of an engine echoed back from the thick forest.
ex.cn: 从茂密的森林里传来引擎的回声。

syn: vt. 反射；重复：reflect, mirror, repeat
n. 回音；效仿：aftersound, bounceback

ex.en: an eclipse of the sun
ex.cn: 日食

en: the way in which plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment, or the scientific study of this

ex.en: the natural ecology of the Earth
ex.cn: 地球的自然生态

ex.en: plant ecology
ex.cn: 植物生态学

t: adj. 经济的；经济学的，便宜的
en: relating to trade, in-dustry, and the management of money

ex.cn: 经济增长缓慢。

ex.en: the government’s economic policy
ex.cn: 政府的经济政策

en: using money, time, goods etc carefully and without wasting any

ex.en: A small car is more economical to run.
ex.cn: 开小型汽车比较省油。

ex.cn: 物美价廉的衣服

ex.cn: 发展成功的经济

ex.en: the slowdown in the Japanese economy
ex.cn: 日本经济的减缓

syn: n. 经济；[经]节约；理财：saving, thrift

ex.cn: 湍急的河水形成了许多漩涡。

ex.cn: 把鸡蛋放在盘子中间，盘边一圈放些蔬菜和香草。

ex.en: He stood at the water’s edge staring across the lake.
ex.cn: 他站在水边，凝视着湖对面。

syn: n. [地质]边缘；优势；刀刃；锋利：margin, superiority, advantage, brink, suburb

ex.cn: 巨大的花束

ex.cn: 巨款

ex.cn: 我写信是要确认/询问/通知你…

ex.en: I recently e-mailed one website to enquire why my goods had not yet arrived.
ex.cn: 我最近给一个网站发邮件去询问为什么我订购的商品还没有到达。

t: v. 使丰富，加料于，增进

ex.en: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
ex.cn: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。

ex.cn: 教育可以大大充实生活。

syn: vt. 使充实；使肥沃；使富足：fertilize

ex.cn: 这所学校将于八月份招收新生.

ex.cn: 注册将于9月进行。

ex.cn: …一个由年轻音乐家组成的乐团。

ex.cn: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

ex.cn: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

ex.cn: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

ex.en: The blade of the oar had entangled itself with the strap of her bag.
ex.cn: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

t: n. 艰巨的事业；事业心，企业

ex.cn: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

ex.en: There will be live entertainment (= performed then, not recorded ) throughout the day.
ex.cn: 现场表演将持续一整天。

syn: n. 娱乐；消遣；款待：recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement

en: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something

ex.cn: 改革的热心支持者

ex.cn: …一场名为“合众国”的演出。

ex.cn: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

ex.cn: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

syn: n. 实体；存在；本质：presence, existence, essence, principle, texture

en: to ask someone, in a very emotional way, to do something for you

ex.en: He entreated them to delay their departure.
ex.cn: 他恳求他们晚些再走。

t: n. 进入，入口；条目，词条

ex.cn: 没有强行闯入的迹象。

ex.cn: 窃贼是怎样进入的？

en: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities

ex.cn: 保护环境的法规

ex.cn: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

ex.en: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
ex.cn: 她的生活方式会令大多数人感到羡慕。

ex.cn: 据信它能抑制一种能在肿瘤中促进细胞增殖的酶的生成。

ex.cn: 这种酶在幼虫体内积累到一定浓度，就会变得有毒并杀死它们。

ex.cn: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

ex.cn: 外国的奇异鸟类

ex.cn: 有异国风情的地方

ex.cn: 水结冰时会膨胀。

ex.cn: 20世纪60年代，悉尼的人口迅速增加。

ex.cn: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。

ex.cn: 北极探险

ex.cn: 又一次珠穆朗玛峰探险

ex.cn: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

ex.cn: 我的护照下周就到期了。

ex.cn: 合约于今年夏天到期的运动员

ex.cn: 清楚易懂的语法知识

ex.cn: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

ex.cn: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

ex.cn: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

ex.cn: 威尼斯是一个美妙的城市，值得好好探究一番。

ex.cn: …150磅的塞姆汀塑料炸药。

ex.cn: 这部电影揭示了战争的极端恐怖。

ex.cn: 报道揭露了现代医疗的不足之处。

ex.cn: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

en: the act of forcing someone to leave a place

ex.cn: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。

ex.cn: 最精美的工艺

ex.cn: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

经济上可行的，经济上合算

ex.cn: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

ex.en: His parents still clung to the misguided belief that his common sense would keep him out of serious trouble.
ex.cn: 他的父母依然错误地认为他的常识能让他远离大的麻烦。

syn: v. 使入歧途（misguide的过去分词）：perverted

ex.cn: 午睡

vi. 小睡；疏忽：caulk off, neglect of

ex.en: The truth of Johnson’s comment was recently brought home to me by the serene calm of a resident who was treating a particularly complicated narcotic-dependent patient.
ex.cn: 最近，一位住院医生对待一位异常复杂的麻醉药依赖病人的平静态度让我领会到了塞缪尔.约翰逊这句话的真谛。

ex.en: As a result, almost 50 years after the agreement was adopted, adequate availability of narcotic drugs for pain treatment remains an unfulfilled promise.
ex.cn: 因此虽然条约早在50年前被通过，但确保治疗疼痛的麻醉药物供应充足仍是个未兑现的承诺。

syn: adj. [药]麻醉的；有麻醉作用的；催眠的：anesthetic, anaesthetic
n. [药]麻醉药；镇静剂；起麻醉作用的事物：drug, banque

en: a description of events in a story, especially in a novel

ex.en: At several points in the narrative the two stories cross.
ex.cn: 叙述中两条故事线多次交织在一起。

syn: n. 叙述；故事；讲述：relation, statement, story, telling, tale
adj. 叙事的，叙述的；叙事体的：related, descriptive

t: adj. 令人作呕的，令人不快的，下流的

ex.en: I went to school with him e_SEnD he was nasty then and he’s nasty now.
ex.cn: 我和他一起上过学他那时很讨厌，现在还是很讨厌。

ex.cn: 你这个讨厌的小家伙！

en: relating to birth

ex.en: Green turtles return to their natal island to breed.
ex.cn: 绿毛龟回到它们出生的岛上繁殖。

ex.en: I was overcome with a feeling of nausea.
ex.cn: 我感到一阵恶心。

syn: n. [临床]恶心，晕船；极端的憎恶：queasiness, naupathia

en: relating to the navy or used by the navy

ex.en: a naval officer
ex.cn: 海军军官

ex.en: ...the navigable portion of the Nile.
ex.cn: ...尼罗河的适航河段。

syn: adj. [水运][航]可航行的；可驾驶的；适于航行的：floatable, flyable

syn: n. [航]航行；[水运]航海：salling, siling

t: adj. 整洁的；雅致的；灵巧的；纯的；不掺水的
en: tidy and carefully arranged

ex.en: neat handwriting
ex.cn: 工整的笔迹

ex.en: His clothes were always neat and clean.
ex.cn: 他的衣服总是很整洁。

syn: adj. 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的：elegant, flowing, graceful

en: to make it necessary for you to do something

ex.en: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
ex.cn: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

ex.en: students with a negative attitude to school
ex.cn: 对上学抱消极态度的学生

ex.cn: 他们都对警察印象不好。

不利影响；消极作用；负影响

n. [语]否定；负数；[摄]底片：infirmation, disaffirmation

t: v. 忽视，搁置未做；n. 忽略，疏忽

ex.en: Many of these ideas have been neglected by modern historians.
ex.cn: 这些观点有许多都被现代的历史学家忽略了。

ex.en: The police officer was accused of neglecting his duty (= not doing everything he should ).
ex.cn: 那位警官被控渎职。

en: failure to take enough care over something that you are responsible for

ex.en: negligence in carrying out safety procedures
ex.cn: 执行安全程序时的疏忽

ex.cn: 那座桥梁的建筑师被控犯有玩忽职守罪。

ph.cn: 重大过失；严重过失；显著的疏忽

ex.cn: 对他财产造成的损失微不足道。

syn: adj. 微不足道的，[数]可以忽略的：bit, inappreciable

ex.cn: 招聘兼职酒吧男服务员，工作时间及薪金面议。

ex.en: The price is not negotiable.
ex.cn: 价格没有商量的余地。

t: adj. 神经病的，神经过敏的；n. 神经过敏者
en: unreasonably anxious or afraid

ex.en: He seemed a neurotic, self-obsessed man.
ex.cn: 他似乎是个神经过敏又自恋的人。

ex.en: These patients are not neurotics.
ex.cn: 这些病人不是神经官能症患者。

syn: adj. 神经过敏的；神经病的：jittery, ouchy
n. 神经病患者；神经过敏者：nervous wreck

ex.en: a medicine that neutralizes the acid in the stomach
ex.cn: 能中和胃酸的药

syn: vt. 抵销；使…中和；使…无效；使…中立：blank, cancel out

en: in spite of a fact that you have just mentioned

ex.en: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
ex.cn: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

syn: adv. 然而，不过；虽然如此：though, natheless
conj. 然而，不过：whereas, however, while, but, yet

en: to eat small amounts of food by taking very small bites

ex.en: He nibbled the biscuit cautiously.
ex.cn: 他小心地啃着饼干。

ph.cn: 一点一点地咬；吹毛求疵；啃

vt. 细咬；一点一点地咬；吹毛求疵：find quarrel in a straw, cavil about

syn: vt. 迷住，缠住；使…着迷；使…困扰：possess, spell

t: n. 缠住，被困扰；观念固执，死脑筋
syn: n. 痴迷；困扰；[内科][心理]强迫观念：besetment, obsessive idea
rm: ob(逆) + sess(=sit坐) + ion → 坐立不安 → 困扰

en: no longer useful, because something newer and better has been invented

ex.en: obsolete weapons
ex.cn: 已被淘汰的武器

ex.en: computer hardware that quickly became obsolete
ex.cn: 很快就变得过时的电脑硬件

syn: adj. [生物]废弃的；老式的：waste, dumped
vt. 淘汰；废弃：fall into disuse, wash out

en: something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing

ex.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
ex.cn: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

ex.en: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
ex.cn: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

syn: n. 障碍，干扰；妨害物：interference, let, bar, disturbance, dam
rm: ob(反) + st(=stand站) + acle(表小东西) → 反着站的小物体 → 障碍， 妨碍物

t: adj. 顽固的，倔强的，不易屈服的，较难治愈的
en: determined not to change your ideas, behaviour, opinions etc, even when other people think you are being unreasonable

ex.en: He was the most obstinate man I’ve ever met.
ex.cn: 他是我遇到过的最固执的人。

ex.en: Don’t be so obstinate!
ex.cn: 别这么固执！

syn: adj. 顽固的；倔强的；难以控制的：resistant, stubborn

ex.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
ex.cn: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

ex.en: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
ex.cn: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

syn: vt. 妨碍；阻塞；遮断：let, violate
vi. 阻塞；设障碍：plug up, block up

en: easy to notice or understand

ex.en: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
ex.cn: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

syn: adj. 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的：distinct, visible, prominent, marked, evident

t: n. 的时刻；机会；需要；v. 引起，导致
en: a suitable or favourable time

ex.en: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago in New Orleans.
ex.cn: 我经常深情地想起一些年前在新奥尔良所发生的一幕。

ph.cn: 特别的时刻；特别的场合

syn: n. 时机，机会；场合；理由：opportunity, chance, opening, sake, reason
vt. 引起，惹起：attract, cause, produce, operate, induce

en: to live or stay in a place

ex.en: He occupies the house without paying any rent.
ex.cn: 他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。

ex.en: The building was purchased and occupied by its new owners last year.
ex.cn: 这幢房屋去年被新业主买下入住了。

ex.cn: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

ex.en: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
ex.cn: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

ex.en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
ex.cn: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

syn: n. 发生；出现；事件；发现：emergence, going on, event, discovery, appearance, circumstance, scene

t: adj. 古怪的，奇数的；单独的；零头的；临时的
en: different from what is normal or expected, especially in a way that you disapprove of or cannot understand

ex.en: It was an odd thing to say.
ex.cn: 这话说得很奇怪。

ex.en: an odd way to behave
ex.cn: 古怪的行为

ph.cn: 出人意料互不相配的一对

syn: adj. [数]奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；临时的；零散的：remaining, extraordinary, temporary, surplus, residual
n. [数]奇数；怪人；奇特的事物：put, wack

ex.en: (= it is likely ) that he will commit the same crime again.
ex.cn: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

ex.cn: 他们失败的可能性有多大？

ex.cn: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。

ex.en: Gemma was reading.
ex.cn: 吉玛正在看书。

ex.en: The researchers demonstrate that it is possible to generate odor in a compact device that can fit on the back of a TV with potentially thousands of odors.
ex.cn: 研究员表示，将一个可以散发上千种气味的小型设备安装在电视背后，从而实现电视(根据情景)生成气味是可能的。

ph.cn: 臭气控制，气味控制；四氟化硅处理

syn: n. 气味；名声：smell, wind, fame

t: n. 长途冒险旅行；一连串的冒险
en: a long journey with a lot of adventures or difficulties

ex.en: a spiritual odyssey
ex.cn: 一次精神上的艰难历程

en: an illegal action or a crime

ex.en: His solicitor said he committed the offence because he was heavily in debt.
ex.cn: 他的律师说他犯罪是因为欠下巨债。

syn: n. 犯罪；违反；过错；攻击：crime, attempt, attack, violation, guilt
vt. 冒犯；使…不愉快：give offense, gross out
vi. 违反；进攻；引起不舒服：vary, be in breach of

t: v. 违犯；伤害的感情；n. 提供；提议
en: a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give them something

ex.en: The offer of talks with Moscow marks a significant change from the previous Western position.
ex.cn: 与莫斯科会谈的提议标志着先前西方立场的一个重大转变。

n. 提议；出价；意图：proposal, intention, meaning, will, bid

t: n. 河流等出口，出路；发泄(感情等)的方法
en: a way of expressing or getting rid of strong feelings

ex.en: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
ex.cn: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的途径。

t: n. 外形，轮廓；大纲，纲要
en: the main ideas or facts about something, without the details

ex.en: a research proposal outline
ex.cn: 研究计划梗概

syn: n. 轮廓；大纲；概要；略图：profile, program, brief, contour
vt. 概述；略述；描画…轮廓：summarize, sum up
rm: out(外部的) + line(线条) → 外部线条 → 轮廓； 草图

t: adj. 远离中心的，偏僻的
en: far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building

ex.en: one of the outlying suburbs
ex.cn: 边远郊区之一

syn: adj. 边远的；无关的：unrelated, irrespective

en: the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory etc

ex.en: Output is up 30% on last year.
ex.cn: 产量比去年提高了30%。

syn: n. [计]输出，输出量；[经]产量；出产：export, crop, harvest, yield
vt. [计]输出：export, bulk out
rm: out(外面) + put(放) → 输出

en: very shocking and extremely unfair or offensive

ex.en: outrageous prices
ex.cn: 骇人的价格

ex.en: an outrageous attack on his policies
ex.cn: 对他政策的蛮横攻击

syn: adj. 粗暴的；可恶的；令人吃惊的：bearish, abhorrent

t: adj. 断然的；明白无误的

ex.en: an outright refusal
ex.cn: 断然拒绝

adj. 完全的，彻底的；直率的；总共的：thorough, full, complete, absolute, total

en: at or from the beginning of an event or process

ex.en: It was clear from the outset that there were going to be problems.
ex.cn: 从一开始就很清楚会有问题出现的。

ex.en: It’s better to get something in writing right at the outset.
ex.cn: 最好一开始就有个书面的东西。

syn: n. 开始；开端：beginning, threshold, opening, conception, origin

en: the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre

ex.en: Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.
ex.cn: 数小时后我们到达了纽约市的外围地带。

syn: n. 市郊，郊区：suburban district, banlieue

en: expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people

ex.en: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
ex.cn: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

syn: adj. 坦率的，直言不讳的：honest, transparent, open

en: to do something better than someone else or be more successful

ex.en: We outstripped all our competitors in sales last year.
ex.cn: 去年我们的销售额超过了所有竞争对手。

syn: vt. 超过；胜过；比…跑得快：better than, overcome, top, cap, outdo

en: to be more important or valuable than something else

ex.en: The benefits of the scheme outweigh the disadvantages.
ex.cn: 这项计划利大于弊。

syn: vt. 比…重（在重量上）；比…重要；比…有价值：come before, take precedence over
rm: out(超过) + weigh(称重) → 比…更重要

ex.en: Using 2 spoons, form the cheese into small balls or ovals.
ex.cn: 用两把勺把干酪挤成小圆球状或椭圆球状。

n. 椭圆形；[数]卵形：ellipse, elliptical shape

en: if a group of people give someone an ovation, they clap to show approval

ex.en: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
ex.cn: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

ex.en: Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
ex.cn: 歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

t: adj. 包括一切的，全部的；n. 罩衫，工装裤
en: considering or including everything

ex.en: The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
ex.cn: 展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。

ex.en: The overall result is an increase in population.
ex.cn: 总的结果是人口增加。

ex.cn: 威廉斯在管理问题上采用的是一种更务实的做法。

ph.cn: 实际的方法；重实效的方法

syn: adj. 实际的；实用主义的；国事的：practical, actual, effective, real, positive
rm: prag(做) + matic → 切实去做 → 务实的

t: vt&vi. 传教；讲道；劝诫；鼓吹
en: to talk about a religious subject in a public place, especially in a church during a service

ex.en: He traveled the southern states, preaching the gospel .
ex.cn: 他游历南方各州宣讲福音。

syn: vt. 说教；讲道；鼓吹；传道；反复灌输：drum in
vi. 说教；讲道；鼓吹；宣扬：boost, sermonize

t: adj. 不稳定的，不安全的
en: a precarious situation or state is one which may very easily or quickly become worse

ex.en: Her health remained precarious, despite the treatment.
ex.cn: 她尽管接受了治疗，但健康状况还是不稳定。

ex.en: the company’s precarious financial position
ex.cn: 公司岌岌可危的财务状况

syn: adj. 危险的；不确定的：dangerous, critical, risky, threatening
rm: pre(在…前面) + car(汽车) + ious → 坐在汽车前面 → 不安全的

en: something you do in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening

ex.en: Fire precautions were neglected.
ex.cn: 防火措施被忽视了。

ex.en: Vets took precautions to prevent the spread of the disease.
ex.cn: 兽医们为防止疾病蔓延采取了预防措施。

syn: n. 预防，警惕；预防措施：prevention, prophylaxis
vt. 警惕；预先警告：keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled

en: when someone or something is considered to be more impor-tant than someone or something else, and therefore comes first or must be dealt with first

ex.en: Guests were seated in order of precedence .
ex.cn: 宾客们按席次就座。

ex.en: Safety must be given precedence .
ex.cn: 安全必须放在第一位。

ph.cn: 优先于；地位高于；比…重要

syn: n. [计]优先；居先：priority, preference to sth

en: an action or official decision that can be used to give support to later actions or decisions

ex.en: a legal precedent
ex.cn: 判例

syn: adj. 在前的；在先的：prior, prius
rm: pre(在…前面) + ced(走， 前进) + ent → 走在前面的 → 先例； 惯例

en: happening or coming before the time, place, or part mentioned

ex.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
ex.cn: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

syn: adj. 在前的；前述的：prior, prius
rm: pre(在…前面) + ced(走) + e → 走在前面 → 先于

en: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care

ex.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
ex.cn: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

ex.en: our planet’s precious resources
ex.cn: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

syn: adj. 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的：golden, valued

en: a very steep side of a high rock, mountain, or cliff

ex.en: A loose rock tumbled over the precipice.
ex.cn: 一块松动的岩石从悬崖上滚落下来。

syn: n. 悬崖；绝壁；险境：escarpment, krantz

t: v. 猛然抛下；突然发生；加速；n. 沉淀物
en: to make something serious happen suddenly or more quickly than was expected

ex.en: The riot was precipitated when four black men were arrested.
ex.cn: 这场骚乱是因为四名黑人男子的被捕而突然引发的。

syn: n. [化学]沉淀物：deposit, sediment, sludge
vt. [化学]使沉淀；促成；猛抛；使陷入：immerse, catalyse

en: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct

ex.en: precise sales figures
ex.cn: 准确的销售数据

ex.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
ex.cn: 很难得到确切的消息。

syn: adj. 精确的；明确的；严格的：accurate, strict, mathematical, rigid, decided

en: someone who had your job before you started doing it

ex.en: Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
ex.cn: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

syn: n. 前任，前辈：father, grand old man

en: if something or someone is predictable, you know what will happen or what they will do – sometimes used to show disapproval

ex.en: The snow had a predictable effect on traffic.
ex.cn: 这场雪对交通造成的影响可以预见。

ex.en: an entertaining but predictable film
ex.cn: 一部有趣但老套的电影

syn: adj. 可预言的：divinable

en: a tendency to behave in a particular way or suffer from a particular illness

ex.en: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
ex.cn: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

syn: n. 倾向；素质；易染病体质：tendency, liability, trend, preference, disposition

ex.en: But magnetic propulsion has some drawbacks.
ex.cn: 但是磁力推进有一些缺陷。

en: to charge someone with a crime and try to show that they are guilty of it in a court of law

ex.en: Shoplifters will be prosecuted.
ex.cn: 在商店行窃者将被起诉。

syn: vt. 检举；贯彻；从事；依法进行：carry out, undertake, pursue, address, have
vi. 起诉；告发；作检察官：law, take legal action

en: a particular event which will probably or definitely happen in the future – used especially when you want to talk about how you feel about it

ex.en: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，几乎没有可能看到这些重大问题得到解答。

ph.cn: 光明的前景，辉煌的前程

syn: n. 前途；预期；景色：scenery, future, picture, expectation, landscape
vi. 勘探，找矿：reconnoitre

t: adj. 预期的; 未来的
en: You use prospective to describe someone who wants to be the thing mentioned or who is likely to be the thing mentioned

ex.en: The story should act as a warning to other prospective buyers.
ex.cn: 这篇报道应该可以对其他可能的购买者起到警告作用。

ph.cn: 前瞻研究；预期研究；远景调查

syn: adj. 未来的；预期的：expected, due, future
n. 预期；展望：outlook, expectation
rm: pro(向前) + spect(看) + ive(形容词后缀) → 向前看的 → 预期的； 未来的

en: a small book that advertises a school, college, new business etc

ex.en: ...a prospectus for a new issue of stock.
ex.cn: …新发行股票的招股说明书。

syn: n. 内容说明书；样张；创办计划书：specimen page, specimen sheet

en: one of several natural substances that exist in food such as meat, eggs, and beans, and which your body needs in order to grow and remain strong and healthy

ex.en: Where do you get your protein?
ex.cn: 你从哪里获得蛋白质？

ex.en: I know that I get around 90g of protein from that.
ex.cn: 我知道我会从中得到90克左右的蛋白质。

syn: n. [生化]蛋白质；朊：albumose
adj. [生化]蛋白质的：glaireous

t: v. 抗议；申明；n. 抗议；反对
en: to come together to publicly express disapproval or opposition to something

ex.en: ‘I don’t see why I should take the blame for this!’ she protested.
ex.cn: “我不明白为什么我要对此承担责任！”她抗议道。

ph.cn: 心甘情愿地；不反对地；[经]在“不保留异议”的情况下

syn: vi. 抗议；断言：exclaim at, take exception to
vt. 抗议；断言：declare, aver

t: n. 礼仪，礼节；外交礼节
en: a system of rules about the correct way to behave on an official occasion

ex.en: a breach of diplomatic protocol
ex.cn: 违反外交礼节

syn: n. 协议；草案；礼仪：agreement, ceremony, understanding, treaty, accord
vt. 拟定：study out

en: the first form that a new design of a car, machine etc has, or a model of it used to test the design before it is produced

ex.en: But how do you come up with the architecture for this evolutionary prototype?
ex.cn: 但是你将如何为这个进化的原型提出系统的架构呢？

ex.en: But it may be an alternative when you have to finish a prototype in limited time.
ex.cn: 但是，当您需要在有限的时间内完成一个原型时，这也许是一种选择。

syn: n. [生物]原型；标准，模范：criterion, standard, level, norms, type
rm: proto(首先) + typ(模型) + e → 首先的模型 → 原型

en: to lengthen or extend (a speech, etc); prolong in time

ex.en: Delay always breeds danger; and to protract a great design is often to ruin it.
ex.cn: 推迟经常孕育危险；拖延一个伟大的工程常常意味着毁灭它。

ex.en: To protract the suspense, he paused for a considerable period of time before telling us the result of the experiment.
ex.cn: 为了延长悬念，他在告诉我们实验结果之前停顿了相当一段时间。

syn: vt. 绘制；延长；伸展：string, spread, prolong

en: to stick out from somewhere

ex.en: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water.
ex.cn: …从水中突出来的一块光滑的圆形巨石。

syn: vt. 使突出，使伸出：exsert, advertise
vi. 突出，伸出：stand out, excel at
rm: pro(向前) + trud(伸出) + e → 向前伸出 → (使)伸出； (使)突出

en: used to say that something will only be possible if something else happens or is done

ex.en: He can come with us, provided he pays for his own meals.
ex.cn: 只要他付自己的饭钱，就可以跟我们一起来。

syn: conj. 假如；倘若：if, supposing
v. 提供；给予（provide的过去式）：gave, supplied

en: a condition in an agreement or law

ex.en: The agreement includes a provision for each side to check the other side’s weapons.
ex.cn: 协议有项规定，允许双方互查武器。

ph.cn: 为…预先采取措施；为…作好准备

syn: n. 规定；条款；准备；[经]供应品：item, preparation, arrangement, preliminary, do
rm: 来自provide(vt. 供应， 提供)

en: likely or able to be changed in the future

ex.en: a provisional government
ex.cn: 临时政府

ex.en: We accept provisional bookings by phone.
ex.cn: 我们接受电话临时预约。

ph.cn: 暂行条例；暂行规则；暂行条款
暂定球（球员认为他的第一次击球可能出界或者掉入水障后所击出的第二个球）；临时球；暂代球

syn: adj. 临时的，暂时的；暂定的：temporary, extraordinary, interim, odd, occasional

en: to cause a reaction or feeling, especially a sudden one

ex.en: The novel has provoked fierce debate in the US.
ex.cn: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

syn: vt. 驱使；激怒；煽动；惹起：fan, egg, anger

en: nearness in distance or time

ex.en: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (= very near to each other ) .
ex.cn: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

syn: n. 亲近，接近；[数]邻近：approach, neighborhood
rm: prox(近) + im + ity → 接近， 邻近； 亲近

t: n. 代理权，代表权；代理人
en: if you do something by proxy, you arrange for someone else to do it for you

ex.en: You can vote by proxy.
ex.cn: 你可以请人代你投票。

syn: n. [法][贸易]代理人；[经]委托书；代用品：deputy, agent, factor, secondary, substitute

en: to try to find out details about someone else’s private life in an impolite way

ex.en: I don’t want to pry , but I need to ask you one or two questions.
ex.cn: 我不想唐突，不过我需要问你一两个问题。

syn: vt. 撬动，撬开：prize up, jimmy
vi. 刺探，探查：burrow into

en: an invented name that a writer, artist etc uses instead of their real name

ex.en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre.
ex.cn: 两个剧本都是以菲利普·戴尔的笔名发表的。

syn: n. 笔名；[法]假名：assumed name, nom de plume

en: the study and treatment of mental illnesses

ex.en: In it, he argued that psychiatry was a branch of medical science and should be investigated by observation and experimentation like the other natural sciences.
ex.cn: 在书中，他主张精神病学是医学的一个分支，应当像其他自然科学一样以观察和实验为研究手段。

ph.cn: 司法精神病学；法医精神病学

ex.en: I understood the psychology of this, but it still hurt.
ex.cn: 我理解这种心理，但这仍然让我感到伤心。

ex.en: It was not until the mid-twentieth century that psychology really came into its own.
ex.cn: 直到20世纪中叶心理学才得到应有的重视。

syn: n. [心理]心理学；心理状态：mentation, psychological science

en: Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something

ex.en: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
ex.cn: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

ex.en: ...government publicity campaigns.
ex.cn: …政府的宣传活动。

syn: n. 宣传，宣扬；公开；广告；注意：advertisement, propaganda, bill, regard, dissemination
rm: 产品可凭借其独特性(peculiarity)， 不用宣传(publicity)也能大为流行(popularity)

t: vt&vi. 毁坏，蹂躏；抢劫，掠夺
en: to damage something very badly

ex.en: a country ravaged by civil war
ex.cn: 遭受内战重创的国家

ex.en: His health was gradually ravaged by drink and drugs.
ex.cn: 酗酒和吸毒渐渐毁了他的健康。

syn: vt. 毁坏；破坏；掠夺：destroy, harry, do for
n. 蹂躏，破坏：destruction, breaking, blasting

t: v. 胡言乱语；热衷谈论；n. 热情赞扬
en: to talk in an angry, uncontrolled, or crazy way

ex.en: He was still ranting and raving the next morning.
ex.cn: 第二天上午他仍在大叫大嚷。

ph.cn: 对…倾倒；热情地谈论；激愤地说
哄动热烈的好评；狂热褒评

syn: n. 咆哮；胡言乱语；热烈赞美：roar, riddlemeree
vi. 咆哮；胡言乱语；狂骂：gnar, full of bull

en: not cooked

ex.en: raw meat
ex.cn: 生肉

ex.en: grated raw carrots
ex.cn: 磨碎的生胡萝卜

ph.cn: 处于自然状态；未开化的；裸体

syn: adj. [食品]生的；未加工的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的：crude, fresh, unripe
vt. 擦伤：brush burn, abrase

en: quickly and easily

ex.en: Boats are readily available to visitors.
ex.cn: 游客可以很方便地租到船只。

ex.en: The information is readily accessible on the Internet.
ex.cn: 这些信息在因特网上一查就能找到。

ph.cn: 易接近的；易达到的；可存取的

syn: adv. 容易地；乐意地；无困难地：easily, lightly

en: a country ruled by a king or queen

ex.en: Defence of the realm is crucial.
ex.cn: 王国的防御是至关重要的。

syn: n. 领域，范围；王国：domain, territory, kingdom, province, world, universe, extent
rm: real(真正的) + m → 真正的好东西(如音乐、 艺术)无国界 → 领域； 王国

en: to cut and collect a crop of grain

ex.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
ex.cn: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

syn: vt. 收获，获得；收割：acquire, earn, buy, find, make
vi. 收割，收获：crop, to harvest

t: n. 后部，后面；vt&vi. 培植，饲养
en: the back part of an object, vehicle, or building, or a position at the back of an object or area

ex.en: He settled back in the rear of the taxi.
ex.cn: 他在出租车后座，往后靠着坐好了。

syn: vt. 培养；树立；栽种：cultivate, foster, plant, set, bed
vi. 暴跳；高耸：rise, tower

t: adj. 明智的；合理的；公平的
en: fair and sensible

ex.en: a reasonable request
ex.cn: 合情合理的要求

ex.en: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
ex.cn: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

syn: adj. 合理的，公道的；通情达理的：rational, logical, possible, just, legitimate
rm: reason(道理) + able(能…的) → 能讲理的 → 通情达理的

t: v. 使放心，使消除疑虑
en: to make someone feel calmer and less worried or frightened about a problem or situation

ex.en: Teachers reassured anxious parents.
ex.cn: 老师们安慰焦急的父母。

en: to remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past

ex.en: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
ex.cn: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

ex.en: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
ex.cn: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

syn: vt. 召回；回想起，记起；取消：think of, come back
n. 召回；回忆；撤消：memory, recollection
vi. 后退；减弱：lower, rein back
vt. 归还：replace, return, restore, give again

en: a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
ex.cn: 保留收据以备退货之需。

ex.en: Can you give me a receipt?
ex.cn: 你能给我一个收条吗？

syn: n. 收到；收据；收入：income, proceeds, earning
vt. 收到：receive from, to hand
rm: re + ceipt(拿， 取) → 拿到的， 取到的 → 收入， 进款

t: n. 接待处；招待会；接收
en: a large formal party to celebrate an event or to welcome someone

ex.en: It’s an ideal location for a wedding reception .
ex.cn: 这里是举办喜宴的理想地点。

ex.en: The occasion was marked by a civic reception .
ex.cn: 市里举行招待会庆祝这个特别的时刻。

syn: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应：reaction, response, behavior
rm: re(表加强) + cept(拿， 取) + ion → 拿住 → 接受

t: n. 后退；撤回；(工商业)衷退，价格暴跌

ex.en: the economic recession of the early 1980s
ex.cn: 20世纪80年代初的经济衰退

syn: n. 衰退；不景气；后退；凹处：depression, downturn, decline, cavity
rm: re(反) + cess(行走) + ion → 向后走 → 衰退； 撤回

en: a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food

ex.en: a recipe book
ex.cn: 一本烹饪书

syn: n. 食谱；[临床]处方；秘诀：secret, tips
rm: re + cip(拿， 取) + e → 抓住关键， 才是诀窍 → 秘诀， 秘方

en: someone who receives something

ex.en: ...the largest recipient of U.S. foreign aid.
ex.cn: …最大的美国对外援助接受方。

syn: n. [包装]容器，[通信]接受者；容纳者：container, vessel, receiver, pocket, bin
adj. 容易接受的，感受性强的：acceptant, susceptive
rm: re(反) + cip(拿， 取) + ient → 不主动拿 → (被动的)接受者

en: a reciprocal arrangement or relationship is one in which two people or groups do or give the same things to each other

ex.en: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
ex.cn: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

ex.en: Such treaties provide reciprocal rights and obligations.
ex.cn: 此类协议规定了相互之间的权利与义务。

ph.cn: 相互转化；反向变换；倒数转换

syn: adj. [贸易]互惠的；相互的；[数]倒数的，彼此相反的：mutual, au pair

t: n. 详述；演奏会；独奏会
syn: n. 朗诵，吟诵；独奏会；背诵；独唱会：oral reading, repetition

en: to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to

ex.en: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
ex.cn: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

syn: vt. 背诵；叙述；列举：repeat, specify, relate
vi. 背诵；叙述：say over, learn sth by memory

en: not caring or worrying about the possible bad or dangerous results of your actions

ex.en: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
ex.cn: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

ex.en: a reckless disregard for safety
ex.cn: 不顾安全的鲁莽行为

syn: adj. 鲁莽的，不顾后果的；粗心大意的：indiscretionary, temerarious

en: to guess a number or amount, without calculating it exactly

ex.en: The expression ‘full moon’ means the fourteenth day of the moon reckoned from its first appearance.
ex.cn: 所谓“满月”是指从新月初现算起的第14天。

ph.cn: 处理；对付；和…算帐；预料到

syn: vt. 测算，估计；认为；计算：expect, feel, find, cast, make
vi. 估计；计算；猜想，料想：estimate, believe, imagine, cast
rm: reck(注意， 留心) + on → 估计； 测算

en: to feel angry or upset about a situation or about something that someone has done, especially because you think that it is not fair

ex.en: Paul resented the fact that Carol didn’t trust him.
ex.cn: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

syn: vt. 怨恨；愤恨；厌恶：hate, be down on
rm: re(再， 又) + sent(感觉) → 再一次痛彻心扉的感觉 → 愤恨

en: to arrange for a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc to be kept for you to use at a particular time in the future

ex.en: Do you have to reserve tickets in advance?
ex.cn: 你必须预先订票吗？

syn: n. [贸易][金融]储备，储存；自然保护区；[军][林]预备队；储备金：store, repertory
vt. [贸易][金融]储备；保留；预约：stay at, save from
rm: re(再， 又) + serv(保持) + e → 预订； 保留

en: a lake, especially an artificial one, where water is stored before it is supplied to people’s houses

ex.en: All these earthquakes happened when the water level in Zipingpu reservoir was low.
ex.cn: 所有这些地震都发生在紫坪铺水库水位很低的时候。

ph.cn: 气藏；气田；煤气存储器；天然气储层

syn: n. [水利]水库；蓄水池：artificial lake

en: a house, especially a large or official one

ex.en: the ambassador’s official residence
ex.cn: 大使官邸

ph.cn: [物理]停留时间；[化]逗留时间（等于residence）

syn: n. 住宅，住处；居住：home, accommodation
rm: 来自resident(a. 居住的)

en: to officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization

ex.en: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job.
ex.cn: 一位医院主管因为有人声称他的职位是骗来的而辞职了。

syn: vt. 辞职；放弃；委托；使听从：yield, desert, refer, quit
vi. 辞职：step down, quit
rm: re(回) + sign(签名) → 要回签名 → 辞职； 放弃

t: n. 辞职书；放弃；听从，顺从
en: when someone calmly accepts a situation that cannot be changed, even though it is bad

ex.en: She gave a sigh of resignation.
ex.cn: 她无奈地叹了一口气。

syn: n. 辞职；放弃；辞职书；顺从：compliance, demission

en: the ability of a substance such as rubber to return to its original shape after it has been pressed or bent

ex.en: And I think what we're seeing in the economy now is the inherent resilience of the American economy and the American people.
ex.cn: 而且我认为，我认为，在经济方面，我们现在看到的是美国经济和美国人民一直以来所固有的弹性。

syn: n. 恢复力；[力]弹力；顺应力：elasticity, elastic force
rm: 来自resilient(a. 有弹性的； 适应力强的)

t: n. 坚决，坚定；决定，决议；决心，解决
en: a formal decision or statement agreed on by a group of people, especially after a vote

ex.en: a resolution calling for a ban on dumping nuclear waste
ex.cn: 要求禁止倾倒核废物的决议

ex.en: They have failed to comply with the resolution.
ex.cn: 他们没有遵守决议。

syn: n. [物][电子][光]分辨率；决议；解决；决心：settlement, decision, determination, push, backbone

en: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty

ex.en: Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems.
ex.cn: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

syn: vt. 决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…：solve, condition, conclude
vi. 解决；决心；分解：settle, work out, figure out
rm: re(完全) + solv(解开) + e → 解决， 解答

en: resonant materials increase any sound produced inside them

ex.en: the violin’s smooth, resonant tone
ex.cn: 小提琴圆润悠扬的音色

ph.cn: 共振腔；空腔谐振器，呼吸腔

syn: adj. 洪亮的，共振的；[语]共鸣的：rotund, syntonous

en: when you must use or depend on something because nothing better is available

ex.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
ex.cn: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

syn: n. 凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地：instrument, shift, road, tool, implement
vi. 求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法：appeal, ask for help
rm: 报告(report)上级， 紧急求助(resort)

en: something such as useful land, or minerals such as oil or coal, that exists in a country and can be used to increase its wealth

ex.en: Canada’s vast mineral resources
ex.cn: 加拿大丰富的矿产资源

ex.en: a country rich in natural resources
ex.cn: 自然资源丰富的国家

syn: n. [计][环境]资源，财力；办法；智谋：financial ability
rm: re(再， 又) + source(源泉) → 可再用的源泉 → 资源

t: n. 呼吸作用；一次呼吸；植物光合作用
en: the process of breathing

ex.en: His respiration grew fainter throughout the day.
ex.cn: 一天当中，他的呼吸越来越微弱。

ph.cn: 人工呼吸；人工呼吸急救法

syn: n. [生理]呼吸；呼吸作用：breath, wind

t: adj. 易于做出迅速反应的
en: If someone or something is responsive, they react quickly and favourably

ex.en: With an election coming soon, your representative should be very responsive to your request.
ex.cn: 大选在即，你们的代表应该对你们的要求作出迅速积极的反应。

syn: adj. 响应的；应答的；回答的：answering

en: unwilling to keep still or stay where you are, especially because you are nervous or bored

ex.en: After a few weeks in Marseille, I grew restless and decided to move on.
ex.cn: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

syn: adj. 焦躁不安的；不安宁的；得不到满足的：storm-tossed, twitchy

en: to make something return to its former state or condition

ex.en: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
ex.cn: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

ex.en: The National Guard was called in to restore order (= make people stop fighting and breaking the law ) when riots broke out.
ex.cn: 暴乱爆发后，国民警卫队被调来恢复秩序。

syn: vt. 恢复；修复；归还：replace, return, repair
vi. 恢复；还原：recover from, unsave
rm: 灾后重建(restore)， 包括商店(store)

en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength

ex.en: Wally gripped my arm, partly to restrain me and partly to reassure me.
ex.cn: 沃利抓住了我的胳膊，部分是想制止我，部分是想安慰我。

syn: vt. 抑制，控制；约束；制止：possess, regulate, contain, manage, bottle
rm: re(回) + strain(拉紧) → 阻止； 抑制

t: v. 重新开始；继续；重新占用
en: to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted

ex.en: She hopes to resume work after the baby is born.
ex.cn: 她想生完孩子后继续工作。

ex.en: The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops.
ex.cn: 叛乱分子继续与政府军发生冲突。

syn: n. [管理]履历；个人简历；摘要：bio, abstract, brief, summary, record
vt. 重新开始；重新获得：recover, start over
rm: re(又， 再) + sum(拿， 取) + e → 重新拿起 → 重新开始

en: the sale of goods in shops to customers, for their own use and not for selling to anyone else

ex.en: a retail price of £8.99
ex.cn: 8.99英镑的零售价

ex.en: The retail value would be around $500.
ex.cn: 零售价在500美元左右。

syn: n. 零售：sell-through, resale
rm: re + tail(切割) → 切割成小块卖 → 零售

t: v. 保持，保有；聘请(律师)
en: to keep something or continue to have something

ex.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
ex.cn: 你有权保留这些物品。

ex.en: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
ex.cn: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

syn: vt. 保持；雇；记住：keep up, to keep
rm: re(再， 又) + tain(拿住) → 一再拿住 → 保留； 保持

t: adj. 沉默寡言的；言不如意的
en: unwilling to talk about what you feel or what you know

ex.en: She is so reticent about her achievements.
ex.cn: 她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

syn: adj. 沉默的；有保留的；谨慎的：silent, cautious, mum

en: to express an idea, feeling, thought etc using words

ex.en: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
ex.cn: “我太累了。”她说。

ex.en: ‘Don’t cry,’ he said softly.
ex.cn: “别哭了。”他柔声说道。

syn: vt. 讲；说明；例如；声称；假设；指明：let, point out, suppose
vi. 讲；表示；念；假定；背诵：make a gesture, to express

t: n. 鳞；尺度；等级；比例规模；天平
en: the size or level of something, or the amount that something is happening

ex.en: A structural survey revealed the full scale of the damage.
ex.cn: 结构检验揭示了实际受损程度。

ex.en: I was shocked by the sheer scale (= very big scale ) of the destruction.
ex.cn: 破坏程度之大让我大为震惊。

syn: n. 规模；[测][数]比例；[动]鳞；[仪]刻度；天平；数值范围：dimensions, ratio, graduation, calibration
vi. 衡量；攀登；剥落；[环境]生水垢：chip, shell, climb

t: n. 解剖刀，(外科用)小刀
en: a small, very sharp knife that is used by doctors in operations

ex.en: I pointed with my scalpel to the chest cavity, where nothing but a black lump of coal squatted in the lipstick-red center.
ex.cn: 我用解剖刀指着她的胸腔，那里只有一团黑乎乎的煤块，伏在唇膏般红色的胸腔中部。

syn: n. [医]解剖刀；外科手术刀：dissecting knife

en: to examine an area carefully but quickly, often because you are looking for a particular person or thing

ex.en: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
ex.cn: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

ex.en: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
ex.cn: 她端详着他的脸，想知道他在想些什么。

syn: vt. 扫描；浏览；细看；详细调查；标出格律：glance through, look through
n. 扫描；浏览；审视；细看：survey, scrutiny
rm: “四看” → 眼睛像扫描仪一样四处看 → 扫描； 浏览

t: n. 冒犯或引起反感的行动；流言，诽谤
en: Scandal is talk about the shocking and immoral aspects of someone's behaviour or something that has happened

ex.en: He loved gossip and scandal.
ex.cn: 他喜欢闲话和流言蜚语。

syn: n. 丑闻；流言蜚语；诽谤；公愤：tale, personalities
rm: scan(扫描) + dal → 扫描时事， 揭露丑闻 → 丑事， 丑闻

t: adj. 不足的，不够多的，缺乏的
en: not enough

ex.en: The story has received scant attention in the press.
ex.cn: 这件事没在报界引起多少注意。

ex.en: They produce goods with scant regard for quality.
ex.cn: 他们的产品不够重视质量。

syn: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；勉强够的：insufficient, short, deficient, lacking, scarce
vt. 减少；节省；限制：block, shorten

en: someone who is blamed for something bad that happens, even if it is not their fault

ex.en: I don't think I deserve to be made the scapegoat for a couple of bad results.
ex.cn: 我认为我不该为出现的一些不良后果充当替罪羊。

syn: n. 替罪羊，替人顶罪者；替身：goat, stand-in

t: n. 伤疤，伤痕，(喻)内心创伤
en: a permanent mark that is left on your skin after you have had a cut or wound

ex.en: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
ex.cn: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

ex.en: a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
ex.cn: 可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

syn: vt. 伤害；给留下伤痕：knife, injure
vi. 结疤；痊愈：cure, heal up

en: almost not or almost none at all

ex.en: The city had scarcely changed in 20 years.
ex.cn: 这座城市20年中几乎没有什么改变。

ex.en: The country had scarcely any industry.
ex.cn: 该国几乎没有工业。

syn: adv. 几乎不，简直不；简直没有：ill, barely

en: if someone scatters a lot of things, or if they scatter, they are thrown or dropped over a wide area in an irregular way

ex.en: The sound of gunfire made the crowd scatter in all directions.
ex.cn: 枪声使人群四散奔逃。

syn: vi. 分散，散开；[军]散射：spread around, spread about
vt. [军]使散射；使散开，使分散；使散播，使撒播：disject, disperse
rm: s + cat(猫) + ter → 老鼠一见到猫就四处逃散 → 散开

en: the natural features of a particular part of a country that you can see, such as mountains, forests, deserts etc

ex.en: The best part of the trip was the fantastic scenery.
ex.cn: 此次旅行最精彩之处就是那美妙绝伦的风景。

syn: n. 风景；景色；舞台布景：landscape, view, picture, prospect, outlook
rm: scen(设置) + ery(表场所， 名词后缀) → 设置景色的场所 → 舞台布景； 景色

t: n. 气味，香味；香水；v. 嗅出，闻到，怀疑有
en: a pleasant smell that something has

ex.en: a yellow rose with a lovely scent
ex.cn: 香气怡人的黄玫瑰

syn: n. 气味；嗅觉；痕迹；察觉能力：smell, nose, mark, wind, trace
vt. 闻到；发觉；使充满…的气味；循着遗臭追踪：discover, wake to
rm: 开放的花朵送出(sent)沁人心脾的香气(scent)

t: adj. 怀疑的，表示疑惑的
en: tending to disagree with what other people tell you

ex.en: ‘You can trust me,’ he said. Jane looked sceptical.
ex.cn: “你可以相信我。”他说。而简看上去一脸怀疑。

syn: adj. 怀疑的；怀疑论的；习惯怀疑的：skeptical, suspicious

en: a list that shows the times that buses, trains etc leave or arrive at a particular place

ex.en: How can he fit everything into his busy schedule ?
ex.cn: 他是怎么把所有的事情都排进自己忙碌的时间表的？

ph.cn: adv. 按时；按照预定时间

syn: vt. 安排，[计划]计划；编制目录；将……列入计划表：budget, propose, design, map, make
n. [交]时间表；[计划]计划表；一览表：kalendar, time-table
rm: “筛斗” → 古代拿筛漏计时 → 时刻表

en: a clever plan, especially to do something that is bad or illegal – used in order to show disapproval

ex.en: a get-rich-quick scheme
ex.cn: 快速致富的手段

syn: n. 计划；组合；体制；诡计：plan, programme, system, organization, fraud
vt. 计划；策划：design, map, propose, project, engineer
rm: 根据图解(schema)来计划(scheme)行程

en: an amount of money that is given to someone by an educational organization to help pay for their education

ex.en: Her latest publication is a fine piece of scholarship.
ex.cn: 她最新出版的作品是一部优秀的学术著作。

syn: n. 奖学金；学识，学问：knowledge, wisdom, learning, study, letter

en: to cut off hair very close to the skin, especially from the face, using a  razor

ex.en: He hadn’t shaved for days.
ex.cn: 他已经好几天没刮脸了。

ex.en: Brian had cut himself shaving .
ex.cn: 布赖恩刮胡子时割破了脸。

ph.cn: 侥幸的脱险；差一点发生的意外

syn: vt. 剃；修面；掠过：razor, oversweep
vi. 剃；刮脸；勉强通过：scrape through, squeeze through
rm: 不要在阴暗处(shade)修面(shave)

en: to cut the wool off a sheep

ex.en: Her long fair hair had been shorn.
ex.cn: 她长长的金发已经剪掉了。

ph.cn: 剪力墙；抗震墙，耐震壁；风力墙

syn: vt. 剪；修剪；剥夺：crop, clip
vi. 剪；[机]剪切；修剪：trim off, to prune

t: n. 棚；车库；v. 发出；脱落
en: a small building, often made of wood, used especially for storing things

ex.en: a tool shed
ex.cn: 工具棚

ex.en: a cattle shed
ex.cn: 牛棚

syn: vt. 流出；摆脱；散发；倾吐：stream, steam, slip
vi. 流出；脱落；散布：discharge, issue

en: A sheer cliff or drop is extremely steep or completely vertical

ex.en: There was a sheer drop just outside my window.
ex.cn: 就在我的窗外有一个陡坡。

syn: adj. 绝对的；透明的；峻峭的：strict, absolute, transparent, positive, crystal
adv. 完全；陡峭地：very, quite a
rm: she(她) + er(表人) → 她是个十足的女人 → 十足的

en: a large piece of thin cloth that you put on a bed to lie on or lie under

ex.en: I’ll go and find you some clean sheets and blankets.
ex.cn: 我去给你们找些干净的床单和毯子。

ex.en: white cotton sheets
ex.cn: 白色的棉布床单

syn: n. 薄片，纸张；[材]薄板；床单：slice, laminae
vt. 覆盖；盖上被单；使成大片：invest, house, roof, cap

en: the outside structure of something, especially the part of a building that remains when the rest of it has been destroyed

ex.en: They cracked the nuts and removed their shells.
ex.cn: 他们打破坚果并剥掉果壳。

syn: n. [动][机]壳，贝壳；炮弹；外形：configuration, profile, shot
vi. 剥落；设定命令行解释器的位置：chip, flake off

t: n. 隐蔽处；掩蔽，遮蔽；避难所
en: protection from danger or from wind, rain, hot sun etc

ex.en: The men took shelter in a bombed-out farmhouse.
ex.cn: 那些男人躲在一间被炸毁的农舍里。

ex.en: All around me, people were running for shelter .
ex.cn: 我周围的人都在奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

syn: n. [法]庇护；避难所；遮盖物：housing, haven, shadow, home, covering
vt. 保护；使掩蔽：secure, preserve
rm: shel(看作shell， 壳) + ter → 像壳一样的地方 → 掩蔽； 住所

t: n. 牧羊人；v. 带领，照看
en: someone whose job is to take care of sheep

ex.en: In comparison, a German shepherd has a biting pressure of 750 pounds per square inch.
ex.cn: 相比较，德国牧羊犬在咬牙时每平方英寸大约有750英镑的压力。

ph.cn: 德国牧羊犬；阿尔萨斯狼犬；德国警犬（等于German police dog）
n. 德国牧羊犬；阿尔萨斯狼犬

syn: vt. 牧羊；带领；指导；看管：guide, coach, supervise
n. 牧羊人；牧师；指导者：minister, priest

t: n. 盾；保护者，保护物；v. 保护，庇护
en: something that protects a person or thing from harm or damage

ex.en: He used his left hand as a shield against the reflecting sunlight.
ex.cn: 他用左手遮挡反射过来的阳光。

syn: n. 盾；防护物；保护者：dong, fendering
vt. 遮蔽；包庇；避开；保卫：avoid, shadow, guard, curtain

t: v. 转变，移动；n. 位置转移，性格转变；轮班
en: to change a situation, discussion etc by giving special attention to one idea or subject instead of to a previous one

ex.en: He stopped, shifting his cane to his left hand.
ex.cn: 他停下来，把手杖移到左手。

syn: n. 移动；变化；手段；轮班：variation, removal, move, instrument, motion
vi. 移动；转变；[遗]转换：to move, forward motion
rm: 电脑键盘上的切换键即Shift键

t: vi&n. 发微光，发闪光；微光
en: to shine with a soft light that looks as if it shakes slightly

ex.en: The lake shimmered in the moonlight.
ex.cn: 月色下，湖面波光粼粼。

syn: n. 微光；闪光：glimmer, gleam
vi. 闪烁；发闪烁的微光：spark, coruscate

en: to shake slightly because you are cold or frightened

ex.en: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
ex.cn: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

syn: n. 颤抖，战栗；碎片：chip, debris
vi. 颤抖；哆嗦；打碎：quake, judder

en: a large group of fish swimming together

ex.en: Among them swam shoals of fish.
ex.cn: 在他们之中游动着一群群鱼儿。

syn: n. [地理]浅滩；鱼群；潜在危险：school, bank, shallow, ford
vi. 变浅：shallow
