ex.cn: 认为从梯子下面穿过不吉利的古老迷信

syn: n. 迷信：aberglaube, fetish

t: n. 上层建筑；统治阶层
en: a political or social system that has developed from a simpler system

ex.en: the whole superstructure of capitalism
ex.cn: 资本主义的整个上层建筑

en: to be in charge of an activity or person, and make sure that things are done in the correct way

ex.en: Griffiths closely supervised the research.
ex.cn: 格里菲思密切指导该项研究。

syn: vt. 监督，管理；指导：manage, police, conduct, run, direct
vi. 监督，管理；指导：direct, charge of
rm: super(超过) ＋ vis(看见) + e → 在超出别人高度的地方看 → 监督， 管理； 指导

en: provided in addition to what already exists

ex.en: supplementary information
ex.cn: 补充信息

syn: adj. 补充的；追加的：complementary, adscititious
n. 补充者；增补物：enlargement
rm: sup(在下面) + ple(填满) + ment + ary → 在下面填满的 → 增补的， 补充的

syn: adv. 可能；按照推测；恐怕：perhaps, maybe, like

en: something that you think is true, even though you are not certain and cannot prove it

ex.en: His version of events is pure supposition .
ex.cn: 他对事情的说法纯属推测。

syn: n. 假定；推测；想像；见解：speculation, theory, perhaps, eye, assumption

t: v. 镇压；平定；抑制；隐瞒
en: to stop people from opposing the government, especially by using force

ex.en: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
ex.cn: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

syn: vt. 抑制；镇压；废止：control, restrain, stay
rm: sup(向下) + press(压) → 压下去 → 压制， 镇压

t: adj. 最高的；最大的，最重要的
en: having the highest position of power, importance, or influence

ex.en: the Supreme Allied Commander in Europe
ex.cn: 欧洲盟军最高指挥官

ex.en: a country where the car reigns supreme
ex.cn: 汽车占绝对优势地位的国家

ph.cn: 最高指挥官；最高统帅；最高司令官

syn: adj. 最高的；至高的；最重要的：highest, maximum, peak, top, principal
n. 至高；霸权：hegemony

t: n. 额外费用，过高的要价
en: money that you have to pay in addition to the basic price of something

ph.cn: 燃油附加费；燃油费；燃油特别付加运赁

syn: n. 超载；额外费：superimposed load, overcarriage

en: if a large amount of a liquid, electricity, chemical etc surges, it moves very quickly and suddenly

ex.en: A wave surged up towards them.
ex.cn: 一个浪头向他们涌来。

ex.en: Adrenalin surged through her veins.
ex.cn: 她血脉偾张。

ph.cn: 缓冲槽；平衡水箱；通风油箱（等于surge chamber）

syn: n. 大浪；汹涌澎湃；巨涌：very rough seas
vi. 激增；汹涌：sharp rise, balloon
rm: s + urge(急迫的) → 水流湍急 → 波动， 涌动； 洋溢

en: a doctor who does operations in a hospital

ex.en: ...a heart surgeon.
ex.cn: …一位心脏外科医生。

ph.cn: 卫生局局长；军医处处长
整形外科医生；骨科医师

syn: n. 外科医生：sawbones, chirurgeon
rm: surge(波动) + on → 做外科医生， 情绪不能太波动 → 外科医生

en: medical treatment in which a surgeon cuts open your body to repair or remove something inside

ex.en: Dr. Hanson is in surgery.
ex.cn: 汉森医生在手术室。

syn: n. [外科]外科；外科手术；手术室；诊疗室：theater, surgical department

en: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty

ex.en: He has had to surmount immense physical disabilities.
ex.cn: 他不得不克服严重的身体残疾。

syn: vt. 克服，越过；战胜：overcome, defeat, negotiate

en: to be even better or greater than someone or something else

ex.en: He had surpassed all our expectations .
ex.cn: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

ex.en: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
ex.cn: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

syn: vt. 超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解：overcome, top, exceed, cap, transcend
rm: sur + pass(通过) → 在上面通过 → 超过

t: n. 余款，盈余；过剩，剩余)
en: an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used

ex.en: Any surplus can be trimmed away.
ex.cn: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。

syn: n. [数]剩余；[贸易]顺差；[会计]盈余；[电子][经]过剩：residual, spare
adj. [数][电子]剩余的；[经]过剩的：remaining, residual, odd

t: v&n. 投降，自首；放弃；屈服
en: to say officially that you want to stop fighting, because you realize that you cannot win

ex.en: Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
ex.cn: 德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。

ex.en: The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

syn: vt. 使投降；放弃；交出；听任：desert, quit
vi. 投降；屈服；自首：give in to sb, throw up the sponge

t: vt&n. 环视，眺望；测量；勘定；检查；概述
en: a set of questions that you ask a large number of people in order to find out about their opinions or behaviour

ex.en: a survey of modern English literature
ex.cn: 现代英国文学概论

ph.cn: n. 实地调查；实地考察

syn: n. 调查；测量；审视；纵览：investigation, measurement, probe, research
vt. 调查；[测][油气]勘测；俯瞰：examine, check into
rm: sur(在…之上) + vey(看)→ 从上往下看 → 调查

en: the state of continuing to live or exist

ex.en: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
ex.cn: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

ex.en: A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
ex.cn: 很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

syn: n. 幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物：remanet, leavings

t: adj. 敏感的；易受感动的
en: likely to suffer from a particular illness or be affected by a particular problem

ex.en: A lot of TV advertising is aimed at susceptible young children.
ex.cn: 很多电视广告瞄准了易受影响的幼儿。

ph.cn: 易受感染菌株；感性品系

syn: adj. 易受影响的；易感动的；容许…的：impressionable, suggestible
rm: sus(表加强) + cept(捕捉) + ible(能…的) → 容易被捕捉的 → 易受影响的， 易受伤害的

t: v. 疑有,猜想;觉得可疑；n. 嫌疑犯；adj. 可疑的"
en: to think that something is probably true, especially something bad

ex.en: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
ex.cn: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

ex.en: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
ex.cn: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

syn: n. [法]嫌疑犯：sus
adj. 可疑的；不可信的：doubtful, questionable
rm: su(s)(在…下面) + spect(看) → 在下面看一看 → 怀疑

en: someone whose job is to check equipment or machines and make sure that they are working properly

ex.en: a laboratory technician
ex.cn: 实验室技术人员

ex.en: a hospital technician
ex.cn: 医院技术人员

syn: n. [劳经]技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人：lab-technician
rm: techn(技艺) + ician(表人) → 技术员， 技师

t: n. 技术，技能；行家手法
en: a special way of doing something

ex.en: He’s a great player, with brilliant technique.
ex.cn: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

syn: n. 技巧，技术；手法：skill, science, mechanics, tips
rm: techn(技艺) + ique(看作ic， …术) → 技术

en: something that is tedious continues for a long time and is not interesting

ex.en: The work was tiring and tedious.
ex.cn: 这工作既累人又枯燥。

syn: adj. 沉闷的；冗长乏味的：dreary, dreich
vi. 大量出现；充满：abound with, be imbued with
vt. 倒出：swill
rm: 和team(n. 群， 队)一起记

en: the telegraphic or telephonic communication of audio, video, or digital information over a distance by means of radio waves, optical signals, etc, or along a transmission line

ex.en: If large media and telecommunication companies decide to close their offerings to the web, I am convinced the web will route around it.
ex.cn: 如果大型媒体和电信公司决定停止向万维网提供内容，我很确信万维网会绕过这一点。

syn: n. 电讯；[通信]远程通信；无线电通讯：radiocommunication

t: n. 用户电报；直通专用电传
en: a method of communica-tion, in which messages are written on a special machine and then sent using the telephone network
having a great or important effect

ex.en: a telling argument
ex.cn: 有说服力的论点

syn: adj. 有效的；生动的；显著的：valid, available, effective, virtual, obvious, prominent
n. 命令；叙述；吐露真情：instruction, relation, order, statement, bidding

t: n. 心情；怒气，脾气；v. 使软化，使缓和
en: a tendency to become angry suddenly or easily

ex.en: That temper of hers will get her into trouble one of these days.
ex.cn: 她那种脾气早晚会让她惹麻烦的。

ex.en: According to Nathan, Robin has quite a temper .
ex.cn: 据内森讲，罗宾脾气很大。

syn: n. 脾气；（钢等）[机]回火；性情；倾向：tendency, liability, trend, preference, disposition
vt. [机]使回火；锻炼；调和；使缓和：comfort, take exercises
rm: 情绪(temper)会影响体温(temperature)

en: the emotional part of someone’s character, especially how likely they are to be happy, angry etc

ex.en: His impulsive temperament regularly got him into difficulties.
ex.cn: 他容易冲动的性格经常使他陷入困境。

syn: n. 气质，性情，[心理]性格；急躁：character, disposition, make

t: adj. 有节制的，不过分的；(气候)温和的
en: behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible

ex.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
ex.cn: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

syn: adj. 温和的；适度的；有节制的：pacific, moderate, gentle, soft, mild

t: n. (行动，活动)速度；节拍；节奏
en: the speed at which music is played or should be played

ex.en: the easy tempo of island life
ex.cn: 岛上生活的轻松节奏

syn: n. 速度，发展速度；拍子：speed, rate, beat

en: continuing for only a limited period of time

ex.en: temporary pain relief
ex.cn: 疼痛的暂时缓解

ex.en: I’m living with my parents, but it’s only temporary.
ex.cn: 我和父母住在一起，但这只是暂时的。

ph.cn: 暂时存储器；暂时库容；中间存储器
临时避难所；临时收容中心；临时安置所；临时庇护站

syn: adj. 暂时的，临时的：extraordinary, odd, interim
n. 临时工，临时雇员：super, casual laborer

en: a strong desire to have or do something even though you know you should not

ex.en: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
ex.cn: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

ex.en: I finally gave in to the temptation and had a cigarette.
ex.cn: 我最终还是屈从诱惑，抽了一支烟。

syn: n. 引诱；诱惑物：invitation, allurement

t: adj. 可防守的，守得住的；可保持的，可维持的

ex.en: an idea which is no longer tenable
ex.cn: 不再成立的观点

syn: adj. （主张等）站得住脚的；可维持的：maintainable
rm: ten(维持， 保持) + able → 能够维持的 → 站得住脚的

en: determined to do something and unwilling to stop trying even when the situation becomes difficult

ex.en: a tenacious negotiator
ex.cn: 锲而不舍的谈判者

syn: adj. 顽强的；坚韧的；固执的；紧握的；黏着力强的：fixed, tough, persistent, set

en: the period of time that someone rents a house, land etc

ex.en: a six-month tenancy
ex.cn: 六个月的租赁期

ex.en: a tenancy agreement
ex.cn: 租赁合同

syn: n. 租期；租用：lease, hire

en: if someone or something has a tendency to do or become a particular thing, they are likely to do or become it

ex.en: ...the government's tendency to secrecy in recent years.
ex.cn: …近年来政府的保密倾向。

syn: n. 倾向，趋势；癖好：liability, trend, direction, tide, set
rm: tend(伸展) + ency → 倾向， 趋向

t: adj. 脆弱的，娇嫩的；温柔的；v. 提供，投标
en: tender food is easy to cut and eat, especially because it has been well cooked

ex.en: Continue cooking until the meat is tender.
ex.cn: 把肉一直烧到松软为止。

syn: adj. 温柔的；柔软的；脆弱的；幼稚的；难对付的：soft, fond
n. 偿付，清偿；看管人；小船：boat, payback
rm: 婴儿太脆弱(tender)， 需悉心照料(tend)

t: n. 紧张局势；情绪紧张；不安状态
en: the feeling that exists when people or countries do not trust each other and may suddenly attack each other or start arguing

ex.en: The tension was becoming unbearable, and I wanted to scream.
ex.cn: 这种紧张变得难以忍受，我真想大声尖叫。

syn: n. 张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压：strain, intensity, stress
vt. 使紧张；使拉紧：stress, wind up

en: one of the long thin parts of a sea creature such as an  octopus  which it uses for holding things

ex.en: Free speech is being gradually eroded year after year by new tentacles of government control.
ex.cn: 言论自由正被政府控制的新触角逐渐侵蚀。

syn: n. 触手，触须，[动]触角：antenna, palpus

ex.en: I passed on my tentative conclusions to the police.
ex.cn: 我把我的初步结论递交给了警方。

syn: adj. [试验]试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的：experimental, cut-and-try
n. 假设，试验：hypothesis, proof, experiment, try

en: a fixed period of time during which someone does something or something happens

ex.en: Teachers often feel overworked in term time (= during the term ) .
ex.cn: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

ph.cn: 依据；按照；在…方面；以…措词

syn: n. 术语；学期；期限；条款：technology, item, session, provision, article

t: n. 生理组织；薄纸；棉纸；织物；一套
en: light thin paper used for wrapping, packing etc

ex.en: a box of tissues
ex.cn: 一盒面巾纸

syn: n. 纸巾；[纺]薄纱；一套：set, gauze

t: n. 标题；题目；称号；法律权利，所有权
en: the name given to a particular book, painting, play etc

ex.en: "Patience and Sarah" was first published in 1969 under the title "A Place for Us."
ex.cn: 《耐心与萨拉》于1969年以《我们的地方》为书名首次出版。

syn: n. 冠军；[计][图情]标题；头衔；权利；字幕：rights, champion, honor, first, heading
vt. 加标题于；赋予头衔；把…称为：repute

t: n. 烤面包，烤火；v. 为祝酒，敬酒
en: bread that has been heated so that it is brown on both sides and no longer soft

ex.en: I had a piece of toast for breakfast.
ex.cn: 我早饭吃了一片吐司。

syn: n. 干杯；烤面包；吐司：bottoms up
vt. 烤；敬酒；使暖和：to roast, bake

en: if a small child toddles, it walks with short, unsteady steps

ex.en: ...once your baby starts toddling.
ex.cn: ...一旦你的小孩开始蹒跚学步。

syn: vi. 蹒跚学步；东倒西歪地走；散步：walk along, have a walk

t: v. 辛劳工作，艰难地行动；n. 苦工，难事
en: When people toil, they work very hard doing unpleasant or tiring tasks

ex.en: People who toiled in dim, dank factories were too exhausted to enjoy their family life.
ex.cn: 在阴暗潮湿的工厂里苦作的人们精疲力竭了，无法享受家庭生活。

ex.en: Workers toiled long hours.
ex.cn: 工人们长时间辛苦工作。

syn: n. 辛苦；苦工；网；圈套：web, net, mesh, trap
vi. 辛苦工作；艰难地行进：labour over, sweat

t: n&a. 标专，记号；象征性的
en: something that represents a feeling, fact, event etc

ex.en: After normalization of attributes, you can count on every token in an attribute being separated from its neighbors by whitespace.
ex.cn: 在属性规范化后，可以依靠的属性中的每个记号是通过空白来与其邻居区分开来。

ph.cn: 令牌环（一个环状的区域网路）

syn: n. 表征；代币；记号：marks, sign
adj. 象征的；表意的；作为对某事的保证的：symbolic, emblematic

en: willingness to allow people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them

ex.en: ...his tolerance and understanding of diverse human nature.
ex.cn: …他对各种人性的宽容和理解。

ph.cn: 葡萄糖耐量；葡萄糖耐受性

syn: n. [机]公差；宽容；容忍；公差：patience, charity, mercy

t: adj. 可忍受的，可容许的，尚好的
en: a situation that is tolerable is not very good, but you are able to accept it

ex.en: The apartment is really too small, but it’s tolerable for the time being.
ex.cn: 这套公寓实在太小，不过暂时还能凑合。

syn: adj. 可以的；可容忍的：gey, sufferable

t: n. (道路，桥梁)通行费；损失，代价；税收
en: the money you have to pay to use a particular road, bridge etc

ex.en: You can pay a toll to drive on Pike's Peak Highway or relax and take the Pike's Peak Cog Railway.
ex.cn: 你可以付通行费开车上派克斯峰公路，或者放松一下，乘坐派克斯峰齿轨式火车。

syn: vt. 征收；敲钟：ring, levy upon
n. [税收]通行费；代价；钟声：price, expense, cost, ring, bell

en: a toneless voice does not express any feelings

ex.en: ‘I’m sorry,’ he said, in a flat toneless voice.
ex.cn: “对不起。”他以淡淡的声调说道。

syn: adj. 沉闷的；单调的；缺乏声调的；无声的：flat, blank, tedious

t: n. 舌头；语言；舌状物（火舌）
en: the soft part inside your mouth that you can move about and use for eating and speaking

ex.en: Joe ran his tongue over his dry lips.
ex.cn: 乔舔了舔干燥的嘴唇。

ex.en: The taste of the chocolate was still on her tongue.
ex.cn: 巧克力的余味依然留在她的舌尖。

syn: n. 舌头；语言：language, longue
vt. 舔；斥责；用舌吹：carpet, lick

t: n&a. 滋补品，补药；强身的，健体的
en: a drink that you have as a medicine to give you more energy or strength when you feel tired

ex.en: A lot of people need a tonic at the end of the winter.
ex.cn: 很多人冬末需要进补。

syn: n. [药]补药；主调音或基音：invigorator
adj. 滋补的；声调的；使精神振作的：tonetic

en: a small electric lamp that you carry in your hand

ex.en: We shone our torches around the cavern.
ex.cn: 我们用手电筒照着山洞。

ph.cn: 火炬传递；火炬接力；圣火传递
焊接炬；熔接气炬；焊接喷灯

syn: n. 火把，火炬；手电筒；启发之物：firebrand, flashlight

t: n. 剧烈痛苦；折磨，烦扰；v. 折磨；纠缠
en: severe mental or physical suffering

ex.en: The journey must have been a torment for them.
ex.cn: 这次旅途对他们来说一定十分痛苦。

syn: vt. 折磨，使痛苦；纠缠，作弄：harry, pursue, worry, trouble, tear
n. 痛苦，苦恼；痛苦的根源：smart, hurt
rm: tor(=tort扭曲) + ment → 扭曲的状态 → 痛苦， 折磨

en: an extremely violent storm consisting of air that spins very quickly and causes a lot of damage

ex.en: The tornado rubbished the whole village.
ex.cn: 龙卷风毁掉了整个村庄。

ex.en: The tornado disrupted broadcasting along the entire coast.
ex.cn: 龙卷风使整个沿海的广播都中断了。

syn: n. [气象]龙卷风；旋风；暴风；大雷雨：cyclone, Tornado Jockey

en: a large amount of water moving very quickly and strongly in a particular direction

ex.en: After five days of heavy rain the Telle river was a raging torrent (= a very violent torrent ) .
ex.cn: 下了五天的大雨之后，泰勒河急流汹涌。

syn: n. 奔流；倾注；迸发；连续不断：transfusion, decantation
rm: tor(=torn转动) + rent → 水流转动不停地前进 → 洪流

t: vt&n. 拷打，折磨，使受剧烈痛苦
en: an act of deliberately hurting someone in order to force them to tell you something, to punish them, or to be cruel

ex.en: He died after five days of excruciating torture.
ex.cn: 遭受了五天的严刑拷打之后，他死了。

syn: vt. 折磨；拷问；歪曲：harry, colour, worry, trouble, tear
n. 折磨；拷问；歪曲：violence, ordeal

en: to throw something, especially something light, with a quick gentle movement of your hand

ex.en: Toss the carrots in some butter before serving.
ex.cn: 上桌前把胡萝卜放在黄油里搅拌一下。

ph.cn: 辗转反侧；翻来覆去难以入睡
对(决定)提出异议(或辩论)；争论已决定的事，作无谓的争执

syn: n. 投掷；摇荡；投掷的距离；掷币赌胜负：putting, cast, throw
vt. 投掷；使…不安；突然抬起；使…上下摇动；与…掷币打赌：wap

en: easily becoming offended or annoyed

ex.en: She is very touchy about her past.
ex.cn: 她对自己的过去非常敏感。

syn: adj. 过敏的；易生气的；难以取悦的：irritable, hypersusceptible

t: adj. 坚韧的，咬不动的；强壮的；粗暴的
en: very strict or firm

ex.en: The EU is taking a tough line with the UK over this issue.
ex.cn: 在这一问题上，欧盟对英国的态度很强硬。

ph.cn: [美国口语]勇敢地承受；坚持到底

syn: adj. 艰苦的，困难的；坚强的，不屈不挠的；坚韧的，牢固的；强壮的，结实的：difficult, strong, hard, rough, firm
n. 恶棍：varlet, Highbinder

en: the business of providing things for people to do, places for them to stay etc while they are on holiday

ex.en: The country depends on tourism for much of its income.
ex.cn: 该国的大部分收入依靠旅游业。

syn: n. 旅游业；游览：pleasure trip, sightseeing

ex.en: She is aching to join in the tournament.
ex.cn: 她渴望参加比赛。

ex.en: They dropped two games in a row and were eliminated from the tournament.
ex.cn: 他们在划船比赛中输了两场比赛，并被淘汰出局。

syn: n. 锦标赛，联赛；比赛：competition, championship, game, match, play

en: to pull a vehicle or ship along behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain

ex.en: The ship had to be towed into the harbor.
ex.cn: 那艘轮船不得不被拖进港口。

syn: n. 拖；[纺]麻的粗纤维；拖曳所用之绳：pull, drag
vt. 拖；牵引；曳：pull, trail

en: a passage that has been dug under the ground for cars, trains etc to go through

ex.en: a railway tunnel
ex.cn: 铁路隧道

ex.en: the Channel Tunnel (= between England and France )
ex.cn: 〔英吉利〕海峡隧道

syn: n. [交]隧道；坑道；洞穴通道：tube, cuniculus
vt. 挖；在…打开通道；在…挖掘隧道：dig
rm: 海峡(channel)像条长长的地道(tunnel)

t: adj. 狂暴的，骚乱的，汹涌的
en: a turbulent situation or period of time is one in which there are a lot of sudden changes

ex.en: the turbulent times of the French Revolution
ex.cn: 法国大革命的动荡时期

ex.en: He has had a turbulent political career.
ex.cn: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

syn: adj. 骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的：angry, chaotic, troubled, confused

en: a surface that consists of soil with grass on top, or an artificial surface that looks like this

ex.en: soft green turf
ex.cn: 柔软的绿色草皮

ph.cn: ◎以赛马为业；赛马场上的赌客

syn: n. [建]草皮；泥炭；跑马场：greensward, divot

en: a state of confusion, excitement, or anxiety

ex.en: She lived through the turmoil of the French Revolution.
ex.cn: 她经历过法国大革命的混乱之后仍旧活着。

ph.cn: 金融风暴；金融危机；金融混乱

syn: n. 混乱，骚动：combustion, disorder, chaos, confusion, involvement

t: n. 营业收入；营业额；人员调整，人员更替率
en: the amount of business done during a particular period

ex.en: The company had a turnover of $3.8 million.
ex.cn: 那个公司拥有380万美元的营业额。

ph.cn: 年营业额，年成交量；年总生物量

syn: n. [贸易]营业额；流通量；翻覆；半圆卷饼：volume of business, rollover
adj. 翻过来的；可翻转的：upturned, eversible
rm: 来自词组turn over(营业额达到； 翻转； 交换)

t: n. 私人教师；[英]大学导师
en: someone who gives private lessons to one student or a small group, and is paid directly by them

ex.en: The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
ex.cn: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

syn: vt. 辅导；约束：restrict, hold oneself in
n. 导师；家庭教师；助教：mentors, teacher counselor

en: a small tool that has two narrow pieces of metal joined at one end, used to pull or move very small objects

ex.en: She was plucking her eyebrows with a pair of tweezers .
ex.cn: 她正拿着一把小镊子在拔眉毛。

ph.cn: 光镊子，光学镊子；光钳；雷射光钳（optical tweezer的复数）

en: a small very thin stem of wood that grows from a branch on a tree

ex.en: There is the bird, sitting on a twig halfway up the tree.
ex.cn: 鸟儿在那里，栖息在树中段的一根细枝上。

syn: vi. 理解：cotton on, get at
vt. 理解：see, absorb, read, seize, cotton on

en: Twilight is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark

ex.en: They returned at twilight.
ex.cn: 他们在黄昏时返回。

ph.cn: n. 城市贫穷地区；界限分明的两者之间的模糊状态

syn: n. 黎明，黄昏；薄暮；衰退期；朦胧状态：morning, dark
adj. 昏暗的，微明的；暮年的：lowering, dingy

t: v. 闪烁，闪耀；闪闪发光
en: if a star or light twinkles, it shines in the dark with an unsteady light

ex.en: stars twinkling in the sky
ex.cn: 天空中闪烁的星星

ex.en: I saw lights twinkling in the little town below us.
ex.cn: 我看到我们下面的小镇灯火闪烁。

syn: vi. 闪烁；发亮：lamp, spark
vt. 使闪耀；闪耀：flare, shine on

t: v. 捻；搓；扭转；盘旋；n. 搓，扭拧；怪癖
en: to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape

ex.en: She twisted her head sideways and looked toward the door.
ex.cn: 她把头转向一边，朝门口看去。

syn: vt. 捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼：screw, harry
n. [力]扭曲；拧；扭伤：distortion, strain
rm: tw(看作two， 两个) + ist(表人) → 两个人扭打在一起 → 缠绕

en: having the usual features or qualities of a particular group or thing

ex.en: typical British weather
ex.cn: 典型的英国天气

ex.en: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
ex.cn: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

syn: adj. [数]典型的；特有的；象征性的：characteristic, representative, proper, very, own
rm: typ(e)(典型) + ical → 典型的

en: a very violent tropical storm

ex.en: The football match have to stand over next week for the typhoon storm.
ex.cn: 由于台风风暴，这场足球赛延期到下个星期举行。

rm: “台风”

en: behaving in a cruel and unfair way towards someone you have power over

ex.en: a tyrannical parent
ex.cn: 一位专横的家长

ex.en: tyrannical laws
ex.cn: 专制的法令

syn: adj. 残暴的；暴君的；专横的：ruffianly, atrocious

en: a thick rubber ring that fits around the wheel of a car, bicycle etc

ex.en: I had a flat tyre (= all the air went out of it ) on the way home.
ex.cn: 回家的路上我的轮胎瘪了。

ex.en: The spare tyre ’s in the boot.
ex.cn: 备用轮胎在行李箱里。

syn: n. [橡胶]轮胎；轮箍：tire

en: extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at

ex.en: a very ugly man
ex.cn: 非常丑陋的男子

ex.en: the ugliest building in town
ex.cn: 城里最难看的建筑

ph.cn: 丑小鸭；小时难看长大后变得才貌出众的人

syn: adj. 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的：evil, ill, black, wicked

en: finally, after everything else has been done or considered

ex.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the child’s parents.
ex.cn: 最终，决定权在这孩子的父母手中。

ex.en: a long but ultimately successful campaign
ex.cn: 一场历时很久但最终成功的运动

syn: adv. 最后；根本；基本上：eventually, finally, basically, lastly, either

en: a threat saying that if someone does not do what you want by a particular time, you will do something to punish them

ex.en: The club gave him an ultimatum – either he apologized, or he would be expelled from the team.
ex.cn: 俱乐部给他下了最后通牒——要么道歉，要么等着被开除出队。

ex.en: The army issued an ultimatum for all weapons in the city to be surrendered on October 26th.
ex.cn: 军队发出最后通牒，必须于 10 月 26 日交出该市的全部武器。

syn: n. 最后通牒；最后结论；基本原理：fundamental, basic principle

en: ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people, but is responsible for making your skin darker when you are in the sun

ex.en: Ozone in the stratosphere is important because it absorbs some of the Sun’s dangerous ultraviolet radiation.
ex.cn: 在平流层的臭氧是重要的，因为它吸收了一些太阳中危险的紫外线辐射。

ex.en: Birds perceive the world differently tohumans, being able to see light in the ultraviolet range of the spectrum.
ex.cn: 鸟类感知世界的方式和人类不同，他们能够在紫外线光谱范围内看见光线。

syn: adj. [光]紫外的；紫外线的：extraviolet

t: adj. 一致同意的；全体一致的
en: agreeing completely about something

ex.en: It was decided by a unanimous vote that the school should close.
ex.cn: 关闭学校是大家一致通过的决定。

syn: adj. 全体一致的；意见一致的；无异议的：unobjectionable, undisputed
rm: un(=uni 一个) + anim(精神) + ous → 大家都秉持一种精神 → 一致同意的

en: not limited by or depending on any conditions

ex.en: the unconditional release of all political prisoners
ex.cn: 所有政治犯的无条件释放

ex.en: unconditional surrender
ex.cn: 无条件投降

syn: adj. [数]无条件的；绝对的；无限制的：strict, absolute, positive, unlimited

en: a feeling or thought that is unconscious is one that you have without realizing it

ex.en: She was found alive but unconscious.
ex.cn: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

syn: adj. [心理]无意识的；失去知觉的；[医]不省人事的；未发觉的：mechanical, automatic, cold, spontaneous

en: the edge of a road, path etc

ex.en: The car skidded across the road and came to a stop on the grass verge.
ex.cn: 汽车滑过路面，在路缘草带上停了下来。

syn: vi. 濒临，接近；处在边缘：go on for, come close to
n. 边缘：margin, brink, suburb, beaded edge

t: adj. 多才多艺的；技术超群的
en: someone who is versatile has many different skills

ex.en: a very versatile performer
ex.cn: 多才多艺的表演者

ex.en: a more versatile workforce
ex.cn: 技术更全面的劳动力

syn: adj. 多才多艺的；通用的，万能的；多面手的：universal, current, utility
rm: vers(转) + at + ile → 可以向各个方向转的 → 多才多艺的， 多面手的； 多用途的， 通用的

en: someone’s version of an event is their description of it, when this is different from the description given by another person

ex.en: Could Donna’s version of what happened that night be correct?
ex.cn: 唐娜对那晚发生的事情的描述是否正确呢？

syn: n. [计]版本；[图情]译文；倒转术：edition, translation
rm: vers(转) + ion → 从原文转化而来 → 译本

t: prep. [略作v或vs](诉讼或比赛中)对
en: used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case

ex.en: the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers
ex.cn: 纽约尼克斯队对洛杉矶湖人队

ex.en: the Supreme Court decision in Roe vs. Wade
ex.cn: 最高法院关于罗诉韦德案的判决

syn: prep. 对；与...相对；对抗：in the teeth of
rm: vers(转) + us → 转向我们 → 与…相对

t: adj. 垂直的；n. 垂直线
en: pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface

ex.en: a vertical line
ex.cn: 垂直线

ex.en: the vertical axis of a graph
ex.cn: 图的纵轴

syn: adj. [测]垂直的，直立的；[解剖][天]头顶的，顶点的：standing, perpendicular
n. [数]垂直线，垂直面：perpendicular plane, perpendicular line

en: a ship or large boat

ex.en: a fishing vessel
ex.cn: 渔船

syn: n. [船]船，舰；[组织]脉管，血管；容器，[轻]器皿：container, ship, pocket

t: n. 老练者；老手；老兵；老式古董车
en: someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war

ex.en: a Vietnam veteran
ex.cn: 越战老兵

syn: n. 老兵；老手；富有经验的人：old moustache, warhorse
adj. 老兵的；经验丰富的：seasoned

t: n. 否决，否决权，禁止；v. 否决，禁止
en: a refusal to give official permission for something, or the right to refuse to give such permission

ex.en: The Senate had a sufficient majority to override the presidential veto (= not accept his refusal ).
ex.cn: 参议院有足够的多数票可以推翻总统的否决。

syn: n. 否决权：neto
vt. 否决；禁止：bar, inhibit

en: to make someone feel annoyed or worried

ex.en: It vexed me to think of others gossiping behind my back.
ex.cn: 想到别人在我背后说闲话让我很恼火。

syn: vt. 使烦恼；使困惑；使恼怒：trouble, irk
vi. 烦恼：trouble, worry, bother about
prep. 取道，通过；经由：by way of, THRU through

en: able to continue to live or to develop into a living thing

ex.en: viable seeds
ex.cn: 可存活的种子

syn: adj. 可行的；能养活的；能生育的：feasible, working
rm: vi(道路) + able(能…的) → 有路可走 → 可行的， 可实施的

en: if something vibrates, or if you vibrate it, it shakes quickly and continuously with very small movements

ex.en: The floor was vibrating to the beat of the music.
ex.cn: 地板随着音乐的节奏在颤动。

ex.en: As air passes over our vocal cords, it makes them vibrate.
ex.cn: 气流通过我们的声带，使之产生振动。

syn: vi. 振动；颤动；摇摆；踌躇：swing, hesitate
vt. 使振动；使颤动：oscillate

en: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs

ex.en: the fight against vice on the streets
ex.cn: 打击街头犯罪

ex.en: The police have smashed a vice ring (= a group of criminals involved in vice ) in Chicago.
ex.cn: 警方捣毁了芝加哥的一个犯罪团伙。

ph.cn: 副处长；副主任；副院长；副会长

syn: n. 恶习；缺点；[机]老虎钳；卖淫：defect, deficiency, fault, disadvantage, abuse
prep. 代替：in place of, in stead of

en: in the area around a particular place

ex.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
ex.cn: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

ex.en: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
ex.cn: 附近曾有一座磨坊。

t: adj. 邪恶的，堕落的；恶意的
en: very unkind in a way that is intended to hurt someone’s feelings or make their character seem bad

ex.en: Sarah can be quite vicious at times.
ex.cn: 萨拉有时相当狠毒。

ex.en: a vicious personal attack on the Duchess
ex.cn: 对公爵夫人恶毒的人身攻击

ph.cn: n. 恶性螺旋形上升；[经]恶性通货膨胀螺旋

syn: adj. 恶毒的；恶意的；堕落的；有错误的；品性不端的；剧烈的：severe, fallen, malicious, poisonous
rm: 来自vice(n. 罪行； 堕落， 邪恶)

en: giving careful attention to what is happening, so that you will notice any danger or illegal activity

ex.en: Please remain vigilant at all times and report anything suspicious.
ex.cn: 请时刻保持警惕，有可疑情况随时报告。

syn: adj. 警惕的；警醒的；注意的；警戒的：alert, watchful

t: adj. 强有力的，精力充沛的
en: using a lot of energy and strength or determination

ex.en: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
ex.cn: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。

ex.en: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
ex.cn: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

syn: adj. 有力的；精力充沛的：male, live, energetic, mighty
rm: vigor(活力) + ous → 有活力的 → 朝气蓬勃的

en: to prove that someone or something is right or true

ex.en: The decision to advertise has been vindicated by the fact that sales have grown.
ex.cn: 销售增长的事实证明做广告宣传的决定是正确的。

syn: vt. 维护；证明…无辜；证明…正确：assert, safekeep

en: to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc

ex.en: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
ex.cn: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

ex.en: regimes that violate human rights
ex.cn: 侵犯人权的政权

syn: vt. 违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎：let, act against

t: adj. 猛烈的，凶暴的；由暴力引起的；强烈的
en: involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

ex.en: the increase in violent crime
ex.cn: 暴力犯罪的增多

ex.en: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
ex.cn: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

syn: adj. 暴力的；猛烈的：fierce, hard

en: almost

ex.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
ex.cn: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

ex.en: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
ex.cn: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

syn: adv. 事实上，几乎；实质上：actually, really, almost, nearly, most

en: If something is wreathed in smoke or mist, it is surrounded by it

ex.en: The ship was wreathed in smoke.
ex.cn: 那艘船笼罩在浓烟中。

ex.en: Fog wreathes the temples.
ex.cn: 云雾缭绕着寺院。

syn: vt. 用花环装饰；将…做成花环；包围；覆盖：invest, case, roof, house, sheet
vi. 缭绕；成圈状；扭曲；环绕盘旋：coil

t: n. 破坏，船舶失事；失事船只
en: a ship that has sunk

ex.en: He was still alive when they pulled him from the wreck.
ex.cn: 他们把他从失事的车辆中拖出来时，他还活着。

syn: n. 破坏；[水运]失事；残骸；失去健康的人：destruction, breaking, blasting, remain, disruption
vt. 破坏；[水运]使失事；拆毁：destroy, undermine, founder

en: to twist and pull something roughly from the place where it is being held

ex.en: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
ex.cn: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

ex.en: The door had been wrenched open.
ex.cn: 门被猛地拉开了。

ph.cn: 扭力扳手；转矩扳手；定力矩扳手

syn: n. 扳手，[机]扳钳；扭伤；痛苦；歪曲；猛扭：violence, smart, strain, hurt
vt. 扭伤；猛扭；曲解；折磨：harry, worry, trouble, tear

t: v. 摔跤，角斗；斗争，努力
en: to fight someone by holding them and pulling or pushing them

ex.en: Police officers wrestled him to the ground .
ex.cn: 警察把他扑倒在地。

syn: n. 摔跤；搏斗；斗争：war, conflict, battle, fight
vi. 摔跤；斗争；斟酌：fight, struggle (with)

t: adj. 不幸的，可怜的；令人难受的
en: someone who is wretched is very unhappy or ill, and you feel sorry for them

ex.en: the poor, wretched girl
ex.cn: 极其不幸的可怜姑娘

syn: adj. 可怜的；卑鄙的；令人苦恼或难受的：poor, mean, base, dirty

en: wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old

ex.en: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
ex.cn: 她的脸上布满皱纹。

syn: n. 皱纹：rugosity, plication
vi. 起皱：crease
rm: 眨眼(twinkle)容易起皱纹(wrinkle)

syn: adj. 锻造的；加工的；精细的：detailed, subtle
v. 工作（work的过去分词）：labored

en: a large boat with a sail, used for pleasure or sport, especially one that has a place where you can sleep
syn: n. 游艇，[船]快艇；轻舟：speed boat, mosquito craft

en: a unit for measuring length, equal to three feet or 0.91 metres

ex.en: a hundred yards away
ex.cn: 100码外

ex.en: an area of 9,000 square yards
ex.cn: 面积为9,000平方码的一片区域

syn: n. 院子；[计量]码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；[建]庭院；帆桁：courtyard, garth

en: thick thread made of cotton or wool, which is used to knit things

ex.en: The old captain would often spin (= tell ) us a yarn about life aboard ship.
ex.cn: 老船长经常会给我们讲一些船上生活的奇闻轶事。

syn: n. [纺]纱线；奇谈，故事：relation, story, tale, narrative
vi. 讲故事：tell a story

en: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored

ex.en: Alan stretched and yawned.
ex.cn: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

syn: n. 哈欠；裂口：breakage, chasm
vi. [生理]打呵欠；裂开：gap, seam

en: to have a strong desire for something, especially something that is difficult or impossible to get

ex.en: He yearned for freedom.
ex.cn: 他曾渴望自由。

syn: vi. 渴望，向往；思念，想念；怀念；同情，怜悯：rare, aspire

t: vt&vi. 生产；让步；投降；屈服；n. 产量
en: to produce a result, answer, or piece of information

ex.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
ex.cn: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

ph.cn: 屈服强度；屈变力；抗屈强度

syn: vt. [力]屈服；出产；放弃：desert, quit
vi. [力]屈服，投降：succumb, to surrender

en: a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads

ex.en: People are still suffering under the yoke of slavery.
ex.cn: 人们仍然生活在奴隶制的枷锁之下。

syn: n. 轭；束缚；牛轭：chain, restriction
vt. 结合；给…上轭：couple, become one, link

en: eagerness to do something, especially to achieve a particular religious or political aim

ex.en: ...his zeal for teaching.
ex.cn: …他对教学的热衷。

syn: n. 热情；热心；热诚：passion, flame, fire, warmth, fervor

t: n. 乐趣；滋味，风味; 兴趣

ex.en: The danger of being caught added a certain zest to the affair.
ex.cn: 被捉奸的危险为这件风流韵事增添了一些刺激性。

syn: n. 风味；热心；强烈的兴趣：enthusiasm, flavor
vt. 给…调味：season, sauce

en: the scientific study of animals and their behaviour

ex.en: The scholarship money she won helped her attend Cornell University, where she majored in zoology.
ex.cn: 她赢得的奖学金帮助她上康奈尔大学，在那里他主修动物学。

syn: n. [动]动物学；动物区系：fauna

en: to provide someone with a place to stay, live, or work

ex.en: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
ex.cn: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

syn: vt. 容纳；使适应；供应；调解：adapt, contain, suit, accept, serve
vi. 适应；调解：adjust, adapt to something

en: a place for someone to stay, live, or work

ex.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
ex.cn: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

ex.en: living accommodations for the crews
ex.cn: 船员的起居舱

syn: n. 住处，膳宿；[分子生物]调节；和解；预订铺位：residence, adjustment, conditioning
rm: ac + commod(看作common， 普通的) + ation(名词后缀) → 再普通的人都需要住处 → 住处， 膳宿

en: to go somewhere with someone

ex.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
ex.cn: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

ex.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
ex.cn: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

syn: vt. 陪伴，伴随；伴奏：attend, keep company
rm: ac(表加强) + company(同伴； 陪伴) → 陪伴； 伴随

t: adj. 厉害的，敏锐的，(疾病等)急性的
en: an acute illness or disease quickly becomes very serious

ex.en: acute arthritis
ex.cn: 急性关节炎

syn: adj. 严重的，[医][植]急性的；[数][生物]敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的：serious, bad, keen

en: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation

ex.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
ex.cn: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

syn: vt. 使适应；改编：condition, suit, season
vi. 适应：adjust, accomodate to, accommodate to
rm: ad + apt(适合的) → 使适合； 适应

t: n. 住址；致词；v. 向致词；在信封上写姓名
en: the details of the place where someone lives or works, which you use to send them letters etc

ex.en: What’s your new address?
ex.cn: 你的新地址是什么？

ex.en: I can give you the address of a good attorney.
ex.cn: 我可以给你一个好律师的地址。

syn: vt. 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞：undertake, pursue, have
n. [计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧：speech, lecture, talk

en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or exists

ex.en: The court affirmed that the information can be made public under the Freedom of Information Act.
ex.cn: 法院公开肯定了此信息能依据《自由信息法案》公之于众。

ex.en: ...a speech in which he affirmed a commitment to lower taxes.
ex.cn: …在其中他公开肯定了减税承诺的一次演讲。

syn: vt. 肯定；断言：declare, to be certain
vi. 确认；断言：recognize, confirm on

t: v. 附加；贴上；盖印；n. 词缀
en: to fasten or stick something to something else

ex.en: We could reprint at a cost of X, or she had found a service that would affix stickers over the price to correct at a cost of X.
ex.cn: 我们可以按成本价格重新印刷，这将花费X，或根据她找到的一种修正服务，可以重新粘贴上正确的价格，这将花费X。

syn: vt. 粘上；署名；将罪责加之于：paste on
n. [语]词缀；附加物：appendix, annexment

en: to affect someone or something in an unpleasant way, and make them suffer
syn: vt. 折磨；使痛苦；使苦恼：harry, worry, trouble, tear, devil
rm: af(向) + flict(打击) → 向某人发出攻击 → 使苦恼； 折磨

en: to provide something or allow something to happen

ex.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
ex.cn: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

ex.en: The new law will afford protection to employees.
ex.cn: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

syn: vt. 给予，提供；买得起：allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
rm: af + ford(看作Ford， 美国大财阀福特家族) → 财大气粗 → 负担得起

en: a business that provides a particular service for people or organizations

ex.en: We had to hire maids through an agency.
ex.cn: 我们得通过代理公司雇用女佣。

syn: n. [贸易]代理，[经]中介；代理处，经销处：procuration, intermediary agent
rm: ag(行动) + ency(表状态， 名词后缀) → 代为行动 → 代理

en: a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with

ex.en: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
ex.cn: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

ph.cn: 隐秘的议程；幕后的动机

rm: ag(做， 行动) + enda(表名词复数) → 做的事情 → 议程

t: v. 使恶化；使加剧；使气恼
en: to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse

ex.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
ex.cn: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

ex.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
ex.cn: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

syn: vt. 加重；使恶化；激怒：anger, complicate
rm: ag + grav(重的) + ate(使…) → 使重 → 加重， 恶化

en: the total after a lot of different figures or points have been added together

ex.en: (=  as a group or in total  ) , women outlive men by 7 or more years.
ex.cn: 总体来看，女性比男性多活七年或以上。

ph.cn: 总共，总计，作为总体，作为整体

syn: vi. [数]集合；[物化][无脊椎]聚集；合计：amount, concentrate, collect, mass, crowd
vt. [数]集合；[物化][无脊椎]聚集；合计：assemble, sum

en: very determined to succeed or get what you want

ex.en: A successful businessman has to be aggressive.
ex.cn: 成功的实业家必须得有股冲劲。

ex.en: an aggressive marketing campaign
ex.cn: 志在必得的营销活动

syn: adj. 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的：invasive, enterprising
rm: ag + gress(行走) + ive(形容词后缀) → 不断行走， 四处闯荡 → 有进取心的

en: when you are so anxious, nervous, or upset that you cannot think calmly

ex.en: She was in a state of considerable agitation.
ex.cn: 她处于相当焦虑的状态。

syn: n. 激动；搅动；煽动；烦乱：warmth, excitation

en: very severe pain

ex.en: the agony of arthritis
ex.cn: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

ph.cn: (感情上的)突然而强烈的爆发，任何精神上的激动
（英）问答专栏阿姨；心理咨询阿姨

syn: n. 苦恼；极大的痛苦；临死的挣扎：unhappiness, vexation

t: adj. 令人愉快的；乐于同意的
en: pleasant

ex.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
ex.cn: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

ex.en: an agreeable young man
ex.cn: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

syn: adj. 令人愉快的；适合的；和蔼可亲的：pleasant, adaptive, lovely, calculated, grateful

en: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc

ex.en: Please read the agreement and sign it.
ex.cn: 请阅读协议书并签字。

syn: n. [法]协议；同意，一致：accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping

en: to destroy something or someone completely

ex.en: Just one of these bombs could annihilate a city the size of New York.
ex.cn: 这种炸弹只要一颗就能彻底毁灭纽约那么大的一座城市。

syn: vt. 歼灭；战胜；废止：defeat, suppress
vi. 湮灭；湮没：submerge

en: a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year

ex.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
ex.cn: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

ph.cn: 结婚纪念日；结婚周年纪念日

en: to make someone feel slightly angry and unhappy about something

ex.en: What annoyed him most was that he had received no apology.
ex.cn: 最令他生气的是没人向他道歉。

ex.en: It really annoys me when I see people dropping litter.
ex.cn: 看到别人乱丢垃圾我非常生气。

syn: vt. 骚扰；惹恼；打搅：harry, ply with
vi. 惹恼；令人讨厌；打搅：brown off

t: adj. 每年的，一年生的；n. 年刊；一年生植物
en: happening once a year

ex.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
ex.cn: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

ph.cn: 年报，年度报告；年度决算；年度财务报告

syn: adj. 年度的；[统计]每年的：yearly, etesian
n. 年刊，[图情]年鉴；一年生植物：year book, almanac
rm: ann(年) + ual → 每年的， 年度的

en: a fixed amount of money that is paid each year to someone, usually until they die

ex.en: He received a paltry annuity of $100.
ex.cn: 他收到了微不足道的100美元年金。

syn: n. [劳经]年金，养老金；年金保险；年金享受权：rente, old-age pension

en: unknown by name

ex.en: the anonymous author of a collection of poems
ex.cn: 一本诗集的佚名作者

ex.en: According to one employee, who wishes to remain anonymous , the company engaged in illegal activities.
ex.cn: 根据一位不愿透露姓名的员工所述，这家公司曾从事非法活动。

ph.cn: 匿名戒酒互助社；慝名戒毒会

syn: adj. 匿名的，无名的；无个性特征的：faceless, innominate

en: opposition to an idea, plan etc
syn: n. [生化]对抗，敌对；对立；敌意：opposition, war, confrontation

en: an event, organization, or thing that is similar to the one you have mentioned but existed earlier

ex.en: historical antecedents
ex.cn: 历史先例

syn: n. 前情；先行词；祖先：father, root
adj. 先行的；前驱的；先前的：advance, prodromal

en: a formal or religious song
syn: n. 赞美诗；圣歌：spiritual, chorale

en: a set of stories, poems, songs etc by different people collected together in one book

ex.en: an anthology of American literature
ex.cn: 美国文学选集

syn: n. （诗、文、曲、画等的）[图情]选集：selection, selected works

en: the scientific study of people, their societies,  culture s  etc

ex.en: "In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
ex.cn: “在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。

ex.en: When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
ex.cn: 当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。

ph.cn: 人类体格学；身体人类学

syn: n. [人类]人类学：humanics

en: a drug that is used to kill  bacteria  and cure infections

ex.en: Your doctor may prescribe antibiotics.
ex.cn: 你的大夫可能会开抗生素。

ph.cn: 抗生素抗性；抗菌素耐药性

syn: adj. [药][微]抗生的；抗菌的：germproof
n. [药]抗生素，[微]抗菌素：microbiotic, bacteriophage
rm: anti(反) + bio(生命) + tic → 抗生素

t: v. 占先，预先处理；预料
en: to expect that something will happen and be ready for it

ex.en: Sales are better than anticipated.
ex.cn: 销量比预期要好。

ex.en: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
ex.cn: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

syn: vt. 预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用：hope, presume upon
rm: anti(在…之前) + cip(拿， 取) + ate(动词后缀) → 在…之前取得 → 先于…行动

en: when you are expecting something to happen

ex.en: She waited in eager anticipation for Robert to arrive.
ex.cn: 她急切地期盼着罗伯特到来。

ex.en: Taylor was excited and full of anticipation at the prospect of the trip.
ex.cn: 泰勒很兴奋，对这次旅行满怀期待。

syn: n. 希望；预感；先发制人；预支：wish, hope, pleasure, promise

en: a piece of furniture, jewellery etc that was made a very long time ago and is therefore valuable

ex.en: The palace is full of priceless antiques.
ex.cn: 宫殿里到处都是价值连城的古董。

ex.en: They bought the clock at an antique shop in Bath.
ex.cn: 他们在巴斯一家古玩店里买了这只钟。

ph.cn: 古董家具；古典家具；古式家具

syn: adj. 古老的，年代久远的；过时的，[古]古董的；古风的，古式的：ancient, old
n. [古]古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格：curiosity, virtu
rm: anti(在…之前) + que → 以前的 → 古时的， 古老的

en: a word that means the opposite of another word

ex.en: a dictionary of synonyms and antonyms
ex.cn: 同义词和反义词词典

syn: n. [语]反义词：opposite

en: a feeling of wanting to do something very much

ex.en: Her voice was full of anxiety.
ex.cn: 她的声音饱含焦虑。

ph.cn: 焦虑症；焦虑性障碍；焦虑症候群

syn: n. [心理]焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事：solicitude, aspiration

t: adv. 不论用何种方法；无论如何

ex.en: The scandal could damage her reputation but the press reported it anyhow.
ex.cn: 这宗丑闻可能损害她的名声，不过报纸还是给登了出来。

syn: adv. 总之；无论如何；不管怎样：anyway, however

en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for causing trouble for someone, for hurting them, or for disappointing them

ex.en: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
ex.cn: 医院员工都深表歉意，但那不能真正补偿。

en: the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose

ex.en: Astronauts have special breathing apparatus.
ex.cn: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

syn: n. 装置，[机]设备；[仪]仪器；器官：device, equipment, installation, furniture, facility, unit, organ
rm: ap(靠近) + para(排列) + tus → 靠近排列 → 器械， 器具

t: v. 分配；确定时间或地点；指派
en: to give someone a particular job or make them responsible for a particular person or thing

ex.en: How much time have you assigned for the meeting?
ex.cn: 你给这个会议定了多长时间？

syn: vt. 分配；指派；[计][数]赋值：portion, part, ticket
rm: as + sign(签名) → 找那个大牌明星签名的任务指派给你了 → 指派， 分配

en: to completely understand and begin to use new ideas, information etc

ex.en: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
ex.cn: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

syn: vt. 吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似：absorb, drink in
vi. 吸收；同化：drink in, suck up
rm: as + simil(相同) + ate(使…) → 使相同 → 使同化

en: someone who you work or do business with

ex.en: one of his business associates
ex.cn: 他的一个生意伙伴

ph.cn: v. 联合；与…联系在一起；和…来往
n. 美国大学修满二年课程的肄业证书

syn: vi. 交往；结交：company, travel, sort, mix
n. [管理]同事，伙伴；关联的事物：brother, partner, fellow, comrade, colleague
rm: as(表加强) + soci(结交； 同伴) + ate(动词后缀) → 交往

en: of various different types

ex.en: paintbrushes in assorted sizes
ex.cn: 各种大小的画笔

ex.en: assorted vegetables
ex.cn: 各种各样的蔬菜

syn: adj. 组合的；各种各样的；混杂的：various, combined

en: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof

ex.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
ex.cn: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

ex.en: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
ex.cn: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

syn: vt. 承担；假定；采取；呈现：undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain
vi. 装腔作势；多管闲事：attitudinize, put on the dog
rm: as + sum(拿， 取) + e → 预先拿取 → 假定， 设想

t: n. 假定之事；承担，担任
en: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof

ex.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
ex.cn: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

syn: n. 假定；设想；担任；采取：conception, perhaps, if

en: a feeling of calm confidence about your own abilities, or that you are right about something

ex.en: the calm assurance with which she handled the horse
ex.cn: 她对付马儿时的从容镇定

ex.en: ‘Jack will never agree to that,’ he said with assurance.
ex.cn: “杰克绝不会同意的。”他肯定地说道。

ph.cn: n. 人寿保险；（保险公司付给的）人寿保险金；（被保险人缴纳的）人寿保险费

syn: n. 保证；保险；确信；断言：certification, insurance, commitment, guarantee, safety

ex.en: I called the phone company about the bill.
ex.cn: 我就电话账单的事给电话公司打了电话。

ph.cn: 有限公司；（英）股份有限公司（等于limited-liability company）

syn: n. [贸易]公司；陪伴，同伴；连队：corporation, establishment, firm, incorporation
vi. 交往：travel, associate, sort, mix

en: similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison

ex.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
ex.cn: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

ph.cn: 可比较的，比得上的；与…相容；可同…比较

rm: com(共同) + par(相等) + able(能…的) → 能等同的 → 可比较的

en: to consider two or more things or people, in order to show how they are similar or different

ex.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
ex.cn: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

syn: vt. 比较；对照；比喻为：contradistinguish, be confronted with
vi. 比较；相比：match
rm: com(共同) + par(相等) + e → 放在一起看看是否相等 → 对比

t: n. 分隔间；火车车厢的分隔间
en: a smaller enclosed space inside something larger

ex.en: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
ex.cn: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

ex.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["engine compartment"]}
ex.cn: 发动机室

ph.cn: 筋膜室综合征；间室症候群

syn: vt. 分隔；划分：to divide, measure off

en: an instrument that shows directions and has a needle that always points north

ex.en: a map and compass
ex.cn: 地图和指南针

syn: n. 指南针，[航][水运]罗盘；圆规：calliper, divider
vt. 包围：case, invest, circumvent, encircle, ring about
rm: com(共同) + pass(通过) → 双边共同通过的地方 → 界限， 范围

t: adj. 可兼容的，可和谐共存的
en: if two pieces of computer equipment are compatible, they can be used together, especially when they are made by different companies

ex.en: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
ex.cn: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

ph.cn: adj. 与……和谐相处；与……相配的

rm: com(共同) + pat(=path感觉) + ible → 有共同感觉的 → 兼容的； 合得来的

en: to force someone to do something

ex.en: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet.
ex.cn: …强制骑车人戴头盔的法律的引入。

syn: vt. 强迫，迫使；强使发生：pressure, force, enforce
rm: com(共同) + pel(推) → 强迫

en: to replace or balance the effect of something bad

ex.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
ex.cn: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

syn: vi. 补偿，赔偿；抵消：make good, to make up for
vt. 补偿，赔偿；付报酬：make good, to make up for
rm: com(以) + pens(偿还) + ate → 以某物来偿还 → 补偿， 赔偿； 弥补

en: money paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or because something they own has been damaged

ex.en: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
ex.cn: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

syn: n. [会计]补偿；报酬；[保险]赔偿金：payment, consideration, insurance, reward, offset

en: the ability to do something well

ex.en: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
ex.cn: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

syn: n. 能力，[胚]胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入：ability, capacity, rights, power, jurisdiction

en: the people or groups that are competing against you, especially in business or in a sport

ex.en: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
ex.cn: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

syn: n. [生态]竞争；比赛，竞赛：game, war, match, tournament, struggle

ph.cn: 竞争价格；公开招标价格

syn: adj. 竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的：played, rival

en: to make a book, list, record etc, using different pieces of information, music etc

ex.en: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
ex.cn: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

syn: vt. 编译；编制；编辑；[图情]汇编：to edit, copy-edit
rm: com(共同) + pile(堆) → 堆在一起 → 汇编； 编纂

t: n. 补足物，船上的定员；补语；v. 补充，补足
en: someone or something that emphasizes the good qualities of another person or thing

ex.en: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser.
ex.cn: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

syn: vt. 补足，补助：make up a loss, make sth up

t: adj. 复杂的；n. 复合体；变态心理
en: consisting of many different parts and often difficult to understand

ex.en: a complex system of highways
ex.cn: 复杂的公路网

ex.en: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
ex.cn: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

ph.cn: 复合结构；复结构；复数结构

syn: adj. 复杂的；合成的：sophisticated, involved, synthetic, detailed, intricate
rm: com(共同) + plex(重叠) → 重叠交叉的 → 复杂的

t: n. 肤色；情况；局面；气质
en: the natural colour or appearance of the skin on your face

ex.en: Drinking water is good for the complexion.
ex.cn: 喝水让气色变好。

syn: n. 肤色；面色；情况；局面：situation, circumstance, thing, color, case

en: fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important

ex.en: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
ex.cn: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

ex.en: issues of considerable importance
ex.cn: 相当重要的问题

syn: adj. 相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的：crucial, important, material, big, major
rm: consider(考虑) + able(能…的) → 能纳入考虑范围的 → 值得考虑的

t: adj. 考虑周到的；体谅别人的
en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people

ex.en: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known.
ex.cn: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力、最体贴的男士。

syn: adj. 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的：thoughtful, wary

en: to send something somewhere, especially in order to sell it
syn: vt. 交付；[交]托运；寄存；把…委托给：park, deliver over

en: Something that consists of particular things or people is formed from them

ex.en: My diet consisted almost exclusively of chocolate-covered cookies and glasses of milk.
ex.cn: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

syn: vi. 组成；在于；符合：make up, be composed of
rm: con(共同) + sist(站) → 站在一起 → 由…构成

t: n. 控制台，仪表板；落地柜；v. 安慰，慰问
en: a flat board that contains the controls for a machine, piece of electrical equipment, computer etc

ex.en: No one could console her when Peter died.
ex.cn: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

syn: n. [计]控制台；[电]操纵台：Prefs, operation desk
vt. 安慰；慰藉：comfort, quiet

t: v. 巩固;；加强；把. 合为一体
en: to strengthen the position of power or success that you have, so that it becomes more effective or continues for longer

ex.en: The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
ex.cn: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

ex.en: The team consolidated their lead with a third goal.
ex.cn: 球队以第三个进球巩固了领先优势。

syn: vt. 巩固，使固定；联合：cement, strengthen, connect, fix, link
vi. 巩固，加强：build up, to reinforce

t: adj. 明显的，引人注目的
en: very easy to notice

ex.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
ex.cn: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

ex.en: a bird with conspicuous white markings
ex.cn: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

syn: adj. 显著的；显而易见的：obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding

en: a secret plan made by two or more people to do something that is harmful or illegal

ex.en: There were many conspiracy theories (= beliefs that something is the result of a conspiracy ) surrounding Princess Diana’s death.
ex.cn: 围绕戴安娜王妃之死有许多阴谋论。

syn: n. 阴谋；共谋；阴谋集团：designing, plot

t: adj. 不变的；经常的；坚定的
en: happening regularly or all the time

ex.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
ex.cn: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

ex.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
ex.cn: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

syn: adj. 不变的；恒定的；经常的：permanent, steady
n. [数]常数；恒量：invariable
rm: con(共同) + stant(站立) → 永远站在一起 → 坚定的， 永恒的， 忠实的

t: adj. 有选举权的；组成的；v. 选民；成份
en: being one of the parts of something

ex.en: the EU and its constituent members
ex.cn: 欧盟及其成员国

syn: n. 成分；选民；委托人：element, client, component, principal
adj. 构成的；选举的：component, electoral
rm: con(共同) + stit(=stat站立) + uent → 站在一起 → 成分

en: if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it

ex.en: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
ex.cn: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

syn: vt. 组成，构成；建立；任命：install, establish, form, found, build
rm: con(共同) + stit(站立) + ute → 设立

ex.en: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
ex.cn: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

syn: n. 宪法；体质；章程；构造：formation, fabric, structure, build, make

en: to limit something

ex.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
ex.cn: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

ex.en: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
ex.cn: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

syn: vt. 驱使；强迫；束缚：chain, bound, force, provoke, enforce
rm: con(表加强) + strain(拉紧) → 约束

ex.en: Caffeine constricts the blood vessels in your body.
ex.cn: 咖啡因会使体内的血管收缩。

ex.en: Linda’s throat constricted and she started to cry.
ex.cn: 琳达喉咙发紧，哭了起来。

syn: vt. 压缩；束紧：to compress, telescope

en: to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something

ex.en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
ex.cn: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

vi. 请教；商议；当顾问：take advice, seek advice
rm: 不顾侮辱(insult)， 不耻请教(consult)

ex.en: Consumers will soon be paying higher airfares.
ex.cn: 不久消费者就要支付更高的机票价了。

ex.en: It will offer a wider choice of goods for the consumer (= consumers in general ) .
ex.cn: 它将为消费者提供更多的商品选择。

ph.cn: 生活消费品，日用消费品
消费需求；消费者的要求
消费性电子产品；家用电子产品

syn: n. [经][生态]消费者；用户，顾客：user, customer, client, guest

en: the act of buying and using products

ex.en: art intended for mass consumption
ex.cn: 供大众消费的艺术品

ex.en: China’s austerity program has cut domestic consumption (= when products are bought in the country where they were produced ) .
ex.cn: 中国的经济紧缩计划缩减了国内消费。

syn: n. [经]消费；消耗；肺痨：expense, depletion
rm: con(共同； 完全) + sumpt(使用) + ion → 消耗； 消费

t: v. 接触；n. 接触；联络；会晤的人；(电)接点
en: communication with a person, organization, country etc

ex.en: Does that metal pit after contact with acid?
ex.cn: 那种金属同酸接触后是否会起凹点?

ex.en: When you contact these two wires, the machine will start at once.
ex.cn: 当你使这两条导线一接触，这台机器就会立刻开始运转。

syn: n. [电][电子]接触，联系：touch, link
vi. 联系，[电][电子]接触：meet, to link
rm: con(共同) + tact(接触) → 接触

en: to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it

ex.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
ex.cn: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

syn: vt. 污染，弄脏：soil, mud, spot, dirty, poison

t: v. 碰撞，坠毁，冲过；n. 突然坠落；事故
en: to have an accident in a car, plane etc by violently hitting something else

ex.en: The jet crashed after take-off.
ex.cn: 这架喷气式飞机起飞后就坠毁了。

ph.cn: 股市崩盘；股市行情暴跌

syn: n. 碰撞；崩溃；坠落：collision, precipitation, impact
vt. 坠落；破碎；撞碎：fall of, fall to pieces
rm: 卡车撞上(crash)路边的一堆垃圾(trash)

en: a round hole in the ground made by something that has fallen on it or by an explosion

ex.en: craters on the moon’s surface
ex.cn: 月球表面的坑

ph.cn: n. 火山口形成的深湖

syn: n. [地质]火山口；弹坑：volcanic vent, dead hole
vt. 在…上形成坑；取消；毁坏：destroy, damage, recall

t: v. 爬行;缓慢地行进，爬满；n. 爬行；自由泳
en: to move along on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground

ex.en: We crawled into bed at 2 am.
ex.cn: 我们凌晨两点爬上了床。

ph.cn: 慢行通过的空间；供电线或水管等通过的槽隙

syn: vi. 爬行；匍匐行进：creep
n. 爬行；[水产]养鱼池；匍匐而行：creep, aquarium
rm: c + raw(生疏的) + l → 对地形生疏， 车要开得慢一点 → 缓慢行进

t: n. 折缝，皱痕；v. 起折痕
en: a line on a piece of cloth, paper etc where it has been folded, crushed, or pressed

ex.en: She smoothed the creases from her skirt.
ex.cn: 她捋平裙子上的皱褶。

ex.en: I’ll have to iron out the creases.
ex.cn: 我得把皱褶熨平。

syn: n. 折痕；折缝：fell, fold
vi. 起皱：wrinkle

t: v. 创造；创作；产生；造成
en: to make something exist that did not exist before

ex.en: Some people believe the universe was created by a big explosion.
ex.cn: 有些人认为宇宙是通过一次大爆炸创造出来的。

ex.en: Her behaviour is creating a lot of problems.
ex.cn: 她的行为引起了很多问题。

syn: vt. 创造，创作；造成：produce, invent

en: the act of creating something

ex.en: a job creation scheme
ex.cn: 创造就业机会的计划

syn: n. 创造，创作；创作物，产物：child, fruit
rm: creat(e)(创造) + ion → 创造

en: a letter or other document which proves your good character or your right to have a particular position

ex.en: The commissioner presented his credentials to the State Department.
ex.cn: 该委员向国务院递交了他的任职资格证书。

ph.cn: 资格审查委员会；证件审核委员会

syn: n. [管理]证书；文凭；信任状（credential的复数）：certificates, diplomata
rm: cred(相信) + ential → 让人相信的东西 → 证明书

en: deserving or able to be believed or trusted

ex.en: Her excuse was barely credible.
ex.cn: 她的借口无法让人信服。

ex.en: a credible alternative to nuclear power
ex.cn: 原子能的可靠替代物

syn: adj. 可靠的，可信的：responsible, reliable, tried, honest, safe

t: n. 信任，信誉；存款；信用贷款；v. 相信
en: an arrangement with a shop, bank etc that allows you to buy something and pay for it later

ex.en: The store agreed to let him have credit.
ex.cn: 商店同意他赊购。

ex.en: What’s the credit limit on your Visa card?
ex.cn: 你的维萨卡信用额度是多少？

ph.cn: 信用制度；信贷制度；赊购或赊销制度

syn: n. 信用，信誉；[金融]贷款；学分；信任；声望：faith, reputation, honor, loan, confidence
vt. 相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂：put faith in, believe in

t: v. 爬行；缓慢移行；(时间)悄悄过去；蔓延
en: if something such as an insect, small animal, or car creeps, it moves slowly and quietly

ex.en: He crept back up the stairs, trying to avoid the ones that creaked.
ex.cn: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

n. 爬行；毛骨悚然的感觉；谄媚者：toadeater, kiss-ass

en: a narrow crack in the surface of something, especially in rock

ex.en: small creatures that hide in crevices in the rock
ex.cn: 藏在岩石缝里的小生物

ph.cn: 缝隙腐蚀；裂隙腐蚀；接触腐蚀；隙间腐蚀

syn: n. 裂缝；裂隙：crack, split

en: a game between two teams of 11 players in which players try to get points by hitting a ball and running between two sets of three sticks

ex.en: The boy traded his knife for a cricket bat.
ex.cn: 那男孩用他的刀子换了一个板球棒。

ex.en: He angrily stomped his cricket after failing the fight.
ex.cn: 比赛失败后，他生气地踏死了他的蟋蟀。

syn: n. 板球，板球运动；[昆]蟋蟀：Chinese Cricket, grig

t: n. 罪犯；adj. 犯罪的，刑事上的
en: someone who is involved in illegal activities or has been proved guilty of a crime

ex.en: Police have described the man as a violent and dangerous criminal.
ex.cn: 警方形容那名男子是个凶暴而危险的罪犯。

ex.en: a convicted criminal
ex.cn: 一名已决罪犯

syn: n. 罪犯：offender, culprit
adj. 刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的：penal, peccant

t: n. 跛子；残疾人；v. 使跛，使残疾
en: someone who is unable to walk properly because their legs are damaged or injured - now considered offensive

ex.en: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
ex.cn: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

syn: vt. 削弱；使跛；[医]使残废：break, to weaken
n. [医]跛子；残废：disablement, lameness

en: a situation in which there are a lot of problems that must be dealt with quickly so that the situation does not get worse or more dangerous

ex.en: The country now faces an economic crisis .
ex.cn: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

ex.en: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
ex.cn: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

ph.cn: 危机管理，处理危急的办法

syn: n. 危机；危险期；决定性时刻：defining moment, critical stage

t: adj. 脆的；干脆的；n. 油炸马铃薯片；v. (使)发脆
en: something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it

ex.en: She kicked at the crisp leaves at her feet.
ex.cn: 她踢着脚边松脆的树叶。

ex.en: He stepped carefully through the crisp deep snow.
ex.cn: 他小心地走在松脆的、厚厚的雪地里。

syn: adj. 脆的；新鲜的；易碎的：fresh, new, fragile, delicate
vt. 使卷曲；使发脆：crimp

en: a standard that you use to judge something or make a decision about something

ex.en: the criteria we use to select candidates
ex.cn: 我们挑选候选人的标准

ph.cn: 设计标准；设计准则；设计规范
失效准则；故障判据；抗剪强度破坏准则

syn: n. （批评判断的）[标准]标准；准则；规范；准据：standard, formula, level, prototype, norm
rm: cri(判断) + ter + ion → 判断的手段 → 标准， 准则

t: adj. 危急的；批评的；苛求的，关键的
en: if you are critical, you criticize someone or something

ex.en: He made some highly critical remarks.
ex.cn: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

ph.cn: 批判性思维，批判性的思考；批判思考能力，判断思维

syn: adj. 鉴定的；[核]临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的：dangerous, crucial, final, decisive, marginal
rm: crit(判断) + ic + al(形容词后缀) → 作出判断的 → 评论的

t: n. 工艺；手工业；船；技巧；诡计
en: a job or activity in which you make things with your hands, and that you usually need skill to do

ex.en: traditional rural crafts
ex.cn: 传统的乡村手工艺

ex.en: arts and crafts
ex.cn: 手工艺

syn: n. 工艺；手艺；太空船：technology, hand, ship, workmanship
rm: c + raft(筏) → 筏也就是船 → 船

t: n. (大学)院长，系主任，教务长
en: a priest of high rank in the Christian church who is in charge of several priests or churches

ex.en: the admissions dean
ex.cn: 招生主任

ph.cn: 詹姆斯·迪恩（好莱坞青春偶像）

rm: “盯” → 院长狠狠地盯着作弊的学生 → 院长

en: a situation in which there are very few of something that people want or need

ex.en: Construction had slowed because of a dearth of labourers.
ex.cn: 建筑进程缓慢是因为劳动力不足。

syn: n. 缺乏；饥馑；粮食不足：shortage, deficiency, short of, need, drought
rm: dear(珍贵的) + th → 物以稀为贵 → 缺乏， 短缺

en: the pieces of something that are left after it has been destroyed in an accident, explosion etc

ex.en: She was hit by flying debris from the blast.
ex.cn: 她被爆炸产生的飞散碎片击中。

syn: n. 碎片，残骸：remain, chip
rm: “堆玻璃” → 一堆碎玻璃 → 碎屑， 残骸

en: a period of 10 years

ex.en: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
ex.cn: …19世纪的最后10年。

syn: n. 十年，十年期；十：decennium, dix
rm: deca(十) + de → 十年， 十年期

en: to be slowly destroyed by a natural chemical process, or to make something do this

ex.en: Her body was already starting to decay.
ex.cn: 她的尸体已经开始腐烂。

ex.en: Most archaeological finds are broken, damaged, or decayed.
ex.cn: 大部分考古发现物都已破裂、损坏或腐烂。

ph.cn: 衰减率；衰变率；衰变速度

syn: vi. 衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽：fail, flag
n. 衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽：recession, downturn, decline, decomposition
rm: 骗(decoy)人变坏(decay)

en: to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
ex.cn: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

syn: v. 欺骗；行骗：take in sb, give the shaft
rm: de(分离) + ceiv(拿， 抓) + e → 欺骗， 蒙骗

t: adj. 正当的，合适的；文雅的，尚可的
en: following moral standards that are acceptable to society

ex.en: a decent burial
ex.cn: 得体的葬礼

ex.en: Paul visited the local bars more frequently than was decent for a senior lecturer.
ex.cn: 保罗过于频繁地光顾当地酒吧，不太合乎高级讲师的身份。

syn: adj. 正派的；得体的；相当好的：proper, goodish

en: a decimal system is based on the number 10

ex.en: changing to a decimal system
ex.cn: 改为十进制

ex.en: calculations accurate to three decimal places
ex.cn: 精确到小数点后三位的计算

syn: adj. 小数的；[数]十进位的：fractional
n. [数]小数：small number, haet

en: to find the meaning of something that is difficult to read or understand

ex.en: She studied the envelope, trying to decipher the handwriting.
ex.cn: 她仔细地看信封，试图辨认上面的字迹。

rm: de(去掉) + cipher(密码) → 解开密码 → 破译

t: n. 甲板；公共汽车一层的车厢；纸牌；v. 装饰
en: one of the levels on a bus, plane etc

ex.en: Eddie returned to the flight deck (= the part of an aircraft where the pilot sits ) .
ex.cn: 埃迪回到了驾驶舱。

syn: n. [船]甲板；行李仓；露天平台：board, storage room
vt. 装饰；[船]装甲板；打扮：paint, hang, dress oneself, array

en: an important official statement about a particular situation or plan, or the act of making this statement

ex.en: a ceasefire declaration
ex.cn: 停火声明

ex.en: Under Islamic law it was possible to divorce by simple declaration.
ex.cn: 从前按照伊斯兰法律，作简单的声明就可以离婚。

syn: n. （纳税品等的）[税收]申报；宣布；公告；[法]申诉书：profession, announcement
rm: 来自declare(v. 正式宣布)

t: v. 宣告，声明；断言；申报应纳税物品
en: to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true

ex.en: A state of emergency has been declared.
ex.cn: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

ex.en: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
ex.cn: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

syn: vt. 宣布，声明；断言，宣称：bill, state
vi. 声明，宣布：to announce, hand down
rm: de(表加强) + clar(清楚) + e → 说清楚 → 正式宣布； 声明

t: n&v. 下降，衰退，减弱；拒绝
en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength

ex.en: The number of staff has declined from 217,000 to 114,000.
ex.cn: 员工人数已从217000人减少到114000人。

ex.en: Hourly output by workers declined 1.3% in the first quarter.
ex.cn: 工人每小时的产量在第1季度下降了1.3%。

syn: n. 下降；衰退；斜面：reduction, recession, fall
vi. 下降；衰落；谢绝：go down, slump
rm: de(向下) + clin(弯曲) + e → 向下弯曲 → 下降； 衰退

en: to decay or make something decay

ex.en: a partially decomposed body
ex.cn: 部分腐烂的尸体

syn: vi. 分解；使腐烂：resolve, break down
vt. 分解；腐烂：analyze, break down
rm: de(分离) + compose(组成) → 把组合在一起的东西分开 → 分解

en: to make something look more attractive by putting something pretty on it

ex.en: Children’s pictures decorated the walls of the classroom.
ex.cn: 教室的墙上装点着儿童画。

syn: vt. 装饰；布置；授勋给：paint, hang, make, post
vi. 装饰；布置：set sth out, trick out
rm: decor(装饰) + ate(动词后缀) → 装饰， 装潢

en: to become less or go down to a lower level, or to make something do this

ex.en: The number of people who have the disease has decreased significantly in recent years.
ex.cn: 近年来，这种病的患者人数明显下降。

ex.en: They want to decrease their reliance on oil.
ex.cn: 他们想减少对石油的依赖。

syn: n. 减少，减小；减少量：reduction, loss
vi. 减少，减小：to cut down, fall off
rm: de(相反) + cre(生长) + ase → 减少

en: an official order or decision, especially one made by the ruler of a country

ex.en: The Emperor issued the decree repealing martial law.
ex.cn: 皇帝下诏令取消了军事管制。

syn: n. [法]法令；判决：sentence, award, act, ordinance
vt. 命令；颁布；注定；判决：require, order, command, determine, fate

en: old and in bad condition

ex.en: The buildings were in a decrepit state.
ex.cn: 这些建筑物破旧不堪。

ex.en: He was a rather decrepit old man.
ex.cn: 他年老体弱。

syn: adj. 衰老的；破旧的：shot, anile
rm: de + crep(发出破裂声) + it → 破旧的

t: v. 奉献，供奉，题献(著作)
en: to say at the beginning of a book or film, or before a piece of music, that it has been written, made, or performed for someone that you love or respect

ex.en: She dedicated her first album to Woody Allen, who she says understands her obsession.
ex.cn: 她把她的第一张唱片献给伍迪·艾伦，她说艾伦理解她的痴迷。

syn: vt. 致力；献身；题献：give oneself, devote  to
rm: de(表加强) + dic(分配， 分派) + ate(动词后缀) → 为…献出 → 献(身)

t: adj. 献身的，一心一意的，热诚的

ex.en: a dedicated and thoughtful teacher
ex.cn: 一位富有敬业精神、待人体贴的教师

syn: adj. [计]专用的；专注的；献身的：devoted, special
rm: de(表加强) + dic(分配， 分派) + ate(动词后缀) → 为…献出 → 献(身)

en: to use the knowledge and information you have in order to understand something or form an opinion about it

ex.en: Alison cleverly deduced that I was the author of the letter.
ex.cn: 艾莉森聪明地推断出我是这封信的作者。

syn: vt. 推论，推断；[数][计]演绎出：understand, reason, conclude
rm: de(向下) + duc(拉) + e→ 向下拉 → 演绎， 推断

en: a feeling that you have no hope at all

ex.en: The noise from the neighbours used to drive him to despair .
ex.cn: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

syn: n. 绝望；令人绝望的人或事：hopelessness, acedia
vi. 绝望，丧失信心：throw up one's hands, lose heart

t: adj. 绝望的；不顾一切的；危急的
en: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger

ex.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
ex.cn: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

ex.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
ex.cn: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

syn: adj. 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的：venturous, devil-may-care
rm: de(去掉) + sper(希望) + ate → 去掉希望 → 绝望的

en: to dislike and have a low opinion of someone or something

ex.en: She despised her neighbours.
ex.cn: 她看不起她的邻居。

syn: vt. 轻视，鄙视：slight, set light by

en: the place that someone or something is going to

ex.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
ex.cn: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

ph.cn: 旅游胜地；旅游目的地；旅游景点

syn: n. [计]目的地，终点：goal, end-point
rm: destin(看作destine， 预定) + ation → 预定的地方 → 目的地

syn: vt. 注定；命定；预定：fate, engage, budget

en: the things that will happen to someone in the future, especially those that cannot be changed or controlled

ex.en: She always had a strong sense of destiny .
ex.cn: 她向来很相信天意。

syn: n. 命运，定数，天命：fate, lot, fortune, portion
rm: 音乐组合Destiny's Child(真命天子)

en: causing damage to people or things

ex.en: the destructive power of modern weapons
ex.cn: 现代武器的破坏力

syn: adj. 破坏的；毁灭性的；有害的，消极的：harmful, evil, fell, negative, passive
rm: de(去掉) + struct(建立) + ive(形容词后缀)  → 毁坏建好的东西 → 破坏(性)的

en: if you detach something, or if it detaches, it becomes separated from the thing it was attached to

ex.en: Please detach and fill out the application form.
ex.cn: 请撕下申请表并填好。

syn: vt. 分离；派遣；使超然：mission, keep apart
rm: de(去掉) + tach(接触) → 去掉接触 → 分离

en: to officially prevent someone from leaving a place

ex.en: Two suspects have been detained by the police for questioning .
ex.cn: 两名嫌疑人被警方拘留审问。

ex.en: She was detained in hospital with a suspected broken leg.
ex.cn: 她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。

syn: vt. 拘留；留住；耽搁：hold, delay

en: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc

ex.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
ex.cn: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

syn: vt. 察觉；发现；探测：explore, perceive
rm: de(去掉) + tect(遮盖) → 去掉遮盖 → 发现， 察觉

en: A detective novel or story is one in which a detective tries to solve a crime

ex.en: ...Arthur Conan Doyle's classic detective novel.
ex.cn: …阿瑟·柯南·道尔的经典侦探小说。

syn: n. 侦探：tec, hawkshaw

en: to stop someone from doing something, by making them realize it will be difficult or have bad results

ex.en: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
ex.cn: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

syn: vt. 制止，阻止；使打消念头：dispute, block, restrain
rm: de + ter(=terr吓唬) → 威慑， 吓住

en: a liquid or powder used for washing clothes, dishes etc

ex.en: ...a brand of detergent.
ex.cn: …一种品牌的清洁剂。

syn: n. 清洁剂；[化工]去垢剂：cleaner, cleaning media
rm: de(去掉) + terg(擦) + ent → 擦掉(脏)东西 → 清洁的

en: to become worse

ex.en: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
ex.cn: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

ex.en: America’s deteriorating economy
ex.cn: 美国日渐恶化的经济

syn: vi. 恶化，变坏：go ill, change for the worse
vt. 恶化：go ill, exasperate
rm: de(向下) + ter(地) + ior + ate → 向地面下降 → 变糟糕 → 变坏

en: the quality of trying to do something even when it is difficult

ex.en: his dogged determination (= very strong determination ) to succeed
ex.cn: 他想要成功的坚定决心

syn: n. 决心；果断：decision, resolution, push, backbone

en: to hate something or someone very much

ex.en: The two men detested each other.
ex.cn: 两个男人互相厌恶。

syn: vt. 厌恶；憎恨：hate, turn away from

en: harm or damage

ex.en: Work hard to succeed but not to the detriment of others.
ex.cn: 在不损害他人利益的前提下为成功艰苦奋斗。

ex.en: A “do what I say, not what I do” world economy will fracture, to the detriment of all.
ex.cn: 在一个“依我所言，勿仿我行”的世界里，世界经济将割裂分化，伤害所有的国家。

syn: n. 损害；伤害；损害物：harm, damage, lesion

en: causing harm or damage

ex.en: the detrimental effect of pollution on the environment
ex.cn: 污染对环境的不利影响

syn: adj. 不利的；有害的：harmful, adverse, against, evil, disadvantageous
rm: detriment(损害， 伤害) + al(形容词后缀) → 不利的， 有害的

t: n. 性情，气质；布置；配置
en: a particular type of character which makes someone likely to behave or react in a certain way

ex.en: the disposition of assets on death
ex.cn: 身后财产的处置

syn: n. 处置；[心理]性情；[军]部署；倾向：tendency, liability, trend, preference, deployment

en: a serious argument or disagreement

ex.en: It is beyond dispute that advances in medicine have enabled people to live longer.
ex.cn: 医学的发展使人们更加长寿，这是无可置疑的。

syn: vt. 辩论；怀疑；阻止；抗拒：discuss, debate, argue, stem, block
vi. 争论：debate, argue with
rm: dis(分开) + put(思考) + e → 分开思考 → 争论， 争吵

en: to ignore something or treat it as unimportant

ex.en: He ordered the jury to disregard the witness’s last statement.
ex.cn: 他指示陪审团忽略证人的最后一句话。

ex.en: Mark totally disregarded my advice.
ex.cn: 马克完全不听我的建议。

syn: vt. 忽视；不理；漠视；不顾：ignore, neglect
n. 忽视；不尊重：inobservancy, negligence
rm: dis(不) + regard(关心) → 不关心 → 不理会， 漠视

ex.en: Traffic was disrupted by a hoax bomb.
ex.cn: 有人虚报有炸弹，造成了交通混乱。

syn: vt. 破坏；使瓦解；使分裂；使中断；使陷于混乱：destroy, tear, undermine, founder
adj. 分裂的，中断的；分散的：divided, scattered
rm: dis(分开) + rupt(打破， 断裂) → 切断 → 使中断

t: n. (博士学位)论文，学术演讲，专题论文
en: a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree

ex.en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.
ex.cn: 他正在写一篇关于索马里内战的论文。

syn: n. 论文，专题；学术演讲：thesis, tractate
rm: 来自dissert(vi. 论述， 写论文)

t: v. 消散，消失；浪费，挥霍
en: to gradually become less or weaker before disappearing completely, or to make something do this

ex.en: As he thought it over, his anger gradually dissipated.
ex.cn: 他想明白后，怒气就渐渐消了。

ex.en: Little by little, the smoke was dissipated by the breeze.
ex.cn: 在微风的吹拂下烟雾渐渐地消散了。

syn: vt. 浪费；使…消散：lose, spend
vi. 驱散；放荡：to break up, sow one's wild oats

t: v. 使液化，融化；使解散
en: if a solid dissolves, or if you dissolve it, it mixes with a liquid and becomes part of it

ex.en: Stir until the sugar dissolves.
ex.cn: 一直搅拌到糖溶解掉。

syn: vt. 使溶解；使分解；使液化：hemolyze, haemolyze
vi. 溶解；解散；消失：melt, disappear
rm: dis(分开) + solve(解决) → 分开解决 → 溶解； 解散

en: to swell or make something swell because of pressure from inside

ex.en: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas.
ex.cn: 通过此切口，二氧化碳气体把胸腔充得肿胀起来。

syn: vi. 扩张；膨胀：fill, swell with

en: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.

ex.en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987.
ex.cn: 这瓶威士忌是1926年被蒸馏的，存放至1987年酿造成熟。

syn: vi. 蒸馏；提炼；渗出：still, try out
vt. 蒸馏；提取…的精华；使渗出：still, fine-still

t: adj. 不同的，清楚的，独特的
en: clearly different or belonging to a different type

ex.en: two entirely distinct languages
ex.cn: 两种完全不同的语言

syn: adj. 明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的：obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
rm: di + stinct(刺) → 刺眼的 → 明显的

t: n. 差别，区分；卓著，荣誉
en: a clear difference or separation between two similar things

ex.en: Eliot’s distinction as a poet
ex.cn: 艾略特作为诗人的杰出才能

ph.cn: 以优异成绩，以杰出的表现

syn: n. 区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章：quality, identity, character, tang, discrimination

en: to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people

ex.en: Could he distinguish right from wrong?
ex.cn: 他能辨别是非吗？

syn: vt. 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出：tell apart, differentiate
vi. 区别，区分；辨别：differentiate, tell from
rm: di(分开) + sting(刺) + uish → 将刺挑出来 → 区别， 辨别

en: to report something in a way that is not completely true or correct

ex.en: His account was badly distorted by the press.
ex.cn: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

syn: vt. 扭曲；使失真；曲解：contort, misinterpret
vi. 扭曲；变形：become deformed, to morph
rm: dis(分开) + tort(卷缠) → 扭曲

en: to take someone’s attention away from something by making them look at or listen to something else

ex.en: Try not to distract the other students.
ex.cn: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

syn: vt. 转移；分心：shift, divert from
rm: dis(分开) + tract(拉) → (注意力)被拉开 → 使分心

t: n. 消遣，娱乐，精神涣散
en: a pleasant activity
syn: n. 注意力分散；消遣；心烦意乱：entertainment, occupation, recreation, relaxation

t: n&vt. 悲痛，忧伤；贫苦；危难
en: a feeling of extreme unhappiness

ex.en: Luke’s behaviour caused his parents great distress.
ex.cn: 卢克的行为使他的父母深感忧虑。

ph.cn: 财务困境，财务危机；金融困顿

ex.cn: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

ex.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
ex.cn: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

ex.cn: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

vi. 打扰；妨碍：intrude upon, hinder from

ex.en: There were disturbances in the crowd as fans left the stadium.
ex.cn: 球迷离开体育场时，人群中发生了骚乱。

ex.en: army training on controlling civil disturbance
ex.cn: 控制平民骚乱的军事训练

syn: n. [通信][电子]干扰；骚乱；忧虑：interference, care, obstacle, disorder, worries
rm: dis(分开) + turb(晃动， 搅动) + ance → 扰乱， 打扰

t: n. 排水沟，沟渠；v. 附入沟中，抛弃
en: a long narrow hole dug at the side of a field, road etc to hold or remove unwanted water

ex.en: Both vehicles ended up in a ditch.
ex.cn: 两辆车都掉进了沟里。

syn: vt. 在…上掘沟；把…开入沟里；丢弃：reject, slough off
vi. 开沟；掘沟：furrow

en: very different from each other

ex.en: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
ex.cn: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

syn: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的：different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
rm: di(分离) + vers(转) + e → 转开 → 不同的， 多样的

en: a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it

ex.en: A slight diversion in the road is causing major headaches for businesses along El Camino Real.
ex.cn: 马路上的一小段绕行道让国王大道沿街的商家十分头疼。

syn: n. 转移；消遣；分散注意力：entertainment, transfer, occupation, recreation, metastasis
rm: di(分离) + vers(转) + ion → 转向， 转移， 转换

en: to change the direction in which something travels

ex.en: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
ex.cn: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

syn: vt. 转移；使…欢娱；使…转向：shift, distract from
vi. 转移：transfer, metastasize
rm: di(分离) + vert(转) → 转移

en: something that is edible can be eaten

ex.en: These berries are edible, but those are poisonous.
ex.cn: 这些浆果可以吃，但那些有毒。

syn: adj. 可食用的：touchable
n. 食品；食物：diet, eating
rm: ed(吃) + ible(可…的) → 可食用的

en: to prepare a book, piece of film etc for printing or broadcasting by removing mistakes or parts that are not acceptable

ex.en: The newspaper edits letters before printing them.
ex.cn: 这家报社刊登读者来信前先作校订。

syn: vt. [计]编辑；校订：copy-edit, redact

en: the form that a book, newspaper, magazine etc is produced in

ex.en: a paperback edition
ex.cn: 平装本

ex.cn: 《嘉人》杂志的美国版

syn: n. [图情]版本：version

t: n. 社论；adj. 编辑的，编者的

ex.en: In an editorial, The New York Times suggests the victory could turn nasty.
ex.cn: 在一篇社论中，《纽约时报》认为该胜利会转成恶梦。

syn: adj. 编辑的；社论的：compilatory

t: adj. 能胜任的，效率高的
en: if someone or something is efficient, they work well without wasting time, money, or energy

ex.en: a very efficient secretary
ex.cn: 效率高的秘书

ex.en: an efficient use of land
ex.cn: 土地的有效使用

syn: adj. 有效率的；有能力的；生效的：able, competent
rm: ef(出) + fic(做) + ient → 能做出来的 → 有能力的； 有效的

t: n. 自我，自己，个人思考和感觉能力
en: the opinion that you have about yourself

ex.en: That promotion really boosted her ego (= made her feel better about herself ).
ex.cn: 那次晋升确实增强了她的自信心。

ex.en: I need someone to massage my bruised ego (= when you feel less confident than before ).
ex.cn: 我需要有人来安抚我受挫的自信心。

ph.cn: n. 密友；个性的另一面；至交

syn: n. [心理]自我；自负；自我意识：me, self

en: to make someone leave a place or building by using force

ex.en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
ex.cn: 官员们用护卫犬驱走抗议者。

rm: e(出) + ject(扔) → 扔出来 → 驱逐， 逐出

t: adj. 复杂的；详尽的；v. 做详细说明

ex.en: pure silks embroidered with elaborate patterns
ex.cn: 绣有精美图案的真丝衣服

vt. 精心制作；详细阐述；从简单成分合成（复杂有机物）：tailor-make

en: if a particular period of time elapses, it passes

ex.en: Several months elapsed before his case was brought to trial.
ex.cn: 过了几个月他的案子才开审。

ex.en: The assignment must be completed within an overall elapsed time of one week.
ex.cn: 这项任务总的时限为一周，必须按时完成。

syn: vi. 消逝；时间过去：ebb away
n. 流逝；时间的过去：passing, effluxion

t: adj. 弹性的，有伸缩性的；n. 橡皮圈
en: a material that is elastic can stretch and then go back to its usual length or size

syn: adj. [力]有弹性的；灵活的；易伸缩的：flexible, stretchy

en: extremely happy and excited, especially because of something that has happened or is going to happen

ex.en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
ex.cn: 他感到欢欣鼓舞，而且喝得有点醉了。

syn: adj. 兴高采烈的；得意洋洋的：high-blown, rapturous

t: n. 肘；衣服肘部；v. 用肘推、挤

ex.cn: 他滑倒了，严重挫伤了一只胳膊肘。

ph.cn: 肘部发炎；网球运动员常见的肘伤

syn: n. 肘部；弯头；扶手：rail, rider
vt. 推挤；用手肘推开：thrust, push against
rm: 力在肘(elbow)， 弓(bow)在手

en: people who are old

ex.en: a retirement village for the elderly
ex.cn: 供老人退休后居住的村子

ph.cn: 共享颐年优先配屋计划

syn: adj. 上了年纪的；过了中年的；稍老的：oldish

en: relating to electricity

ex.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
ex.cn: 大火是电力故障引起的。

ex.cn: 电力[电气]工程师

ph.cn: 电气设备；电力设备；电器设备

en: someone whose job is to connect or repair electrical wires or equipment

ex.en: I've heard an electrician got hurt when he hiked.
ex.cn: 我听说有个电工在高空检修电线时摔伤了。

syn: n. 电工；电气技师：wireman, electrochemical engineering

t: adj. 电子的，用电子操纵的

ex.en: electronic games
ex.cn: 电子游戏

ex.en: an electronic organizer (= a small piece of electronic equipment that you can use to record addresses, phone numbers etc )
ex.cn: 电子记事本

rm: 来自electric(a. 电的)

en: the study or industry of making equipment, such as computers and televisions, that work electronically

ex.en: an electronics engineer
ex.cn: 电子工程师

ph.cn: 消费性电子产品；家用电子产品
电力电子学；动力电子设备

syn: n. [电子]电子学；电子工业：electronic industry
rm: 来自electric(a. 电的)

en: beautiful, attractive, or graceful

ex.en: a tall, elegant young woman
ex.cn: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

ex.en: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
ex.cn: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

syn: adj. 高雅的，优雅的；讲究的：graceful, exquisite

en: simple or basic

ex.en: the elementary principles of justice and democracy
ex.cn: 正义和民主的基本信条

ex.en: You’ve made a very elementary mistake.
ex.cn: 你犯了一个非常基本的错误。

ph.cn: n. 初等教育，基本教育（指小学）

syn: adj. 基本的；初级的；[化学]元素的：basic, fundamental, essential, primary, first

en: to lift someone or something to a higher position

ex.en: Gradually elevate the patient into anupright position.
ex.cn: 把病人慢慢托到直立的位置。

en: existing or popular for only a short time

ex.en: Fashion is by nature ephemeral.
ex.cn: 从本质上说，时尚不过是一时的潮流。

syn: adj. 短暂的；朝生暮死的：brief, little, transient, passing

ph.cn: 防疫；疫病防治；流行病预防

syn: adj. [医]流行的；传染性的：popular, fashionable, going, ruling, pop
n. 传染病；流行病；风尚等的流行：infection, infectious disease

ex.en: Watch next week’s thrilling episode!
ex.cn: 请收看下周精彩的一集！

en: a period of history

ex.en: the Victorian epoch
ex.cn: 维多利亚时代

ex.en: The king’s death marked the end of an epoch.
ex.cn: 这位国王的去世标志着一个时代的结束。
