en: to be exactly the same in size, number, or amount as something else

ex.en: Two plus two equals four.
ex.cn: 二加二等于四。

ex.en: Prices become more stable when supply equals demand.
ex.cn: 供需相当时价格就变得较为稳定。

ph.cn: 在其他条件都相同的情况下

syn: adj. [数]平等的；相等的；胜任的：competent, adequate, equivalent, even
vt. 等于；比得上：be equivalent to, bear comparison with

ex.en: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
ex.cn: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

syn: n. [数]方程式，等式；相等；[化学]反应式：eqs, equivalence

en: an imaginary line drawn around the middle of the Earth that is exactly the same distance from the North Pole and the South Pole

ex.en: The United States is north of the equator.
ex.cn: 美国位于赤道以北。

ex.en: In the hot zone near the equator the sun heats the air continually; hence the air there ascends.
ex.cn: 在靠近赤道的热带地区，太阳不断地加热那里的空气，于是那里的热空气就上升。

ex.en: The government is anxious not to upset the economic equilibrium.
ex.cn: 政府急切希望不要打乱经济平衡。

ex.cn: 所供应食品的合理分配

ex.cn: 以公平、正义为原则的社会

ex.en: The word has no equivalent in English.
ex.cn: 这个单词在英语中没有对应词。

ph.cn: 等效应力；折算应力；相当应力

n. [物价][化学]等价物，相等物：countertype, quid pro quo
rm: equi(相等) + val(力量) + ent → 力量相等的 → 相等的， 等量的

en: if you are equivocal, you are deliberately unclear in the way that you give information or your opinion

ex.en: His answer was equivocal.
ex.cn: 他的回答模棱两可。

ex.en: She was rather equivocal about her work.
ex.cn: 她谈到她的工作时有点含糊其词。

syn: adj. 模棱两可的；可疑的：suspicious, doubtful

ex.en: an attempt to eradicate inflation
ex.cn: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

ex.cn: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

syn: vt. 根除，根绝；消灭：destroy, root out

en: to remove writing from paper

ex.en: Some of the names had been accidentally erased.
ex.cn: 有几个名字无意中被擦掉了。

en: to build something such as a building or wall

ex.en: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
ex.cn: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

ex.en: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
ex.cn: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

syn: vt. 使竖立；建造；安装：construct, fit, fix, structure, frame
adj. 竖立的；笔直的；因性刺激而勃起的：straight, upright

en: the process by which rock or soil is gradually destroyed by wind, rain, or the sea

ex.en: the problem of soil erosion
ex.cn: 水土流失的问题

ex.en: the erosion of the coastline
ex.cn: 海岸线受到的侵蚀

ph.cn: n. 水土流失；土壤侵蚀；土壤流失；泥土流失

syn: n. 侵蚀，[化学]腐蚀：corrosion, eating away

ex.cn: 大家都忍受着死亡的痛苦被迫地抢着做一些令人难以理解的差事。

ex.en: They can view a list of errands that match their interest profile, and, by entering a price, can bid to perform the errand.
ex.cn: 他们可以查看与他们的兴趣简档匹配的差事列表，并且，通过输入价格，可以为执行差事投标。

ph.cn: 徒劳的奔波；徒劳无功的工作

syn: n. 使命；差事；差使：mission, message

t: adj. 古怪的，反复无常的，不稳定的
en: something that is erratic does not follow any pattern or plan but happens in a way that is not regular

ex.en: His breathing was becoming erratic.
ex.cn: 他的呼吸越来越不均匀。

ex.en: his erratic behaviour
ex.cn: 他难以捉摸的行为

syn: adj. 不稳定的；古怪的：unstable, odd, volatile, curious
n. 漂泊无定的人；古怪的人：fantastic, weirdo

en: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct

ex.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
ex.cn: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

syn: adj. 错误的；不正确的：false, wrong, improper, incorrect, inaccurate
rm: err(徘徊) + oneous → 在正确事物旁边徘徊 → 错误的， 不正确的

en: if fighting, violence, noise etc erupts, it starts suddenly

ex.en: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
ex.cn: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

ex.en: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
ex.cn: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

syn: vi. 爆发；喷出；发疹；长牙：out break, blow up
vt. 爆发；喷出：out break, blow up

en: if fighting, violence, or a bad situation escalates, or if someone escalates it, it becomes much worse

ex.en: The fighting on the border is escalating.
ex.cn: 边境地区的战事在不断升级。

ex.en: We do not want to escalate the war.
ex.cn: 我们不想让战争升级。

rm: 来自Escalator， 原来是自动电梯的商标， 后来才出现了动词escalate

en: a set of moving stairs that take people to different levels in a building

ex.en: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
ex.cn: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

t: n. 护卫者；护航舰；v. 护送，护卫
en: a person or a group of people or vehicles that go with someone in order to protect or guard them

ex.en: a police escort
ex.cn: 警察护卫队

syn: n. 陪同；护航舰；护卫队；护送者：guard

ex.cn: 穹顶表面铺了瓦片。

n. 外部；表面；外型；外貌：aspect, without, colour
rm: 金玉其外(exterior)， 败絮其中(interior)

ex.en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
ex.cn: 员工用毒药来消灭鼹鼠和野兔。

syn: vt. 消灭；根除：destroy, kill off

en: relating to the outside of something or of a person’s body

ex.en: the external appearance of the building
ex.cn: 大楼的外观

n. 外部；外观；外面：outside, without, surface, face, garment
rm: ex(外) + ternal → 外面的

t: adj. 消灭了的，熄灭了的，绝种的
en: an extinct type of animal or plant does not exist any more

ex.en: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
ex.cn: 恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。

ex.en: Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
ex.cn: 熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。

syn: vt. 使熄灭：out

en: to make a fire or light stop burning or shining

ex.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes.
ex.cn: 请把香烟都熄灭了。

ex.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
ex.cn: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

en: to illegally force someone to give you something, especially money, by threatening them

ex.en: Corrupt government officials were extorting money from him.
ex.cn: 腐败的政府官员那时正向他勒索钱财。

syn: vt. 敲诈；侵占；强求；牵强地引出：exact, shark up

t: a&ad&n. 额外的/地，非常，另外；额外的人

ex.en: There are no hidden extras.
ex.cn: 没有任何隐蔽的额外费用。

ex.cn: 他先前对爵士乐、流行乐和非洲音乐旋律的融合已经证明是非常成功的。

ph.cn: n. 核聚变；[物]核子融合

syn: n. 融合；[物]熔化；熔接；融合物：melt, amalgamation
rm: fus(流) + ion → 流到一起 → 熔合

t: n. 大惊，小怪；v. 忙乱，使烦躁
en: anxious behaviour or activity that is usually about unimportant things

ex.en: James said he’d better be getting back or there’d be a fuss .
ex.cn: 詹姆斯说他最好回来，否则就会有人小题大做了。

ex.en: The Steamatic enables you to clean any carpet with the minimum of fuss .
ex.cn: 蒸汽清洁器可以让你轻轻松松地清洁地毯。

ph.cn: 大惊小怪，小题大做；吵吵闹闹
焦虑；过分关心，过分体贴

syn: vi. 小题大作；忙乱；焦燥；焦急；无事自扰：make a big deal out of, break a butterfly on the wheel
n. 大惊小怪，大惊小怪的人；小题大作；忙乱：alarmism, hoo-ha

en: in a happy way

ex.en: ‘Morning, Albert,’ she called gaily.
ex.cn: “早安，艾伯特。”她快乐地喊道。

syn: adv. 华丽地；欢乐地：splendidly, bravely

en: one of the large groups of stars that make up the universe

ex.en: Astronomers have discovered a distant galaxy.
ex.cn: 天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

ph.cn: n. 中国银河证券有限责任公司
n. 螺旋星云（等于spiral nebula）

syn: n. 银河；[天]星系；银河系；一群显赫的人：the Milky Way

t: n&v. 眩目地照射，闪耀，瞪视
en: to look angrily at someone for a long time

ex.en: She gave him a hostile glare.
ex.cn: 她狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

syn: n. 刺眼；[光]耀眼的光；受公众注目：dazzle

t: n&vi. 微光，闪光，短暂而微弱的闪现
en: to shine softly

ex.en: His teeth gleamed under his moustache.
ex.cn: 他的八字须下面，牙齿晶莹发亮。

syn: n. 微光；闪光；瞬息的一现：glimmer, stroboflash
vi. 闪烁；隐约地闪现：spark, coruscate

en: to move smoothly and quietly, as if without effort

ex.en: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
ex.cn: 侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

syn: n. 滑翔；滑行；滑移；滑音：slippage, portamento
vt. 滑翔；滑行；悄悄地走；消逝：ebb away
rm: 和slide(n./v. 滑动)一起记

en: a light that is not very bright

ex.en: a weak glimmering light
ex.cn: 微弱的闪光

syn: n. 微光；闪光；少许：little, touch
vi. 闪烁；发微光：spark, coruscate

en: a quick look at someone or something that does not allow you to see them clearly

ex.en: I glimpsed a figure at the window.
ex.cn: 我瞥见窗前有个身影。

syn: n. 一瞥，一看：glance, dekko
vi. 瞥见：catch sight of
rm: glim(灯光) + pse → 像灯光一闪 → 一瞥

en: to shine brightly with flashing points of light

ex.en: The river glittered in the sunlight.
ex.cn: 阳光下河面波光粼粼。

syn: vi. [光]闪光；闪烁：flare light, lightning flash
n. [光]闪光；灿烂：stroboflash, coruscation
rm: g + litter(看作little， 小) → 一闪一闪小星星 → 闪光

t: n. 全世界的，全球的；综合的
syn: adj. 全球的；总体的；球形的：spherical, ball-shaped
rm: glob(球体) + al → 全球的， 全世界的

en: sad because you think the situation will not improve

ex.en: Anne dismissed these gloomy thoughts from her mind.
ex.cn: 安妮抛开了心里这些沮丧的念头。

syn: adj. 黑暗的；沮丧的；阴郁的：dark, sad, blue, gray, disappointed

t: adj. 辉煌的；壮丽的，光荣的
en: having or deserving great fame, praise, and honour

ex.en: a truly glorious future
ex.cn: 无比美好的将来

ex.en: a glorious victory
ex.cn: 光荣的胜利

syn: adj. 光荣的；辉煌的；极好的：wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
rm: “哥劳累死” → 劳累致死， 荣誉来之不易 → 光荣的

t: n. 光泽，光滑；虚饰；注释；v. 加光泽于
en: a bright shine on a surface

ex.en: This gel will add gloss to even the dullest hair.
ex.cn: 用了这种发胶，即使最干枯的头发也会增添光泽。

ph.cn: v. 掩盖，掩饰；给以光滑的表面

syn: n. 光彩；注释；假象：notes, splendor
vt. 使光彩；掩盖；注释：cover up, screen from

en: a list of special words and explanations of their meanings, often at the end of a book

ex.en: A glossary of terms is included for the reader's convenience.
ex.cn: 为了方便读者，还收录了术语汇编。

t: n. 光辉；v. 发白热光；脸发红发热
en: a soft steady light

ex.en: She had a healthy glow in her cheeks.
ex.cn: 她脸上泛着健康的红晕。

ph.cn: 预热塞，电热塞；热线点火塞

syn: vi. 发热；洋溢；绚丽夺目：burn, fever heat
n. 灼热；色彩鲜艳；兴高采烈：calorescence, ardor

t: n. 胶水，胶；v. 粘贴，紧贴
en: a sticky substance used for joining things together

ex.en: ...a tube of glue.
ex.cn: …一管胶水。

syn: vt. 粘合；似胶般固着于：conglutinate
rm: 用胶水(glue)把那幅蓝色的(blue)画贴上

en: a man

ex.en: Dave’s a nice guy when you get to know him.
ex.cn: 戴夫是个好人，你了解他后就知道了。

ex.en: Jake’s a real tough guy.
ex.cn: 杰克是个很厉害的家伙。

ph.cn: 好家伙（电影鬼娃新娘中的玩偶）

syn: n. 男人，家伙：boy, apple, customer, he, man
vt. 嘲弄，取笑：poke fun at, monkey

en: a  gym

ex.en: The next day, the arsonist was arrested at a gymnasium.
ex.cn: 第二天，纵火犯在一家体育馆被逮捕了。

ex.en: After computer printers and duffle bags had been carried to dorm rooms, everyone gathered in the gymnasium, students on one side of the bleachers, parents on the other.
ex.cn: 电脑打印机和行李包都运进了宿舍之后，所有人都到学校的体育馆集合，学生在露天看台的一侧，家长们在另一侧。

syn: n. 体育馆；健身房：gym, sports palace

t: n&v. (下)冰雹；(冰雹般)一阵，落下
en: frozen raindrops which fall as hard balls of ice

ex.en: heavy showers of rain and hail
ex.cn: 夹着冰雹的阵阵大雨

syn: n. [气象]冰雹；致敬；招呼；一阵：precipitation, blast
int. 万岁；欢迎：welcome, rah

t: n&v. (途中)暂停，停止，终止；v. 犹豫
en: a stop or pause

ex.en: Heavy snowfalls brought traffic to a halt (= made it stop moving ).
ex.cn: 大雪使得交通陷于停顿。

ex.en: The World Championship was brought to a temporary halt (= was stopped from continuing ).
ex.cn: 世界锦标赛暂停举行。

ph.cn: 系统中止；系统停止；系统挂起；死机

syn: vi. 停止；立定；踌躇，犹豫：desist from, come to a stop
n. 停止；立定；休息：break, stop, rest, stay, stand
rm: h + alt(高音) → 高处不胜寒， 该停下来了 → 停住

en: to make it difficult for someone to do something

ex.en: She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
ex.cn: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

ex.en: An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
ex.cn: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

syn: vt. 妨碍；束缚；使困累：let, chain, bound
n. 食盒，食篮；阻碍物：hindrance, incumbrance
rm: 篮子(hamper)在左手， 锤子(hammer)在右手

t: n. 手；掌握；责任；人手；指针；v. 传递
en: the part of your body at the end of your arm, including your fingers and thumb, that you use to hold things

ex.en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

ex.en: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
ex.cn: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

ph.cn: adv. 在手头；在进行中；在控制中

syn: n. [解剖]手，手艺；帮助；指针；插手：assistance, craft, aid, index, finger
vt. 传递，交给；支持；搀扶：encourage, carry, second, back, transfer

en: a short book that gives information or instructions about something

ex.en: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook
ex.cn: 《小说写作手册》

syn: n. [图情]手册；指南：manual, guide, notebook

t: v. 妨碍；n. 障碍，残废
en: to make it difficult for someone to do something that they want or need to do

ex.en: The charity is handicapped by lack of funds.
ex.cn: 这个慈善机构因为缺乏资金难以开展工作。

syn: n. 障碍；不利条件，不利的因素：obstacle, let, bar, dam, disadvantage
vt. 妨碍，阻碍；使不利：let, slow

en: an animal, object, or building that is handsome looks attractive in an impressive way

ex.en: a row of handsome Georgian houses
ex.cn: 一排宏伟的乔治王朝时期的房子

syn: adj. （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的：generous, liberal

en: to kill someone by dropping them with a rope around their neck, or to die in this way, especially as a punishment for a serious crime

ex.en: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
ex.cn: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

ph.cn: 坚持下去；不挂断；握住不放

syn: vt. 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决：paint, swing from
vi. 悬着，垂下；被绞死；悬而不决：trail
n. 大屠杀；毁灭：destruction, death

t: n. 在当地居民家居住

ex.en: You could live in a homestay.
ex.cn: 也可以住在当地人家中。

en: consisting of people or things that are all of the same type

ex.en: a homogeneous society
ex.cn: 同种族人组成的社会

syn: adj. [化学]均匀的；[数]齐次的；[生物]同种的：conspecific
rm: homo(同类的) + gene(基因) + ous → 相同基因的 → 同种类的

en: to move by jumping on one foot

ex.en: a little girl hopping and skipping
ex.cn: 一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩

ph.cn: n. 嘻哈文化（由快板歌、涂墙艺术、霹雳舞等构成的亚文化）

syn: vt. [计][通信]跳跃；跳过：jump, clear
n. [计][通信]跳跃；舞会；短途旅行：jump, ball, dance, spring

en: the line far away where the land or sea seems to meet the sky

ex.en: In the distance, the dot of a boat appeared on the horizon.
ex.cn: 远处小黑点般的一条小船出现在地平线上。

ph.cn: 在地平线上；即将来临的
即将来临，已露端倪；地平以上

syn: n. [天]地平线；视野；眼界；范围：extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, area
rm: ho + riz(音似： rise“升起”) + on → 太阳从地平线上升起 → 地平线

t: adj. 可怕的，恐怖的；讨厌的
en: very bad - used, for example, about things you see, taste, or smell, or about the weather

ex.en: The weather has been really horrible all week.
ex.cn: 整个星期天气都很糟。

ex.en: a horrible smell
ex.cn: 极难闻的气味

syn: adj. 可怕的；极讨厌的：terrible, awesome, fearful, dire, dreadful

en: the practice or science of growing flowers, fruit, and vegetables

ex.en: The area has a long tradition of horticulture.
ex.cn: 园艺是这个地区源远流长的传统。

ex.en: Thus, to earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
ex.cn: 因此，为了赚取植物科学奖章，一个童子军可以选择农学，园艺，或田野植物学。

syn: n. [园艺]园艺，园艺学：gardening

t: n. 输水软管；长统袜；v. 浇园子，用管冲洗
en: A hose is a pipe made of rubber or plastic, along which a liquid or gas flows, for example from one part of an engine to another

ex.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
ex.cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

ph.cn: 金属软管；柔性管；金属蛇形管

syn: n. [橡胶]软管；长统袜；男性穿的紧身裤：flexible pipe, flexible conduit
vt. 用软管浇水；痛打：light into, belabour
rm: 要想玫瑰花(rose)开， 需把软管(hose)拿来浇水

en: friendly behaviour towards visitors

ex.en: Thanks for your hospitality over the past few weeks.
ex.cn: 感谢你几周来的热情款待。

syn: n. 好客；殷勤：complaisance, gallantry

t: n. 主人; 许多，一大群，旅店老板
en: someone at a party, meal etc who has invited the guests and who provides the food, drink etc

ex.en: Our host greeted us at the door.
ex.cn: 主人在门口迎接我们。

ph.cn: n. 主办城市；举办城市

syn: n. [计]主机；主人；主持人；许多：lots of, sea, hundred, master, thousands of
vt. 主持；当主人招待：to chair, preside over

en: someone who is kept as a prisoner by an enemy so that the other side will do what the enemy demands

ex.en: The group are holding two tourists hostage (= keeping them as hostages ) .
ex.cn: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

ex.en: a family taken hostage at gunpoint
ex.cn: 在枪口下被劫为人质的一家人

syn: n. 人质；抵押品：guarantee, pledge

t: adj. 敌对的，敌方的，不友好的
en: angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them

ex.en: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
ex.cn: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

ex.en: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
ex.cn: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

syn: adj. 敌对的，敌方的；怀敌意的：adverse, enemy, opposed
n. 敌对：opposition, antagonism
rm: host(主人) + ile → 鸿门宴的主人 → 不友善的

t: n. 猎狗；卑鄙的人；v. 用猎狗追，追逐
en: a dog that is fast and has a good sense of smell, used for hunting

ex.en: A troubled hound was baying the moon.
ex.cn: 一条受惊不安的猎狗正在对月狂吠。

ex.en: Our fox and hound find their long friendship thoroughly obliterated and end up trying to kill each other.
ex.cn: 我们的狐狸和猎狗发现他们的老交情彻底被毁了，最后居然要杀死对方。

syn: vt. 追猎；烦扰；激励：stimulate, eat, burden, power
n. 猎犬；卑劣的人：hunter, gundog

t: v. (鸟)盘旋，翱翔，(人)逗留在附近徘徊
en: If you hover, you stay in one place and move slightly in a nervous way, for example because you cannot decide what to do

ex.en: Judith was hovering in the doorway.
ex.cn: 朱迪丝在门口徘徊。

syn: vi. 盘旋，翱翔；徘徊：plane, orbit
n. 徘徊；盘旋；犹豫：vibration, spinning around
rm: 爱人(lover)在自己身边徘徊(hover)

en: if a dog,  wolf  , or other animal howls, it makes a long loud sound

ex.en: The dogs howled all night.
ex.cn: 那些狗整夜嘷叫。

syn: vi. 咆哮；怒吼；狂吠：gnar, huff and puff
n. 嗥叫；怒号；嚎哭：bluster

t: adj. 去不掉的，擦不掉的
en: impossible to remove or forget

ex.en: Her words left an indelible impression on me for years to come.
ex.cn: 她的话多年来我都难以忘怀。

syn: adj. 难忘的；擦不掉的：unforgettable, memorable

en: protection against loss or damage, especially in the form of a promise to pay for any losses or damage

ex.en: insurance providing indemnity against future liabilities
ex.cn: 对将来的债务提供保障的保险

syn: n. 补偿，[经]赔偿；保障；赔偿物：compensation, satisfaction, offset

en: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be

ex.en: His action is indicative of growing concern about the shortage of skilled labour.
ex.cn: 他的行为显示对于熟练工人短缺现象的日益关注。

syn: adj. 象征的；指示的；表示…的：symbolic, emblematic

en: something that can be regarded as a sign of something else

ex.en: All the main economic indicators suggest that trade is improving.
ex.cn: 所有主要的经济指标都表明贸易情况正在改善。

syn: n. [微][试剂][计][电][电子][机]指示器；指示剂；指示符；压力计：pointer, viewer

t: adj. 不感兴趣的，不关心的，质量不高的
en: not at all interested in someone or something

ex.en: an indifferent cook
ex.cn: 手艺平平的厨师

syn: adj. 漠不关心的；无关紧要的；中性的，中立的：neutral, insignificant

t: adj. 土生土长的，本土的
en: indigenous people or things have always been in the place where they are, rather than being brought there from somewhere else

ex.en: the many indigenous cultures which existed in Siberia
ex.cn: 存在于西伯利亚的许多当地文化

ph.cn: 本地知识；乡土知识；土著知识

syn: adj. 本土的；土著的；国产的；固有的：native, inherent, mainland, intrinsic
rm: indi(内部) + gen(产生) + ous → 内部产生的 → 本地的

en: angry and surprised because you feel insulted or unfairly treated

ex.en: an indignant reply
ex.cn: 愤慨的回复

syn: adj. 愤愤不平的；义愤的：aggrieved

t: adj. 必不可少的，必需的
en: someone or something that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them

ex.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives.
ex.cn: 移动电话已经成为我们生活中的必需品。

syn: adj. 不可缺少的；绝对必要的；责无旁贷的：obbligato
rm: in(不) + dispensable(可有可无的) → 不是可有可无的 → 必不可少的， 必需的

t: adj. 个人的，个别的；个体的；n. 个人，个体
en: considered separately from other people or things in the same group

ex.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
ex.cn: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

ex.en: the needs of the individual customer
ex.cn: 每位顾客的需求

syn: adj. [经]个人的；个别的；独特的：personal, different, subjective, distinct, unique
n. [经]个人，[生物]个体：unity, private person
rm: in + divid(e)(分割) + ual → 分割开的 → 个别的， 单独的

en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it

ex.en: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
ex.cn: 医生们说手术可能导致心脏病。

syn: vt. 诱导；引起；引诱；感应：attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
rm: in(内) + duc(拉) + e → 向内拉 → 引诱； 引起

en: to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them

ex.en: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
ex.cn: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。

syn: vt. 满足；纵容；使高兴；使沉迷于…：meet, fulfill, fill, please, baby
vi. 沉溺；满足；放任：luxuriate, to satisfy
rm: in + dulg(屈服， 让步) + e → 屈服于欲望 → 满足(欲望等)； 放纵

syn: adj. 笨拙的；不适当的：inadequate, unhappy, wrong, clumsy, awkward

t: adj. 无活动能力的；惰性的
en: not producing a chemical reaction when combined with other substances

ex.en: inert gases
ex.cn: 惰性气体

syn: adj. [化学]惰性的；呆滞的；迟缓的；无效的：noble, useless

en: the force that keeps an object in the same position or keeps it moving until it is moved or stopped by another force

ex.en: political inertia
ex.cn: 政治上的保守

ph.cn: 热惰性；热惯性（温升速率的倒数）；热惯量

syn: n. [力]惯性；[化学]惰性，迟钝；不活动：nonreactivity, inaction

t: adj. 不可避免的，照例必有的
en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid

ex.en: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
ex.cn: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

syn: adj. 必然的，不可避免的：certain, necessary, automatic
rm: in(不) + evitable(可避免的) → 不可避免的

en: a baby or very young child

ex.en: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.
ex.cn: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

ph.cn: 婴儿配方；婴儿配方食品
婴儿死亡率，早期失效；早期故障期

syn: n. 婴儿；幼儿；未成年人：baby, minor
adj. 婴儿的；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的：earlier, young, baby, minor, tender

t: v. 传染，受影响，受感染
en: to give someone a disease

ex.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
ex.cn: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

syn: vt. [医]感染，传染：affect, contract, catch, disease, communicate

en: an infectious illness can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air you breathe

ex.en: infectious diseases
ex.cn: 传染性疾病

ex.en: Flu is highly infectious.
ex.cn: 流感传染性很强。

syn: adj. [内科]传染的；传染性的；易传染的：catching, epidemic

en: something that you think is true, based on information that you have

ex.en: There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
ex.cn: 从她的来信可以得到两种推论。

syn: n. 推理；推论；[数]推断：conclusion, reasoning, consequence
rm: 从这些参考书(reference)里， 你能推断(inference)出什么？

t: n. 地位(能力)低的人；adj. 劣质的,差的,下等的"
en: not good, or not as good as someone or something else

ex.en: It was a gentleman's duty always to be civil, even to his inferiors.
ex.cn: 一个绅士的责任是一直保持彬彬有礼，即使是对比自己地位低的人。

syn: adj. 差的；自卑的；[植]下级的，下等的：junior, lower
n. 下级；次品：lessness, subordinate

t: v. 大批出动，成群出现(鼠类及害虫)
en: if insects, rats etc infest a place, there are a lot of them and they usually cause damage

ex.en: ...pests like aphids which infest cereal crops.
ex.cn: …像蚜虫那样大肆侵害谷类作物的害虫。

syn: vt. 骚扰；寄生于；大批出没；大批滋生：harry, ply with

en: without limits in space or time

ex.en: The universe is infinite.
ex.cn: 宇宙是无限的。

syn: adj. 无限的，[数]无穷的；无数的；极大的：huge, tremendous, thousand, million, boundless
n. 无限；[数]无穷大；无限的东西（如空间，时间）：Mugen, immenseness

en: a hospital – often used in the names of hospitals in Britain

ex.en: All they need now are the keys to the infirmary.
ex.cn: 现在所需要的就是医务室的门钥匙。

ex.en: A smile creeps onto his face as he realizes that he’s in the infirmary.
ex.cn: 一丝笑容爬上他的脸上，他意识到自己身处于医务室中。

syn: n. 医务室；医院；养老院：hospital, old people's home

t: adj. 无效的，作废的；n. 病人，病弱者；adj. 病弱的
en: a contract, ticket, claim etc that is invalid is not legally or officially acceptable

ex.en: Without the right date stamped on it, your ticket will be invalid.
ex.cn: 票上若没有加盖正确日期就是废票。

syn: adj. 无效的；有病的；残废的：useless, disabled, ineffective
n. 病人；[医]残废者：sick, patient
rm: in(无) + val(价值) + id → 无价值的 → 无效的， 作废的

t: adj. 无价的, 无法估价的 "

ex.en: The internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.cn: 因特网是十分有价值的信息来源。

syn: adj. 无价的；非常贵重的：inestimable, impayable
rm: in(无) + valuable(有价值的) → 无价的

en: if something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is true

ex.en: It invariably rains when I go there.
ex.cn: 我每次去那儿都下雨。

ex.en: The security guards were invariably ex-servicemen.
ex.cn: 保安人员毫无例外地都是退伍军人。

syn: adv. 总是；不变地；一定地：always, toujours

t: n. 详细目录，存货清单；存货盘存
en: a list of all the things in a place

ex.en: ...one inventory of twelve sails for each yacht.
ex.cn: …为每艘游艇配备12张帆的存货。

ph.cn: 实地清点盘存；编制...清单

syn: n. [贸易]存货，存货清单；详细目录；[会计]财产清册：goods in stock, stock-sheet
rm: in + vent(来) + ory(表物) → 有关所有进来的货物的 → 目录； 存货

en: to put something in the opposite position to the one it was in before, especially by turning it upside down (= the bottom is on the top and the top is on the bottom )

ex.en: Invert the cake onto a serving plate.
ex.cn: 把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

en: to buy shares, property, or goods because you hope that the value will increase and you can make a profit

ex.en: I’ve got a few thousand dollars I’m looking to invest.
ex.cn: 我有几千美元想作投资。

ph.cn: v. 投资于；[口]买进；寄希望于

syn: vt. 投资；覆盖；耗费；授予；包围：fund, award, give, house, sheet
vi. 投资，入股；花钱买：invent money in, plow into

en: to try to find out the truth about something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem

ex.en: The state police are investigating the incident.
ex.cn: 州警察正调查此事。

ex.en: The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
ex.cn: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

syn: v. 调查；研究：check into, inquire into
rm: invest(投资) + i + gate(大门) → 先进行市场调查是通往投资的大门 → 调查

en: to watch people who are taking an examination and make sure that they do not cheat

ex.en: Different is, the exam in the life often does not have person invigilate.
ex.cn: 不同的是，生活中的考试常常是没有人监考的。

ex.en: I need to invigilate the biology practice examination for the first class.
ex.cn: 我需要在第一节课监考生物模拟考试。

syn: vi. 监考；看守：watch over, keep watch

t: adj. 无敌的，不能征服的

ex.en: The might of the army is "invincible," according to state media but the refugees are rather cynical about the ill equipped force.
ex.cn: 朝鲜官方媒体称朝鲜的军事力量是“无敌的”，可是朝鲜难民却对装备落后的军队表示出不屑。

syn: adj. 无敌的；不能征服的：unbeatable, unrivaled

en: something that is invisible cannot be seen

ex.en: The house was surrounded by trees, and invisible from the road.
ex.cn: 这所房子树木环绕，从路上是看不见的。

syn: adj. 无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的：intangible, discarnate, aeriform
rm: in(不) + vis(看见) + ible(可…的) → 看不见的， 无形的

t: v. 开发票；n. 发票，装货清单
en: to send someone an invoice

ex.en: The agency invoices the client who then pays the full amount to the agency.
ex.cn: 那个代销处给客户开具发票，然后客户向代销处支付全部的款项。

ph.cn: 商业发票，正式签证的贸易发票
形式发票；试算发票；备考货单

syn: n. [会计]发票；货物；发货单：cargo, commodity
rm: in + voice(声音) → 大声把人叫进来开发票 → 发票； 给…开发票

t: v. 使陷入，使卷入，包含
en: if an activity or situation involves something, that thing is part of it or a result of it

ex.en: What will the job involve?
ex.cn: 这份工作包括什么？

ex.en: I didn’t realize putting on a play involved so much work.
ex.cn: 我没想到上演一出戏剧需要做这么多的工作。

syn: vt. 包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于：contain, comprise
rm: in(进入) + volv(卷) + e → 使卷入， 牵涉

t: n. 反话，冷嘲，讽刺性的事件、情况等
en: a situation that is unusual or amusing because something strange happens, or the opposite of what is expected happens or is true

ex.en: Life is full of little ironies.
ex.cn: 生活中充满了小小的讽刺。

syn: n. 讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事：hit, satire
adj. 铁的；似铁的：ferrous
rm: iron(铁) + y → 像铁一样冷冰冰的话 → 反话， 讽刺

ex.cn: 模块化系统可以很好地匹配您的需求，而不需要考虑是哪个模块提供的。

ex.en: This also means that you can refer to a savepoint only in the same execution of a procedure, but not from another execution of the same or other procedures irrespective of the nesting level.
ex.cn: 这也意味着您只能在存储过程的同一次执行中引用保存点，而不能从同一个过程或任何嵌套级别的其他过程的不同执行中引用。

syn: adj. 无关的；不考虑的；不顾的：unrelated, unconcerned

ex.en: Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
ex.cn: 江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。

ex.en: In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
ex.cn: 与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。

ex.en: It really irritates me when he doesn’t help around the house.
ex.cn: 家里的事情他一点都不帮忙，真让我恼火。

syn: vt. 刺激，使兴奋；激怒：stimulate, fan, anger, motivate, needle

en: a word for an island, used in poetry or in names of islands

ex.en: the British Isles
ex.cn: 不列颠群岛

ph.cn: 英国属地曼岛（首都道格拉斯，位于欧洲）

syn: n. 岛：island

en: to separate one person, group, or thing from other people or things

ex.en: The town was isolated by the floods.
ex.cn: 洪水使该镇与外界隔绝。

ex.en: The US has sought to isolate Cuba both economically and politically.
ex.cn: 美国一直想在经济和政治上孤立古巴。

syn: vt. [生物]使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘：segregate, seclude
vi. [生物]隔离；孤立：cordon off, to stand alone
rm: isol(＝insul岛屿) + ate(使…) → 使隔离， 使孤立

t: n. 出版，问题，发行；v. 分发，出版，发行

ex.en: Abortion is a highly controversial issue.
ex.cn: 堕胎是个很有争议的话题。

ex.en: We should raise the issue of discrimination with the council.
ex.cn: 我们应提请市政会讨论歧视的问题。

syn: n. 问题；流出；期号；[会计]发行物：question, flux
vt. [会计]发行，发布；发给；放出，排出：discharge, exhaust

t: n. 条款，项目，一条(新闻)

ex.en: He opened the cardboard box and took out each item.
ex.cn: 他打开纸板箱把里面的物品一一拿出来。

ex.en: The store is having a sale on furniture and household items.
ex.cn: 这家商店正在减价出售家具和家居用品。

syn: n. [法]条款，项目；一则：event, provision, clause, article

t: n. 旅行计划，旅行日记，旅程

ex.en: The next place on our itinerary was Sedona.
ex.cn: 我们旅行计划的下一站是塞多纳。

ex.cn: 一副象牙国际象棋

ex.en: He laid his hand on my shoulder.
ex.cn: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

ex.en: They laid a wreath at the place where so many people died.
ex.cn: 他们在这么多人丧生的地方放了一个花圈。

adj. 世俗的；外行的：strange, mundane

ex.en: He pulled off layer upon layer of clothing (= many layers of clothing ).
ex.cn: 他把衣服一件件地脱掉。

syn: n. 层，阶层；地层：thickness, degree, stratum, tier

ex.en: To the layman (= laymen in general ) all these plants look pretty similar.
ex.cn: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。

ex.en: If you don’t understand what the doctor says, ask to have it explained in layman’s terms (= in simple language ).
ex.cn: 如果你听不懂医生的话，就请他用通俗易懂的语言来解释一下。

ex.en: It will close more than 200 stores nationwide resulting in the layoffs of an estimated 2,000 employees.
ex.cn: 在全国范围内将关闭二百多家商店，造成约两千人失业。

ex.en: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
ex.cn: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

ex.en: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
ex.cn: 发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

syn: n. [植]小叶；传单：circular, lobule
rm: leaf(树叶) + let(表小东西) → 大街上的传单如落叶般铺天盖地 → 传单

ex.en: There is a leak in the ceiling.
ex.cn: 天花板上有条裂缝。

ex.en: The boat had sprung a leak (= a hole had appeared in it ).
ex.cn: 小船出现了漏洞。

syn: n. 泄漏；漏洞，裂缝：crack, split

en: a big jump

ex.cn: 他把一根枝条扔到河里，那条狗一个飞跃就追了过去。

syn: vi. 跳，跳跃：jump, dance
n. 飞跃；跳跃：jump, spring, bound

en: to use a building, car etc under a lease

ex.en: I’m interested in leasing your cottage.
ex.cn: 我有兴趣租下你的小屋。

ex.cn: 我一离开房间宝宝就会不安。

ex.cn: 下火车前一定要带好随身物品。

en: if something is legal, you are allowed to do it or have to do it by law

ex.en: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
ex.cn: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

ex.cn: 使携带身份证成为法定要求的计划

syn: adj. [法]法律的；合法的；法定的：legitimate, lawful
rm: leg(法律) + al(形容词后缀) → 法律的； 合法的

t: n. 传说，传奇，传奇文学；地图图例
en: an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events

ex.en: Local legend has it that (= says that ) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
ex.cn: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

syn: n. 传奇；说明；[测]图例；刻印文字：explanation, notes, romance, illustration

en: to make a law about something

ex.en: Most member countries have already legislated against excessive overtime.
ex.cn: 大部分成员国已经立法禁止过度加班。

ex.cn: 文森特赫然出现在我面前，脸色苍白阴沉得像块墓碑。

ex.en: Mrs. Morrell reached for a loop of garden hose.
ex.cn: 莫雷尔夫人伸手去拿一圈橡胶软管。

n. 环；圈；弯曲部分；[航]翻筋斗：annulus, anulus

ex.cn: 彩票

ex.cn: 你真的认为彩票中奖会带给你幸福吗？

syn: n. 彩票；碰运气的事，难算计的事；抽彩给奖法：sweepstake, scratchcard

ex.cn: 内森正懒洋洋地躺在小屋外的草堤上。

ex.cn: 球队的忠实支持者

ex.cn: 她在公司多年的忠诚服务

syn: adj. 忠诚的，忠心的；忠贞的：loving, devoted, faithful

ex.en: Lubricate all moving parts with grease.
ex.cn: 给所有活动部件加润滑油。

ex.en: legal niceties
ex.cn: 法律细节

syn: n. 精密；美好；细节；拘泥细节：detail, fairness, specific

en: a hard silver-white metal that is often combined with other metals, for example to make steel. It is a chemical element: symbol Ni

ex.en: ...a large glass jar filled with pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters.
ex.cn: …一个装满1分、5分、10分和25分硬币的大玻璃罐。

syn: n. [化学]镍；镍币；五分镍币：Ni, medio
rm: “你抠” → 连五分钱都舍不得给 → 五分镍币

en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream

ex.en: All the victims still suffered nightmares.
ex.cn: 所有的受害者仍为恶梦所扰。

syn: n. 恶梦；梦魇般的经历：paroniria, oneirodynia
adj. 可怕的；噩梦似的：terrible, horrible, awesome, fearful, dire

en: nothing

ex.en: The new machine reduced labour costs to almost nil.
ex.cn: 新机器把劳动成本几乎降到零。

syn: n. 无，[数]零：nothing, nonbeing

en: a gas that has no colour or smell, and that forms most of the Earth’s air. It is a chemical element: symbol N

ex.en: Well, we know nitrogen has what?
ex.cn: 对于氮气我们知道什么？

ex.en: The plant requires nitrogen in order to make proteins.
ex.cn: 植物需要氮以便制造蛋白质。

syn: n. [化学]氮：azote

en: the group of people in some countries who belong to the highest social class and have titles such as ‘Duke’ or ‘Countess’

ex.en: the nobility of his intentions
ex.cn: 他崇高的志向

syn: n. 贵族；高贵；高尚：prince, noble, dignity

t: adj. 名义上的，有名无实的；极微的；象征性的
en: a very small sum of money, especially when compared with what something would usually cost or what it is worth

ex.en: A nominal charge is made for use of the tennis courts.
ex.cn: 使用这些网球场只是象征性地收取费用。

syn: adj. 名义上的；有名无实的；[会计]票面上的：titular
rm: nomin(名字， 名目) + al → 名义上的

en: to officially suggest someone or something for an important position, duty, or prize

ex.en: This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
ex.cn: 本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

syn: vt. 推荐；提名；任命；指定：install, constitute, name, place, specify

t: n. 被提名者，被任命者
en: someone who has been officially suggested for an important position, duty, or prize

ex.en: the Democratic Party presidential nominee
ex.cn: 民主党被提名的总统候选人

syn: n. 被任命者；被提名的人；代名人：appointee, designee

en: the usual or normal situation, way of doing something etc

ex.en: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
ex.cn: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

syn: n. 规范，基准；[经管]定额，分配之工作量：criterion, quota

t: n. 怀乡病，留恋过去，怀旧
en: a feeling that a time in the past was good, or the activity of remembering a good time in the past and wishing that things had not changed

ex.en: He looked back on his university days with a certain amount of nostalgia.
ex.cn: 他带着一点留恋，回忆起大学时光。

ex.en: a wave of nostalgia for how great life was in the 1960s
ex.cn: 一阵对20世纪60年代美好生活的强烈怀旧之情

syn: n. 乡愁；怀旧之情；怀乡病：homesickness

t: n. 名人；显要人物；adj. 显著的；著名的
en: important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned

ex.en: If there are any notable inconsistencies or discrepancies, think through how you are going to explain the situation.
ex.cn: 如果有任何显著的不相符或让人起疑的情况，要想好该如何去解释这个情况。

syn: adj. 值得注意的，显著的；著名的：famous, obvious, remarkable, prominent, marked
n. 名人，显要人物：personality, lion, celebrity
rm: not(知道) + able(可…的) → 可知道的 → 值得注意的

en: someone, especially a lawyer, who has the legal power to make a signed statement or document official

ex.en: Want to be an assistant judge or notary.
ex.cn: 想成为一名助理法官或公证人。

ex.en: The notary looked at the count with astonishment.
ex.cn: 那公证人惊异地望着伯爵。

syn: n. [法]公证人：scrivener

en: A system of notation is a set of written symbols that are used to represent something such as music or mathematics

ex.en: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.
ex.cn: 乐谱为C大音阶而构思，在这个音阶中的每一个线和间都代表一个音符。

ex.en: ...some other abstract notation system like a computer language.
ex.cn: …一些如计算机语言的其它抽象符号系统。

syn: n. [计][数]符号；乐谱；注释；记号法：symbol, notes, sign, mark

en: a V-shaped cut or hole in a surface or edge

ex.en: Cut a notch near one end of the stick.
ex.cn: 在手杖的一端刻一个V形记号。

ph.cn: 陷波滤波器；凹口滤波器；阶式滤波器
切口灵敏度；缺口灵感度

syn: n. [木]刻痕，凹口；等级；峡谷：degree, classification, score, grade, rate
vt. 赢得；用刻痕计算；在…上刻凹痕：win, purchase

ex.en: I owe him nothing.
ex.cn: 我不欠他什么。

syn: n. 无；零；不关紧要之事：nil, nonbeing
adv. 毫不；决不：none, nowise

en: to formally or officially tell someone about something

ex.en: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy.
ex.cn: 船长通知了海岸警卫队这一灾难。

syn: vt. 通告，通知；公布：message, post, publish
rm: not(知道) + ify(使…) → 使人知道 → 通知， 报告

ex.en: “By investing in it, we can count it as an offset,” she said.
ex.cn: 她说：“通过对其投资，我们可以把它视为一项补偿。”

ph.cn: 胶印，平版印刷；胶版印刷；平板印刷

syn: n. 抵消，补偿；平版印刷；支管：compensation, indemnity
vt. 抵消；弥补；用平版印刷术印刷：kill, recover
rm: 来自词组set off(抵消)

t: a&ad. 离岸的(地)；近海的(地)

ex.en: The building can accommodate all of the offshore workers and protect them from hurricane damage.
ex.cn: 这个建筑能容纳所有的海上工人并且保护他们不受飓风的伤害。

syn: adj. 离岸的；[海洋]近海的；吹向海面的：paralic
adv. [海洋]向海面，向海：seaward

t: n. 子孙后代；动物的幼仔
en: an animal’s baby or babies

ex.en: a lion and its offspring
ex.cn: 一头狮子和它的幼崽

syn: n. [生物]后代，子孙；产物：child, creation, fruit, seed
rm: off(出来) + spring(春天) → 春天出生的 → 子女， 后代

en: a sign of what will happen in the future

ex.en: The car won’t start. Do you think it’s an omen?
ex.cn: 汽车发动不起来。你觉得这是某种预兆吗？

syn: n. 预兆；征兆：warning, symptom
vt. 预示；有…的前兆；预告：indicate, forecast, shadow, announce

en: making you feel that something bad is going to happen

ex.en: ‘How long will she be ill?’ he asked. There was an ominous silence.
ex.cn: “她的病多久会好？”他问。大家的沉默让人感觉不妙。

ex.en: The car is making an ominous rattling sound.
ex.cn: 汽车在发出一种不妙的咔嗒声。

syn: adj. 预兆的；不吉利的：ill, premonitory

t: v. 疏忽，忘记；省略；遗漏
en: to not include someone or something, either deliberately or because you forget to do it

ex.en: Please don’t omit any details, no matter how trivial they may seem.
ex.cn: 请不要忽略任何细节，不管它多细小。

syn: vt. [数]省略；遗漏；删除；疏忽：understand, elide

en: used to say what part of someone or something is hit or touched

ex.en: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
ex.cn: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。

ex.en: Matt kissed her on the cheek.
ex.cn: 马特亲吻了她的脸颊。

syn: adv. 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着：forward, antrorsely
prep. 向，朝……；关于；在……之上；在……时候：towards, unto, at, concerning, about

t: conj. 一旦；adv. 一次；从前
en: from the time when something happens

ex.en: Once I get him a job, he’ll be fine.
ex.cn: 一旦我帮他找到了工作，他就会好的。

ex.en: Once in bed, the children usually stay there.
ex.cn: 孩子们一旦上了床，一般就不下来了。

syn: adv. 一次；曾经：ever, e'er
n. 一次，一回：breath, one time

t: adj. 即将来临的；接近的

ex.en: He crashed into an oncoming car.
ex.cn: 他撞上了一辆迎面驶来的汽车。

syn: adj. 即将到来的；接近的；新兴的：coming, emerging, rising
n. 来临，接近：approach, neighborhood

en: a piece of paper money worth one dollar

ex.en: I don’t have any ones.
ex.cn: 我没有一美元的纸币。

ph.cn: （将来）有一天；总有一天；（过去）某一天
adv. 成为一体；[口]只试一次

syn: adj. 一的；唯一的：unique, sole
n. 一：ane

en: continuing, or continuing to develop

ex.en: their ongoing search for a new director
ex.cn: 他们仍在寻找一个新主任

ex.en: ongoing negotiations
ex.cn: 还在进行的谈判

syn: adj. 不间断的，进行的；前进的：advancing, unremitting, uninterrupted
n. 前进；行为，举止：behavior, dealing, advancement, going, progress
rm: on(在…中) + going(进行， 进展) → 进行中的

t: v. 不理(某人的愿望要求)，不顾

ex.en: The EU commission exercised its power to override British policy.
ex.cn: 欧盟委员会行使其权力来否决英国的政策。

ph.cn: 手动超越控制；并联手动阀

syn: vt. 推翻；不顾；践踏：throw down, topple down
n. [会计]代理佣金：agency commission
vt. 泛滥；超过；蹂躏：better than, top
vi. 泛滥；蔓延：creep, to spread

en: to be in charge of a group of workers and check that a piece of work is done satisfactorily

ex.en: A team leader was appointed to oversee the project.
ex.cn: 任命了一位组长来监管该工程。

syn: vt. 监督；审查；俯瞰；偷看到，无意中看到：police, survey
rm: over(在…之上) + see(看) → 监督

t: v. 超过，赶上；突然降临
en: to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them

ex.en: He pulled out to overtake the van.
ex.cn: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

ex.en: Never try to overtake on a bend.
ex.cn: 绝不要在转弯处超车。

syn: vt. 赶上；压倒；突然来袭：catch up with, to catch up
vi. 超车：cut in

t: adj. 公开的，明显的，公然的
en: overt actions are done publicly, without trying to hide anything

ex.en: an overt attempt to silence their political opponents
ex.cn: 他们想压制政敌言论的明显企图

ex.en: Overt race discrimination is illegal.
ex.cn: 公然的种族歧视是非法的。

syn: adj. 明显的；公然的；蓄意的：obvious, distinct, visible, declared, evident

en: to remove a leader or government from power, especially by force

ex.en: Rebels were already making plans to overthrow the government.
ex.cn: 反叛者已在密谋颠覆政府。

syn: n. 推翻；倾覆；瓦解：capsizal, disintegration
vt. 推翻；打倒；倾覆：floor, fell

en: a short piece of music written as an introduction to a long piece of music, especially an opera

ex.en: They began making overtures to the Irish government.
ex.cn: 他们开始向爱尔兰政府表示友好。

syn: n. 前奏曲；提案；序幕：preludio, prolusion
vt. 提议；为……奏前奏曲：vote, make the offer

en: if water overwhelms an area of land, it covers it completely and suddenly

ex.en: But the various pros and cons should not blindly overwhelm one another.
ex.cn: 但是，众多的利弊得失不应盲目的一个压倒另一个。

ex.en: We try not to think about it because it would overwhelm us to an extent that we would just vegetate.
ex.cn: 我们尽量不去想它，因为在某种我们能够想像到的程度上他会压倒我们。

syn: vt. 压倒；淹没；受打击：flood, flow
rm: over(在…之上) + whelm(淹没， 压倒) → 征服

t: adj. 过分劳累的，过度兴奋的

ex.en: Clara was tired and overwrought after all the problems of the last few days.
ex.cn: 经历了过去几天的重重困难之后，克拉拉既疲惫又紧张。

en: to need to pay someone for something that they have done for you or sold to you, or to need to give someone back money that they have lent you

ex.en: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
ex.cn: 我该付你多少钱？

syn: vt. 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于：appreciate, be grateful to

en: the fact of owning something

ex.en: The price of home ownership is increasing.
ex.cn: 房价在不断上涨。

syn: n. [法]所有权；物主身份：property, droit

en: a substance which is produced when a substance is combined with oxygen

ex.en: iron oxide
ex.cn: 氧化铁

syn: n. [化学]氧化物：oxyde
rm: ox(=oxy氧) + ide → 氧化物

t: n. 一步；走或跑的速度
en: the speed at which something happens or is done

ex.en: He quickened his pace , longing to be home.
ex.cn: 他加快步伐，盼望着早点回到家中。

ph.cn: n. 改变习惯；更换口味

syn: n. 一步；步速；步法：footwork

t: v. 抚慰；平静；平安；绥靖
en: to make someone calm, quiet, and satisfied after they have been angry or upset

ex.en: ‘You’re right,’ Rita said, in order to pacify him.
ex.cn: “你是对的。”丽塔安抚他道。

syn: vt. 使平静；安慰；平定：calm, comfort, quiet, compose

t: n. 垫子；拍纸簿；v. 步行，走路
en: several sheets of paper fastened together, used for writing or drawing

ex.en: Keep a telephone pad and a pen to hand.
ex.cn: 手边准备一本电话记事簿和一支笔。

ex.en: a pad of paper
ex.cn: 一本拍纸簿

ph.cn: 刹车片；盘式刹车片；制动衬块；闸垫

syn: n. [机]衬垫；便笺簿；填补；印色盒：liner, interleaver
vi. 步行；放轻脚步走：foot, hoof it

t: n. 短桨；vt&vi. 用桨划动
en: a short pole that is wide and flat at the end, used for moving a small boat in water

ex.en: Each man had a paddle for an hour and then a rest.
ex.cn: 每人划一小时桨， 然后休息一下。

ex.en: We strive to paddle to follow the stream, however, we are unsure if how and when we will reach the horizon.
ex.cn: 我们沿着河流奋力划桨，但是我们无法确定我们什么时候和怎样才能到达地平线。

syn: n. 划桨；明轮翼：oarage
vt. 拌；搅；用桨划：pug

en: A pageant is a colourful public procession, show, or ceremony. Pageants are usually held outdoors and often celebrate events or people from history.

ex.en: ...a historical pageant of kings and queens.
ex.cn: …一场历史上的国王和王后们的盛大庆典。

syn: n. 盛会；游行；虚饰；露天表演：parade, frills

en: Pain is the feeling of unhappiness that you have when something unpleasant or upsetting happens

ex.en: ...grey eyes that seemed filled with pain.
ex.cn: …似乎充满了痛苦的灰色眼睛。

ph.cn: [医]发育期痛；青少年发育期的关节痛

syn: v. 使痛苦（pain的第三人称单数形式）：wrenches

en: very careful and thorough

ex.en: The work had been done with painstaking attention to detail.
ex.cn: 这项工作被一丝不苟地完成了。

ex.en: Chris described in painstaking detail what had happened.
ex.cn: 克里斯非常详细地描述了所发生的事情。

syn: adj. 艰苦的；勤勉的；小心的：careful, tough, rough, diligent
n. 辛苦；勤勉：industry, diligence
rm: pains(痛苦) + taking(花费…的) → 煞费苦心的

t: adj. 可口的，美味的；惬意的
en: palatable food or drink has a pleasant or acceptable taste

ex.en: a very palatable wine
ex.cn: 口感极佳的酒

syn: adj. 美味的，可口的；愉快的：delicious, good, bright

en: the inside surface of your hand, in which you hold things

ex.en: He held the pebble in the palm of his hand .
ex.cn: 他把那颗卵石握在手心里。

syn: n. 手掌；[林]棕榈树；掌状物：vola

t: n. 同等；同辈；v. 凝视
en: your peers are the people who are the same age as you, or who have the same type of job, social class etc

ex.en: American children did less well in math than their peers in Japan.
ex.cn: 美国儿童的数学成绩不如日本的同龄儿童。

ex.en: Staff members are trained by their peers.
ex.cn: 员工由同事培训。

syn: vi. 凝视，盯着看；窥视：pore, stare at
n. 贵族；同等的人：prince, noble, nobility

en: a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement

ex.en: No littering. Penalty $500.
ex.cn: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

ex.en: Withdrawing the money early will result in a 10% penalty.
ex.cn: 提前支取这笔钱将被处以10%的罚金。

syn: n. [经]罚款，罚金；[法]处罚：fine, amercement
rm: pen(刑事的) + al + ty(名词后缀) → 惩罚； 罚金

en: a long metal stick with a weight at the bottom that swings regularly from side to side to control the working of a clock

ex.en: After several years of Republican government, the pendulum will undoubtedly swing back and voters will elect a Democrat.
ex.cn: 由共和党执政数年后，选民无疑会掉过头来，选出一位民主党人。

en: to enter something and pass or spread through it, especially when this is difficult

ex.en: bullets that penetrate thick armour plating
ex.cn: 穿过厚装甲的子弹

ex.en: Sunlight barely penetrated the dirty windows.
ex.cn: 阳光几乎照不进那些肮脏的窗户。

syn: vt. 渗透；穿透；洞察：filter, permeate
vi. 渗透；刺入；看透：sink, osmose

t: n&vt. 养老金，退休金；给予养老金
en: an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill

ex.en: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
ex.cn: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

ex.en: If you are self-employed, you should think about taking out a private pension .
ex.cn: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

ph.cn: 公积金计划；退休金办法；养老计划

syn: n. 退休金，[劳经]抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费：retirement pay, subsidy
rm: pens(悬挂， 引申为“付钱”) + ion → 养老金

en: to notice, see, or recognize something

ex.en: That morning, he perceived a change in Franca’s mood.
ex.cn: 那天早上，他注意到弗兰卡情绪的变化。

ex.en: Cats are not able to perceive colour.
ex.cn: 猫不能辨别颜色。

syn: vt. 察觉，感觉；理解；认知：detect, feel, absorb, see, read
vi. 感到，感知；认识到：to feel, come to realize
rm: per(全部) + ceiv(拿住) + e → 全部拿住 → 感知， 察觉

t: adj. 察觉得到的，看得出的
en: something that is perceptible can be noticed, although it is very small

ex.en: a small but perceptible change
ex.cn: 微小但可以察觉的变化

ex.en: The sound was barely perceptible .
ex.cn: 那声音几乎听不见。

syn: adj. 可察觉的；可感知的；看得见的：seen, visible

en: Perception is the recognition of things using your senses, especially the sense of sight

ex.en: And when they do, what do you think their perception will be?
ex.cn: 当他们这样做时，你觉得他们的知觉是怎样的？

ph.cn: 美感，审美观念；审美知觉

syn: n. 知觉；[生理]感觉；看法；洞察力；获取：consciousness, viewpoint, sense, feel, insight
rm: 来自perceive(vt. 感知， 察觉)

en: the sound or effect of two things hitting each other with great force

ph.cn: 冲击钻探，冲魂；冲唤钻眼，冲魂井

syn: n. [临床]叩诊；振动；碰撞；敲打乐器；打击乐器组：vibration, collision, impact, crash

t: "a. 终年的,四季不断的,持久的；n. 多年生植物"
en: a plant that lives for more than two years

ex.en: ...a low-growing perennial.
ex.cn: …一种长不高的多年生植物。

ex.cn: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

ex.cn: 享有盛名的文学奖

ex.cn: 赫赫有名的大学

ex.cn: 把瓜切成两半，挖出瓜瓤。

ex.en: ...pumps that circulate the fuel around in the engine.
ex.cn: …使燃料在发动机内循环的压泵。

n. [机]泵，抽水机；打气筒：inflator

en: arriving, happening, or being done at exactly the time that has been arranged

ex.en: She’s always very punctual for appointments.
ex.cn: 她一向准时赴约。

ex.en: the punctual payment of invoices
ex.cn: 准时结清费用清单

syn: adj. 准时的，守时的；精确的：accurate, precise, mathematical, strict, rigid
rm: punct(刺) + ual(形容词后缀)→ 像针刺那么准确 → 守时的； 准时的

en: a small hole made accidentally in a tyre

ex.en: She was cycling home when she had a puncture .
ex.cn: 她骑车回家途中轮胎被扎破了。

syn: vt. 刺穿；揭穿；削弱：break, cut through

en: having a strong taste or smell

ex.en: He expressed some fairly pungent criticisms.
ex.cn: 他提出了一针见血的批评。

syn: adj. 辛辣的；刺激性的；苦痛的；尖刻的：spicy, bitter

en: the small black round area in the middle of your eye

ex.en: The sick man's pupils were dilated.
ex.cn: 病人的瞳孔放大了。

syn: n. 学生；[解剖]瞳孔；未成年人：student, minor

en: to force people to leave a place or organization because the people in power do not like them

ex.en: Anorexics may overeat before purging themselves or vomiting.
ex.cn: 厌食症患者会在暴饮暴食之后服用泻药或者把吃下去的东西呕吐出来。

ph.cn: 净化气体；吹扫用的气体

syn: vi. 净化；通便：fine purification, purify
vt. 净化；[机]清洗；通便：cleanse, purify

en: the quality or state of being pure

ex.en: the purity of tap water
ex.cn: 自来水的纯净度

ex.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["spiritual purity"]}
ex.cn: 心灵的纯洁

syn: n. [化学]纯度；纯洁；纯净；纯粹：fineness, immaculacy

t: n. 追赶；追求；从事，消遣
en: when someone tries to get, achieve, or find something in a determined way

ex.en: The quarterback sprinted toward the end zone with Jansen in hot pursuit (= following closely behind ) .
ex.cn: 那名四分卫快速冲向底线区，詹森穷追不舍。

rm: 钱包(purse)被小偷偷去， 赶忙追赶(pursuit)

en: to move something to a particular place or position, especially using your hands

ex.en: He put the coffee on the table.
ex.cn: 他把咖啡放在桌上。

ex.en: Where did you put the programmes?
ex.cn: 你把节目单放在哪里了？

提出，提交；放入；种植；使就职
穿上；上演；增加；假装；使…上场

vi. 出发；击；航行；发芽：leave, set out

t: v. 开垦，开拓；要求归还
en: to make an area of desert, wet land etc suitable for farming or building

ex.en: This land will be reclaimed for a new airport.
ex.cn: 这块土地将被开发用来建新机场。

vi. 抗议，喊叫：protest against sth, exclaim at

ex.en: She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue.

t: v. 使和解；使复交；调解，调停
en: to have a good relationship again with someone after you have quarrelled with them

ex.en: Jonah and his youngest son were, on the surface at least, reconciled.
ex.cn: 乔纳和他小儿子和好了，至少表面上如此。

ex.en: It was some hours before she recovered consciousness .
ex.cn: 过了几个小时她才恢复知觉。

ex.en: Once she stumbled, but somehow she recovered her balance and carried on running.
ex.cn: 她绊了一下，但还是找回平衡，继续向前跑去。

ex.en: We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
ex.cn: 我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。

ex.en: Many government officials were recruited from private industry.
ex.cn: 很多政府官员是从私营企业招募来的。

ex.cn: 设长方形的宽是 x 米。

syn: n. [数]矩形；长方形：orthogon
rm: rect(直的) + angl(角) + e → 长方形的每个角均为直角 → 长方形， 矩形

en: to correct something that is wrong

ex.en: I did my best to rectify the situation, but the damage was already done.
ex.cn: 我竭尽全力去挽回局面，但损害已经造成了。

syn: vt. 改正；精馏；整流：correct, straighten up

t: v. 使再循环；回收利用
en: to put used objects or materials through a special process so that they can be used again

ex.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
ex.cn: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

ex.en: packaging made of recycled paper
ex.cn: 再生纸包装材料

syn: n. 再生；再循环；重复利用：regeneration, breeding, rebirth

t: v. 买回，赎回；补偿；补救

ex.en: Olivier’s performance redeemed an otherwise second-rate play.
ex.cn: 奥利维尔的表演补救了一出本是二流水平的戏。

syn: vt. 赎回；挽回；兑换；履行；补偿；恢复：fulfill, turn, restore, pay, repair

en: not necessary because something else means or does the same thing

ex.cn: 多余信息的删除

ex.cn: 影片结尾部分

syn: n. 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书：involved in, mention

ex.cn: 市政会同意在11月就此问题进行全民投票。

en: to make a substance purer using an industrial process

ex.en: oil refining
ex.cn: 石油的提炼

syn: vt. 精炼，提纯；改善；使…文雅：improve, polish up

en: to not do something that you want to do

ex.en: Mrs. Hardie refrained from making any comment.
ex.cn: 哈迪太太忍住了没做任何评论。

n. 叠句，副歌；重复：repeat, iteration

t: adj. 使精力恢复的；使耳目一新的
en: pleasantly different from what is familiar and boring

ex.en: It made a refreshing change to talk to someone new.
ex.cn: 和刚认识的人谈话感觉很新鲜。

en: small amounts of food and drink that are provided at a meeting, sports event etc

ex.cn: 会后有茶点招待。

ex.en: Refugees were streaming across the border.
ex.cn: 难民正涌过边境。

ex.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["refugee camps"]}
ex.cn: 难民营

t: v. 归还；n. 归还；归还额

ex.en: I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .
ex.cn: 我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。

vt. 退还；[金融]偿还；付还：replace, tender

ex.en: Her country suffered through her refusal to accept change.
ex.cn: 她的国家因为她拒绝接受变革而受了害。

syn: n. 拒绝；[贸易][金融]优先取舍权；推却；取舍权：rejection, denial
rm: 来自refuse(v. 拒绝)

ex.en: The new tax laws were rammed through regardless of the opposition of the majority of the people.
ex.cn: 不顾大多数人民的反对，新的税法强行通过了。

rm: regard(关心) + less(少) → 很少关心 → 不顾后果地

ex.en: ‘It’s all your fault!’ he retorted.
ex.cn: “那都是你的错！”他反驳道。

en: to move away from the enemy after being defeated in battle

ex.en: The rebels retreated to the mountains.
ex.cn: 叛乱分子撤退到山区。

ex.en: They were attacked and forced to retreat.
ex.cn: 他们受到攻击，被迫撤退。

en: to make a situation satisfactory again after there has been a serious mistake or problem

ex.cn: 将军为挽回局面而孤注一掷。

n. [计]检索；恢复，取回：recovery, restoration, renewal

en: thinking back to a time in the past, especially with the advantage of knowing more now than you did then

ex.cn: 回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

ex.cn: …在他和前任秘书的风流韵事被揭露之后。

en: to punish someone who has done something to harm you or someone else

ex.en: The poor murdered girl must be revenged.
ex.cn: 一定要为被害的可怜女孩报仇。

vt. 报复；替…报仇；洗雪：get back on, get even with

en: money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services

ex.en: advertising revenue
ex.cn: 广告收入

ex.cn: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000万英镑。

en: showing a lot of respect and admiration

ex.cn: 毕恭毕敬的低语声

syn: adj. 虔诚的；恭敬的；尊敬的：religious, good, dear

en: if a vehicle or its driver reverses, they go backwards

ex.cn: 我不欠你什么。 如果说欠的话，是你欠我才对。

vt. 颠倒；倒转：bottom up, head over heels

en: a careful examination of a situation or process

ex.en: The policy comes up for review (= will be reviewed ) in April.
ex.cn: 这项政策将在4月份予以审议。

ex.en: All fees are subject to review(= may be reviewed ).
ex.cn: 所有费用有待审查。

ph.cn: 文献回顾；文献综述；文献评论

vt. 回顾；检查；复审：examine, inspect
rm: re(重新， 再) + view(看) → 回顾； 复习

en: to change something because of new information or ideas

ex.en: The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
ex.cn: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

ex.cn: 我们已修正了对人口增长的估计。

vi. [图情]修订；[印刷]校订；复习功课：to amend
rm: re(一再) + vis(看) + e → 反复看 → 修订； 复习

en: When something such as the economy, a business, a trend, or a feeling is revived or when it revives, it becomes active, popular, or successful again

ex.en: ...an attempt to revive the economy.
ex.cn: …一次重振经济的尝试。

vt. 使复兴；使苏醒；回想起；重演，重播：recall, reinvigorate

en: a refusal to accept someone’s authority or obey rules or laws

ex.en: The prime minister is now facing a revolt by members of his own party.
ex.cn: 首相现在面临着党内倒戈。

syn: vi. 反抗；反叛；反感，厌恶：strive against, come out against
vt. 使反感；使恶心：sicken

en: to move around like a wheel, or to make something move around like a wheel

ex.en: The wheel began to revolve.
ex.cn: 轮子开始旋转。

ex.en: The restaurant slowly revolves, giving excellent views of the city.
ex.cn: 餐厅缓缓旋转，城市美景尽收眼底。

vt. 使…旋转；使…循环；反复考虑：turn over

en: something that you get because you have done something good or helpful or have worked hard

ex.en: The school has a system of rewards and punishments to encourage good behaviour.
ex.cn: 学校有奖惩制度以鼓励良好行为。

en: the art of speaking or writing to persuade or influence people

ex.en: ...the noble institutions of political life, such as political rhetoric, public office, and public service.
ex.cn: …政治生活中令人尊崇的机制，诸如政治修辞艺术、政府机构以及公益服务。

ex.en: Begin to listen to your own body rhythms.
ex.cn: 开始聆听你自己身体的规律性变化。

syn: n. 节奏；韵律：meter, cadence

en: a narrow piece of attractive cloth that you use, for example, to tie your hair or hold things together

ex.cn: 头发上系着丝带的小姑娘们

ex.cn: 一捆用淡蓝色丝带扎好的信

en: a long area of high land, especially at the top of a mountain

ex.cn: 我们沿着山脊小心前行。

en: very silly or unreasonable

ex.en: That’s a ridiculous idea!
ex.cn: 那主意很荒唐！

ex.cn: 别傻了！

en: to put ropes, sails etc on a ship

ex.en: The ship was fully rigged and ready to sail.
ex.cn: 船已装备就绪，等待起航。

ph.cn: 试验台；试验装置，试验设备

syn: n. 装备；钻探设备；服装；[船]帆装：equipment, clothing, arm, garment, wear
vt. 操纵；装配；装扮；装上索具：man, guide, manipulate
rm: 挖(dig)个洞把器械(rig)藏起来

t: adj. 正直的，正当的，公正的
en: morally good and fair

ex.en: a righteous God
ex.cn: 正义的上帝

syn: adj. 正义的；正直的；公正的：judicial, straight, just, square
rm: rig(直的； 正确的) + hte + ous(形容词后缀) → 正直的； 公正的

en: a tool for cutting paper, cloth etc, made of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle, with holes for your finger and thumb

ex.en: a pair of scissors
ex.cn: 一把剪刀

syn: n. [五金]剪刀；剪式跳法：forfex, cutting tools

en: to angrily criticize someone, especially a child, about something they have done

ex.en: Do not scold the puppy, but simply and firmly say ‘no’.
ex.cn: 不要责骂小狗，但要干脆利落地说“不”。

syn: vi. 责骂；叱责：rate, hop on
vt. 骂；责骂：rate, hop on

en: an important or exciting news story that is printed in one newspaper or shown on one television station before any of the others know about it

ex.cn: 抢独家新闻的记者

syn: vt. 掘；舀取；抢先获得；搜集：pick, dip

en: if you scorch something, or if it scorches, its surface burns slightly and changes colour

ex.en: The walls had been blackened and scorched by fire.
ex.cn: 这些墙被大火熏黑了。

syn: vt. 烧焦；使枯萎；挖苦：blast, wither up
vi. 烧焦；枯萎：flag, wither away

en: a written or printed copy of a piece of music, especially for a large group of performers, or the music itself

ex.en: a musical score
ex.cn: 乐谱

ex.en: Who wrote the score for the movie?
ex.cn: 这部电影的配乐是谁谱写的？

ph.cn: 为（某队）进球/得分；为…得分；把…改写成器乐曲

syn: n. 分数；二十；配乐；[木]刻痕：marks, twenty
vt. 获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下：acquire, earn, buy, find, value
rm: 分， 分(score)， 考试的核心(core)

en: the feeling that someone or something is stupid or does not deserve respect

ex.en: Researchers greeted the proposal with scorn.
ex.cn: 研究者们对这个提议报以轻蔑的态度。

syn: n. 轻蔑；嘲笑；藐视的对象：floccinaucinihilipilification, disparagement
vt. 轻蔑；藐视；不屑做：spurn at, sneeze at

t: n. 侦察员，侦察机，侦察舰
en: a soldier, plane etc that is sent to search the area in front of an army and get information about the enemy

ex.en: He sent three scouts ahead to take a look at the bridge.
ex.cn: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

ph.cn: n. 童子军；过于理想而不切实际者；单纯的政治家

syn: n. 搜索，[航][军]侦察；侦察员；侦察机：searching, scanning
vt. [航][军]侦察；跟踪，监视；发现：detect, watching, dog, guard

t: n. 碎片，碎屑；少许，少量

ex.cn: 用旧零碎材料拼做的一块小地毯

syn: n. [机]碎片；残余物；打架；少量：bit, debris, chip, fight

ex.en: Scrape the carrots and slice them thinly.
ex.cn: 把这些胡萝卜去皮切成薄片。

ex.en: The two of them scraped their dishes clean .
ex.cn: 他们两个把盘子擦得干干净净。

syn: n. 刮掉；擦痕；困境；刮擦声：difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix
vt. 刮；擦伤；挖成：raw, brush burn

t: v. 抓；搔，挖；n. 抓痕，擦伤
en: to rub your skin with your nails because it feels uncomfortable

ex.en: John yawned and scratched his leg.
ex.cn: 约翰打了个呵欠，挠了挠腿。

ex.en: Try not to scratch.
ex.cn: 尽量别挠。

ph.cn: 从头开始；白手起家；从起跑线开始

syn: n. 擦伤；抓痕；刮擦声；乱写：abrasion, brush-burn
adj. 打草稿用的；凑合的；碰巧的：hit-and-miss

t: n. 螺旋，螺丝；螺旋浆；vt&vi. 钉住，拧
en: a thin pointed piece of metal that you push and turn in order to fasten pieces of metal or wood together

ex.en: Fix the frame in position and tighten the screws .
ex.cn: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

syn: vt. 旋，拧；压榨；强迫：force, enforce
n. 螺旋；[机]螺丝钉；吝啬鬼：spiral, helix

t: n. 手迹，笔迹; 手稿; 剧本
en: writing done by hand

ex.en: a diary entry written in neat black script
ex.cn: 用工整的黑色字写下的一则日记

syn: n. 脚本；[图情]手迹；书写用的字母：play book

en: a long piece of paper that can be rolled up, and is used as an official document

ex.en: Ancient scrolls were found in caves by the Dead Sea.
ex.cn: 在死海边的洞穴里发现了古代的卷轴。

syn: n. 卷轴，画卷；名册；卷形物：book, roll

en: careful and thorough examination of someone or something

ex.en: Their activities have come under police scrutiny .
ex.cn: 他们的活动受到警方的严密监视。

syn: n. 详细审查；监视；细看；选票复查：observation, monitoring, surveillance, watch

en: an object made out of stone, wood, clay etc by an artist

ex.en: ...stone sculptures of figures and animals.
ex.cn: …人物及动物石雕。

syn: n. [建]雕塑；[轻]雕刻；刻蚀：carving, incision
vt. [建]雕塑；[轻]雕刻；刻蚀：grave, engrave

ex.cn: 漂满绿色浮沫的池塘

syn: n. 浮渣；泡沫；糟粕：bubble, foam, yeast

t: n&v. 海豹；封蜡，封印；印记

ex.cn: 这扇窗户被封了起来。

vt. [机]密封；盖章：pressure, air proof

ex.en: She was repairing Billy’s trousers, where the seam had come undone.
ex.cn: 她在补比利裤子的开线处。

ex.en: Join the shoulder seams together.
ex.cn: 把肩部缝起来。

t: v. 使隔离；使孤立，使隐退

t: adj. 第二的，中级的；次要的

rm: 来自second(num. 第二)

en: a substance, usually liquid, produced by part of a plant or animal

ex.en: These secretions are used by the caterpillar as a defence.
ex.cn: 这些分泌物被毛虫用作自卫武器。

syn: n. [生理]分泌；分泌物；藏匿；隐藏：excretion, concealment

ex.en: The thought of such cruelty sickened her.
ex.cn: 想到如此残忍的行为，她就很愤慨。

ex.en: All decent people should be sickened by such a pointless waste of life.
ex.cn: 凡正派的人都会痛恨这样无谓地浪费生命。

vi. 生病；变厌腻：fall sick, take sick

ex.cn: 这次封锁历时近四个月。

ex.en: a three-day police siege at a remote country cottage
ex.cn: 警方对一座偏僻村舍历时三天的包围

syn: n. 围攻；包围；围城；不断袭击；长期努力：besiegement, encirclement
vt. 围攻；包围：invest, case

ex.en: Press the raspberries through a fine sieve to form a puree.
ex.cn: 用一把细筛子把黑莓压榨成浓汁。

vt. [粮食][数]筛；滤：screen, ree

ex.en: ‘Well, there’s nothing we can do about it now,’ she sighed.
ex.cn: “唉，我们现在对此无能为力。”她叹口气说。

syn: vi. 叹息，叹气：suspire
n. 叹息，叹气：suspiration

en: when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists

ex.en: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
ex.cn: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

syn: n. 观光；游览：tourism, pleasure trip
adj. 观光的；游览的：visiting, touring

t: n. 记号；标志；征兆；v. 签名

ex.en: A paw print in the dust was a sign that a tiger was close.
ex.cn: 沙土里的一个爪印表明附近有老虎。

ex.en: There were no signs of forced entry into the house.
ex.cn: 没有强行入室的痕迹。

syn: n. 迹象；符号；记号；手势：symbol, breath, evidence, mark, motion
vi. 签署；签名：subscribe

en: a sound or action that you make in order to give information to someone or tell them to do something

ex.en: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
ex.cn: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

vt. 标志；用信号通知：mark
rm: sign(签名) + al → 用签名作为自己的标志 → 标志

ex.en: Her signature is totally illegible (= cannot be read ) .
ex.cn: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

ex.en: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
ex.cn: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

syn: n. 署名；签名；信号：a scratch of pen

t: adj. 意义深长的；重要的
en: having an important effect or influence, especially on what will happen in the future

ex.en: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
ex.cn: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

ex.en: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
ex.cn: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。

en: to represent, mean, or be a sign of something

ex.en: Some tribes use special facial markings to signify status.
ex.cn: 有些部落使用特殊的面部标记来表示地位。

ex.cn: 狮子的形象代表权力和力量。

syn: vt. 表示；意味；预示：indicate, bid, forecast, mean, shadow
vi. 有重要性；要紧；冒充内行：matter, count for

en: almost the same

ex.en: We have similar tastes in music.
ex.cn: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

ex.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
ex.cn: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

syn: adj. 相似的：alike, like
n. 类似物：analog

en: to make something easier or less complicated

ex.en: an attempt to simplify the tax system
ex.cn: 简化税制的尝试

ex.en: The law needs to be simplified.
ex.cn: 这部法律需要简化。

syn: vt. 简化；使单纯；使简易：predigest, deformalize

ex.en: a machine that simulates conditions in space
ex.cn: 一台模拟太空环境的机器

ex.en: Interviews can be simulated in the classroom.
ex.cn: 可以在教室里模拟面试。

adj. 模仿的；假装的：affected, assumed

en: things that are simultaneous happen at exactly the same time

ex.en: They grabbed each other’s hands in simultaneous panic.
ex.cn: 他们俩同时惊慌起来，相互抓住对方的手。

ex.en: Up to twenty users can have simultaneous access to the system.
ex.cn: 最多可有20名用户同时登该系统。

syn: adj. 同时的；联立的；同时发生的：synchronous, coinstantaneous

en: a feeling, belief, or statement that is sincere is honest and true, and based on what you really feel and believe

ex.en: Please accept my sincere apologies .
ex.cn: 请接受我真诚的道歉。

ex.en: his sincere desire to find out the truth
ex.cn: 他想查明真相的真切愿望

syn: adj. 真诚的；诚挚的；真实的：actual, positive, true, real, genuine
rm: sin(罪) + cere → 把罪过一一坦白， 态度真诚 → 真诚的

t: adj. 单一的；未婚的；单人的；n. 单打，单程票
en: only one

ex.en: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
ex.cn: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

ex.en: They won the game by a single point.
ex.cn: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

syn: adj. 单一的；单身的；单程的：unitary, onefold
n. 一个；单打；单程票：yin, one-way ticket

en: very great or very noticeable

ex.en: He showed a singular lack of tact in the way he handled the situation.
ex.cn: 他处理这局面的方式显得极不得体。

ex.en: a singular achievement
ex.cn: 非凡的成就

syn: adj. 单数的；单一的；非凡的；[数]异常的：remarkable, extraordinary, novel, wonder, exquisite

en: a large open container that you fill with water and use for washing yourself, washing dishes etc

ex.en: Dirty plates were piled high in the sink.
ex.cn: 脏盘子在洗涤槽里堆得很高。

vt. 使下沉；挖掘；使低落：to dig, tap into

en: If something is sited in a particular place or position, it is put there or built there

ex.en: He said chemical weapons had never been sited in Germany.
ex.cn: 他说从未在德国部署过化学武器。

syn: n. 地点；[自]位置；场所：location, spot, situation, where, lie
vt. 设置；为…选址：intercalate, instal

t: adj. 坐落在的；处于某种境地的
en: to be in a particular place or position

ex.en: His hotel is situated in one of the loveliest places on the Loire.
ex.cn: 他的旅馆坐落在卢瓦尔的一个最优美的地方。

t: n. 骨骼；(建筑物、计划的)骨架；纲要
en: the most important parts of something, to which more detail can be added later

ex.en: We agreed on a skeleton outline of the proposal.
ex.cn: 我们给提案商定了一个基本框架。

adj. [解剖]骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的；概略的：boned, scrawny

t: n. 草图，素描;；n. 短剧；简述；v. 草拟
en: a simple, quickly made drawing that does not show much detail

ex.en: So if we just sketch that.
ex.cn: 那么如果我们把那画个草图。

ex.en: He squiggled a sketch on the ground.
ex.cn: 他在地上胡乱地画了个草图。

syn: n. 素描；略图；梗概：outline, croquis

en: a group of animals or plants whose members are similar and can breed together to produce young animals or plants

ex.en: Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
ex.cn: 已有七种猛禽被观察到。

ex.en: pandas and other endangered species
ex.cn: 熊猫以及其他濒危物种

syn: n. [生物]物种；种类：category, variety, manner, nature, kind
rm: 科学家从一些生物物种(species)中选取好的制成标本(specimen)

en: a specific thing, person, or group is one particular thing, person, or group

ex.en: games suitable for specific age groups
ex.cn: 适合特定年龄组的游戏

ex.en: a specific example of alcohol’s effect on the body
ex.cn: 酒精对身体影响的具体例子

ph.cn: 比表面；比表面积；表面系数

syn: adj. 特殊的，特定的；明确的；详细的；[药]具有特效的：precise, strict, decided, detailed, particular
n. 特性；细节；特效药：quality, tang, identity, detail, character

t: n. 载明，详述；规格，清单，说明书
en: a detailed instruction about how a car, building, piece of equipment etc should be made

ex.en: The bolts met all the engineering specifications .
ex.cn: 这些螺栓符合所有的工程设计规格。

ph.cn: 产品规格；制品技术规格
设计规范；设计规格；设计任务书；设计细节

syn: n. 规格；说明书；详述：description, amplification
rm: specific(明确的) + ation → 明确说明 → 说明书

t: n. 标本，样品，样张；试样
en: a small amount or piece that is taken from something, so that it can be tested or examined

ex.en: a blood specimen
ex.cn: 血样

syn: n. 样品，[图情]样本；标本：pattern, swatch

en: a very impressive show or scene

ex.en: a multimedia dance and opera spectacle
ex.cn: 盛大的多媒体舞蹈戏剧表演

syn: n. 景象，奇观；眼镜；引人羡慕的人：scene, sight

en: very impressive

ex.en: a mountainous area with spectacular scenery
ex.cn: 景色壮丽的山区

ex.en: a spectacular success
ex.cn: 辉煌的成就

syn: adj. 壮观的，惊人的；公开展示的：tremendous, incredible

en: someone who is watching an event or game

ex.en: The match attracted over 40,000 spectators.
ex.cn: 这场比赛吸引了四万多名观众。

ph.cn: 吸引大量观众的体育运动

syn: n. 观众；旁观者：audience, onlooker
rm: spect(看) + ator → 观众； 旁观者

en: the set of bands of coloured light into which a beam of light separates when it is passed through a  prism

ex.en: the electromagnetic spectrum
ex.cn: 电磁（波）谱

syn: n. [光]光谱；频谱；范围；余象：extent, boundary, region, territory, area
rm: spect(看) + rum → 能看到光的颜色 → 光谱

en: to guess about the possible causes or effects of something, without knowing all the facts or details

ex.en: She refused to speculate.
ex.cn: 她拒绝猜测。

ex.cn: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

ex.en: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
ex.cn: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

syn: vt. 强调；在…下面划线；预告：emphasize, stress, highlight
rm: under(在…下) + line(画线) → 在…下面画线 → 画线于…之下； 强调

t: adj. 含蓄的，潜在的；在下面的
en: The underlying features of an object, event, or situation are not obvious, and it may be difficult to discover or reveal them

ex.en: To stop a problem you have to understand its underlying causes.
ex.cn: 要解决问题，你得了解其潜在原因。

ph.cn: 标的资产；基础资产；相关/指定资产

syn: adj. 潜在的；根本的；在下面的；优先的：organic, potential, fundamental, preferred, ultimate
rm: under(在…下) + lying(躺着的) → 在下面躺着的 → 在下面的

en: to gradually make someone or something less strong or effective

ex.en: economic policies that threaten to undermine the health care system
ex.cn: 可能会损害医疗保健制度的经济政策

syn: vt. 破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基：destroy, founder
rm: under(在…下) + mine(挖) → 在下面挖 → 削弱； 破坏

en: directly under another object or covered by it

ex.en: He got out of the car and looked underneath.
ex.cn: 他下车往底下看了看。

ex.en: It’s near where the railway goes underneath the road.
ex.cn: 它靠近铁路从公路下方穿过的地方。

syn: adv. 在下面；在底下：hereunder, down below
n. 下面；底部：basis, bottom, base

t: v. 同意，答应；着手做某事
en: to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it

ex.en: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
ex.cn: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

syn: vt. 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图：accept, pursue, address, try, offer

t: v. 给保险；同意赔款(海上保险)
en: if an insurance company underwrites an insurance contract, it agrees to pay for any damage or loss that happens

ex.en: The government has agreed to underwrite the project with a grant of £5 million.
ex.cn: 政府同意拨款 500 万英镑资助该项目。

t: v. 解开，拨开；败坏(名声，成果)
en: to open something that is tied, fastened or wrapped

ex.en: The screws can be undone by hand.
ex.cn: 这些螺丝可以用手拧开。

ex.en: I undid the package carefully.
ex.cn: 我小心地打开包裹。

syn: vt. 取消；解开；破坏；扰乱：destroy, recall, disorder
vi. 撤消：repeal rescission, take back

ex.en: This is undoubtedly important.
ex.cn: 这无疑是重要的。

syn: adv. 确实地，无庸置疑地：strictly, real

en: more than is reasonable, suitable, or necessary

ex.en: De Gaulle felt that America had undue influence in Europe.
ex.cn: 戴高乐感到美国在欧洲影响力过大。

ex.en: The kick should be taken without undue delay.
ex.cn: 应立即开球，不得无故拖延。

ph.cn: n. 不正当影响；[律]不正当压力
不当延误；不应有的延误

syn: adj. 过度的，过分的；不适当的；[金融]未到期的：excessive, ultra, tall, unreasonable, unhappy

en: worried or slightly afraid because you think that something bad might happen

ex.en: She eventually fell into an uneasy sleep.
ex.cn: 她终于睡着了，但睡得并不踏实。

syn: adj. 不舒服的；心神不安的；不稳定的：uncomfortable, unstable
rm: un(不) + easy(安心的) → 不安心的 → 心神不安的

en: the number of people in a particular country or area who cannot get a job

ex.en: a town where there is high unemployment
ex.cn: 高失业率城镇

syn: n. [劳经]失业；失业率；失业人数：joblessness, jobless rate
rm: un(不) + employ(雇用) + ment → 不被雇用 → 失业

t: adj. 不平坦的，不均匀的
en: not smooth, flat, or level

ex.en: She walked back carefully over the uneven ground.
ex.cn: 她小心翼翼地从凹凸不平的地面上走回来。

syn: adj. 不均匀的；不平坦的；[数]奇数的：odd, heterogeneous

en: if you unfold something that was folded, or if it unfolds, it opens out

ex.en: He unfolded the map.
ex.cn: 他展开地图。

syn: vt. 打开；呈现：crack, assume, open up
vi. 展开；显露：expand, develop

en: moving in a way that does not look graceful

ex.en: a tall ungainly teenager
ex.cn: 一个动作笨拙的高个子少年

syn: adj. 笨拙的；不雅的：clumsy, awkward
adv. 笨拙地；不雅地：ungracefully, lumpingly

t: adj. 不变的，一贯的；n. 制服
en: being the same in all its parts or among all its members

ex.en: Grade A eggs must be of uniform size.
ex.cn: A 级鸡蛋必须大小相同。

syn: adj. 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的：united, consistent, corresponding, matching, same
n. [服装]制服：monkey suit, livery
rm: uni(单一) + form(形式) → 单一形式的 → 相同的， 一致的

t: v. 使联合，统一，使相同，一致
en: if you unify two or more parts or things, or if they unify, they are combined to make a single unit

ex.en: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
ex.cn: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

ex.en: His music unifies traditional and modern themes.
ex.cn: 他的音乐结合了传统和现代的主题。

syn: vt. 统一；使相同，使一致：accord, reconcile

en: a unilateral action or decision is done by only one of the groups involved in a situation

ex.en: a unilateral declaration of independence
ex.cn: 单方面宣布独立

syn: adj. [数][植]单边的；[昆]单侧的；单方面的；单边音；（父母）单系的：one-sided

t: adj. 唯一的，独一无二的
en: being the only one of its kind

ex.en: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
ex.cn: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

ph.cn: 唯一机会；极难得的机会

syn: adj. 独特的，稀罕的；[数]唯一的，独一无二的：distinct, individual, one, sole, picturesque
rm: uni(单一) + que(有…特点的) → 唯一的， 独一无二的

t: adj. 全体的，普遍的；全球的
en: involving everyone in the world or in a particular group

ex.en: free universal healthcare
ex.cn: 免费的全民保健制度

ex.en: These stories have universal appeal.
ex.cn: 这些故事人人都喜欢。

syn: adj. 普遍的；通用的；[天]宇宙的；全世界的；全体的：widespread, entire, corporate, worldwide, current
n. 一般概念；普通性：general concept

t: adj. 未必的，不大可能的
en: not likely to happen

ex.en: Donna might be able to come tomorrow, but it’s very unlikely.
ex.cn: 唐娜明天也许能来，不过这可能性很小。

syn: adv. 未必：not necessarily

t: adj. 有德行的; 善良的
en: behaving in a very honest and moral way

ex.en: a virtuous man
ex.cn: 品行端正的男子

ex.en: Sue considered herself very virtuous because she neither drank nor smoked.
ex.cn: 休认为自己品行非常端正，因为她既不喝酒也不抽烟。

syn: adj. 善良的；有道德的；贞洁的；正直的；有效力的：straight, square, just
rm: 来自virtue(n. 德行； 美德)

en: a very small living thing that causes infectious illnesses

ex.en: children infected with the Aids virus
ex.cn: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

ex.en: a virus infection
ex.cn: 病毒感染

ph.cn: 乙型肝炎病毒；[病毒学]B型肝炎病毒

syn: n. [病毒]病毒；恶毒；毒害：vindictiveness, Vyrus

en: something that is visible can be seen

ex.en: The comet is visible to the naked eye (= can be seen without using special equipment ).
ex.cn: 这颗彗星肉眼看得见。

ex.en: Check the plant for any visible signs of disease.
ex.cn: 检查一下植物是否有患病的迹象。

syn: adj. 明显的；看得见的；现有的；可得到的：obvious, distinct, seen, evident
rm: vis(看) + ible(可…的) → 可见的， 看得见的

en: to form a picture of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
ex.cn: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

syn: vt. 形象，形象化；想像，设想：imagine, picture, think of

t: adj. 生命的；必需的；极期重要的
en: extremely important and necessary for something to succeed or exist

ex.en: The work she does is absolutely vital.
ex.cn: 她所做的工作至关重要。

ex.en: It is vital to be honest with your children.
ex.cn: 对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。

syn: adj. 至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的：dynamic, life-or-death
rm: vit(生命) + al → 事关生命的 → 生死攸关的

t: adj. 鲜艳的；活泼的，有生气的；清晰的
en: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real

ex.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
ex.cn: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

ex.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
ex.cn: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

ph.cn: 生动的描述；生动的报导
逼真模式；栩栩如生的描写

syn: adj. 生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的：telling, live, bright
rm: viv(生命) + id → 有生命力的 → 生动的

en: teaching or relating to the skills you need to do a particular job

ex.en: vocational qualifications
ex.cn: 职业资格

syn: adj. 职业的，行业的：professional, occupational
rm: 来自vocation(n. 职业)

en: a popular and fashionable style, activity, method etc

ex.en: Suntanning first came into vogue in the mid-1930s.
ex.cn: 晒黑皮肤最早流行于20世纪30年代中期。

syn: n. 时尚；流行，时髦：fashion, mode, style, popularity, prevalence
adj. 时髦的，流行的：popular, fashionable, modern, tony, going

ex.en: Her eyes were void of all expression.
ex.cn: 她的眼神一片茫然。

ph.cn: adj. 没有的，缺乏的；没有…的
空隙率；空隙分数；空隙组分

syn: adj. 空的；无效的；无人的：empty, hollow, useless, bare, vacant
n. 空虚；空间；空隙：vacuum, room, clearance, blank, emptiness

t: adj. (液体)易挥发的；(人)反复无常的
en: a volatile liquid or substance changes easily into a gas

ex.en: an increasingly volatile political situation
ex.cn: 日益动荡的政治局势

syn: adj. [化学]挥发性的；不稳定的；爆炸性的；反覆无常的：unstable, explosive

en: a mountain with a large hole at the top, through which lava(= very hot liquid rock ) is sometimes forced out

ex.en: Pompeii was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.
ex.cn: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

ph.cn: 休眠火山；睡火山，休火山

rm: vol(=will意志力) + can(会) + (n)o → 火山爆发不以人的意志为转移 → 火山

en: electrical force measured in volts

ex.en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
ex.cn: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

syn: n. [电]电压：electric tension, electrical pressure

en: the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc

ex.en: the volume of trade
ex.cn: 贸易量

ph.cn: 体积分率，体积分数；容积率

syn: n. 量；[物]体积；[计]卷；音量；大量；[图情]册：lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, bulk
adj. 大量的：massive, extensive, substantial, macro, much
rm: 和volute(a. 向上卷的)一起记

t: adj. 自愿的，志愿的；有意的
en: done willingly and without being forced

ex.en: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
ex.cn: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

syn: adj. 自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的：autonomous, willing, studied, designed, intended
rm: volunt(意愿) + ary → 出于自身意愿的 → 自愿的

en: someone who does a job willingly without being paid

ex.en: Most of the relief work was done by volunteers.
ex.cn: 大部分救援工作都由志愿人员完成。

en: to bring food or drink up from your stomach out through your mouth, because you are ill

ex.en: He had swallowed so much sea water he wanted to vomit.
ex.cn: 他呛了这么多海水，所以想吐。

ex.en: I knew I was really in trouble when I began vomiting blood.
ex.cn: 我开始吐血的时候才知道我的麻烦大了。

syn: vt. 吐出；使……呕吐：spit out, regorge
vi. [医]呕吐；吐出：shoot the cat, hork
rm: v + o(形似嘴) + mit(词根mit指“发送”) → 张嘴发送 → 呕吐

en: an official statement or receipt that is given to some­one to prove that their accounts are correct or that money has been paid

ex.en: As a basic business voucher in the economic exchange, invoice is a primitive evidence for financial accounting and an important proof for taxation check.
ex.cn: 发票作为经济交往中基本的商事凭证，是财务会计核算的原始凭证和税务稽查的重要凭据。

syn: n. 收据；[法]证人；保证人；证明者：guarantee, witness

en: a serious promise

ex.en: Jim made a vow that he would find his wife’s killer.
ex.cn: 吉姆发誓要找到杀害他妻子的凶手。

syn: n. 发誓；誓言；许愿：oath, pledge
vt. 发誓；郑重宣告：plight one's troth, cross my heart

t: adj. 粗俗的，趣味不高的，通俗的，庸俗的
en: remarks, jokes etc that are vulgar deal with sex in a very rude and offensive way

ex.en: vulgar behaviour
ex.cn: 粗俗的行为

syn: adj. 粗俗的；通俗的；本土的：popular, low, mainland, coarse, informal
n. 平民，百姓：populace, common man
rm: vulg(人们， 大众) + ar → 大众的， 通俗的

en: someone who is vulnerable can be easily harmed or hurt

ex.en: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
ex.cn: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

ex.en: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
ex.cn: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

syn: adj. 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的：sensitive, assailable
rm: vuln(受伤) + er + able(易…的) → 易受伤的

t: n. 周薪；v. 从事(战争等)
en: money you earn that is paid according to the number of hours, days, or weeks that you work

ex.en: He earns a good wage.
ex.cn: 他工资挺高。

ph.cn: 罪恶的报应，死[源自《圣经》]

syn: vi. 进行；发动；从事：progress, do
n. 工资；代价；报偿：price, expense, pay, cost

t: n. 赌注；v. 押注，打赌
en: an agreement in which you win or lose money according to the result of something such as a race

ex.en: There have been various wagers on certain candidates since the senator announced his retirement.
ex.cn: 自从那位参议员宣布引退之后，对某些候选人的打赌猜测纷纷出现。

syn: n. 赌注；赌博；赌物：stake, bet
vi. 打赌：lay, stake, make a bet

ex.en: The ragged man drags a waggon of rag fragments.
ex.cn: 那个衣衫褴褛的人拉著一货车破布碎片.

ex.en: They mounted in front of the waggon, and Abraham grew reflective.
ex.cn: 他们上了车，坐在马车的前面，亚伯拉罕开始沉思起来。
